title: AI and Digital Tool Adoption in SMEs: A Structured, Theory-Building Review and a Prospective Supply-Chain Account, 2015-2025
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: AI and Digital Tool Adoption in SMEs: A Structured, Theory-Building Review and a Prospective Supply-Chain Account, 2015-2025
detail.abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) make up roughly nine in ten firms in most economies, yet they are the slowest part of the digital supply chain. This review asks what ten years of research (2015-2025) have shown about why SMEs adopt, or do not adopt, artificial intelligence (AI) and related digital technologies, and what happens when they do. It is a structured, theory-building review, and it takes clear positions. Most of the evidence covers general SME and Industry 4.0 digitalisation; work that is strictly about supply chains is a minority, so the supply-chain account offered here is a forward-looking contribution rather than a settled finding, and AI is treated as the newest step on a longer digital-adoption path. I argue five things. First, the field borrowed its main frameworks from research on large firms, and these fit SMEs poorly. Second, explanation has built up three logics that now sit side by side (cost, capability, and managerial cognition) rather than replacing one another, and the strongest cognitive claim holds mainly in higher-income settings. Third, the account does not travel well to emerging economies, where weak institutions make barriers lock together instead of simply adding up. Fourth, pressure from regulators and large buyers is joining digital and sustainability goals, which changes the reason to adopt in the first place. Fifth, the almost uniformly positive performance findings owe at least as much to weak research designs (one-off surveys, self-reported outcomes, surviving firms only) as to the technology itself. On this base I build an SME-native account in which adoption arrives through three channels: autonomous (the owner-manager's own judgement), mimetic (copying peers), and imposed (buyer or regulator demands). All three pass through the same gate, the firm's absorptive capacity, inside a wider institutional field, and they follow the logic of improvising effectuation rather than fixed stages. The account is stated as testable propositions, ranked by the strength of the evidence behind them. This review closes with a research agenda shaped by generative AI.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述性论文梳理了2015-2025年间关于中小企业采用AI及数字技术的十年研究，指出该领域存在五大问题：理论框架移植自大企业、三种解释逻辑并存但适用性有限、新兴经济体情境被忽视、监管压力正改变采用动机、正向绩效结论存在方法论偏差。作者构建了中小企业本位的解释框架，提出三条采用渠道（自主、模仿、强制）均需通过吸收能力这一"闸门"，并遵循效果逻辑而非阶段模型。
AI.research_question: 过去十年（2015-2025）的研究揭示了中小企业为何采用或不采用人工智能及相关数字技术？以及采用后会发生什么？
AI.motivation: 中小企业占全球企业总数的90%，却是数字供应链中最缓慢的环节。现有研究主要聚焦大型企业，缺乏针对中小企业的系统性、理论建构型综述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采纳理论（来自大企业研究的框架）、三种解释逻辑（成本、能力、管理认知）、吸收能力理论、效果逻辑理论、制度理论
AI.method: 结构化、理论建构型综述（theory-building review），采取明确立场陈述，基于证据强度提出可检验命题并排序
AI.findings: 五大核心论点：(1)借用大企业框架不适用于中小企业；(2)成本、能力、管理认知三种逻辑并存，最强的认知主张仅在高收入情境成立；(3)新兴经济体中制度薄弱使障碍相互锁定；(4)监管和买方压力正将数字与可持续目标捆绑；(5)正面的绩效发现更多源于弱研究设计（横截面调查、自我报告、幸存者偏差）。作者构建了三渠道模型（自主-模仿-强制），均需通过吸收能力"闸门"，遵循效果逻辑而非阶段模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 为中小企业数字技术采纳构建了"中小企业本位"的理论框架，区别于传统的移植大企业理论路径；提出三渠道采纳模型（自主、模仿、强制）并通过吸收能力和制度场域整合；引入效果逻辑解释中小企业采纳决策过程；基于证据强度对命题进行分层排序。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者和企业管理者，中小企业数字转型不能照搬大企业经验；指出新兴经济体需要关注制度障碍的"锁定效应"；揭示现有研究的方法论偏差，避免对AI商业价值的过度乐观；提出生成式AI驱动的研究议程。

title: The Agentic Trilemma: Extending the AIconomics Framework to the Governance of Autonomous AI Agents

detail.title: The Agentic Trilemma: Extending the AIconomics Framework to the Governance of Autonomous AI Agents

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an independent practitioner-scholar. The frameworks and outcomes described in this paper were developed through direct executive engagement across enterprise AI transformation programs. No external funding was received for this research. No other conflicts of interest are declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is based on practitioner case evidence from enterprise programs in which the author held direct executive responsibility. All organizational references have been anonymized where appropriate to protect confidentiality. No human subjects research, patient data, or formal experimental methodology was employed. Formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All work was self-funded by the author as an independent practitioner-scholar contribution.

detail.abstract:
The AIconomics Trilemma formalized enterprise AI governance as the simultaneous management of transformation velocity, economic return, and regulatory responsibility-three dimensions whose joint optimization requires dedicated management discipline. That framework, like the broader enterprise AI governance literature it joined, was developed under an implicit assumption: that a human decision-maker sits between AI output and consequential action. Agentic AIautonomous systems that plan, decide, execute, and adapt without per-action human approvalbreaks this assumption directly. This paper extends the Trilemma to the agentic context, introducing Autonomy Calibration as a moderating variable that determines how rapidly governance failures in the original three dimensions can compound once human-in-loop review is removed from the decision cycle.

The paper makes four contributions beyond the original framework. First, it formalizes the Agentic
Trust Reserve, a construct describing how trust depletion — previously modeled as a human-
incident-paced phenomenon — occurs at machine velocity under autonomous agency, and
proposes the Agentic Trust Depletion Rate (ATDR) as a measurable instrument. Second, it extends
the Maturity Model introduced in prior work to flag agentic governance debt as a specific,
quantifiable liability relevant to mergers and acquisitions due diligence, where an acquired
organization’s ungoverned agent fleet transfers directly to the acquirer. Third, it introduces the
Agentic Balance Quotient, a board-reportable extension of the original Balance Quotient calibrated
to the velocity at which agentic failure modes propagate, grounded in 2026 empirical findings on
SSRN Working Paper | Lakshman (2026) | The Agentic Trilemma
Fourth, it identifies a sixth organizational archetype — the Delegator — describing organizations that delegate
Trilemma management itself to autonomous agents, creating a recursive governance problem
absent from the original five-archetype model.

The paper positions its contribution explicitly against the existing 2025–2026 agentic AI
governance literature, which has approached the problem predominantly through technical,
security, and identity-management lenses rather than through economic governance theory, and
proposes six testable propositions extending the Trilemma’s research agenda into the agentic
domain.

AI.tldr: 本文在"AIconomics三难困境"框架基础上，将其扩展至"代理型AI"（Agentic AI）场景——即AI系统无需人类逐项批准即可自主规划、决策、执行和调整。论文引入了"自主校准"作为调节变量，并提出了四项贡献：代理信任储备与代理信任消耗速率（ATDR）、代理治理债务、代理平衡商数，以及第六种组织原型"委托者"。
AI.research_question: 当人类从AI决策循环中被移除（即进入代理型AI时代），原有的企业AI治理三难困境（转型速度、经济回报、监管责任）将如何演变？
AI.motivation: 原有AI治理文献隐含假设人类决策者位于AI输出与行动之间，但代理型AI直接打破这一假设。随着自主系统在没有逐项人类审批的情况下运行，治理失败可能以机器速度级联放大，亟需新的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: AIconomics三难困境（AIconomics Trilemma）；自主校准（Autonomy Calibration）作为调节变量；代理信任储备（Agentic Trust Reserve）与代理信任消耗速率（ATDR）；代理治理债务（Agentic Governance Debt）；代理平衡商数（Agentic Balance Quotient）；六种组织原型（含新增的"委托者"Delegator）。
AI.method: 理论扩展与构建：在原有三难困境框架基础上，通过引入调节变量、提出新的理论构念和可检验命题，将治理框架从"人类在环"延伸至"自主代理"场景。部分命题参考2026年实证发现。
AI.findings: 1) 信任消耗在代理型AI下以机器速度而非人际速度发生；2) 未受治理的代理型AI资产在并购中会作为负债转移，形成可量化的治理债务；3) 代理型故障模式的传播速度需要新的平衡度量指标；4) 存在一种将治理本身委托给AI代理的"委托者"组织，引发递归治理问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经济治理理论扩展至代理型AI领域，填补了现有文献偏重技术、安全和身份管理视角而缺乏经济学治理理论的空白；提出ATDR、代理治理债务等可测量构念，为后续实证研究提供基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业董事会和并购尽职调查提供了可报告的治理指标（代理平衡商数、代理治理债务）；识别了"委托者"这一治理陷阱，提醒企业注意治理本身被外包给AI的递归风险。

title: Data-Driven Financial Decision Making in Manufacturing Organizations and its Impact on Macroeconomics: A Multi-industry Analysis

detail.title: Data-Driven Financial Decision Making in Manufacturing Organizations and its Impact on Macroeconomics: A Multi-industry Analysis
detail.abstract:
Purpose 
This study investigates how data-driven decision-making (DDDM) frameworks shape financial outcomes across manufacturing sub-sectors and examines their aggregated implications for macroeconomic performance. It tests the joint effects of data infrastructure, analytical capability, and organizational culture on return on investment (ROI), operating margin, and cost reduction in 412 manufacturing firms across seven industries, and links micro-level gains to productivity, output, and employment at the macro level.
Method 
A sequential explanatory mixed-methods design was adopted. Quantitative data were obtained through a structured online survey (N = 412) and analyzed using descriptive statistics, Pearson correlations, and partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) in SmartPLS 4. Qualitative depth was added through 18 semi-structured interviews with CFOs and controllers, coded thematically in NVivo 14. Macroeconomic linkages were derived using sectoral value-added weights from national accounts. 
Findings
 Data-driven maturity (DDM) is a strong, positive predictor of financial performance (beta = 0.63, p < .001), explaining 58% of its variance. Analytical capability (beta = 0.52) is the dominant antecedent of DDDM, followed by data infrastructure (beta = 0.41) and organizational culture (beta = 0.29). Pharmaceuticals and electronics lead adoption; textiles and steel lag. Simulated aggregation suggests a 1-point improvement in DDM maturity is associated with a 0.7-1.1 percentage-point uplift in manufacturing-sector total factor productivity (TFP). 
Implications 
Manufacturing CFOs should treat analytical capability as a strategic asset rather than an IT cost. Policymakers can stimulate macroeconomic growth by subsidizing analytics up-skilling and SME BI adoption. Targeted investment produces measurable financial gains within 18-24 months and contributes to industrial productivity, export competitiveness, and employment quality.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于412家制造企业数据，发现数据驱动成熟度（DDM）对财务绩效有强预测作用（β=0.63），其中分析能力是最关键的前因变量；微观层面的DDM提升与宏观层面的全要素生产率增长（0.7-1.1个百分点）相关联。
AI.research_question: 数据驱动决策框架如何塑造制造业子行业的财务绩效？微观层面的DDDM收益如何聚合影响宏观经济表现？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对DDDM微观财务收益与宏观经济影响之间联动关系的系统检验，尤其是跨制造业子行业的比较分析不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据驱动决策理论、资源基础观（RBV）、动态能力理论、全要素生产率理论
AI.method: 顺序解释性混合方法：定量阶段（N=412结构化调查，PLS-SEM分析）+ 定性阶段（18位CFO/财务总监半结构化访谈，主题编码）+ 宏观层面基于行业增加值权重进行聚合估算
AI.findings: DDM对财务绩效有强正向预测作用（β=0.63，解释58%方差）；分析能力（β=0.52）是最重要的DDDM前因，其次为数据基础设施（β=0.41）和组织文化（β=0.29）；制药和电子行业领先，钢铁和纺织滞后；DDM每提升1点，制造业全要素生产率提升0.7-1.1个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了从微观DDDM前因→财务绩效→宏观TFP的跨层级理论框架，识别了分析能力作为DDDM关键驱动因素的独特作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议制造企业CFO将分析能力视为战略资产而非IT成本；建议政策制定者通过补贴分析技能培训和中小企业BI采纳来刺激宏观经济增长；指出定向投资可在18-24个月内产生可量化的财务收益。

title: Retailer-supplier Coordination of Pricing and Delivery Ratings Availability Decisions in Online Marketplaces
affiliations: Tianjin University of Technology, University of South Carolina and Lingnan University

detail.title: Retailer-supplier Coordination of Pricing and Delivery Ratings Availability Decisions in Online Marketplaces

declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the General Research Fund (GRF) of the Hong Kong Research Grants Council under Research Project No. LU13500822.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Paper to appear in Production and Operations Management with DOI 10.1177/10591478261460106

detail.abstract: Businesses selling in online marketplaces often enhance their offerings with short delivery times, but short delivery times typically result in low delivery-time conformance--the probability of on-time delivery, often published in the form of delivery-time ratings. As a result, short delivery times may simultaneously enhance and undermine the perceived value of online offerings. Marketplace operators can moderate this trade-off between delivery time and delivery-time conformance by making delivery-time ratings available or not. We (i) characterize the conditions for the emergence of the trade-off, (ii) identify the mechanisms that may allow managers to preempt the trade-off, and (iii) outline the conditions under which it is profitable for online retailers to solicit and publish delivery-time ratings. We model and compare alternative scenarios for the supply chain of a retailer and a supplier that offer a product in an online marketplace and determine prices and promised delivery times. We develop analytic models and support them with data provided by the Cainiao's logistic network. Differences of outcomes across scenarios reveal that the aforementioned trade-off can be preempted by simultaneously making delivery-time ratings available and coordinating the prices and promised delivery times. Disclosure of ratings can reduce delivery times but is profitable only if the disclosure increases system-wide value. Confirming this finding, analyses of Cainiao's data indicate that the availability of delivery-time ratings can reduce the average promised delivery time by 3.912 hours (or 7.4%). Several extensions show that our results hold for different contexts, including both drop-shipping and retailer-managed fulfillment models. In conclusion, our results suggest when and how supply chains in online marketplaces can use pricing to make the offering of shorter delivery times a dominant strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在线市场中短交货时间与准时交付率之间的权衡，发现同时公开交货时间评级并协调价格与承诺交货时间可以化解这一矛盾，但公开评级仅在增加系统总价值时才有盈利性。
AI.research_question: 在线市场中，短交货时间与交货时间符合率之间的权衡如何产生？市场运营者如何通过公开交货时间评级来调节这一权衡？
AI.motivation: 短交货时间虽能提升在线产品的感知价值，但通常会导致准时交付率（交货时间符合率）降低，从而产生一种权衡。市场运营者可以通过是否公开交货时间评级来调节这一矛盾，但缺乏系统的理论指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链协调理论、信号理论、定价与时间承诺的联合决策模型。
AI.method: 分析模型（解析建模）结合实证数据（来自菜鸟物流网络的真实数据）进行验证。
AI.findings: (1) 短交货时间与准时交付率之间存在内在权衡；(2) 同时公开交货时间评级并协调价格与承诺交货时间可以化解这一权衡；(3) 公开评级可缩短交货时间（菜鸟数据显示平均缩短3.912小时，即7.4%），但仅在增加系统总价值时才有盈利性；(4) 上述结论在代发货和零售商管理履约模型下均成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统建模了短交货时间与交货时间符合率之间的权衡机制，提出了通过评级披露与定价协调来化解该权衡的理论路径，拓展了在线市场供应链协调理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在线零售商提供了何时及如何公开交货时间评级的决策指南，表明公开评级并非总是有利，需结合系统总价值进行判断；菜鸟数据验证了公开评级可有效缩短交货时间。

title: The Fallible Collaborator: Reconciling Human Tolerance of AI Errors versus Human Errors in Decision-making Systems

detail.title: The Fallible Collaborator: Reconciling Human Tolerance of AI Errors versus Human Errors in Decision-making Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is professionally employed as a Clinical Trial Manager in the biotechnology industry. This paper is an independent theoretical review and does not represent the views, policies, or commercial interests of the author's employer. The author declares no relevant financial or non-financial competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This work is a theoretical review and synthesis of previously published, publicly available academic literature. As the research does not involve primary data collection from human or animal subjects, ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was conducted entirely independently.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This manuscript is a literature review and conceptual analysis. It does not report the results of a clinical trial or any health-related intervention on human participants.

detail.abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into complex decision-making environments, understanding human tolerance of algorithmic errors remains a critical challenge. This paper synthesizes a purposefully selected sample of 10 recent (2024-2025) academic works to evaluate the hypothesis that humans judge AI errors more harshly than human errors due to a mismatched expectation of deterministic, calculator-like perfection. The analysis reveals a duality in human-AI interaction: while users frequently exhibit "single-error shock" and acute algorithm aversion when AI violates the perfect automation schema, they concurrently fall prey to automation bias, over-trusting confident AI outputs. Crucially, algorithm aversion is heavily mediated by status quo bias; when AI is framed as the conventional standard, intolerance diminishes. We propose a refined conceptual model advocating for a paradigm shift from treating AI as an infallible tool subject to flawed human oversight, toward integrating it as a fallible collaborator. Optimizing this relationship in highstakes domains requires structural task delegation and explicit communication of the algorithm's metacognitive uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文综合分析了10篇近期（2024-2025）学术文献，探讨人类对AI错误的容忍度问题。研究发现人类对AI错误比对人类错误更严厉，源于对AI完美性的错误预期。提出应将AI从"无谬工具"重新定位为"可犯错协作者"，并通过任务结构性委派和不确定性沟通来优化人机关系。
AI.research_question: 人类对算法错误的容忍度如何？为什么人类对AI错误的评判比人类自身错误更严厉？
AI.motivation: 随着AI越来越多地被整合到复杂决策环境中，理解人类对算法错误的容忍度成为一个关键挑战。现有研究对此问题尚缺乏系统性的综合分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 完美自动化图式（perfect automation schema）、算法厌恶（algorithm aversion）、自动化偏见（automation bias）、现状偏差（status quo bias）
AI.method: 对10篇2024-2025年发表的学术文献进行有目的性抽样和综合合成分析。
AI.findings: 1. 用户表现出"单次错误冲击"和强烈的算法厌恶；2. 用户同时陷入自动化偏见，过度信任自信的AI输出；3. 算法厌恶受到现状偏差的强烈调节，当AI被框定为常规标准时，不宽容度降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个 refined conceptual model，倡导从将AI视为"无谬工具"的范式转向将AI视为"可犯错协作者"。
AI.practical_contributions: 在高风险领域优化人机关系需要结构性任务委派和明确传达算法的元认知不确定性。

title: AI-Driven Real Estate Accounting for Cost-Effective Property Purchasing: Evidence and Framework from the Bangladesh Context

detail.title: AI-Driven Real Estate Accounting for Cost-Effective Property Purchasing: Evidence and Framework from the Bangladesh Context
detail.abstract: The real estate sector in Bangladesh contributes approximately 7.8 percent of gross domestic product and remains the single largest store of household wealth, yet property purchasing decisions are routinely undermined by opaque pricing, fragmented land records, informal cash transactions, and weak accounting disclosures by developers. This paper develops and empirically evaluates an Artificial Intelligence (AI)-driven real estate accounting framework that integrates machine learning-based valuation, natural language processing of cadastral and contractual documents, blockchain-anchored audit trails, and Activity-Based Costing (ABC) to support cost-effective property purchasing in Bangladesh. Drawing on a mixed-methods design that combines a structured survey of 412 buyers and 38 developers across Dhaka, Chattogram and Sylhet (2022-2025), a hedonic dataset of 11,684 apartment transactions, and 22 expert interviews, we (i) quantify the hidden cost wedge in apartment purchases, (ii) train and benchmark gradient-boosting and deep-learning valuation models against developer asking prices, and (iii) evaluate willingnessto-adopt AI-augmented accounting disclosures. The proposed XGBoost-LSTM hybrid achieves a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 6.4 percent against registered deed values, outperforming hedonic OLS (14.1 percent) and developer brochure pricing (21.7 percent overstatement on average). Structural equation modelling shows that perceived transparency (β = 0.41, p < 0.001) and regulatory trust (β = 0.29, p < 0.001) significantly mediate the relationship between AI-driven disclosure and intention to purchase. We conclude with a four-layer reference architecture, policy implications for RAJUK, the National Board of Revenue and the Bangladesh Bank, and a research agenda spanning explainable AI, IFRS 15/16 alignment and Sharia-compliant property finance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对孟加拉国房地产市场中定价不透明、土地记录碎片化、现金交易不规范及开发商信息披露薄弱等问题，构建并实证评估了一个集成了机器学习估值、自然语言处理、区块链审计追踪和作业成本法的人工智能房地产会计框架。研究发现，提出的XGBoost-LSTM混合模型在估值精度上大幅优于传统方法，且感知透明度与监管信任显著中介了AI驱动披露与购买意愿之间的关系。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和评估一个AI驱动的房地产会计框架，以支持孟加拉国购房者实现成本有效的房产购买决策？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国房地产行业虽然对GDP贡献约7.8%且是家庭财富的最大储存形式，但定价不透明、土地记录碎片化、现金交易不规范及开发商信息披露薄弱等问题严重损害了购房决策的效率与公平性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了机器学习估值理论、自然语言处理（文档分析）、区块链审计追踪技术、作业成本法（ABC），以及通过结构方程模型检验的感知透明度与监管信任中介机制。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：412名购房者与38家开发商的结构化调查（2022-2025，覆盖达卡、吉大港、锡尔赫特）、11,684笔公寓交易的享乐价格数据集、22场专家访谈；采用XGBoost-LSTM混合模型进行估值，以结构方程模型检验中介效应。
AI.findings: (1) XGBoost-LSTM混合模型的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）为6.4%，优于享乐OLS模型的14.1%和开发商宣传册定价的平均高估21.7%；(2) 感知透明度（β=0.41, p<0.001）和监管信任（β=0.29, p<0.001）显著中介了AI驱动披露与购买意愿的关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI驱动的会计信息披露机制引入房地产购买决策理论，通过结构方程模型实证验证了感知透明度与监管信任的中介作用，拓展了技术采纳与信息披露在房地产领域的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了四层参考架构；为RAJUK、国家税务局和孟加拉国银行提供了政策建议；规划了可解释AI、IFRS 15/16对齐及伊斯兰金融合规等研究方向，为新兴市场房地产数字化转型提供了实践路径。

title: Cognitive Horsepower: A Working Metric for Constraint-Adjusted Human-Agent Labor in the Inference Economy

detail.title: Cognitive Horsepower: A Working Metric for Constraint-Adjusted Human-Agent Labor in the Inference Economy
detail.abstract: Generative AI has sharply reduced the cost of producing fluent language, but it has not eliminated the cost of approving, evidencing, and governing language in high-stakes organizations. In regulated communications, financial disclosure, medical affairs, public affairs, and other claims-governed settings, the scarce resource is not raw content volume; it is verified cognitive work that preserves approved meaning under evidence, policy, and liability constraints. This paper introduces Cognitive Horsepower (cHP) as a proposed operational metric for measuring constraint-adjusted human-agent labor. The framework defines cognitive work as the transformation of source information into a lower-load, higher-structure output subject to semantic-fidelity constraints, and defines cHP as the rate at which such work is completed. To avoid conflating generation speed with useful enterprise productivity, the paper distinguishes raw cHP, verified cHP, and constrained cHP. It then formalizes review debt through an expected-cost model in which AI labor cost includes inference cost, verification cost, semantic-drift probability, and liability magnitude. The contribution is not an empirically validated universal standard. Rather, it is a domain-bounded measurement framework and validation protocol intended to support future empirical benchmarking of humans, AI agents, and human-agent teams on regulated knowledge-work tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"认知马力"(cHP)作为衡量受约束的人机协作劳动的运营指标，区分原始cHP、验证cHP和约束cHP，并通过预期成本模型形式化"审查债务"，为受监管知识工作领域提供测量框架和验证协议。
AI.research_question: 在高风险组织中，当生成式AI大幅降低语言流畅度成本后，如何量化衡量受证据、政策和责任约束的人机协作认知劳动？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI虽降低了内容生成成本，但在受监管领域（如金融披露、医疗事务等），稀缺资源并非原始内容量，而是经过验证的、在约束条件下保持语义保真度的认知工作。缺乏衡量这种"约束调整后劳动"的运营指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知工作定义为"将源信息转化为低负载、高结构输出并受语义保真度约束"的过程；cHP作为完成该工作的速率指标；区分原始cHP（生成速度）、验证cHP（生成+验证）、约束cHP（受语义漂移和责任约束后的有效产出）；审查债务（Review Debt）的期望成本模型。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与形式化建模——提出cHP操作化定义与审查债务的预期成本模型（包含推理成本、验证成本、语义漂移概率和责任大小四个参数），提出未来实证验证的协议框架。
AI.findings: 本文是概念性贡献而非实证性验证，主要产出为：1) cHP作为约束调整后劳动速率的运营指标；2) 原始/验证/约束三层cHP区分；3) 审查债务的期望成本形式化模型；4) 面向受监管知识工作任务的实证验证协议。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"认知马力"(cHP)这一新概念，将认知劳动量化为速率指标；2) 形式化"审查债务"概念，揭示AI生成速度与企业生产力之间的差距；3) 为衡量人机团队在受监管领域中的有效产出提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为企业评估AI在受监管场景中的实际生产力提供操作化指标，避免将生成速度等同于有用产出；2) 为金融机构、医疗、公共事务等领域的人机协作绩效评估提供可量化的测量框架；3) 为未来跨组织、跨任务的实证比较研究提供标准化验证协议。

publicationDetails.detailsText: In: Cappello M. (ed.), News media, pluralism and journalism in the digital age, IRIS, European Audiovisual Observatory, Strasbourg, December 2025

detail.abstract:
For years, member states have adopted different approaches to safeguarding editorial freedom and media independence. Recent evidence provided by the Media Pluralism Monitor (MPM),174 Rule of Law Reports175 from the European Commission, and studies on media plurality and diversity online176 all point to a worrying trend. Persistent structural issues continue to undermine media freedom in many member states, including increasing interference in editorial decisions from state actors, weak or politically dependent media regulators and opaque systems for allocating public funds to media outlets. The lack of a unified, media-specific regulatory framework has contributed to regulatory fragmentation across member states, which may, in turn, affect both the internal market and the quality of media services available to citizens and businesses.
In recent years, the European Commission has come to recognise the gravity of the threat media capture poses to European democracy and the rule of law across the EU. This recognition has underlined the urgent need for stronger, EU-level measures to address issues such as concentration of media ownership and erosion of editorial independence. In response to these challenges, the European Union adopted the European Media Freedom Act (EMFA).

AI.tldr: 欧盟因成员国媒体自由持续恶化、监管碎片化等问题，出台了《欧洲媒体自由法案》(EMFA)以应对媒体所有权集中和编辑独立性侵蚀等挑战。
AI.research_question: 欧盟如何通过《欧洲媒体自由法案》应对成员国媒体自由受损、监管碎片化以及媒体所有权集中等问题？
AI.motivation: 成员国媒体自由持续恶化，国家行为体干预编辑决策、媒体监管机构软弱或政治依附、公共资金分配不透明等结构性问题长期存在，且缺乏统一的媒体监管框架，威胁欧洲民主与法治。
AI.theoretical_framework: 媒体自由与独立性理论、媒体所有权集中理论、欧盟监管一体化理论
AI.method: 政策分析，结合媒体多元性监测(MPM)、欧盟委员会法治报告等实证证据
AI.findings: 欧盟意识到媒体俘获对民主与法治的严重威胁，因此通过EMFA这一欧盟层面的措施来应对媒体所有权集中和编辑独立性侵蚀问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 为媒体自由与监管一体化研究提供了欧盟层面的政策响应案例，丰富了关于媒体俘获与民主治理关系的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟成员国应对媒体自由威胁提供了统一的法律框架，有助于减少监管碎片化、保护编辑独立性，并提升媒体服务质量和内部市场运作。

title: Secondary Metallurgy Digital Readiness Index (SMDRI) for Integrated Steel Plants: A Novel Five-Level Framework for Assessing Digital Transformation, Process Stability, Steel Cleanliness and Autonomous Metallurgical Operations

detail.title: Secondary Metallurgy Digital Readiness Index (SMDRI) for Integrated Steel Plants: A Novel Five-Level Framework for Assessing Digital Transformation, Process Stability, Steel Cleanliness and Autonomous Metallurgical Operations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This research was conducted independently to advance operational and digital methodologies within metallurgical engineering.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve any human participants, clinical trials, or animal experiments. The framework is entirely based on mathematical modelling, industrial process simulations, and automated digital system metrics.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was carried out as part of an independent academic and professional pursuit in operational efficiency.

detail.abstract:
The steel industry is in a state of transformation with the advent of Industry 4.0, Artificial Intelligence, IIoT, Cyber Physical Systems, Cloud Computing, Digital Twins and Big Data. Whereas there has been great success in the automation of blast furnaces and rolling mills, as well as predictive maintenance, the secondary metallurgy area remains underdeveloped from a digital maturity perspective (1). Secondary metallurgy is crucial in the production of high-quality steels because it ensures the cleanliness of steel, controllability of inclusions, uniformity of temperature, yield of alloys, and quality of the final product (2). The importance of secondary metallurgy units like LF, RH degasser, Vacuum Degassing System, CAS-OB, Ladle Treatment Stations can be easily gauged by the fact that these units directly contribute to all these factors (2).

In addition to lack of clear direction, there is a dire lack of a benchmarkable maturity model for assessing digital transformation readiness within secondary metallurgy in the industry as well as academia (3). Most Industry 4.0 maturity models currently assess the entire manufacturing entity from a macro level and they completely disregard the specific metallurgical properties required for secondary steelmaking (4). Hence, steel plants lack the basis to gauge their digital maturity levels, to identify the correct technology to invest in and also to formulate future roadmaps for achieving autonomous secondary metallurgy operations (5).

In order to address the problem of an appropriate industry wide and academic evaluation framework for secondary metallurgy the Secondary Metallurgy Digital Readiness Index (SMDRI) has been developed in this study for integrated steel plants. The SMDRI has been designed with 5 progressively mature levels, namely Basic Operation, Process Control, Digital Monitoring, Predictive Metallurgy and Autonomous Secondary Metallurgy. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to operations, technology and quality are integrated including LF Power Consumption, Electrode Consumption, RH vacuum efficiency, Inclusion index, steel cleanliness index, heat turnaround time, data integration ratio, and utilization of predictive analytics (6).

A quantitative methodology has also been developed to estimate the digital maturity level for each steel plant on a scale from 0-100. The SMDRI's conceptual architecture has been formulated linking automation, operational excellence, data availability, predictive capabilities and autonomous decision making in secondary metallurgy operations. The potential benefits of Digital Twins, Machine Learning algorithms and advanced process analytics are also examined (7).

The current paper proposes a framework as a step toward Steel Industry 5.0. The provided framework is anticipated to assist in developing an industry wide and academical reference for measuring digital maturity in the scope of secondary metallurgy to researchers and practitioners. It may support comparative studies, prioritize investments, initiate enhancement projects, evaluate sustainability issues and future plans for integrated steel plants.

AI.tldr: 本文针对钢铁行业二次冶金领域数字化成熟度评估缺失的问题，开发了二次冶金数字化就绪指数（SMDRI），提出了包含5个成熟度等级和关键绩效指标的评估框架，旨在为钢铁企业实现自主化二次冶金运营提供基准和路线图。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个专门针对钢铁行业二次冶金领域的数字化成熟度评估框架，以衡量和指导企业数字化转型？
AI.motivation: 二次冶金是生产高品质钢材的关键环节，但其数字化成熟度远低于高炉和轧机等环节；现有工业4.0成熟度模型从宏观层面评估整个制造实体，忽视了二次冶金特有的冶金特性需求，导致钢铁企业缺乏评估自身数字化水平、识别投资方向和制定发展路线图的依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字化成熟度模型理论、工业4.0/5.0转型框架、二次冶金工艺理论
AI.method: 定量方法论：开发了0-100分的数字化成熟度评分体系；构建了SMDRI概念架构，链接自动化、运营卓越、数据可用性、预测能力和自主决策；整合了与运营、技术和质量相关的关键绩效指标（KPIs）。
AI.findings: 提出了SMDRI框架，包含5个渐进成熟度层级（基础操作、过程控制、数字监控、预测冶金、自主二次冶金）；设计了涵盖LF电耗、电极消耗、RH真空效率、夹杂物指数、钢水洁净度指数、周转时间、数据集成率、预测分析利用率等KPIs；探索了数字孪生、机器学习算法和先进过程分析的潜在效益。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了二次冶金领域数字化成熟度评估的理论空白，将工业4.0成熟度模型从宏观层面细化到特定冶金工艺领域，提出了专门针对二次冶金的评估维度与指标体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为钢铁企业提供了衡量二次冶金数字化成熟度的行业参考基准，帮助企业识别合适的投资技术、制定数字化转型路线图、开展比较研究、优先安排改进项目、评估可持续性问题，并推动向钢铁工业5.0迈进。

title: Mandate: Underwriting, Monitoring and Governing AI Agents that Transact and Borrow A Credit-Risk and Accountability Workflow for Agentic Commerce

detail.title: Mandate: Underwriting, Monitoring and Governing AI Agents that Transact and Borrow A Credit-Risk and Accountability Workflow for Agentic Commerce
detail.abstract:
Autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents have begun to transact and, in short order, will borrow on behalf of consumers and businesses. The payment industry has moved quickly to build the rails for this: identity, authorisation and settlement standards are emerging from the card networks and the protocol consortia-Google and Coinbase's Agent Payments Protocol (AP2), the Stripe-OpenAI Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP), Coinbase's x402, and the card networks' agentic tokens (Mastercard Agent Pay, Visa Intelligent Commerce). These rails settle who the agent is and that a payment may be made. They do not decide how much credit to extend, whether it is affordable, whether the agent has been compromised or has drifted from its principal's intent, or who is accountable when something goes wrong. Those are credit risk and conduct questions. 

This paper sets out MANDATE, an end-to-end decision workflow that treats an agent as a bounded delegate operating under a mandate envelope. The workflow combines: (i) the mandate envelope as the unit of bounded, time-boxed, revocable authority; (ii) a three-layer dynamic limit that tightens under uncertainty rather than refreshing periodically; (iii) a credit-grounded agent trust score; (iv) an online behavioural change-point monitor - a Mahalanobis drift statistic on a streaming baseline, winsorised and fed to a Page-Hinkley test-paired with a graduated, reversible circuit breaker; (v) a hash-chained provenance ledger; and (vi) a transparent liability-attribution matrix. A conformance gap-map scores a deploying firm's readiness control-by-control, and a thin adapter layer maps each standardised rail onto the same engine. On an illustrative synthetic stream into which a behavioural compromise is injected-with every transaction kept below the static per-transaction cap-the monitor detects the regime change two transactions after onset and the breaker revokes the mandate shortly afterward, while the ledger detects a retrospective tamper. 

All figures and thresholds are illustrative and configurable. The contribution is a coherent, auditable workflow that closes the credit-and-conduct gap the payment rails leave open.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MANDATE框架，一个针对AI代理在支付场景中的端到端决策工作流，弥补现有支付轨道在信用和操守方面的空白。该工作流将AI代理视为在"授权信封"约束下的有限委托代理，结合动态限额、信任评分、行为漂移检测、哈希链溯源账本和透明责任分配矩阵，实现对代理行为的实时监控与风险管控。
AI.research_question: 当AI代理代表消费者和企业进行借贷和支付时，如何设计一个端到端的决策工作流来管理信用风险和操守风险？
AI.motivation: 现有的支付轨道（如卡组织、协议联盟）已经解决了代理的身份识别、授权和结算问题，但没有解决"借多少、是否可负担、代理是否被攻破或偏离委托人意图、出事谁负责"等信用和操守问题。随着AI代理即将大规模参与借贷活动，这一空白亟需填补。
AI.theoretical_framework: "有限委托代理"（bounded delegate）理论：将AI代理视为在"授权信封"（mandate envelope）约束下运营的有限、有时限、可撤销的委托实体。结合动态限额理论、在线变更点检测（Page-Hinkley检验）、马氏距离漂移统计量等统计学方法。
AI.method: 提出MANDATE框架，包含六个核心组件：(1)授权信封；(2)三层动态限额；(3)基于信用的代理信任评分；(4)在线行为变更点监测器（马氏距离漂移统计量+Page-Hinkley检验+可逆断路器）；(5)哈希链溯源账本；(6)透明责任分配矩阵。通过合成数据流注入行为入侵进行验证。
AI.findings: 在合成数据流中，当注入行为入侵（每笔交易均低于静态单笔限额）时，监测器在入侵发生两笔交易后检测到状态变化，断路器随后撤销授权，同时哈希链账本检测到历史篡改。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"有限委托代理"框架用于AI代理治理，将授权管理从静态限额发展为动态、可撤销、可追溯的闭环管控体系。将行为变更点检测技术应用于AI代理操守监控。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可落地的端到端工作流，包含合规差距映射表（conformance gap-map）用于评估企业就绪度，以及薄适配层（adapter layer）将各标准化支付轨道接入同一引擎。为支付行业在AI代理借贷场景下的风险管控提供了完整解决方案。

title: The Business of Being Barbie… . A Case Study of an Ambidextrous Intellectual Property Protection Strategy *
affiliations: and Mackenzie Presbyterian University

detail.title: The Business of Being Barbie… . A Case Study of an Ambidextrous Intellectual Property Protection Strategy *

declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded in part (30%) by the National Science Center in Poland under the grant “Brand Abuse: Brand as a New Personal Interest under the Polish Civil Code against an EU and US Backdrop” (grant holder: Marlena Maria Jankowska-Augustyn, No. 2021/43/B/HS5/01156). For the purposes of Open Access, the author has applied a CC-BY license to any Author Accepted Manuscript (AAM) version arising from this submission. The research was also co-financed The research activities were also co-financed (70%) by the funds granted under the Research Excellence Initiative of the University of Silesia in Katowice.

detail.abstract: This paper examines Mattel's intellectual property strategy for Barbie through a dual SWOT framework, demonstrating how the brand operates simultaneously as both a defensive fortress and an offensive growth engine. Drawing on legal records, financial disclosures and market data, the study demonstrates that Barbie's intellectual property portfolio exemplifies an "ambidextrous strategy"-one that protects brand integrity through rigorous enforcement while expanding across film, fashion, gaming and digital ecosystems through strategic licensing and partnerships. The weighted SWOT analysis shows that Barbie's defensive strengths significantly outweigh external threats, thereby creating a formidable enforcement infrastructure capable of countering counterfeiters, AI-driven look-alikes and jurisdictional challenges. On the offensive side, Barbie’s monetization capabilities align closely with expansion opportunities, enabling the brand to scale into new markets while managing exposure risks through curated growth. These parallel strategies are not mutually exclusive but symbiotic: enforcement actions against counterfeiters preserve consumer trust, which in turn enables luxury collaborations, while trade dress protection enhances the appeal of IP extensions such as feature films and video games. The paper contributes to intellectual property scholarship by demonstrating that SWOT analysis can serve as a practical framework for shaping and assessing IP strategy and to business strategy literature by illustrating how established brands maintain market dominance through calibrated, complementary defensive and offensive IP management in competitive, fast-changing industries.

AI.tldr: 本文通过双重SWOT框架分析美泰公司芭比娃娃的知识产权战略，揭示了其如何同时作为防御堡垒和进攻增长引擎运作。研究表明，芭比的知识产权组合体现了"双元战略"：一边通过严格执法维护品牌完整性，一边通过战略许可和合作向电影、时尚、游戏及数字生态扩张。防御与进攻策略相辅相成，共同支撑品牌在快速变化行业中的市场主导地位。
AI.research_question: 美泰公司如何通过知识产权战略使芭比品牌同时实现防御性保护与进攻性增长？
AI.motivation: 成熟品牌在快速变化的竞争环境中面临双重挑战：既要防范侵权、仿冒等威胁，又要拓展新市场实现增长。现有研究缺乏整合分析这两种战略的框架，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双重SWOT分析框架；双元战略（ambidextrous strategy）理论；知识产权战略的防御-进攻双元视角。
AI.method: 基于法律记录、财务披露和市场数据的案例研究；加权SWOT分析；定性分析结合定量佐证。
AI.findings: （1）防御方面，芭比的防御优势显著超过外部威胁，形成了强大的执法基础设施，能有效应对仿冒品、AI驱动的模仿品和司法管辖权挑战；（2）进攻方面，芭比的变现能力与扩张机会高度匹配，通过策展式增长进入新市场；（3）防御与进攻策略相互共生：反仿冒执法保护消费者信任从而支撑奢侈合作，商业外观保护增强IP延伸（如电影、游戏）的吸引力。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明SWOT分析可以作为制定和评估知识产权战略的实用框架；为商业战略文献提供了成熟品牌通过协调互补的防御和进攻型IP管理维持市场主导地位的实证案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为品牌管理者提供了在竞争激烈、快速变化的行业中如何同时运用防御性和进攻性知识产权策略的实践指南；展示了如何通过策略性许可与合作实现品牌IP的系统性扩张。

title: UCP-Compatible Agent-Authorized Payments via Closed-Loop Wallet Settlement

detail.title: UCP-Compatible Agent-Authorized Payments via Closed-Loop Wallet Settlement
detail.abstract:
This paper describes a model for executing the payment leg of an agent-driven commerce flow as a wallet-to-wallet transfer within a single closed-loop wallet operator. The model is positioned as a wallet-native settlement implementation that can sit behind a checkout/payment step in a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) commerce journey; it is not a replacement for UCP. UCP governs the broader interaction between agents, merchants, and commerce systems - discovery, catalog, cart, checkout, order state, and post-purchase. This paper focuses only on what happens after a UCP-compatible checkout intent has been formed: the payment is authorized through an AP2-style mandate (or any equivalent user-authorization protocol that yields a verifiable, scoped mandate) and is then executed as a customer-to-customer wallet transfer.

We separate an agent that constructs or receives a UCP-compatible checkout intent, an authorization layer that converts a user-signed mandate into a wallet request, and a wallet system that is the sole execution authority for fund movement. We map each step to a concrete wallet API call, describe the trust boundaries and failure modes implied by the wallet state machine, and document the limitations of a closed-loop approach.

The core contribution is a single, narrow reinterpretation: the wallet customer-to-customer transfer is treated as the execution of authorized commercial intent - the settlement leg of a UCP checkout/payment intent - rather than as a peer payment. The model is UCP-compatible at the payment step and AP2-compatible at the authorization step; it depends on neither, and AP2 (or an equivalent scheme) can sit upstream as the source of mandates while the wallet-side execution discipline remains unchanged. This is a design/position paper: no implementation or empirical evaluation is presented.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个在封闭式钱包运营商内部，通过钱包间转账执行智能体驱动商业流程中支付结算环节的模型。该模型将钱包客户间转账重新定义为授权商业意图的执行（即UCP结账/支付意图的结算环节），而非点对点支付。论文为设计/立场论文，无实施或实证评估。
AI.research_question: 如何在一个封闭式钱包系统中，将智能体驱动的电商支付结算环节设计为钱包间转账，并使其与UCP（通用商务协议）和AP2授权协议兼容？
AI.motivation: 随着智能体（agent）在电商领域的普及，需要一种标准化的支付结算模型，使封闭式钱包系统能作为UCP协议中结账/支付步骤的后端结算层，同时保持与AP2等用户授权协议的兼容性。
AI.theoretical_framework: UCP（通用商务协议）框架、AP2授权协议、钱包状态机理论、信任边界与故障模式分析
AI.method: 设计研究/立场论文。通过概念建模，将支付流程分解为：构建UCP结账意图的智能体、将用户签署授权转换为钱包请求的授权层、作为唯一资金转移执行主体的钱包系统。将每一步映射到具体钱包API调用，描述信任边界和故障模式。
AI.findings: 提出了一个钱包原生结算模型，将钱包客户间转账重新定义为授权商业意图的执行（结算环节）而非点对点支付。该模型在支付步骤上与UCP兼容，在授权步骤上与AP2兼容，但不依赖两者。AP2或等效方案可作为授权来源，钱包端执行纪律保持不变。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个单一、狭窄的概念重新诠释：将钱包客户间转账视为授权商业意图的执行——UCP结账/支付意图的结算环节，而非点对点支付。明确了智能体、授权层和钱包系统之间的职责分离与信任边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为封闭式钱包运营商提供了与UCP兼容的结算实现模型，描述了具体的API调用映射和故障模式，指出了封闭式方案的局限性。

title: Beyond the Boundary: Structure, Signal, and Robustness in Failed Auction Reversion at Daily Value Area Extremes

detail.title: Beyond the Boundary: Structure, Signal, and Robustness in Failed Auction Reversion at Daily Value Area Extremes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no conflicts of interest to declare. This research was conducted independently without any financial relationship with any organization that could be perceived to have influenced the study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded. Data was purchased from Databento at a total cost of approximately $200. No external funding was received.

detail.abstract: This paper presents pre-registered tests of delta proxy signal quality at daily value area extremes in liquid futures markets, using 216,376 probes across E-mini S&P 500, E-mini Nasdaq 100, 10-Year Treasury Note, and Gold futures spanning January 2015 through May 2026. The primary contribution is a systematic comparison of three order flow proxies — binary close-vs-open classification, delta decomposition, and a Lee-Ready approximation — under pre-registered conditions with block bootstrap inference and Benjamini-Yekutieli false discovery rate correction. All three pre-registered primary tests are significant after FDR correction. Delta decomposition produces statistically superior signal quality on extension distance (pooled tau-difference = −0.0144, 95% CI [−0.0161, −0.0127], FDR p = 0.023) and time above value area (tau-difference = −0.0035, FDR p = 0.002). Trade duration results are ambiguous with a confidence interval crossing zero and are reported as such. Beyond the proxy comparison, systematic characterization reveals: a structurally consistent ~52% failed auction rate across all four instruments over eleven years; value area maturity as the dominant predictor of mechanism quality; a monotonic win rate progression from 22.8% on first boundary probes to above 76% by the tenth within-session test; and a perfectly monotonic time-above-VA quartile structure. A pre-registered volatility regime analysis directly challenges the practitioner assumption that mean-reversion strategies require calm markets — the mechanism strengthens monotonically under volatility stress, with both the COVID-19 crash and the 2022-2023 rate-hiking cycle outperforming normal conditions. Cross-timeframe characterization confirms core structural findings from 3 minutes through 60 minutes.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在四大流动性期货市场（2015-2026年）的216,376次探测，系统比较了三种订单流代理指标，发现Delta分解在信号质量上显著优于其他方法，并揭示了价值区域边界探测中一系列稳定的市场微观结构规律。
AI.research_question: 在流动性期货市场的日内价值区域极端位置，不同订单流代理指标（二元收盘-开盘分类、Delta分解、Lee-Ready近似）的信号质量如何？市场微观结构在此场景下呈现何种系统性特征？
AI.motivation: 实践者对"Delta代理信号质量"存在不同假设（如均值回归策略需要平静市场），但缺乏系统的、预注册的实证检验。已有研究多关注订单流本身，而非不同代理指标在极端价格区域的表现比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论（Market Microstructure Theory）、价值区域理论（Value Area Theory）、拍卖市场理论（Auction Market Theory）、订单流信号代理理论
AI.method: 预注册实验设计，基于216,376次探测；使用三种订单流代理指标进行系统比较；采用块引导法（block bootstrap）进行统计推断；使用Benjamini-Yekutieli错误发现率（FDR）校正进行多重假设检验。
AI.findings: 1）三个预注册的主检验在FDR校正后均显著；2）Delta分解在延伸距离和时间高于价值区域两个指标上统计上优于其他代理；3）交易持续时间结果模糊（置信区间跨零）；4）发现~52%的失败拍卖率在四个品种和十一年间结构一致；5）价值区域成熟度是机制质量的主导预测因子；6）胜率从首次边界探测的22.8%单调上升至第十次的76%以上；7）波动率加剧时均值回归机制反而强化（COVID-19和加息周期均优于正常条件），挑战了传统假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在预注册框架下系统比较三种订单流代理指标在极端价格区域的信号质量；发现并证明了价值区域边界探测中一系列稳定的、跨品种跨时间维度的微观结构规律；挑战了"均值回归需要平静市场"的实践者假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交易实践者提供了关于Delta分解代理指标优越性的实证证据；揭示了价值区域探测的胜率单调增长模式（从22.8%到76%+），可用于交易策略设计；指出波动率加剧时均值回归策略可能更强而非更弱，修正了实务界的操作假设。

title: Futures methods for field epidemiology: structured approaches to anticipatory reasoning under uncertainty

detail.title: Futures methods for field epidemiology: structured approaches to anticipatory reasoning under uncertainty
detail.abstract: The paper identifies a gap in futures studies regarding the use of these methods in time-constrained, high-uncertainty decision environments: Field epidemiology is characterised by decision‐making under conditions of urgency, incomplete data, and uncertainty, particularly in early outbreak response and preparedness. In these contexts, epidemiologists are routinely required to reason about how situations may develop, although anticipatory judgement is rarely supported by formal methods. This paper argues that futures methods represent a useful addition to the field epidemiologist’s toolkit by providing structured approaches to generate decision‐relevant evidence about plausible futures. Futures methods, including scenario‐based approaches and foresight, make assumptions, drivers, and uncertainties explicit, enabling systematic exploration of alternative trajectories. This supports transparent and accountable reasoning in contexts where empirical epidemiological evidence is limited. The paper shows that anticipatory practices already exist within field epidemiology, particularly through simulation and preparedness exercises, but are typically framed in terms of validation and training rather than as sources of structured evidence. Formalising these practices using futures methods strengthens evidence‐based decision‐making by clarifying the basis of judgement, supporting comparison across alternative developments, and improving transparency. Incorporating such approaches represents a proportionate extension of existing practice, aligned with the evolving demands of contemporary epidemiology.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了将未来学方法（如情景分析和预见）引入现场流行病学领域，以支持在时间紧迫、高不确定性环境下的决策。
AI.research_question: 如何将未来学方法应用于时间紧迫、高不确定性的现场流行病学决策环境？
AI.motivation: 现场流行病学在疫情暴发应对中面临紧迫性、数据不完整和高不确定性，但现有的前瞻性判断缺乏正式方法支持，存在方法空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 未来学方法（情景分析、预见）、循证决策理论、前瞻性判断理论
AI.method: 概念性论证与文献分析，通过识别现场流行病学中已有的前瞻性实践（模拟演练）并论证其可与未来学方法系统化整合。
AI.findings: 现场流行病学已存在前瞻性实践（如模拟和准备演练），但通常被视为验证和培训工具，而非结构化证据来源；将未来学方法正式化可强化循证决策，提高透明度与可比较性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将未来学方法引入流行病学领域，填补了该领域在正式前瞻性方法上的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为现场流行病学家提供了实用的结构化方法，以生成决策相关证据，支持在数据有限的情况下做出透明、可问责的决策。

title: Event Log Extraction from Unstructured Enterprise Messaging Using LLMs
affiliations: Northeast Petroleum University

detail.title: Event Log Extraction from Unstructured Enterprise Messaging Using LLMs
detail.abstract: High-quality event logs are essential for process mining, yet critical business information increasinglyresides in customer service conversations.Existing extraction methods based on Large LanguageModels (LLMs) struggle with hallucination and domain-knowledge gaps when processingsuch conversational text. We propose an LLMs-driven event log extraction framework purposebuiltfor customer service conversations. It orchestrates a retrieval–extraction–verificationpipeline: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) injects external domain knowledge to groundactivity recognition; a Self-Consistency module aggregates ten independent extraction passesthrough confidence-weighted voting. A dedicated verification Large Language Model (LLM)then adjudicates low-confidence predictions, jointly suppressing hallucination and recognitionerrors. Across three public customer-service dialogue datasets, LLMs-based Event Log ExtractionMethod (LLMs-EEM) attains an average F1-score of 93%, surpassing the NLI-BARTbaseline by 4 percentage points and standalone LLM methods by 8 percentage points. Theseresults confirm that the multi-stage collaborative design simultaneously improves extractionaccuracy and robustness in complex conversational environments.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于大语言模型的多阶段事件日志提取框架（LLMs-EEM），通过检索增强生成、自一致性聚合和专用验证模块，在客服对话数据中实现了93%的平均F1分数，较基线方法提升4-8个百分点。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大语言模型从客服对话文本中准确提取高质量的事件日志，克服幻觉和领域知识缺失的问题？
AI.motivation: 客服对话中蕴含大量关键业务流程信息，但现有基于LLM的提取方法在处理这类对话文本时存在幻觉（hallucination）和领域知识缺口问题，亟需一种专门面向客服对话的事件日志提取方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 检索增强生成（RAG）、自一致性（Self-Consistency）机制、多阶段协同验证框架
AI.method: 提出了LLMs-EEM框架，包含三个核心模块：(1) RAG注入外部领域知识以指导活动识别；(2) 自一致性模块通过置信度加权投票聚合10次独立提取结果；(3) 专用验证LLM对低置信度预测进行裁定，联合抑制幻觉和识别错误。
AI.findings: 在三个公开客服对话数据集上，LLMs-EEM取得93%的平均F1分数，比NLI-BART基线高出4个百分点，比独立LLM方法高出8个百分点，验证了多阶段协同设计在复杂对话环境中提升提取准确性和鲁棒性的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了针对对话式文本的事件日志提取框架，将RAG、自一致性和验证机制有机整合为多阶段协同流程，为LLM在流程挖掘领域的信息提取任务中抑制幻觉提供了系统性解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为客服对话场景提供了高质量的事件日志提取工具，显著提升了从非结构化对话数据中提取结构化业务流程信息的准确性和可靠性，对客户服务流程分析和优化具有直接应用价值。

title: Emerging Technologies and Policy: Blockchain, Big Data, and the Role of Government in the Global Economy

detail.title: Emerging Technologies and Policy: Blockchain, Big Data, and the Role of Government in the Global Economy
detail.abstract: The convergence of blockchain technology, big data analytics, and government policy frameworks represents a defining force in the architecture of the contemporary global economy. This paper examines each of these three pillars as interacting forces that collectively shape digital economic trajectories. Drawing on recent peer-reviewed literature published between 2023 and 2025, the paper analyzes blockchain's structural components (distributed ledgers, consensus mechanisms, smart contracts, and cryptographic hashing), its disruptive economic potential, and its growth outlook. It further examines big data through the Three Vs paradigm (volume, velocity, and variety), exploring its organizational demands, cross-sector applications, and its unequal impact across developed and developing economies. The government dimension explores institutional enhancement, public investment strategies, and evidence-based policy frameworks from OECD and ASEAN contexts. The paper argues that sustainable digital economic growth requires a symbiotic policy alignment across all three domains: technologically adaptive governance, data-literate institutions, and blockchain-integrated trade infrastructure. Findings suggest that nations failing to coordinate across these three vectors will face structural competitiveness disadvantages in the emerging digital economy.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了区块链、大数据与政府政策三大支柱如何协同塑造数字经济格局，并指出三者之间的政策协调是实现可持续数字经济增长的关键。
AI.research_question: 区块链技术、大数据分析与政府政策框架如何相互作用并共同塑造数字经济的发展轨迹？
AI.motivation: 区块链、大数据与政府政策已成为当代全球经济的核心驱动力，但三者之间的互动关系及其协同效应尚缺乏系统性分析，尤其是在可持续数字经济增长的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三个支柱框架：区块链（分布式账本、共识机制、智能合约、密码哈希）、大数据（Three Vs范式：体量、速度、多样性）、政府政策（制度增强、公共投资、循证政策）。三者需实现共生性政策对齐。
AI.method: 文献综述，基于2023-2025年间经同行评审的近期文献，并结合OECD和ASEAN等区域的案例分析。
AI.findings: 可持续的数字经济增长需要三个领域之间的共生性政策对齐：技术适应性治理、数据素养型机构以及区块链集成的贸易基础设施。未能在这三个向量上进行协调的国家将在新兴数字经济中面临结构性竞争力劣势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了三个支柱协同的分析框架，强调政策对齐而非单个技术的孤立发展，为数字经济治理提供了系统性理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体建议：建设技术适应性治理体系、提升机构数据素养、发展区块链集成的贸易基础设施，并指出不协调发展的竞争风险。

title: Who Buys the Exit? Domestic Prosecution Risk and the Purchase of Foreign Citizenship

detail.title: Who Buys the Exit? Domestic Prosecution Risk and the Purchase of Foreign Citizenship
detail.abstract: Who buys their way out of an authoritarian state’s enforcement? Using a newly compiled register of all 4,167 foreign naturalizations granted by Cambodia (2000–2023), I study cross-border investment naturalization as an observable margin of elite exit. In 2018, a Cambodian reform that fast-tracked naturalization while raising its price sharply expanded foreign naturalization. I exploit this common host-country opening to ask which Chinese provinces took it up. Using the cross-province intensity of Xi Jinping’s anti-corruption campaign as a measure of prosecution risk, I find that take-up rose disproportionately from high-enforcement provinces: a one–standard-deviation increase in pre-2018 enforcement raises post-2018 naturalizations by a factor of roughly 2.6. The estimate survives a score wild-cluster bootstrap and controls for provincial wealth, diaspora networks, province corruption history and reproduces at the individual level (2.30 times higher odds of post-opening entry, driven by enforcement, not wealth). That take-up surged despite a higher price points to demand for a credible exit rather than a discount—rare individual- and regional-level evidence consistent with purchased citizenship as a hedge against domestic prosecution and expropriation risk.

AI.tldr: 本文利用柬埔寨2000-2023年全部4167例外籍归化入籍登记数据，研究中国精英如何通过投资移民获取外国公民身份以规避国内政治风险。研究发现，2018年柬埔寨快速入籍改革后，来自习近平反腐运动力度更强省份的中国公民获取柬埔寨公民身份的数量显著增加（标准差每增加1，入籍数增加约2.6倍），表明购买公民身份是对国内追诉和剥夺风险的套期保值。
AI.research_question: 中国精英如何通过跨境投资归化（购买公民身份）来规避威权国家的执法？具体而言，哪些中国省份的公民更倾向于利用柬埔寨的入籍改革获取外国身份？
AI.motivation: 理解威权国家中精英的"退出"行为——他们是否通过购买外国公民身份来对冲国内的政治追诉和财产剥夺风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精英退出理论、政治风险对冲理论；将反腐运动力度作为政治追诉风险的代理变量。
AI.method: 使用柬埔寨2000-2023年全部4167例外国归化登记数据；利用2018年柬埔寨快速入籍改革作为外生冲击；采用跨省分析（以习近平反腐运动强度衡量追诉风险）；使用分数通联自助法（score wild-cluster bootstrap）进行稳健性检验；在个人层面进行逻辑回归。
AI.findings: 2018年柬埔寨入籍改革后，来自反腐执法力度更高省份的中国公民获取柬埔寨公民身份的数量不成比例地增加。前2018年执法力度每增加一个标准差，2018年后入籍数量增加约2.6倍。个人层面分析显示，执法力度使入籍概率提高2.30倍，且这一效应由执法驱动而非财富。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了首个个人和区域层面的证据，证明购买公民身份是对国内追诉和剥夺风险的套期保值；揭示了威权国家精英"用脚投票"的退出机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 对反腐政策的有效性评估提供新视角——反腐可能促使精英通过跨境方式规避执法；为资本外流和移民政策制定提供参考。

title: Becoming Cinderella: Strategic Beauty Investment Under Marriage Norms
affiliations: The University of Hong Kong - School of Economics and Finance, The University of Hong Kong and

detail.title: Becoming Cinderella: Strategic Beauty Investment Under Marriage Norms
detail.abstract: This paper studies whether marriage-market incentives induce strategic investment in physical appearance. We exploit China's "leftover women" norm-a fertility-driven, discrete age threshold that penalizes women's marital desirability in their early thirties-as exogenous variation in beauty-investment returns. Using a nationwide inpatient dataset of over 100,000 plastic surgery admissions, we find that women's cosmetic procedures bunch sharply before this threshold, with no analogous pattern for functional procedures or men. Bunching concentrates in facial and breast procedures, intensifies with stronger fertility norms and marriage-market competition, and eases with women's labor-market opportunities. A search model rationalizes these patterns as a deadline effect.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国"剩女"现象造成的年龄门槛，发现女性会在该年龄阈值前集中进行整形手术（尤其是面部和胸部手术），这体现了婚姻市场激励对美容投资的影响，且效应在生育观念强、婚姻竞争激烈及劳动市场机会少的地区更为显著。
AI.research_question: 婚姻市场激励是否会促使女性在美容方面进行策略性投资？
AI.motivation: 检验婚姻市场中的年龄压力（如"剩女"现象）是否驱动女性在颜值上进行"最后冲刺"式的投资。
AI.theoretical_framework: 婚姻市场搜寻理论、截止日期效应（Deadline Effect）
AI.method: 利用中国"剩女"年龄阈值作为外生冲击，基于全国超过10万例整形手术住院患者数据，采用断点回归和双重差分方法进行分析。
AI.findings: 女性整形手术在30岁前（"剩女"门槛前）显著集中；这种效应主要存在于面部和胸部手术，而非功能性手术或男性群体；该效应在生育观念更强、婚姻市场竞争更激烈的地区更为突出，而在女性劳动市场机会更好的地区有所缓解。
AI.theory_contributions: 为婚姻市场激励影响人力资本投资（尤其是外貌投资）提供了因果证据，拓展了截止日期效应在婚姻经济学中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示社会规范（如"剩女"标签）如何扭曲女性的美容消费行为，为理解性别不平等和婚姻市场竞争提供政策启示。

title: Does Diversification Fail During Crisis Periods

detail.title: Does Diversification Fail During Crisis Periods
detail.abstract: This paper studies whether international equity diversification continues to protect a US investor during crisis periods. Using daily ETF and index data from 2006Q1 to 2026Q1, the paper examines the five main US trading partners and a broader 42-country ETF sample, classified into 20 developed and 22 emerging/frontier markets. Diversification is evaluated through five measures: within-quarter correlation with the US market, conditional Sharpe ratio, world-adjusted quarterly abnormal return, six-factor alpha, and country/industry adjusted alpha. The empirical design compares annual crisis windows with event-anchored alternatives to distinguish short-lived crisis effects from more persistent changes in market integration. Diversification opportunities therefore exist in all three crises, but the channel shifts across crises. The GFC mainly represents diversification deterioration through higher correlations, especially over a longer period, although selected partner markets still provide limited abnormal-return support. COVID produces a less stable pattern: short-period evidence suggests selective diversification benefits, but these weaken once the rebound is included. The 2025 Trump tariff episode is different because the strongest evidence comes from return-based channels rather than only from correlation reduction. In particular, foreign partner portfolios generate stronger Sharpe-ratio and benchmark-adjusted abnormal-return gains over the shorter tariff period, while the longer period shows clearer correlation decoupling. Among the five main US trading partners, Mexico is the best overall diversifier, especially during the 2025 Trump tariff period. Japan is the most consistent abnormal-return diversifier in the GFC and COVID, while China is useful mainly for low-correlation diversification but is less stable. By group, emerging/frontier markets are the better overall diversifier because they offer lower normal-period correlations and stronger adjusted-return support in the GFC and COVID. Developed markets are more useful during the Trump tariff period, when they show clearer correlation decoupling.

AI.tldr: 本文研究国际股票多元化是否能在危机时期保护美国投资者。使用2006Q1至2026Q1的ETF和指数日数据，通过五种衡量指标分析美国五大贸易伙伴及42个国家样本（20个发达市场+22个新兴/前沿市场），发现三次危机（全球金融危机、新冠疫情、2025年特朗普关税）中均存在多元化机会，但渠道在不同危机间发生转变。
AI.research_question: 国际股票多元化是否能在不同危机时期持续保护美国投资者？三次危机中的多元化保护机制有何差异？
AI.motivation: 金融危机时期资产相关性上升，传统多元化保护可能失效，亟需检验国际多元化在不同危机中的实际保护效果及其变化机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际投资组合理论、市场分割与一体化理论、危机期间相关性动态变化理论
AI.method: 使用五类指标（季度内相关性、条件夏普比率、世界调整季度异常收益、六因子alpha、国家/行业调整alpha），比较年度危机窗口与事件锚定窗口，区分短期危机效应与持续性市场一体化变化。
AI.findings: （1）GFC：多元化主要通过高相关性恶化（长期视角），但部分伙伴市场提供有限异常收益支持；（2）COVID：短期有选择性多元化收益，但纳入反弹后减弱；（3）2025年特朗普关税：回报渠道贡献最强（夏普比率和基准调整异常收益），长期显示更清晰的相关性脱钩。墨西哥是最佳整体多元化工 具（尤其关税期），日本是GFC和COVID中最稳健的异常收益来源，新兴/前沿市场在GFC和COVID中表现更好，发达市场在关税期更有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了危机类型（金融冲击vs.贸易政策冲击）对国际多元化保护渠道的差异化影响，提出了"渠道转换"概念，区分了相关性渠道与回报渠道在不同危机中的相对重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国投资者在不同危机情境下选择国际多元化策略提供指导：GFC和COVID关注新兴/前沿市场，2025年关税周期关注发达市场；短期看回报渠道，长期看相关性渠道。

title: Regime-Specific Volatility Dynamics and Cross-Market Contagion: Evidence from S&P 500 and Nifty 50, 2007-2024

detail.title: Regime-Specific Volatility Dynamics and Cross-Market Contagion: Evidence from S&P 500 and Nifty 50, 2007-2024

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: ot applicable. This study uses publicly available financial market data and does not involve human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted independently as part of the author's academic research.

detail.abstract: This paper presents an empirical analysis of regime-specific volatility dynamics and cross-market contagion between the S&P 500 (United States) and the Nifty 50 (India) over the period 2007-2024a sample encompassing the Global Financial Crisis, the European Sovereign Debt Crisis, India's demonetisation episode, the NBFC liquidity crisis of 2018-19, and the COVID-19 market crash. Using GARCH(1,1) and GJR-GARCH(1,1) models estimated by maximum likelihood on 4,528 and 4,236 daily log-return observations respectively, we document high volatility persistence in both indices, with persistence parameters (α+β) of 0.979 for the S&P 500 and 0.992 for the Nifty 50, and confirm significant, asymmetric leverage effects in both markets-with GJR-GARCH materially outperforming symmetric GARCH (S&P 500: ΔAIC =-145.77; Nifty 50: ΔAIC =-81.71) and the leverage effect markedly stronger in the US market (γ = 0.196 versus 0.119). Applying a rolling 252day threshold-based regime classification framework to GJR-GARCH conditional volatility series, we classify each trading day into bull, bear, or high-volatility regimes, finding that both indices spend a remarkably similar share of days in the high-volatility crisis regime-16.09% for the S&P 500 and 15.96% for the Nifty 50-suggesting global crisis synchronisation rather than market-specific dynamics. Cross-market contagion analysis on 4,124 overlapping trading days reveals that 60-day rolling return correlations increase monotonically across regime combinations, rising from 0.220 during joint bull conditions to 0.251 during joint bear conditions and to 0.328 when both markets simultaneously experience high-volatility conditions-a contagion ratio of 1.49x relative to calm-period linkages.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2007-2024年数据，使用GARCH族模型分析美国S&P 500与印度Nifty 50指数的波动率动态及跨市场传染效应，发现两指数高波动率持续性和不对称杠杆效应显著，且在高波动危机期间市场联动性大幅增强（传染比1.49倍）。
AI.research_question: 美国S&P 500与印度Nifty 50指数在不同市场状态（牛市、熊市、高波动危机期）下的波动率动态特征如何？两市场之间存在怎样的跨市场传染效应？
AI.motivation: 全球金融一体化加深背景下，理解发达市场与新兴市场之间的波动传导机制对风险管理、资产配置和监管政策制定至关重要，而现有研究对印度市场与美股在多次危机事件中的联动关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: GARCH(1,1)模型、GJR-GARCH(1,1)模型（捕捉杠杆效应）、滚动窗口阈值体制分类框架、滚动相关系数分析。
AI.method: 基于4,528个（S&P 500）和4,236个（Nifty 50）日度对数收益率观测值，采用最大似然估计拟合GARCH与GJR-GARCH模型；利用252天滚动窗口阈值法对条件波动率进行牛/熊/高波动三体制分类；计算60天滚动收益率相关系数，按体制组合分析传染效应。
AI.findings: ①两指数波动率持续性极高（α+β分别0.979和0.992）；②杠杆效应显著且美国更强（γ=0.196 vs 0.119），GJR-GARCH优于GARCH；③两指数高波动危机日占比接近（16.09% vs 15.96%）；④跨市场相关性从联合牛市0.220上升至联合危机0.328，传染比1.49倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统对比美印股指在不同市场体制下的波动率特征与联动变化；量化了危机期间跨市场传染的倍数效应（1.49x），为波动率溢出文献提供了新兴市场与发达市场配对的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国投资者和风险管理人提供了美印市场波动率联动模式及危机传染强度的量化参考；有助于优化跨市场投资组合的风险对冲策略和压力测试场景设计。

title: Skilled Immigration Access and Corporate Financial Policy
affiliations: Rutgers Business School - Rutgers University

detail.title: Skilled Immigration Access and Corporate Financial Policy
detail.abstract: This paper studies how access to scarce skilled labor affects corporate financial policy. The analysis links Labor Condition Application disclosures from the U.S. Department of Labor for the H-1B program to Compustat public firms from 2008 to 2025 using a manually verified employer to public firm crosswalk. New H-1B hiring is followed by higher market leverage. In firm and year fixed effects specifications with unified Compustat controls, a one standard deviation increase in lagged new H-1B hiring is associated with a 2.26 percentage point increase in market leverage. The relation is strongest where skilled labor is central to managerial resource allocation, especially among firms with high recent sales growth and high research and development intensity. To organize identification, the paper constructs predicted access improvements equal to baseline period firm H-1B exposure multiplied by declines in national H-1B cap pressure. Predicted access improvements increase new H-1B hiring, and the reduced form shows that the same access improvements raise market leverage by 0.423 percentage points. Timing tests show that lagged access improvements predict current hiring and leverage, while future access improvements do not. The results are stable after excluding large information technology service providers, excluding the top one percent of H-1B exposed firm year observations, and leaving out each estimating fiscal year in turn. The evidence points to a market valuation channel: access to scarce skilled labor changes financial policy through market based capital structure. The findings connect strategic human capital access to corporate financial policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究稀缺技能劳动力获取如何影响公司财务政策。利用美国劳工部H-1B劳工条件申请数据与Compustat上市公司数据（2008-2025年），发现新H-1B雇佣增加会显著提高企业市场杠杆率。通过预测性准入改善指标进行识别，验证了市场估值渠道：稀缺技能劳动力的获取通过市场导向的资本结构影响财务政策。
AI.research_question: 稀缺技能劳动力的获取如何影响企业的财务政策（特别是资本结构中的市场杠杆率）？
AI.motivation: 传统公司财务理论主要关注资本、技术等传统生产要素对企业财务决策的影响，但对人力资本（特别是稀缺技能劳动力）获取如何影响财务政策的研究相对不足。本文旨在连接战略人力资本获取与公司财务政策，填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场估值渠道（market valuation channel）：稀缺技能劳动力的获取通过影响市场对企业价值的评估，进而改变企业的市场导向资本结构决策。
AI.method: 1. 数据来源：H-1B劳工条件申请（LCA）数据与Compustat上市公司数据，通过手动验证的雇主-上市公司对照表匹配（2008-2025年）。2. 基准模型：企业与年份双向固定效应模型，加入统一Compustat控制变量。3. 识别策略：构建"预测性准入改善"指标，等于基期企业H-1B暴露度乘以全国H-1B配额压力的下降幅度。
AI.findings: 1. 新H-1B雇佣增加一个标准差，市场杠杆率提高2.26个百分点。2. 该效应在近期销售增长率高、研发密集度高的企业中最为显著。3. 预测性准入改善增加新H-1B雇佣，且通过简化形式检验使市场杠杆率提高0.423个百分点。4. 时序检验表明：滞后期准入改善预测当前雇佣和杠杆率，未来准入改善则无预测力。5. 排除大型IT服务提供商、排除H-1B暴露度前1%的观测值、逐一排除每个估算财年后，结果依然稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统建立并实证检验了"稀缺技能劳动力获取→市场估值→财务政策"这一传导渠道，将战略人力资本理论与公司资本结构理论相连接，拓展了公司财务决策影响因素的研究边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业管理者提供了关于人才获取如何影响公司资本结构决策的实证依据。2. 为政策制定者理解H-1B签证政策变动对企业财务行为的实际影响提供了参考。3. 提示企业在制定财务政策时需将稀缺人力资本的可获得性纳入考量。

title: From Configuration to Conversion: Evidence from a Large-Scale Field Experiment
affiliations: California State University, San Marcos, University of Tennessee and Emory University - Goizueta Business School

detail.title: From Configuration to Conversion: Evidence from a Large-Scale Field Experiment
detail.abstract: While prior research shows that customization can create consumer value, most studies evaluate outcomes conditional on completed purchases and therefore treat configurator engagement as exogenous. As a result, little is known about how configurator use during the shopping process affects purchase conversion. We address this gap using a large-scale field experiment conducted in collaboration with a global reseller of luxury accessories. Leveraging randomized variation in the design of product detail pages, we introduce exogenous shifts in consumers' likelihood of using a configurator and analyze detailed clickstream and transaction data from more than 1.3 million online visits. This design allows us to causally identify the effect of configurator engagement on purchase outcomes while observing both purchasing and non-purchasing sessions. Configurator use increases purchase likelihood by 1.6 percentage points, corresponding to a 27% increase relative to the baseline conversion rate. The effect depends strongly on consumers' interaction patterns: browsing more products prior to customization increases the configurator's effectiveness, whereas higher interaction intensity within the configurator, measured by clicks and time spent, reduces it, consistent with cognitive overload. The impact of configurator use also varies across product and device characteristics: it increases conversion for higher-priced products but decreases conversion for lower-priced items, and its effect is stronger for desktop users than for mobile users. Together, these findings provide causal evidence on how interactive customization technologies influence economic outcomes in digital retail environments and offer guidance for the effective design and deployment of product configurators.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模实地实验发现，使用产品配置器能显著提高购买转化率27%，但其效果受到消费者互动模式、产品价格和设备类型的调节。
AI.research_question: 在购物过程中，消费者使用产品配置器如何影响购买转化率？
AI.motivation: 已有研究多基于已完成购买的条件评估定制化的价值，将配置器使用视为外生变量，忽视了配置器使用对购买转化率的因果影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者决策过程理论、认知负荷理论
AI.method: 大规模实地实验，与全球奢侈品配件经销商合作，通过随机化产品详情页设计引入外生冲击，分析130万+在线访问的点击流和交易数据。
AI.findings: ①使用配置器使购买概率提高1.6个百分点（相对提升27%）；②浏览更多产品后再使用配置器效果更好，但配置器内高交互强度（点击和时间）因认知过载而降低效果；③对高价产品转化率提升，对低价产品则降低；④桌面端用户效果强于移动端用户。
AI.theory_contributions: ①首次提供配置器使用对购买转化的因果证据；②揭示了认知负荷在定制化过程中的调节作用；③识别了产品价格和设备类型等边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电商平台和零售商设计产品配置器提供指导：优化配置器交互强度、根据产品价格和用户设备类型差异化部署配置功能。

title: When Social Risks Matter: Retail Fund Flows and Social Concern
affiliations: HEC Montreal - Department of Decision Sciences, Université de Sherbrooke - Faculty of Administration,  and University of Liège - HEC Liège

detail.title: When Social Risks Matter: Retail Fund Flows and Social Concern
detail.abstract: We introduce a Human Capital Concern (HCC) index that captures public concern about financially material social risks. Analyzing U.S. mutual fund flows of retail investors, we document that, during periods of elevated human capital concern, flow sensitivity to fund social risk scores increases by 60%. Non-linear effects in the intensity and duration of the HCC index suggest that investors mainly respond to unexpected social news shocks. Funds with a stronger social score earn higher returns following high-HCC periods, with effects persisting for only two months. This pattern is consistent with investors updating their expectations about the future returns of social-risk assets.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了人力资本关注（HCC）指数，发现当公众对社会风险关注度升高时，散户投资者对基金社会风险得分的资金流动敏感性提升60%，且社会评分较高的基金在关注度高峰后两个月内获得更高收益。
AI.research_question: 散户投资者是否以及如何根据社会风险（Social Risk）的公众关注度变化调整其基金投资行为？
AI.motivation: 尽管ESG投资日益普及，但散户投资者是否真正关心社会风险（而非环境或治理因素），以及这种关注如何影响其投资决策，尚缺乏系统性证据。作者试图通过构建新的关注度指数来填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）投资者注意力与信息冲击理论：投资者对意外社会新闻冲击做出非线性反应；2）期望更新理论：投资者根据社会风险信息更新对未来收益的预期，导致资金流向调整和价格压力。
AI.method: 1）构建HCC指数（基于Google搜索量等数据衡量公众对社会风险的关注）；2）使用美国共同基金流量数据，进行面板回归分析基金资金流动对社会风险得分的敏感性；3）分析HCC指数的非线性和持续性效应；4）检验基金后续收益表现。
AI.findings: 1）HCC高企时期，资金流动对社会风险得分的敏感性提高60%；2）HCC指数的强度与持续时间存在非线性效应，投资者主要对意外社会新闻冲击做出反应；3）社会评分高的基金在HCC高峰后两个月内获得更高收益，但该效应仅持续两个月。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次将公众对社会风险的关注度（而非ESG综合指标）与散户基金投资行为直接联系起来；2）验证了投资者注意力非对称性和期望更新理论在ESG投资领域的适用性；3）揭示了社会风险定价的短期性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为基金经理和资产管理机构提供参考：社会风险关注度上升时，调整投资组合的社会风险暴露可获取短期超额收益；2）对政策制定者而言，表明公众舆论冲击能通过金融市场传导至企业行为，具有社会治理的间接效应；3）为散户投资者提供行为指导：社会风险信息的短期定价效应需及时捕捉。

title: Beyond Rodeo Drive: California and the Forgotten Meaning of Luxury
affiliations: Luxury Strategy & Consumer Culture

detail.title: Beyond Rodeo Drive: California and the Forgotten Meaning of Luxury

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests, direct corporate funding, or personal relationships that influenced the conceptual development, theoretical frameworks, or analytical conclusions of this working paper. While the author serves as an entrepreneur in the sustainable consumer goods sector, this research was executed independently as a purely theoretical contribution to the fields of luxury strategy and consumer culture theory.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This manuscript is a purely conceptual and theoretical paper based on public cultural archetypes, existing literature, and secondary source analysis. It did not involve any empirical research with human participants, animal subjects, or the collection of private personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant, financial assistance, or funding from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding agencies. The work was conducted and supported entirely by the author in an independent capacity.

detail.abstract:
Contemporary discussions of luxury are overwhelmingly centered on products, brands, exclusivity, and consumption. Luxury is generally understood as the acquisition of scarce objects that signal status, wealth, or distinction — what Veblen (1899) termed conspicuous consumption and Bourdieu (1984) analyzed as the expression of cultural capital through material distinction. Yet such an interpretation may be incomplete.

This conceptual paper proposes an alternative understanding of luxury through the lens of California as a symbolic and cultural laboratory. Rather than treating luxury primarily as ownership, the article argues — drawing on MacIntyre’s (1981) virtue ethics, Nussbaum’s (2011) capabilities approach, and Morhart et al.’s (2015) framework of brand authenticity — that luxury begins with the preservation and cultivation of rare forms of value expressed through character, stewardship, resilience, humanity, creativity, freedom, and meaning.

Through four Californian archetypes — the love story of Concepción Argüello and Nikolai Rezanov, the reconstruction of San Francisco following the earthquake of 1906, the moral questions raised by the Rodney King crisis, and the cultural symbolism embedded within Charmed — the paper develops an original conceptual framework: the Rarity Hierarchy, distinguishing between material rarity (the traditional domain of luxury brands) and existential rarity (character, devotion, resilience, dignity). The article further argues that sustainability represents not an external constraint on luxury but one of its original principles: the preservation of what is rare, valuable, and enduring.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了将奢侈品等同于物质稀缺与地位象征的传统观点，提出奢侈品应被重新理解为对稀有价值（如品格、韧性、人性、创造力等）的保存与培育。作者以加州为文化与象征实验室，通过四个加州原型案例，构建了“稀有性层级”概念框架，区隔了物质稀有性与存在稀有性，并指出可持续性本就是奢侈品的内在原则。
AI.research_question: 奢侈品的本质是什么？除了物质稀缺与地位信号之外，是否存在一种更根本的理解方式？
AI.motivation: 现有奢侈品讨论过度聚焦于产品、品牌、排他性与消费，忽视了奢侈品可能蕴含的更深层价值维度。本文试图挑战这一主流叙事，提供一种替代性的概念理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: MacIntyre的美德伦理学、Nussbaum的能力方法论、Morhart等人的品牌真实性框架，以及Veblen的炫耀性消费和Bourdieu的文化资本理论作为对话对象。
AI.method: 概念性论文（conceptual paper），通过四个加州原型案例分析构建理论框架。
AI.findings: 提出了“稀有性层级”（Rarity Hierarchy）框架，区分了物质稀有性（传统奢侈品牌的领域）与存在稀有性（品格、奉献、韧性、尊严）。可持续性不是对奢侈品的外部约束，而是奢侈品保存稀有、有价值、持久事物的原初原则之一。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义了奢侈品的本质，将关注点从物质拥有转向存在价值；提出了“稀有性层级”这一原创性概念框架；将可持续性内嵌于奢侈品定义之中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为奢侈品行业提供了超越物质排他性的品牌定位思路；为可持续奢侈品实践提供了理论基础，即可持续性不是妥协而是回归奢侈品的本质。

title: Does the Delta Method Matter in Practice? Order-of-Magnitude Hedge-P&L Divergence in a Two-Asset WTI/KRW Quanto Knock-Out Option

detail.title: Does the Delta Method Matter in Practice? Order-of-Magnitude Hedge-P&L Divergence in a Two-Asset WTI/KRW Quanto Knock-Out Option

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no relevant financial or non-financial interests, and no personal or organizational relationships, that could have appeared to influence the research reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants or animals; therefore, ethics approval is not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: A Korean crude-oil importer is jointly exposed to the price of WTI crude oil and to the KRW/USD exchange rate. We study a two-asset quanto knockout (KO) option written on this combined exposure, in which WTI follows a Merton jump-diffusion and KRW/USD follows a correlated geometric Brownian motion, and we hedge it under a deliberately constraining practitioner rule that applies a single scalar delta to both legs, 𝛿 𝐹 𝑋 = 𝛿 𝑊 𝑇 𝐼. Holding the product, the at-the-money strike, the combined premium, and the simulated price paths fixed, we vary only the delta-estimation methodology-a Longstaff-Schwartz regression delta (American), a Black-76 proxy delta (European), and a Turnbull-Wakeman arithmetic-Asian proxy delta (Asian)and ask whether the resulting hedge performance (knock-out frequency, early-exercise frequency, and the realized profit-and-loss distribution) is consistent across the three. All quantities are read directly from a completed Excel/VBA production workbook. We find that the answer is methodology-dependent in a way that is itself the headline result: the knockout and earlyexercise statistics behave as a function of the price path (as the model construction predicts), but the realized P&L distributions diverge by an order of magnitude across methodologies, with the two proxy-delta engines exhibiting a pronounced bimodal, heavy-loss profile absent from the regression-delta engine. We document this honestly as evidence that the convenient 𝛿 𝐹 𝑋 = 𝛿 𝑊 𝑇 𝐼 simplification does not by itself guarantee cross-methodology P&L consistency, and we enumerate the modeling assumptions on which every number rests. Our contribution is deliberately practical, and this is where it departs from the existing literature on this problem class. Where the recent numerical-analysis work on two-asset jump-diffusion American options is concerned with proving that a pricing scheme converges, our concern is what a hedging desk actually realizes once the option is sold: we run the complete workflow of a specific firm-a Korean crude importer-on its own calibrated Excel/VBA model, and we show that a choice practitioners routinely treat as a matter of implementation convenience (which closed-form delta to plug in) moves realized hedge risk by an order of magnitude. The paper is thus a practitionerfacing robustness warning grounded in a real, reproducible production model, not a new pricing method: the pricing engine is Longstaff-Schwartz regression Monte Carlo, which carries only the convergence guarantees of that method, and we make no claim to the viscosity-solution / monotone-scheme rigor of the PIDE literature.

AI.tldr: 本文基于一家韩国原油进口商的真实Excel/VBA生产模型，发现当采用两种资产（WTI原油价格和韩元/美元汇率）的价差敲出期权时，使用不同的delta估计方法（Longstaff-Schwartz回归delta、Black-76代理delta、Turnbull-Wakeman算术亚式代理delta）会导致对冲绩效（特别是已实现损益分布）出现数量级差异，其中两种代理delta引擎产生明显的双峰、重亏损分布，而回归delta引擎则没有。
AI.research_question: 在两种资产的价差敲出期权对冲中，不同delta估计方法（美式回归delta、欧式Black-76代理delta、亚式Turnbull-Wakeman代理delta）是否会产生一致的对冲绩效？
AI.motivation: 实务中，韩国原油进口商同时面临WTI原油价格风险和韩元/美元汇率风险，常使用一种简化的单标量delta（δ_FX = δ_WTI）进行对冲。但该简化假设是否能保证不同方法论下的损益一致性，缺乏实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: Merton跳扩散模型（WTI原油价格）、相关几何布朗运动（韩元/美元汇率）、Longstaff-Schwartz回归蒙特卡洛（美式期权定价）、Black-76模型（欧式代理delta）、Turnbull-Wakeman模型（算术亚式代理delta）。
AI.method: 在固定产品、平值行权价、综合溢价和模拟价格路径的条件下，仅改变delta估计方法（三种方法），直接从完成的Excel/VBA生产工作簿中读取敲出频率、提前行权频率和已实现损益分布，进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 敲出和提前行权统计量随价格路径变化（符合模型构造预期），但已实现损益分布在方法论间出现数量级差异：两种代理delta引擎呈现明显的双峰、重亏损分布，而回归delta引擎则没有。
AI.theory_contributions: 指出了现有文献中关于两资产跳扩散美式期权的数值分析工作主要关注定价方案是否收敛，而本文关注的是期权售出后对冲交易台实际实现的损益，填补了这一视角空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个面向实务工作者的稳健性警示：实务中通常被视为实现方便的选择（选择哪种封闭式delta）会将已实现对冲风险移动一个数量级；基于真实、可复现的生产模型（韩国原油进口商的Excel/VBA模型）展示这一现象。

title: Opaque Auctions: Implicit Signals and Value of Information in Ad Auctions
affiliations: City University of Hong Kong (CityU) - Department of Marketing and Seoul National University

detail.title: Opaque Auctions: Implicit Signals and Value of Information in Ad Auctions
detail.abstract: Online advertising markets exhibit two characteristic features: opacity in the platform's allocation process and two-sided information asymmetry, whereby platforms observe user engagement data unknown to advertisers while advertisers possess private business valuations unknown to the platform. In standard auction settings with commitment power, a platform can implement publicly observable auction-design rules through which its private information is directly incorporated into advertisers' decisions. However, the platform's strategy is often unobservable to advertisers, and thus the platform lacks commitment, implying that its private information can only be transmitted implicitly through observable choices. We develop a model of opaque auctions characterized by two-sided private information and the platform's lack of commitment to auction-design strategies. In this setting, the platform can set reserve prices and decide which advertisers to solicit, choices that may serve as implicit signals. First, we show that the reserve price cannot credibly convey the platform's private information, but selective bidder solicitation can: the platform optimally excludes some advertisers from the auction, and being invited serves as a credible signal of high advertiser-impression match value, inducing more aggressive bidding. When either the platform or the advertisers have full information, we show that being invited no longer carries information, and thus inviting all advertisers is optimal. Second, acquiring the advertisers' private information can harm the platform by undermining the credibility of the signaling mechanism, an effect absent with commitment. Third, the incentives of the platform and the advertisers to share their private information and acquire counter-party's information are aligned if and only if the market size is large enough. These results show that the value of information is determined by the interaction among the information environment, commitment power, and market size.
