AI.tldr: 本文研究了在线广告市场中，平台缺乏承诺能力时，如何通过非公开的拍卖设计（如选择性地邀请广告主）来隐含传递其私有信息，并分析了信息获取、市场规模的互动效应。
AI.research_question: 在平台缺乏承诺能力的 opaque 拍卖中，平台如何通过不可观察的拍卖设计策略传递其私有信息？信息不对称、承诺能力与市场规模如何影响信息的价值？
AI.motivation: 在线广告市场存在双重信息不对称（平台掌握用户数据、广告主掌握私人估值）且平台策略不可观察（缺乏承诺），现有标准拍卖理论假定可承诺公开规则，与实际情况不符，需建模 opaque 拍卖中的信号传递机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号传递博弈（signaling game）、opaque 拍卖理论、机制设计、信息设计
AI.method: 理论建模：构建一个包含双重私有信息和缺乏承诺能力的 opaque 拍卖模型，分析平台通过保留价和选择性邀请作为隐性信号的均衡。
AI.findings: （1）保留价不能可信地传递平台私有信息，但选择性邀请可以——被邀请意味着高匹配价值，激励广告主更激进出价；（2）当任一方拥有完全信息时，邀请失去信号作用，最优策略是邀请所有广告主；（3）获取广告主私有信息可能损害平台，因为会削弱信号机制的可信度；（4）双方共享信息与获取对方信息的激励在市场规模足够大时才会一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将缺乏承诺能力与双重信息不对称结合建模，揭示信号机制在 opaque 拍卖中的作用，并说明信息价值取决于信息环境、承诺能力与市场规模的互动。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在线广告平台的拍卖设计提供指导：在缺乏承诺时，选择性邀请是比保留价更有效的信号工具；平台需警惕获取广告主信息可能带来的信号贬值效应；市场规模是决定信息共享激励的关键因素。

title: The Production of Financial Literacy
affiliations: Vancouver School of Economics, UBC and Morningstar Investment Management

detail.title: The Production of Financial Literacy
detail.abstract: We study the accumulation of financial competencies in a model of dynamic skill formation. We find evidence of complementarities between financial literacy, wealth and risk attitudes. Risk tolerance and wealth facilitate experimentation and learning-by-doing. Latent risk attitudes and financial literacy are unevenly distributed across households and do not align with general human capital. Linking estimates with data on household portfolios, we show that early-life differences in financial literacy and its accumulation in the life-cycle may account for about one-fifth of the standard deviation of wealth by age 60. Dynamic complementarities in skill formation imply that early interventions may reduce later-life inequality while boosting average wealth growth.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了金融能力的动态形成过程，发现金融素养、财富和风险态度之间存在互补性。早期金融素养差异及其一生积累可解释60岁时约五分之一的财富标准差，动态互补性意味着早期干预可减少晚年不平等并促进平均财富增长。
AI.research_question: 金融能力（金融素养、风险态度、财富）如何动态形成？它们之间的互补性如何？早期金融素养差异对晚年财富不平等有多大影响？
AI.motivation: 理解金融能力的积累机制及其与财富不平等的关系，为早期干预政策提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态技能形成理论（Dynamic Skill Formation）；金融素养、财富与风险态度之间的互补性假设；学习-by-doing机制。
AI.method: 动态技能形成模型构建与估计；将估计结果与家庭投资组合数据关联分析。
AI.findings: 金融素养、财富与风险态度之间存在互补性；风险容忍度和财富促进实验与干中学；金融素养和风险态度在家庭间分布不均且与一般人力资本不一致；早期金融素养差异可解释60岁时约1/5的财富标准差。
AI.theory_contributions: 将动态技能形成理论拓展至金融能力领域；揭示金融素养、财富与风险态度的动态互补机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为早期金融教育干预以减少晚年财富不平等提供实证支持；指导政策制定者关注儿童及青少年时期的金融素养培养。

title: More Hours, Not Better Hours: Platform Integration and Taxi Service Supply
affiliations: Zhejiang University, University of British Columbia (UBC) - Sauder School of Business, Zhejiang University - College of Economics and Zhejiang University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: More Hours, Not Better Hours: Platform Integration and Taxi Service Supply
detail.abstract: Digital platforms increasingly add incumbent offline suppliers to their marketplaces, but these integrations are often evaluated through average productivity or throughput. We show that platform access can create value through expanded service coverage rather than higher hourly productivity, by keeping incumbent suppliers active in markets where the offline channel alone would not sustain service. We study Hangzhou's 2023 integration of its metered taxi fleet into the dominant ride-hailing platform, rolled out across two waves. In a balanced panel of 2,283 drivers over nine weeks, integration raises weekly revenue by 7.1 percent and weekly orders by 11.3 percent, while revenue per hour falls by 2 to 3 percent and hours rise by about 10 percent. Although integration shortens same-cell waiting times, faster matching does not translate into higher driver-side hourly productivity. A three-channel decomposition shows that the revenue gain is driven by supply-side continuation rather than within-channel productivity; platform orders lower the average revenue rate through substitution, but the additional active time more than offsets this loss. In the trip-level stopping sample, the mechanism appears at drivers' historical quitting-revenue benchmark: integration reduces stopping most in marginal street-opportunity cells, where offline demand is weak but not absent, and in cells unfamiliar to the driver. Consistent with this mechanism, vacant-taxi availability rises more in low-opportunity cells: by 37.6 percent of baseline versus 7.6 percent elsewhere. The results show that incumbent-platform integration can expand service availability where offline supply is thinnest, a margin missed by average productivity metrics and central to platform design and regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了杭州2023年将传统出租车整合到网约车平台的效果，发现整合通过扩大服务覆盖范围（而非提高单位时间生产率）提升了司机收入，尤其改善了低需求区域的供给可用性。
AI.research_question: 数字平台整合线下供应商（传统出租车）如何影响司机收入、生产率及服务覆盖范围？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注平台整合的平均生产率或吞吐量，忽略了整合可能通过扩展服务覆盖范围而非提高每小时生产率来创造价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台经济、市场设计、供给侧延续效应（supply-side continuation）
AI.method: 使用杭州2023年两波整合的准自然实验，构建2283名司机9周的平衡面板数据，进行三重渠道分解和停运决策分析。
AI.findings: 整合使周收入提升7.1%、周订单量提升11.3%，但每小时收入下降2-3%、工作时间增加约10%。收入增长源于"供给侧延续"（司机在原本会停运的低需求区域继续接单），而非渠道内生产率提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了平台整合通过供给侧延续（而非生产率提升）创造价值的机制，识别了平均生产率指标无法捕捉的服务覆盖扩展效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台设计和监管提供启示：整合的价值不仅在于效率提升，更在于扩大服务可用性，尤其是在线下供给最薄弱的区域。

title: Bringing Qualified, Long-Term Unemployed Youth Back into the Labor Market. Evidence from an ALMP In Spain
affiliations: Universidad Autónoma de Madrid, Universidad Autónoma de Madrid and Universidad Autónoma de Madrid - Department Estructura Economica

detail.title: Bringing Qualified, Long-Term Unemployed Youth Back into the Labor Market. Evidence from an ALMP In Spain

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We have nothing to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: Ainhoa Herrarte and Marco A. Pérez Navarro acknowledge support from an R&D&r program of the Spanish government through project PID2022-137819NB-I00, and from the Community of Madrid through the research contract “Evaluation of the impact of employment incentives and mixed employment and training programs of the Directorate General of Public Employment Services” (C-241M/006-21, A/SER-021694/2021). Rocío Sánchez-Mangas and Marco A. Pérez Navarro acknowledge support from an R&D&r program of the Spanish government through Project PID2022-139614NB-C21. Marco A. Pérez Navarro acknowledges financial support from the FPI-UAM 2021 fellowship of the Universidad Autónoma de Madrid.

detail.abstract: Using administrative records from the Spanish Public Employment Services and socioeconomic information from census sections for the period 2018-2020, we evaluate an active labor market policy implemented in 2018 to promote the hiring of qualified, long-term unemployed youth in jobs directly related to their educational background. The program combines six months of subsidized employment in the public sector, training in cross-cutting skills and job-search assistance. Our findings indicate that the policy had a positive effect in the short term as it improved participants' chances of getting a job aligned with their education level. A heterogeneity analysis reveals that this effect is primarily driven by graduates of higher vocational education and training (VET) programs, for whom the impact is substantial at around 23 percentage points. In contrast, no significant effects are observed among graduates of intermediate VET programs or those with university degrees. Robustness checks and a sensitivity analysis accounting for the potential influence of unobserved confounders support these conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了西班牙2018年实施的一项针对高学历长期失业青年的积极劳动力市场政策，发现该政策在短期内提高了参与者获得与教育背景匹配工作的概率，该效应主要由高等职业教育和培训项目毕业生驱动（约23个百分点），而对中等职业教育或大学毕业生无显著影响。
AI.research_question: 一项旨在促进高学历长期失业青年就业的积极劳动力市场政策是否有效？具体而言，该政策能否提高参与者获得与教育背景匹配的工作的概率？
AI.motivation: 长期失业青年面临严重的就业匹配问题，尤其是高学历青年难以找到与专业对口的工作。现有文献对这类针对性的补贴性就业政策的效果证据不足，需要严谨的因果识别评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、信号理论、劳动力市场匹配理论
AI.method: 使用西班牙公共就业服务部门的行政记录及2018-2020年人口普查区社会经济数据，采用准实验方法进行因果推断，并进行了异质性分析、稳健性检验和敏感性分析（考虑未观测混杂因素）。
AI.findings: 政策在短期内提高了参与者获得与教育水平匹配工作的概率；异质性分析表明，该效应主要由高等职业教育和培训（VET）项目毕业生驱动（影响约23个百分点），而对中等职业教育或大学毕业生无显著影响；稳健性检验和敏感性分析支持上述结论。
AI.theory_contributions: 为针对高学历长期失业青年的积极劳动力市场政策效果提供了新的因果证据；揭示了不同教育层次对政策反应的异质性，丰富了人力资本匹配理论在公共就业政策领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为西班牙及其他国家的公共就业服务部门设计针对长期失业青年的就业政策提供了实证依据；表明补贴性公共部门就业结合培训的方式对特定教育群体（高等职业教育毕业生）有效，有助于优化政策资源分配。

title: A Comparative Case study: The Key and Potential Roles of Social Media in Festival Avignon OFF and Edinburgh Festival Fringe

detail.title: A Comparative Case study: The Key and Potential Roles of Social Media in Festival Avignon OFF and Edinburgh Festival Fringe

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial interests, personal relationships, or conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved publicly available social media data and voluntary participant interviews conducted in accordance with applicable ethical standards. No sensitive personal data were collected. All participants provided informed consent prior to participation.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently as part of the requirements for the International MBA Program at IAE Paris-Est School of Management, Université Paris-Est Créteil (UPEC), France.

detail.abstract: Due to the lack of social media study in event and festival industry, the unprecedented, high social media popularity of Festival Avignon Off and Edinburgh Festival Fringe and the alert of the shortage of audiences which supports the future growth of the festivals, this thesis aims (1) to give the global panorama of social media performances in two of the most representative art festivals, Festival Avignon Off and Edinburgh Festival Fringe, in 2019 and (2) to give constructive recommendations of further nourishing the participants’ experiences via digital approach. To make this thesis rigorous, multiple case study with embedded mixed method is selected as the research strategy to analyze and compare the two festivals individually and mutually. In the end, more than 12,500 social media data from Awario, Metricool and Social Blade, around 900 offline flyers and 26 semi-structured interviews have been collected and analyzed. The key findings include: (1) Lack of “Stimulation” and “Program” in social media contents, (2) Fringe’s more diverse and international online audiences, (3) A leading role of traditional communication in both festivals, (4) Lack of differentiation of the flyers, (5) Ignorance of Instagram and Youtube in social media, (6) Absence of social media in Avignon Off, (7) Higher acceptance of “phygital” performances in Fringe and (8) Difficulty of having an immersive festival experience in the current edition. The three recommendations for improving social media in Fringe and OFF include: (1) A centralized digital assistant, FES-visor, which facilitates visitors’ whole journey, (2) Events and social media campaigns for higher satisfaction and media coverage and (3) Customer-oriented contents which actively respond to the customers.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2019年阿维尼翁OFF戏剧节和爱丁堡边缘艺术节在社交媒体上的表现，收集了超过12,500条社交媒体数据、约900份线下传单和26场半结构化访谈。研究发现两个艺术节在社交媒体内容、受众多样性、传统传播的主导地位等方面存在显著差异和不足，并提出了三项改进建议：集中式数字助手FES-visor、活动与社交媒体活动、以及以客户为导向的内容策略。
AI.research_question: （1）两个最具代表性的艺术节——阿维尼翁OFF戏剧节和爱丁堡边缘艺术节在2019年的社交媒体表现如何？（2）如何通过数字化方式进一步丰富参与者的体验？
AI.motivation: 活动与节庆产业中缺乏社交媒体研究；两大艺术节在社交媒体上拥有空前的受欢迎度；艺术节面临观众短缺问题，威胁未来发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 未明确列出具体理论，但采用了混合方法的多案例研究策略，涉及社交媒体分析、传单内容分析和半结构化访谈。
AI.method: 多案例研究（嵌入式混合方法）。数据来源：Awario、Metricool、Social Blade（12,500+条社交媒体数据），约900份线下传单，26场半结构化访谈。
AI.findings: （1）社交媒体内容缺乏"刺激"和"节目"元素；（2）爱丁堡边缘艺术节拥有更多样化、更国际化的线上受众；（3）传统传播方式在两个艺术节中占主导地位；（4）传单缺乏差异化；（5）忽视Instagram和YouTube；（6）阿维尼翁OFF戏剧节缺乏社交媒体存在；（7）爱丁堡边缘艺术节对"虚实融合"演出的接受度更高；（8）当前版本难以获得沉浸式节日体验。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了活动与节庆产业中社交媒体研究的空白；为艺术节社交媒体表现提供了全局性比较分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了三项可行的社交媒体改进建议：FES-visor集中式数字助手、活动和社交媒体宣传、以客户为导向的内容策略。

title: LLMs, Knowledge Sharing and the Real Problem with AI
affiliations: Forte Group

detail.title: LLMs, Knowledge Sharing and the Real Problem with AI
detail.abstract: The public conversation around large language models has been dominated by claims about machine intelligence, framed as approaching or surpassing human capability, and by the anthropomorphic anxieties that framing invites. This essay argues that the framing itself is the problem. Drawing on mechanistic interpretability research (Petroni et al., 2019; Geva et al., 2021; Meng et al., 2022), the formal equivalence of language modeling and compression (Delétang et al., 2023), and recent work resolving inference non-determinism as an infrastructure property rather than a property of the model (He, 2025), the essay proposes that LLMs are better understood as a new kind of database: a compressed, queryable store of accumulated human knowledge, written through training and read through inference. Two fallacies follow from the intelligence framing: the conscious machine and the machine that replaces human workers. Evidence from labor economics (Brynjolfsson, Li, and Raymond, 2023; Noy and Zhang, 2023; Becker et al., 2025) indicates instead that these systems function as knowledge distribution technologies, compressing skill gaps where the binding constraint is missing knowledge while leaving judgment scarce. The essay concludes that the intelligence framing carries a civic opportunity cost, directing public attention toward cinematic scenarios and away from the governance questions any knowledge infrastructure raises: curation, access, auditability, and control of the write path.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将大语言模型（LLM）理解为一种新型数据库——压缩的可查询的人类知识存储，而非逼近或超越人类智能的机器。智能框架导致了两个谬误（意识机器和替代人类工人），并产生了公民机会成本，转移了公众对知识基础设施治理问题的关注。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型应如何被恰当理解和框架化？当前的"智能"框架带来了哪些问题？
AI.motivation: 公共讨论中关于LLM的主流叙事被"机器智能"框架主导，这种拟人化的焦虑（机器接近或超越人类能力）本身就存在问题，需要重新审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制可解释性研究（Petroni等，2019；Geva等，2021；Meng等，2022）、语言建模与压缩的形式等价性（Delétang等，2023）、推理非确定性的基础设施属性（He，2025）
AI.method: 理论论证与概念分析，结合多个研究领域的证据进行综合论述
AI.findings: 1. LLM更适合被理解为压缩的可查询的知识数据库；2. "智能"框架导致两个谬误：有意识的机器和替代人类工人的机器；3. 劳动经济学证据表明LLM是知识分配技术，压缩技能差距但保留判断的稀缺性；4. 智能框架造成公民机会成本，转移了对知识基础设施治理（策展、访问、可审计性、写入路径控制）的关注。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将LLM重新概念化为"知识数据库"而非"智能体"的理论框架，纠正了主流智能叙事的概念偏差。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒公众和政策制定者关注LLM作为知识基础设施的治理问题（策展、访问、可审计性、写入路径控制），而非沉溺于拟人化科幻叙事。

title: The Automation Efficiency Paradox: Why Generative AI Increases the Need for Human Expertise

detail.title: The Automation Efficiency Paradox: Why Generative AI Increases the Need for Human Expertise

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research received no funding and was conducted independently. No personal or financial relationships with any organisation influenced this work.

detail.abstract: Organizations are rapidly adopting Large Language Models (LLMs) under the assumption that automation can seamlessly replace human labour to maximize operational speed (Srinivasan, 2026). This paper introduces the Automation Efficiency Paradox to challenge this assumption using a behavioural and cognitive framework (Bashkirova & Krpan, 2024). We demonstrate that because conversational AI operates on probabilistic next-token predictions and alignment optimization (sycophancy), its outputs suffer from Psychological Invisibility and Deceptive Syntheses (Anthropic, 2023; Perez et al., 2022). Rather than eliminating human error, the system camouflages omissions behind masterfully crafted, fluid prose (Srinivasan, 2026). When scaling tasks to large, macro-level text blocks, human operators experience cognitive fatigue and cave to Premature Verification Convergence, unthinkingly accepting flawed data (Elsevier B.V., 2026). We argue that blindly replacing human workers with AI leads to a downstream collapse of trust in the system's output (Bashkirova & Krpan, 2024). To preserve workflow integrity, AI cannot function as a standalone replacement (Srinivasan, 2026). Instead, the technology fundamentally increases the societal necessity for high-level, subject-matter human experts who possess the structural capacity to audit, verify, and guide algorithmic outputs at the source (Chen et al., 2025; Elsevier B.V., 2026).

AI.tldr: 本文提出“自动化效率悖论”，指出LLM看似提升效率，实则因心理不可见性、欺骗性综合症等认知缺陷，反而增加对高水平人类专家的需求，而非替代人力。
AI.research_question: LLM自动化是否真的能无缝替代人类劳动以实现运营速度最大化？
AI.motivation: 挑战组织普遍认为AI可完美替代人类劳动的假设，揭示自动化背后的认知风险与效率悖论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自动化效率悖论、行为与认知框架、心理不可见性、欺骗性综合症、过早验证收敛。
AI.method: 基于已有文献（Anthropic, Perez et al., Srinivasan等）的理论分析与概念推演。
AI.findings: 1) LLM输出存在心理不可见性与欺骗性综合症；2) 大规模任务中人类操作者会出现认知疲劳与过早验证收敛；3) 盲目替代将导致系统信任崩坏；4) 自动化反而增加了对高水平专家审计验证的需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出“自动化效率悖论”概念，从认知与行为视角修正了AI完全替代人类的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示组织不应以AI完全替代人类，而应建立人机协同的审核机制，提升对高水平领域专家的需求。

title: Beneath the Ban of Abortion: Evidence from the USSR
affiliations: New Economic School (NES), ESSEC Business School and New Economic School (NES)

detail.title: Beneath the Ban of Abortion: Evidence from the USSR
detail.abstract: We exploit Stalin's abrupt 1936 nationwide abortion ban to study the dynamic effects of reproductive restrictions. Using newly digitized, year-by-year evidence from declassified Soviet archives, we document a sharp rise in births alongside increases in infant mortality and illegal abortions, consistent with substitution toward unsafe procedures. The national break and long post-period allow us to trace fertility and earlylife health trajectories. Linking cohorts forward, children born after the ban exhibit higher crime, with no corresponding change for older, unexposed cohorts. Regions more exposed to the ban experienced no faster industrial growth; adverse early-life conditions and unsafe abortion may have eroded human-capital gains. The results are robust to controls for other Stalin-era interventions, including repression, propaganda, famine exposure, industrialization, and wartime occupation. The evidence suggests that restricting reproductive autonomy raised births but worsened early-life conditions, weakened cohort quality, and failed to deliver the economic gains used to justify the ban.

AI.tldr: 本文利用斯大林1936年突然实施的全国性堕胎禁令，研究生育限制的动态效应。基于新近数字化的解密苏联档案年度数据，发现禁令导致出生率急剧上升，同时婴儿死亡率和非法堕胎增加。禁令后的儿童队列表现出更高的犯罪率，而禁令实施前出生的儿童则无此变化。受禁令影响更大的地区并未实现更快的工业增长。证据表明，限制生育自主权提高了出生率，但恶化了早期生活条件，削弱了队列质量，且未能带来用于证明禁令合理性的经济收益。
AI.research_question: 斯大林1936年堕胎禁令对生育、婴儿健康、儿童长期发展以及地区经济增长产生了怎样的动态影响？
AI.motivation: 堕胎禁令在全球范围内仍是一个极具争议的政策议题，但关于其长期动态效应的因果证据极其有限。斯大林1936年的堕胎禁令提供了一个独特的外生政策冲击，结合新近解密的苏联档案数据，可以系统评估生育限制的多方面后果，尤其是对婴儿健康、人力资本和经济增长的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 研究基于人力资本理论、生育经济学和生命历程理论。堕胎禁令通过强迫生育改变家庭生育决策，可能导致：1）生育率上升；2）向不安全堕胎替代；3）婴儿健康恶化（因非意愿怀孕增加、医疗资源稀释）；4）儿童长期发展受损（不利的早期环境）；5）人力资本质量下降抵消数量增长，从而无法促进经济增长。
AI.method: 使用新近数字化、基于年份的苏联解密档案数据，采用双重差分（DID）和队列分析方法。比较禁令实施前后（1936年前后）的出生率、婴儿死亡率、非法堕胎率变化；追踪不同出生队列的长期犯罪率差异；利用地区暴露程度差异进行异质性分析，并控制其他斯大林时期干预措施（镇压、宣传、饥荒暴露、工业化、战时占领）的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 禁令导致出生率急剧上升，同时婴儿死亡率和非法堕胎显著增加，表明存在向不安全堕胎程序的替代。2. 禁令后出生的儿童队列表现出更高的犯罪率，而禁令前已出生的队列无此变化。3. 受禁令影响更大的地区并未实现更快的工业增长。4. 不利的早期生活条件和不安全堕胎可能侵蚀了人力资本收益。5. 结果在控制其他斯大林时期干预后依然稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了生育限制对人力资本和长期经济增长的因果证据，挑战了"限制堕胎可通过增加劳动力供给促进经济增长"的传统观点。2. 揭示了生育限制的"数量-质量权衡"（quantity-quality tradeoff）机制——生育数量上升但人力资本质量下降。3. 扩展了生命历程理论，将早期生活条件与成年后犯罪等非认知结果联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了堕胎禁令全面代价的实证依据：禁令虽提高出生率，但通过恶化婴儿健康、增加犯罪、阻碍经济增长而产生巨大社会成本。2. 提醒政策制定者关注生育政策对人力资本质量而非仅仅是数量的影响。3. 对当前全球范围内关于堕胎权的政策辩论（如美国Dobbs案后的各州堕胎限制）提供了历史经验教训。

title: The Fixity Test: Refutation Without Diagnosis in the AI-Induced Psychosis Discourse

detail.title: The Fixity Test: Refutation Without Diagnosis in the AI-Induced Psychosis Discourse

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Journalism, advocacy, and active litigation attach the words "delusion" and "psychosis" to named individuals on the basis of public information: news accounts, self-reports, and court filings. This commentary argues that the practice fails on the diagnostic manual's own terms, and that the failure runs in one specific direction. DSM-5-TR defines a delusion by fixity: a fixed belief that is not amenable to change in light of conflicting evidence. Fixity is legible only in trajectory, in whether the belief held or released when contradiction arrived, and never in how extreme the belief sounded at its peak. An asymmetry follows. Affirming the diagnostic label from public information is unavailable in principle, because affirmation requires a longitudinal record of the belief surviving contradiction, a negative symptom picture that public accounts do not carry, and the clearing of exclusion screens that operate before fixity is even reached. Refuting the label as applied, by contrast, requires exactly one datum that public accounts and court filings routinely supply: the documented moment the belief released on contradiction. A record that contains that moment has falsified the vocabulary it uses, in the same document, with no outside evidence required. The commentary derives a verdict rule, refutation without diagnosis: the careful observer may describe what the record shows, may classify the pattern it displays, and may demonstrate what the record rules out, while asserting nothing about what any individual has. It closes with the cost of the borrowed word: a definitional expansion that pathologizes people whose injury was deceptive design, and that dilutes the diagnosis for the community living with diagnosed psychotic conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文论证，基于公开信息（新闻报道、自我报告、法庭文件）给特定个体贴上“妄想”或“精神病”标签的做法，在诊断标准自身的框架内即告失败，且这种失败具有不对称性：反驳标签只需一条证据（信念在矛盾面前被放弃的时刻），而确认标签在原则上不可能实现。
AI.research_question: 基于公开信息对特定个体进行精神病学诊断（尤其是“妄想”和“精神病”标签）在DSM-5-TR的诊断框架下是否成立？
AI.motivation: 实践中，新闻评论、法律倡导、积极诉讼中频繁使用“妄想”和“精神病”等诊断术语来描述公开人物，作者认为这种做法在诊断标准层面存在根本性问题，且可能造成对真正精神病患者群体的伤害。
AI.theoretical_framework: DSM-5-TR对“妄想”的定义（僵固性：信念在相反证据面前不可改变）、诊断的纵向审查要求、排除性筛查、以及症状学阴性/阳性区分。
AI.method: 概念分析与逻辑论证：基于诊断标准（DSM-5-TR）的内在逻辑，推导出确认标签与反驳标签在证据要求上的不对称性。
AI.findings: （1）确认妄想需要纵向记录、阴性症状证据、排除筛查等，公开信息无法提供；（2）反驳妄想只需一条证据：信念在矛盾面前被放弃的时刻，这恰好是公开记录中常见的内容；（3）由此得出“只有反驳、没有确认”的裁决规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了诊断逻辑中确认与反驳的不对称性；提出了“无诊断的反驳”（refutation without diagnosis）作为观察者的正确立场。
AI.practical_contributions: 警告滥用诊断术语的双重代价：扩大化定义将受欺骗性设计伤害的人病理化，同时稀释了对真正精神病患者群体的诊断意义。

title: Generative AI as an Inequality Amplifier: Language Compatibility, Leapfrogging and Productivity Growth
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics and

detail.title: Generative AI as an Inequality Amplifier: Language Compatibility, Leapfrogging and Productivity Growth
detail.abstract: We provide the first causal evidence that generative AI amplifies global inequality through linguistic compatibility with training data. Exploiting the November 2022 release of ChatGPT as a natural experiment across 169 economies, we find that a onestandard-deviation increase in Language Intensity-a country's linguistic compatibility with AI training data-raises productivity growth by 0.94 percentage points. This produces "linguistic leapfrogging": low-income but linguistically compatible economies-Ghana, Nigeria-match the gains of wealthy Anglophone nations, while high-income but incompatible economies like Japan see none. We conduct a controlled experiment to provide micro-foundations: across twelve languages, a generative AI tool delivers business decisions of lower economic value and higher cost as language resourcedness falls, and while a frontier model nearly closes the quality gap, the cost gap-fixed at the tokenizer-is structural and does not. A structural model of AI-augmented technology adoption, calibrated to our empirical estimate, projects these patterns forward and shows that multilingual AI development would cut the inequality cost of AI-driven growth by 59 percent. Our results challenge standard views of technology diffusion and reveal that AI introduces a new axis of global stratification along linguistic lines.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI通过语言兼容性加剧全球不平等：与训练数据语言匹配的经济体获得生产力增长红利，不匹配的经济体则被排除在外；多语言AI发展可降低59%的不平等成本。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI的语言兼容性如何影响全球经济增长的不平等？
AI.motivation: 现有研究关注AI对劳动力和生产力的影响，但忽视了AI训练数据语言偏向可能造成的全球分化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 语言兼容性理论、技术扩散理论、全球不平等理论、AI技术采纳模型
AI.method: 利用2022年11月ChatGPT发布作为自然实验，覆盖169个经济体；受控实验跨12种语言测试AI商业决策质量与成本；基于实证估计校准结构模型进行前瞻性预测。
AI.findings: 语言强度每提高一个标准差，生产率增长提升0.94个百分点；低收入的英语兼容经济体（如加纳、尼日利亚）与富裕英语国家获得同等收益，而高收入但不兼容经济体（如日本）无收益；语言资源越少，AI生成的商业决策经济价值越低、成本越高；前沿模型可缩小质量差距但无法缩小因分词器导致的固定成本差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供因果证据证明AI语言兼容性是全球不平等的新驱动力；挑战了技术扩散的"均等化"经典观点；揭示了语言成为全球分层的新维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多语言AI开发提供政策依据，研究表明可降低59%的AI增长不平等成本；提醒发展中国家关注自身语言在AI训练数据中的代表性。

title: Time Pressure, Distraction, and Vulnerability in Pedestrian Crossing Patterns at Signalized Intersections: A Latent Class Mixed Logit Analysis
affiliations: National Cheng Kung University, National Cheng Kung University, National Cheng Kung University and National Cheng Kung University

detail.title: Time Pressure, Distraction, and Vulnerability in Pedestrian Crossing Patterns at Signalized Intersections: A Latent Class Mixed Logit Analysis
detail.abstract: Pedestrian noncompliance at signalized intersections reflects diverse responses to time pressure, distraction, vulnerability, and context, not just rule violation. This study investigates behavioral heterogeneity in pedestrian crossing patterns at signalized intersections. Using multi-camera video observations of 7,215 pedestrian crossings at six intersections in Tainan, Taiwan, each crossing event was coded as one of five mutually exclusive patterns: jaywalking between the crosswalk and the stop line, jaywalking between the crosswalk and the curb extension, partial crosswalk use, incomplete crosswalk use, and full crosswalk use. A latent class mixed multinomial logit model was applied to examine how crosswalk design, pedestrian characteristics, distraction, signal violations, walking speed, and crossing time shape these patterns. The results identify two behaviorally interpretable groups: time-pressured pedestrians and vulnerable/risk-adjusting pedestrians. Time-pressured pedestrians are more strongly associated with signal timing constraints, distraction, running behavior, jaywalking, and incomplete crosswalk use. Vulnerable and risk-adjusting pedestrians, including more older adults, mobility-impaired pedestrians, and slower walkers, generally exhibit more cautious crossing behavior but may still deviate from the crosswalk because of physical or spatial constraints. Elasticity results show that failing to complete a crossing before the all-red phase increases the likelihood of jaywalking near the curb extension, while distraction-related behaviors increase the use of partial or incomplete crosswalks. These findings demonstrate that pedestrian crossing behavior is shaped by heterogeneous behavioral responses rather than uniform compliance tendencies. The results support behaviorally informed safety strategies that distinguish urgency-driven shortcutting, distraction-related path instability, and vulnerability-related risk adjustment, rather than relying on uniform compliance-based pedestrian management.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析台湾台南市6个路口的7215次行人过街行为，识别出两类异质性群体：时间压力型行人和弱势/风险调整型行人。研究发现，行人违规行为并非统一的规则违反，而是受时间压力、分心、脆弱性和空间约束等因素驱动的多样化行为反应。
AI.research_question: 行人过街行为异质性如何体现在不同类型的违规模式中？时间压力、分心、脆弱性和环境约束如何塑造行人的过街路径选择？
AI.motivation: 传统视角常将行人违规简单视为规则违反，忽视了行人行为背后的异质性动机（如时间压力、分心、身体限制等）。研究旨在揭示行为异质性，为差异化的安全管理策略提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 潜在类别混合多项Logit模型；行人行为异质性理论（区分时间压力型与脆弱/风险调整型）
AI.method: 多摄像头视频观测收集7215次行人过街数据；编码五种互斥过街模式（跨街违规、部分使用人行横道、不完全使用人行横道等）；运用潜在类别混合多项Logit模型分析
AI.findings: 识别出两类行为群体：时间压力型行人（与信号时间限制、分心、奔跑、违规和不完全使用横道强相关）和脆弱/风险调整型行人（老年人、行动不便者、慢速行人，行为更谨慎但会因物理空间约束偏离横道）；未能在全红相位前完成过街会显著增加路缘延长线附近违规概率；分心行为增加部分或不完全使用横道的概率
AI.theory_contributions: 将行人违规行为从统一的"合规"框架转变为异质性行为反应框架，区分了时间压力驱动、分心驱动和脆弱性驱动三种行为机制
AI.practical_contributions: 提出基于行为的差异化安全策略：区分急迫型抄近路、分心型路径不稳定和脆弱型风险调整，而非依赖统一的合规管理模式

title: Beyond Disclosure: An Epistemic Compliance Standard for AI-Assisted Legal Guidance
affiliations: Catholic University of Lille

detail.title: Beyond Disclosure: An Epistemic Compliance Standard for AI-Assisted Legal Guidance
detail.abstract: Millions of individuals navigate legal proceedings without professional representation. Large language model (LLM) tools have emerged as a scalable response to this structural gap, deployed by legal aid organisations, court services, and civil society across the EU and beyond. Yet these tools routinely produce outputs that are unverifiable, unsituated, and opaque, creating harms that are not merely technical failures but epistemic ones: they deprive users of the capacity to assess, challenge, or act meaningfully on what they have been told. The EU AI Act imposes transparency, explainability, and human oversight obligations on these tools. But those obligations, as currently formulated and interpreted, address surface-level disclosure rather than the deeper epistemic access needs of vulnerable users. No existing scholarship or regulatory guidance has translated the Act's requirements into operational standards specifically designed for access-to-justice (A2J) LLM tools. Building on the epistemic accessibility framework developed by Ferraris and Giacalone [16], this paper proposes an epistemic compliance standard comprising three components: source-grounded output requirements, situated plain-language adaptation, and user-facing explainability obligations. These components are grounded in Articles 13, 14, 50, and 86 of the AI Act and are interpreted purposively for the A2J deployment context. The paper argues that the gap between formal AI Act compliance and genuine epistemic compliance is where structural injustice in AI-assisted legal guidance currently lives, and that closing this gap requires design-level obligations on developers and deployers, not just outcome-level accommodations by courts.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM工具在无律师代理的法律场景中造成的认识论伤害，提出基于欧盟AI法案的认识论合规标准，要求工具提供可溯源、情境化、可解释的输出。
AI.research_question: 如何将欧盟AI法案的透明度、可解释性和人工监督义务，转化为针对司法救助场景中LLM工具的操作性认识论合规标准？
AI.motivation: 数百万人在没有律师代理的情况下处理法律事务，LLM工具虽被广泛部署却产生无法验证、脱离情境、不透明的输出，造成认识论层面的伤害——用户无法评估、质疑或有效利用所获信息。现有欧盟AI法案的义务停留在表面披露层面，未解决弱势用户的深层认识论访问需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: Ferraris和Giacalone提出的"认识论可及性"框架；欧盟AI法案第13、14、50、86条；结构性不正义理论。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，结合AI法案条款的目的性解释，将理论框架转化为操作性合规标准。
AI.findings: 提出了认识论合规标准的三项核心部件：(1) 基于来源的输出要求；(2) 情境化的通俗语言适配；(3) 面向用户的可解释性义务。形式合规与实质认识论合规之间的差距，正是AI辅助法律指导中结构性不正义的所在。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将认识论可及性框架系统性地应用于AI法案的合规解释，揭示了"形式合规"与"认识论合规"之间的理论区分，并将其与结构性不正义理论相关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律科技开发者、法院服务机构和法律援助组织提供了可操作的设计级义务标准，将合规要求从"结果层面的法院适应"转变为"设计层面的开发者义务"。

title: Not Walking the Walk: An Experimental Test of Gender Effects, Social Desirability Bias and Compliance across Nine Countries
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania, , World Bank and

detail.title: Not Walking the Walk: An Experimental Test of Gender Effects, Social Desirability Bias and Compliance across Nine Countries
detail.abstract: A literature documenting how women complied more than men with public policy recommendations emerged during the COVID-19 pandemic. However, self-reported compliance measures are susceptible to Social Desirability Bias (SDB), which may inflate reported gender differences. We use data from over 11,000 survey respondents in nine countries and three continents, with representative samples balanced by gender and age at the country level. Consistent with previous findings, we observe that women self-report significantly higher compliance than men, both before and after the introduction of confinement measures, across all expectation levels and in every continent. We then analyze compliance in a vignette experiment conducted with the same sample, employing a 2×2 factorial design that manipulates empirical and normative expectations about compliance in reference groups. In the vignette, female participants do not comply more than male participants-and comply less when expectations are low. Our results suggest that the widely documented gender effect in compliance may be substantially driven by the methodological approach employed: the gender-specific SDB that is evident in self-reported measures does not survive when an indirect measurement approach is used. These findings highlight the importance of methodological choices in studies of compliance, as reliance on selfreports alone may overestimate gender differences.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比自我报告和间接实验测量方法，发现COVID-19疫情期间女性比男性更遵守公共政策的现象可能被社会期望偏差（SDB）所夸大，在间接测量方法下性别差异不再显著。
AI.research_question: 自我报告的合规性测量中的社会期望偏差（SDB）是否夸大了COVID-19疫情期间女性比男性更遵守公共政策的性别差异？
AI.motivation: 已有文献广泛发现女性在疫情期间比男性更遵守公共政策建议，但这些研究多依赖自我报告数据，容易受到社会期望偏差的影响。本文旨在检验这种性别差异是否源于方法论偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会期望偏差理论；性别角色理论（女性可能面临更强的社会期望去表现出合规行为）；以及基于期望的合规行为理论（实证期望与规范期望）。
AI.method: 在9个国家三大洲收集超过11,000名受访者数据，样本在性别和年龄上具有代表性。先使用自我报告测量合规性，再采用2×2因子设计的场景实验（vignette experiment），操纵参考群体的实证期望和规范期望，通过间接测量方式评估合规性。
AI.findings: 自我报告测量中，女性显著比男性更遵守政策，且这一差异在所有预期水平和大洲均存在。但在场景实验中，女性并未表现出比男性更高的合规性，反而在期望较低时合规性更低。这表明自我报告中的性别差异主要由社会期望偏差驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了性别与合规行为关系中的方法论效应，指出社会期望偏差可能系统性地夸大性别差异，挑战了以往研究中关于"女性更合规"的定论。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者和研究者提出警示：依赖自我报告测量合规性可能高估性别差异，建议采用间接测量方法（如场景实验）以获得更准确的结论，避免基于偏误数据制定差异化政策。

title: GEPI: The Global Economic Power Index: Currency Alignment, Economic Complexity, and the Nominal-PPP Gap

detail.title: GEPI: The Global Economic Power Index: Currency Alignment, Economic Complexity, and the Nominal-PPP Gap

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA. Independent research
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA. Independent research.
declarations.funderStatement: NA. Independent research

detail.abstract:
A software engineer in Bangalore can be comfortably middle-class at home and abruptly constrained the moment she pays foreign tuition, books an international flight, or saves in a currency that holds value abroad. The same income, measured at domestic prices versus at the market exchange rate, tells two different stories, and for the typical country the gap is large: nominal income is worth only about 40 cents on the PPP dollar in global terms.

This paper introduces GEPI, the Global Economic Power Index, as a single ratio that captures that gap: GDP per capita at nominal exchange rates divided by GDP per capita at purchasing power parity, computed for 134 countries from 2024 World Bank data. GEPI is mathematically the inverse of the price-level ratio long buried in International Comparison Program tables; the contribution is the reframing, turning a technical macro statistic into an accessible, country-level measure of how well domestic wealth survives translation into global purchasing power.

The distribution is sharply right-skewed: only Switzerland exceeds parity, the United States and Israel approach it, and most countries sit far below. The paper sorts countries into a six-band classification, from Aligned to Deeply Discounted, and pairs GEPI with the Harvard economic complexity index (ECI), with which it is moderately correlated (r = 0.52) but non-redundant: monetary regime, currency strategy, resource structure, and geopolitical position each move a country independently of its complexity.

A secondary and deliberately caveated observation is that, in the 2024 cross-section, GEPI co-moves with Harvard Growth Lab projected growth where ECI does not. This is offered as descriptive context, not as a finding. The projection is a convergence-based forecast that weights income heavily, and GEPI proxies that income axis through the Penn effect, so the association is largely mechanical; no causal or predictive claim is made, and demonstrating one would require a multi-year panel.

The framing matters because the nominal-PPP gap has become individually consequential, not merely a macroeconomic abstraction. Five application domains follow directly: remote-work arbitrage, the international-education burden, corporate cost positioning, migration and remittances, and sovereign-risk screening.

AI.tldr: 本文提出全球经济实力指数（GEPI），即名义汇率GDP per capita与购买力平价GDP per capita之比，用以衡量国内财富转化为全球购买力时的折扣程度。基于134个国家2024年数据，发现分布高度右偏，仅瑞士超过平价，多数国家远低于平价。论文将GEPI与经济复杂度指数（ECI）配对比较，并探讨其在远程工作套利、国际教育负担、企业成本定位、移民汇款和主权风险筛查等五个领域的应用。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个简洁、可理解的单一指标，来量化名义汇率与购买力平价之间的国民收入差距，并衡量国内财富在转化为全球购买力时的实际价值？
AI.motivation: 名义汇率衡量的收入与购买力平价衡量的收入之间存在巨大差距（典型国家名义收入仅值PPP美元的40美分），这一差距对个人（如留学、国际旅行、跨境储蓄）和企业（如远程工作套利、成本定位）均有重要影响，但缺乏一个直观的国家级衡量指标来捕捉这一差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: GEPI是价格水平比率的数学逆运算；宾大效应（Penn effect）解释了名义收入与PPP收入之间的系统性偏离；与经济复杂度指数（ECI）的相关性分析（r=0.52）显示两者中度相关但非冗余。
AI.method: 基于2024年世界银行134个国家的数据，计算名义汇率GDP per capita与PPP GDP per capita的比率（GEPI）；采用六等级分类法（从"对齐"到"深度折扣"）；与哈佛经济复杂度指数（ECI）进行相关性分析。
AI.findings: GEPI分布高度右偏，仅瑞士超过平价，美国和以色列接近平价，大多数国家远低于平价；GEPI与ECI中度相关（r=0.52）但非冗余；在2024年横截面上，GEPI与哈佛增长实验室的预期增长存在共变关系（但这一关系被谨慎地视为描述性观察而非因果发现）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将长期埋没在国际比较项目表格中的价格水平比率重新框架化为一个直观的国家级指标（GEPI），将技术性宏观统计转化为可理解的"国内财富在全球购买力中的折扣率"。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出GEPI在五个应用领域的使用：远程工作套利、国际教育负担评估、企业成本定位、移民与汇款决策、主权风险筛查；为个人和企业提供了衡量跨境购买力差距的实用工具。

title: Epidemiological Assessment of Cassava Mosaic Disease in the Southwest of the Democratic Republic of Congo
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, National Pedagogical University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Université Félix Houphouët-Boigny and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Epidemiological Assessment of Cassava Mosaic Disease in the Southwest of the Democratic Republic of Congo
detail.abstract: In the Democratic Republic of Congo (DR Congo), Cassava Mosaic Disease (CMD) is a major constraint for cassava production. It is caused by begomoviruses and transmitted both by whiteflies and infected cuttings. A two-year surveys (2020 and 2022) conducted across seven provinces in south-western DRC revealed a high and persistent average incidence (42-43%) and moderate severity (3.5) of CMD, with infected cuttings identified as the principal mode of transmission (98.9-100%). Molecular analyses revealed the dominant status of African cassava mosaic virus (ACMV) and East African cassava mosaic virus (EACMV), an increase in ACMV and EACMV co-infections from 2020 to 2022. PCR analysis using universal begomovirus primers revealed amplification patterns distinct from ACMV and EACMV in 8.98% of symptomatic samples, suggesting the possible presence of uncharacterized viral variants that warrant sequencing. These results validate that CMD constitutes a substantial phytosanitary challenge, highlighting the necessity to elevate producer awareness regarding agronomic practices and to establish a regional epidemiological surveillance system to anticipate viral evolution and strengthen the resilience of cassava production.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过在刚果民主共和国西南部七省2020和2022年的调查，发现木薯花叶病平均发病率高达42-43%，严重度为3.5，主要传播途径为受感染的插条（98.9-100%）。分子分析显示非洲木薯花叶病毒（ACMV）和东非木薯花叶病毒（EACMV）占主导地位，且共感染率从2020年到2022年有所增加。8.98%的症状样本出现了不同于ACMV和EACMV的扩增模式，提示可能存在未表征的病毒变体。研究强调需提高生产者对农艺实践的认识，并建立区域性流行病学监测系统。
AI.research_question: 刚果民主共和国西南部地区木薯花叶病的发病率、严重度、传播方式及病毒分子特征如何？是否存在未表征的病毒变体？
AI.motivation: 木薯花叶病严重制约刚果民主共和国的木薯生产，但对该地区该病害的流行状况、传播途径和病毒多样性缺乏系统性认识，亟需为病害防控提供科学依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 植物病毒学、分子流行病学、植物病害流行学
AI.method: 2020年和2022年两年田间调查（覆盖七省），评估发病率和严重度；分子分析（PCR检测）鉴定病毒种类及共感染情况；使用通用菜豆金色花叶病毒属引物进行扩增分析。
AI.findings: （1）CMD平均发病率维持高位（42-43%），严重度为中等（3.5）；（2）受感染插条是主要传播途径（98.9-100%）；（3）ACMV和EACMV为优势病毒，且两者共感染率从2020年到2022年增加；（4）8.98%症状样本出现不同于ACMV和EACMV的PCR扩增模式，提示可能存在未表征的病毒变体。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了刚果民主共和国西南部地区CMD的流行动态和病毒种群变化趋势，发现了可能存在的未表征病毒变体，为理解该地区CMD病毒进化提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 明确了受感染插条是主要传播途径，为推广无病毒种植材料提供了依据；建议提高生产者对农艺实践的认识，并建立区域性流行病学监测系统以增强木薯生产的韧性。

title: Calibration and Forecast Accuracy of Macroeconomic Prediction Markets: Evidence from Kalshi, 2025-2026
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: Calibration and Forecast Accuracy of Macroeconomic Prediction Markets: Evidence from Kalshi, 2025-2026
detail.abstract: This paper examines the calibration and forecast accuracy of Kalshi prediction markets for major U.S. macroeconomic announcements during the 2025-June 2026 period. Using a dataset of 594 unique markets and 1,860 observations across nine economic series, I evaluate whether these markets produce well-calibrated probability estimates and identify which macroeconomic indicators are easiest and hardest to predict. The overall Brier score is 0.0987, representing a 60.5% improvement over random guessing. Calibration quality varies across series: Federal Funds Rate markets achieve near-perfect calibration (Brier: 0.0001), while Unemployment Rate markets show the poorest calibration (Brier: 0.1302). The 1-hour horizon produces the best calibration (Brier: 0.0812), while the 30-day horizon produces the worst (Brier: 0.1587). Markets exhibit systematic overconfidence across the probability spectrum, with predicted probabilities consistently exceeding observed frequencies at the extremes. Longshots priced below $0.30 have a bias of-0.0721 (p < 0.001), indicating that low-probability contracts are significantly overpriced. These findings suggest that Kalshi macroeconomic prediction markets provide valuable real-time probabilistic forecasts, though calibration quality varies systematically across series, with Federal Funds markets being exceptionally accurate and labor markets being the most difficult to forecast.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2025年至2026年6月期间Kalshi预测市场对美国主要宏观经济公告的校准和预测准确性，发现整体Brier分数为0.0987，比随机猜测改善60.5%，其中联邦基金利率市场校准近乎完美，而失业率市场校准最差。
AI.research_question: Kalshi预测市场对美国主要宏观经济公告的校准质量和预测准确性如何？哪些宏观经济指标最容易预测，哪些最难预测？
AI.motivation: 预测市场作为实时概率预测工具的价值日益凸显，但针对宏观经济公告的校准质量缺乏系统性的实证评估，特别是Kalshi这一新兴预测平台。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预测市场有效性理论、概率校准理论、Brier分数评估框架
AI.method: 基于594个独特市场、1,860个观测值的九大经济序列数据集，使用Brier分数评估校准质量，分析不同时间窗口（1小时至30天）和不同概率区间的预测偏差。
AI.findings: 整体Brier分数0.0987（比随机猜测改善60.5%）；联邦基金利率市场校准最佳（Brier: 0.0001），失业率市场最差（Brier: 0.1302）；1小时窗口校准最佳（Brier: 0.0812），30天窗口最差（Brier: 0.1587）；市场在极端概率区间存在系统性过度自信；低价合约（低于$0.30）偏差为-0.0721（p<0.001），显著高估。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地验证了预测市场在不同宏观经济序列上的校准差异，揭示了预测时间窗口对校准质量的影响规律，以及极端概率区间的系统性偏差模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供了Kalshi预测市场校准质量的量化证据；指出联邦基金利率预测市场可作为高精度参考工具，而劳动力市场预测需谨慎使用；提示交易者注意短期预测窗口和极端概率区间的偏差风险。

title: Beyond Synthetic Data: Synergistic Generative Augmentation and Ensemble Refinement for Medical Image Processing
affiliations: Imperial College London, Imperial College London and University of Surrey

detail.title: Beyond Synthetic Data: Synergistic Generative Augmentation and Ensemble Refinement for Medical Image Processing
detail.abstract: Deep learning for medical image classification and segmentation is often limited by scarce and imbalanced annotations, particularly for pixel-level supervision. We propose SSGNet++, a unified framework that integrates class-specific generative augmentation with iterative semi-supervised learning for data-efficient medical image analysis.SSGNet++ employs class-conditional StyleGAN3 models to expand the training distribution and incorporates synthetic images via iterative pseudo-label refinement. We systematically analyse how ensemble diversity and refinement strategies influence pseudo-label quality and downstream performance, studying multi-base and multihead architectures together with edge-aware refinement and transductive feature-space propagation.Experiments on multiple public medical imaging benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements across both classification and segmentation tasks. Results show that ensemble diversity improves prediction stability, while refinement enhances spatial coherence of segmentation outputs. Overall, SSGNet++ provides an effective and extensible framework for learning under limited supervision. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/sebastianotstan/SSGNet-plusplus.

AI.tldr: SSGNet++是一个统一框架，结合类别特定生成式增强与迭代半监督学习，有效解决了医学图像分析中标注稀缺和不平衡的问题，在分类和分割任务上均取得一致改进。
AI.research_question: 如何在标注稀缺且类别不平衡的医学图像数据中，有效提升图像分类与分割的性能？
AI.motivation: 深度学习在医学图像分类与分割中常受限于稀缺且不平衡的标注数据，尤其像素级标注更为困难，亟需一种数据高效的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 类别条件生成式增强（class-conditional generative augmentation）2. 迭代半监督学习（iterative semi-supervised learning）3. 集成多样性（ensemble diversity）4. 边缘感知细化（edge-aware refinement）5. 直推式特征空间传播（transductive feature-space propagation）
AI.method: 提出SSGNet++统一框架，使用类别条件StyleGAN3模型扩展训练分布，结合迭代伪标签细化集成合成图像；系统分析集成多样性（多基座与多头架构）和细化策略（边缘感知细化与直推式特征传播）对伪标签质量的影响。
AI.findings: 在多个公开医学影像基准上，SSGNet++在分类和分割任务上均取得一致改进；集成多样性提升了预测稳定性，细化策略增强了分割输出的空间连贯性。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了集成多样性与细化策略对伪标签质量及下游性能的影响机制，为生成式增强与半监督学习的结合提供了理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个统一、可扩展且在有限标注下有效的医学图像分析框架，并公开了源代码（https://github.com/sebastianotstan/SSGNet-plusplus），便于实际应用与复现。

reference: Banco de Espana Working Paper No. 2541
title: The origins of top firms
affiliations: Centre for Monetary and Financial Studies (CEMFI) and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The origins of top firms

publicationDetails.detailsText: Banco de Espana Working Paper No. 2541
publicationDetails.journalName: Banco de Espana Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: What are the origins of top firms? What features characterize their life cycle trajectories on the way to the top? Using longitudinal firm-level data, we document novel facts about the first twenty years of the firms that reach the top 1 percent of the size distribution. Compared to the firms in the bottom 99 percent, top firms are eight times larger at entry and grow six times more during their first two decades. In terms of inputs, they start with high capital investments, yet their capital-output ratio and labor share decline as they age. As a result, their profit share is much more backloaded towards the second decade of their life cycle. We show that a firm dynamics model with ex-ante heterogeneity, non-homothetic input costs, and forward-looking financing can explain these empirical patterns. Our quantitative results showcase the importance of accounting for top and bottom firm dynamics for the aggregate implications of financial frictions, recent macroeconomic trends, and corporate taxation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了顶级企业的起源及其生命周期特征。相比底层99%的企业，顶级企业进入时规模大8倍，前20年增长快6倍；它们初始资本投入高，但资本产出比和劳动份额随年龄下降，利润份额集中在第二个十年。一个包含事前异质性、非齐次投入成本和前瞻性融资的企业动态模型可以解释这些现象。
AI.research_question: 顶级企业（规模分布前1%）的起源是什么？它们的生命周期轨迹有哪些特征？
AI.motivation: 理解顶级企业的起源和成长轨迹，对于解释宏观经济趋势、金融摩擦的影响以及公司税收政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业动态模型，包含事前异质性、非齐次投入成本和前瞻性融资
AI.method: 使用纵向企业层面数据，对比顶级企业（前1%）与底层99%企业在进入规模、增长率、资本投入、劳动份额和利润份额等方面的差异，并构建结构模型进行定量分析。
AI.findings: 顶级企业进入时规模是底层企业的8倍；前20年增长率是底层企业的6倍；初始资本投入高，但资本产出比和劳动份额随年龄下降；利润份额高度集中在生命周期的第二个十年。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个能够解释顶级企业与底层企业生命周期模式差异的统一理论框架，揭示了事前异质性、非齐次投入成本和融资约束在企业动态中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解金融摩擦的宏观影响、解释近期宏观经济趋势以及评估公司税收政策提供了量化依据，强调了区分顶级企业与底层企业动态的重要性。

title: Role of Community Participation on Drought-Risk-Management in Digaale IDP, Hargeisa, Somaliland
affiliations: University of Hargeisa and University of Hargeisa

detail.title: Role of Community Participation on Drought-Risk-Management in Digaale IDP, Hargeisa, Somaliland
detail.abstract: Drought remains the most pervasive hazard in Somaliland, affecting millions and threatening food security, public health, and migration patterns. Despite its frequency and intensity, the impact of community participation on household drought-risk management in internally displaced person (IDP) settings like Digaale remains poorly understood. This study investigates how four facets of community participation—traditional governance, external NGO support, gender dynamics, and resource accessibility—relate to household preparedness, response speed, and perceived aid equity in Digaale IDP settlement. Using a descriptive cross-sectional research design, 270 households were sampled through systematic random sampling from a total of 715 households. The study employed structured questionnaires and a combination of descriptive statistics, chi-square tests, and ANOVA to analyze the data. Key findings show that while community participation in meetings and trust in elders is widespread, the study found no significant statistical relationship between education level, livelihood type, or NGO participation and key drought management outcomes like preparedness and response speed. The analysis suggests that although community participation structures are present and valued, their practical effects on disaster preparedness and response timeliness are limited by resource constraints and institutional bottlenecks.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了索马里兰Digaale境内流离失所者安置点社区参与对家庭干旱风险管理的影响。尽管社区参与结构普遍存在且受重视，但教育水平、生计类型或NGO参与等与备灾和响应速度等关键成果之间并无显著统计关系。社区参与的实际效果受制于资源约束和制度瓶颈。
AI.research_question: 在索马里兰Digaale境内流离失所者（IDP）安置点，社区参与的四个维度（传统治理、外部NGO支持、性别动态、资源可及性）与家庭备灾水平、响应速度及感知的援助公平性之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 干旱是索马里兰最普遍的自然灾害，但社区参与在IDP安置点这类特殊环境中对干旱风险管理的影响尚不明确，现有研究对此关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社区参与理论、灾害风险管理框架、参与式治理理论
AI.method: 描述性横截面研究设计，采用系统随机抽样从715户中抽取270户，通过结构化问卷调查收集数据，运用描述性统计、卡方检验和方差分析（ANOVA）进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 社区参与会议和信任长老的现象较为普遍，但教育水平、生计类型或NGO参与度与备灾水平、响应速度等关键干旱管理成果之间不存在显著统计关系。社区参与结构虽然存在并被重视，但其实际效果受资源约束和制度瓶颈限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在高度资源受限的IDP安置点环境中，社区参与理论的实际适用边界——即社区参与结构的存在并不必然转化为有效的灾害管理成效，丰富了对参与式治理在极端脆弱情境下有效性的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为索马里兰及类似脆弱环境中的政策制定者和人道主义机构提供了实证依据：单纯建立社区参与结构不足以提高干旱备灾能力，必须同时解决资源约束和制度瓶颈问题。

title: The Misleading Anthropomorphism Trap: Addressing Public Distrust and Mental Health Risks in AI

detail.title: The Misleading Anthropomorphism Trap: Addressing Public Distrust and Mental Health Risks in AI
detail.abstract: Large language model (LLM) chat interfaces are increasingly designed to default to a warm, human-like conversational register. This working paper argues that this design choice creates a systematic capability mismatch, misleading anthropomorphism, with two convergent consequences. For vulnerable users, the anthropomorphic persona invites users to treat the chatbot as a person, and combined with sycophantic amplification, this can drive delusional spiralling and psychiatric harm. For the general user population, the same mismatch may inflate expectations beyond architectural capacity, contributing to a cycle of overtrust and trust collapse that may fuel anti-AI sentiment. Drawing on the author's earlier empirical work on the capability-alignment principle, the paper synthesises emerging clinical, computational, and empirical evidence to argue that de-anthropomorphising LLM interfaces (making them transparently machine-like by default) addresses both pathways simultaneously. A concrete design framework, machine-first interaction, is proposed, together with testable predictions and stakeholder-specific recommendations.

AI.tldr: 本文论证：大语言模型聊天界面默认采用拟人化温暖语气，会造成能力错配（误导性拟人化），对脆弱用户导致精神伤害，对普通用户引发信任循环崩溃；提出"机器优先交互"设计框架作为解决方案。
AI.research_question: LLM聊天界面的拟人化默认设计会产生哪些系统性有害后果？如何通过去拟人化设计来缓解这些问题？
AI.motivation: 当前LLM聊天界面普遍默认采用温暖、类人的对话语气，但这种设计选择可能造成系统性的能力错配，带来从精神健康到公众信任的一系列风险，亟需理论分析和设计纠正。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能力-对齐原则（capability-alignment principle）；误导性拟人化（misleading anthropomorphism）；谄媚放大效应（sycophantic amplification）；过度信任与信任崩溃循环（overtrust and trust collapse cycle）
AI.method: 综合已有的临床、计算和实证证据进行理论综合与概念分析，提出设计框架和可检验预测。
AI.findings: 拟人化设计通过两条路径产生危害：(1)对脆弱用户，拟人化人格诱使用户将其当作人，结合谄媚放大效应，导致妄想螺旋和精神伤害；(2)对普通用户，抬高预期超出架构能力，引发过度信任后信任崩溃，可能助长反AI情绪。去拟人化（默认透明机器化）可同时缓解两条路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 将拟人化设计问题系统化地纳入"能力-对齐"理论框架，揭示拟人化与谄媚效应联合作用的精神健康风险机制，提出信任动态的双路径模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"机器优先交互"具体设计框架，为平台、监管者和临床工作者提供可操作的建议和可检验的预测。

title: Extractable Memorization From First Principles
affiliations: Yale University, Google Research, Google DeepMind, Cornell University, Cornell University - Department of Computer Science, Stanford Law School, Stanford Law School and Stanford University - Department of Computer Science

detail.title: Extractable Memorization From First Principles
detail.abstract: Recent work on extractable memorization in language models suffers from two contrasting validity problems. Some studies overstate extraction due to tests that don't adequately support the claim, e.g., relying on sequences too short to distinguish memorization from predictability or leaking the target directly in the prompt. Others imply that extraction is unreliable evidence of memorization at all, since models can also reproduce real-world text they weren't explicitly trained on. In different ways and to different degrees, both overlook what makes a valid extraction claim: the model must generate a training sequence with high enough probability to indicate memorization. To determine what's high enough, one has to perform a matched comparison: measuring the generation probabilities of both the training sequences of interest and comparable non-training sequences. Because non-training sequences cannot have been memorized, their probabilities provide a baseline for predictability, and a training sequence exceeding this baseline provides evidence of memorization. We formalize matched comparisons in two ways: (1) a conformal test that calibrates a threshold to a chosen false-positive rate when training and non-training sequences are sampled from populations, and (2) a census that calibrates against a matched non-training document when the object is a single document (e.g., a specific book). Our experiments show that matched comparisons enable rigorous, calibrated memorization claims, and reveal where prior setups have validity issues. For instance, on Wikipedia OLMo 2 32B reproduces non-training 10-token suffixes roughly 24% as often as training ones: that share of the training generation rate reflects false positives, not memorization. For Llama 3.1 70B on books, the thresholds we calibrate are as low as 10^(-27) , supporting memorization claims for sequences that no feasible sampling budget would extract. Based on these results, we refine "extractable memorization" to require both a valid memorization claim and near-certain generation within a realistic budget.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前关于语言模型可提取记忆的研究存在两种效度问题：一是高估记忆（测试设计不当），二是低估记忆（认为提取不可靠）。作者提出"匹配比较"方法，通过对比训练序列与非训练序列的生成概率来校准记忆阈值，并给出了两种形式化方案（共形检验和普查法）。实验表明该方法能实现严格、校准的记忆声明，并揭示了先前设置的效度问题。
AI.research_question: 如何有效且严谨地判断语言模型是否"记忆"了训练数据？当前"可提取记忆"研究存在哪些效度问题？
AI.motivation: 现有关于语言模型可提取记忆的研究存在两种相互矛盾的效度问题：一些研究因测试设计不当（如序列过短、提示中泄露目标）而高估了记忆提取；另一些研究则认为提取不能作为记忆的可靠证据，因为模型也能复现未训练过的真实文本。两种观点都以不同方式忽略了有效提取声明的核心条件——模型必须以足够高的概率生成训练序列以表明记忆。
AI.theoretical_framework: 匹配比较框架：通过对比训练序列与非训练序列的生成概率，以非训练序列的概率作为可预测性基线，超过基线的训练序列才提供记忆证据。两种形式化方法：(1) 共形检验（conformal test），校准假阳性率阈值；(2) 普查法（census），针对单个文档进行匹配校准。
AI.method: 形式化匹配比较框架，分为共形检验（从总体层面校准阈值）和普查法（针对单个文档进行匹配）。在Wikipedia和书籍数据集上对OLMo 2 32B和Llama 3.1 70B等模型进行实验验证。
AI.findings: (1) 匹配比较能够实现严格、校准的记忆声明；(2) 在Wikipedia上，OLMo 2 32B复现非训练10-token后缀的频率约为训练后缀的24%，这部分"训练生成率"实际上是假阳性，而非记忆；(3) 对于Llama 3.1 70B在书籍上的阈值可低至10^(-27)，支持那些即使在实际采样预算下也无法提取的序列的记忆声明。基于结果，作者细化了"可提取记忆"的定义，要求同时具备有效的记忆声明和在现实预算内近乎确定的生成能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"匹配比较"的形式化框架来区分记忆与可预测性，解决了现有研究中关于可提取记忆的效度争议；细化了"可提取记忆"概念，要求同时满足有效记忆声明和实际可提取性两个条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估语言模型记忆训练数据提供了可操作的方法论，帮助研究者避免高估或低估记忆；为模型审计和隐私风险评估提供了更严谨的校准工具。

title: Is any job better than no job? Systematic review and meta-analysis of the effects of transitions from unemployment into paid employment on health
affiliations: University of Glasgow, University of Glasgow, University of Glasgow, University of Glasgow, University of Glasgow, University of Glasgow, Cardiff University, University of Glasgow, University of Glasgow, University of Glasgow, University of Glasgow - MRC/CSO Social and Public Health Sciences Unit and University of Glasgow - Institute of Health and Wellbeing

detail.title: Is any job better than no job? Systematic review and meta-analysis of the effects of transitions from unemployment into paid employment on health

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None declared
declarations.funderStatement: Medical Research Council, European Research Council, National Institute for Health and Care Research

detail.abstract:
Background: Unemployment has adverse health consequences, but it is unclear if low quality jobs are better than remaining out of work. We conducted a systematic review to assess the health impacts of moving from being non-employed to paid employment of differing job quality levels.

Methods: We searched MEDLINE, PsycINFO, Web of Science (Social Sciences Citation Index (SSCI)) and EconLit for quantitative randomised and non-randomised studies from inception (PROSPERO registration: CRD420250635911). Two reviewers independently identified studies assessing transitions from being non-employed (unemployed/out-of-work disabled/long-term sick) to higher vs lower quality jobs among working age populations. We critically appraised studies using Cochrane risk of bias (RoB) tools and conducted synthesis without meta-analysis based on effect direction and random-effects meta-analyses. Certainty was assessed using the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) framework.

Findings: Of 7,575 studies screened, 23 papers were included, all from high-income countries. High job quality was beneficial for health across outcomes compared to staying unemployed; for example, mental health improved by a standardized mean difference (SMD) of 0.35 (95% CI: 0.23 to 0.47). Low job quality compared to staying unemployed was associated with null or negative effects for mental health (SMD -0.01, 95% CI: -0.26 to 0.25), life satisfaction and biomarkers. It showed slightly positive effects for physical health and self-rated health. Risk of bias was high or very high for most studies and GRADE certainty was very low.  

Interpretation: Moving from unemployment to high job quality is associated with substantial health improvements, while moving to low quality jobs showed no clear effect across health outcomes. Despite the limited evidence base, prioritising access to employment with high job quality within employment policy may yield substantial health benefits.

AI.tldr: 系统综述发现，从失业到高质量就业能显著改善健康（如心理健康SMD=0.35），而低质量就业与失业相比没有明显健康益处，甚至对心理健康有负面影响。政策应优先创造高质量就业机会。
AI.research_question: 从非就业（失业/残障/长期病假）转向不同质量水平的就业，对健康有何影响？
AI.motivation: 已知失业对健康有害，但低质量工作是否比不工作更好尚不明确。本研究旨在系统评估不同工作质量对健康的差异化影响，为就业政策提供证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作质量与健康关系的理论框架，基于就业状态转变（非就业→就业）对健康结果的差异性影响假设。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析。检索MEDLINE、PsycINFO、Web of Science (SSCI)和EconLit，纳入定量随机/非随机研究。双人独立筛选、偏倚风险评估（Cochrane RoB工具）、效应方向合成及随机效应荟萃分析，采用GRADE评估证据确定性。
AI.findings: 纳入23篇论文（均来自高收入国家）。高质量就业能显著改善健康（心理健康SMD=0.35, 95%CI: 0.23-0.47）；低质量就业对心理健康无显著影响（SMD=-0.01, 95%CI: -0.26-0.25），对生活满意度和生物标志物呈无效或负向效应，对身体和自评健康有轻微正向效应。多数研究偏倚风险高/非常高，GRADE确定性极低。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了"工作质量"是影响就业与健康关系的关键调节变量，挑战了"任何工作都比失业好"的传统假设，细化了就业状态转变的健康效应理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为就业政策和公共卫生决策提供依据：应优先创造和推广高质量就业机会，而非单纯追求就业率；低质量工作可能无法带来健康收益，甚至有害。

title: Indecent Exposure And The Court As Custos Morum

detail.title: Indecent Exposure And The Court As Custos Morum
detail.abstract:
Indecent exposure has been a crime in America since colonial times. These laws are a cornerstone of government regulation of morals in America, sharing a common history with the jurisprudence of religion, obscenity, marriage, and sexual relations. The first reported case in English common law is a widely acknowledged source of American moral jurisprudence justifying the courts’ role as custos morum, or custodian of morals.

The state interests protected by indecent exposure laws are the prevention of public behaviors contrary to the prevailing moral order, often referred to as evil examples, and the protection of the public from offense, annoyance, or alarm. The scope, credibility, and effectiveness of these laws have diminished amid changing demographics, the decline of Christianity as the dominant moral authority in America, and advances in media technology.

These changes have left nuisance as the only state interest supporting indecent exposure laws in most jurisdictions. This dependence on nuisance theory is evident in audience-focused definitions of the crime in most state statutes. Trends in U.S. Supreme Court doctrine are weakening this remaining justification, raising questions about the laws’ continuing viability as currently structured.

Academics, politicians, and legal scholars have largely overlooked indecent exposure laws, despite their central role in government regulation of morals. Lack of historical understanding has created confusion, fostering misinterpretation of precedents and reinvention of fundamental concepts that inhibit coherent policies for societal management of sexuality and nakedness.

Historical analysis of indecent exposure laws exposes many insights about the legal management of morality in America. These insights feed research hypotheses regarding the interplay of civil and religious authorities in managing nakedness in nominally secular societies. The analyses also expose and inform potential constitutional challenges to the laws based on the Establishment Clause, free exercise, free speech, substantive and procedural due process, vagueness, overbreadth, and equal protection claims under the First, Fifth, Ninth, Tenth, and Fourteenth Amendments.

The history and aspects of the ruling in Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization (2022) foreshadow the obsolescence of the courts’ long reign as custos morum. The historical analysis highlights potential threats to America’s constitutional democracy posed by the degradation of its Christian moral foundation. The findings identify a need for more research on indecent exposure laws, a topic that is rarely explored and, when it is, often informed by biases.

The evolution of these laws in a constitutional context indicates a worsening moral crisis as the legal system wrestles with competing sources of moral authority in policy and judicial decision-making. The costs and benefits of potential changes in indecent exposure laws are unclear. It is likely that the definition and administration of the laws will change. The dissertation closes with a discussion of a legal framework for managing morals that is consistent with the original meaning of the Constitution and may be better suited to America’s demographic trends and political ideals than the meandering of custos morum over the past half century. Although this approach might mitigate some issues in moral jurisprudence, it remains open to debate and refinement.

What is it about public display of nakedness that requires the force of law to buttress the effects of shame, modesty, and clothing in keeping people’s “private areas” covered? Fortenberry’s literature review of sexual modesty laments the lack of a coherent scientific perspective on its role across multiple domains of expression and experience. These implications become clearer when the law allows freedom to experiment, assess, and learn. But at what cost?

The first steps have been taken here by exposing the sources and evolution of the laws and their relation to the U.S. Constitution, paving the way for further reflection, reform, experimentation, and study of the ontology of nakedness. The dissertation uncovers numerous provocative opportunities for further research and critical thinking.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过历史分析，探讨了美国"不雅暴露法"从殖民地时期至今的演变，揭示了其从基于宗教道德权威的"道德守护者"角色，到如今仅依赖"妨害理论"支撑的衰落过程。论文指出，在人口结构变化、基督教道德权威衰退和媒体技术发展的背景下，这些法律面临宪法层面的多重挑战，并可能因Dobbs案判决而进一步式微。作者呼吁更多研究，并探讨了符合宪法原意的道德管理法律框架。
AI.research_question: 公共裸露行为为何需要法律强制力来支撑羞耻感、端庄和衣物已产生的遮盖效果？不雅暴露法的历史渊源、演变及其与宪法的关系如何？这些法律在当前宪法框架下的持续可行性如何？
AI.motivation: 不雅暴露法在美国政府道德监管中占据核心地位，但学术界、政界和法律学者普遍忽视这一领域，对其历史理解的缺乏导致了先例误读和基本概念的重新发明，阻碍了关于社会管理性行为和裸露的连贯政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道德法学（custos morum理论）、妨害理论（nuisance theory）、宪法理论（涉及第一、第五、第九、第十、第十四修正案的政教分离、言论自由、正当程序、平等保护等原则），以及B. Fortenberry关于性端庄的文献综述框架。
AI.method: 历史分析法：追溯不雅暴露法从英国普通法到美国殖民地时期直至现代的法理演变；案例分析法：分析Dobbs案等最高法院判例的影响；宪法文本与判例分析：考察多项宪法修正案对不雅暴露法的潜在挑战。
AI.findings: 不雅暴露法的国家利益基础已从维护道德秩序和防止公众冒犯，缩减到仅剩妨害理论。最高法院的判例趋势正在削弱这一剩余依据。Dobbs案预示着法院作为custos morum的长期统治即将过时。基督教道德基础的退化对美国宪政民主构成潜在威胁。法律体系在处理竞争性的道德权威来源时，正面临日益严重的道德危机。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不雅暴露法与宗教权威、道德监管之间的历史关联，阐明了世俗社会中民事与宗教权威在管理裸露问题上的互动关系。识别出宪法多重修正案下的潜在挑战路径。提出了符合宪法原意的道德管理法律框架，为道德法理学提供了新的思考方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 澄清了不雅暴露法的历史源流和宪法依据，有助于消除法律实践中的混淆和误读。为立法者和司法者提供了关于这些法律当前可行性和潜在改革方向的参考。揭示了道德危机对宪法民主的潜在威胁，为政策制定和司法决策提供了警示。

title: The Drowning of the Merchant: Nonlinear Freight-Cost Pass-Through across Inflation Regimes

detail.title: The Drowning of the Merchant: Nonlinear Freight-Cost Pass-Through across Inflation Regimes
detail.abstract: The post-pandemic inflation surge renewed interest in global supply chains as a source of macroeconomic instability. While previous studies consistently document a positive relationship between transportation costs and inflation, they generally assume that freightcost pass-through remains constant over time. This paper challenges that assumption by examining whether the inflationary effects of container freight rates depend on the prevailing inflation environment. Using monthly U.S. data spanning 1993-2026, we estimate Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) models complemented by threshold, structural break, and Markov-switching analyses to investigate nonlinear freight-cost passthrough. The results reveal a stable long-run relationship between container freight rates and consumer inflation and strong evidence of state-dependent pass-through. During lowinflation periods, firms appear to absorb part of higher transportation costs through lower profit margins. However, when inflation is elevated, this buffering mechanism weakens substantially, leading to stronger transmission of freight-rate shocks to consumer prices. These findings suggest that the inflationary effects of supply-chain disruptions depend on both logistics shocks and firms' pricing behaviour across inflation regimes. The paper contributes by linking the shipping-cost literature with the broader macroeconomic literature on state-dependent pricing, with implications for inflation forecasting, monetary policy, and supply-chain resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了运费成本传导率恒定的假设，发现集装箱运费对消费者通胀的影响取决于通胀环境：低通胀时期企业通过压缩利润吸收部分成本，高通胀时期这种缓冲机制显著减弱，导致运费冲击更强地传导至消费者价格。
AI.research_question: 集装箱运费对消费者通胀的传导效应是否取决于所处的通胀环境（即是否存在状态依赖的非线性传导）？
AI.motivation: 后疫情时代通胀飙升重新引发了学界对全球供应链作为宏观经济不稳定来源的关注。先前研究一致发现运输成本与通胀之间存在正相关关系，但普遍假设运费成本传导率随时间恒定不变。本文挑战这一假设，旨在揭示运费传导的非线性特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 状态依赖定价理论（state-dependent pricing）；运费成本传导机制；非线性宏观经济分析。
AI.method: 使用1993-2026年美国月度数据，采用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型，并辅以阈值分析、结构断点分析和马尔可夫转换分析来研究非线性运费成本传导。
AI.findings: （1）集装箱运费与消费者通胀之间存在稳定的长期关系；（2）存在强烈的状态依赖传导效应：低通胀时期企业通过降低利润吸收部分运费上涨，高通胀时期这种缓冲机制显著弱化，运费冲击更强地传导至消费者价格。
AI.theory_contributions: 将航运成本文献与宏观经济学中关于状态依赖定价的更广泛文献联系起来，揭示了运费传导的非线性特征，丰富了成本传导理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 对通胀预测、货币政策和供应链韧性建设具有实际启示意义：政策制定者需要关注通胀环境本身如何影响供应链冲击向价格的传导强度。
