detail.abstract: This paper investigates a theoretical mechanism linking comparative advantage to the distribution of skills in the working population. We develop a tractable multi-country, multi-industry model of trade with unobservable skills in the labor market and show that comparative advantage derives from (i) cross-industry differences in the substitutability of workers' skills and (ii) crosscountry differences in the dispersion of skills. We establish the conditions under which higher skill dispersion leads to specialization in industries characterized by higher skill substitutability across tasks. The main results are robust when the model is extended to allow for partial observability of skills. Finally, we use distributions of literacy scores from the International Adult Literacy Survey to approximate crosscountry productivity differences due to skill dispersion and we carry out a quantitative assessment of the impact of skill dispersion on the pattern of trade.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个多国多行业贸易模型，揭示比较优势来源于技能分散度的跨国差异与行业间技能可替代性的差异，并利用国际成人素养调查数据进行了量化评估。
AI.research_question: 比较优势如何与劳动力人口的技能分布相关联？技能分散度如何影响贸易模式？
AI.motivation: 传统比较优势理论多关注要素禀赋或技术差异，而本文试图从劳动力技能分布（特别是技能分散度）这一微观层面解释比较优势的来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多国多行业贸易模型、不可观测技能假设、技能可替代性、技能分散度
AI.method: 理论建模（多国多行业贸易模型），并利用国际成人素养调查（IALS）中的读写能力分数分布数据进行量化分析。
AI.findings: 比较优势源于：(i) 行业间工人技能可替代性的差异；(ii) 国家间技能分散度的差异。技能分散度越高的国家，倾向于专业化于技能可替代性较高的行业。该结论在允许技能部分可观测的情况下依然稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 将技能分布（技能分散度）纳入比较优势的理论框架，为要素禀赋理论提供了微观基础的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解不同国家基于人力资本分布的贸易专业化模式提供了理论依据和量化评估方法，有助于政策制定者从技能结构角度优化产业布局。

reference: Journal of Human Resources, volume 49, issue 4, 2014[10.3368/jhr.49.4.906]
title: Ability, Parental Valuation of Education and the High School Dropout Decision
affiliations: University of Saskatchewan, Vancouver School of Economics, UBC and University of British Columbia (UBC)

detail.title: Ability, Parental Valuation of Education and the High School Dropout Decision

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Human Resources, volume 49, issue 4, 2014[10.3368/jhr.49.4.906]

detail.abstract: The probability of dropping out of high school varies considerably with parental education. Using a rich Canadian panel dataset, we examine the channels determining this socioeconomic status effect. We estimate an extended version of Carneiro, Hansen and Heckman (2003)'s factor model, incorporating effects from cognitive and non-cognitive ability and parental valuation of education (PVE). We find that cognitive ability and PVE have substantial impacts on droppingout and that parental education has little direct effect on dropping-out after controlling for these factors. Our results confirm the importance of determinants of pre-high school ability stocks but also indicate an important role for PVE during teenage years.

AI.tldr: 本文利用加拿大面板数据，扩展了Carneiro等人的因子模型，发现认知能力和父母教育价值观是影响高中辍学率的关键因素，而父母教育水平的直接影响在控制这些变量后很弱。
AI.research_question: 父母教育水平如何通过不同渠道（认知能力、非认知能力、父母教育价值观）影响高中辍学率？
AI.motivation: 高中辍学率与父母教育水平存在显著差异，但影响机制尚不明确。理解这些渠道对于制定有效的干预政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展了Carneiro, Hansen and Heckman (2003)的因子模型，引入了认知能力、非认知能力和父母教育价值观（PVE）三个潜在因子。
AI.method: 使用加拿大丰富的面板数据，估计扩展的因子模型，控制认知能力、非认知能力和PVE等潜在变量，分析父母教育对辍学率的直接和间接影响。
AI.findings: 1. 认知能力和父母教育价值观对高中辍学有显著影响；2. 在控制认知能力、非认知能力和PVE后，父母教育水平对辍学率的直接影响很小；3. 高中前的能力积累和青少年时期的PVE都是重要影响因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了父母教育影响高中辍学的内在机制，区分了能力积累效应和价值观传递效应，丰富了人力资本代际传递的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为降低高中辍学率的政策设计提供了方向：既要关注早期认知能力的培养，也要重视青少年时期父母教育价值观的塑造。

title: When Do Crises Scar the Law of Motion? An Identification Frontier for Macroeconomic Propagation

detail.title: When Do Crises Scar the Law of Motion? An Identification Frontier for Macroeconomic Propagation
detail.abstract: Persistent output losses after financial crises are well documented, but persistence does not say whether a crisis changed the economy's law of propagation. This paper characterizes the identification frontier of that question. An economy is a layered state-space architectureshock activation, internal propagation, measurement readout-whose transition operator is itself a state variable; a crisis scars the economy only if it persistently displaces this operator. Four obstructions are priced exactly. Pointwise operator motion is undefined without a declared anchor, whose residual ambiguity is a single stabilizer orbit of dimension (n-J 0)(n-K 0). A cross-shock functional separates exactly the fixed affine class, so crisis interactions cannot distinguish scarring from nonlinear state dependence. By finite-jet interpolation, scarring and unrestricted state dependence are observationally equivalent on one-way crisis excursions and separated only by state-matched comparisons across the event-decidable at finite resolution if and only if the displacement exceeds (1+ √ 2)Lδwith restrictions on the rival class purchasing identification on a stated schedule. Event attribution is valid exactly under conditional exchangeability of crisis timing; circular dating provably manufactures certification, and departures carry a computable sensitivity price. A frontier theorem partitions every scarring question into answered, anchored, conditional, and unanswerable cells; a five-gate protocol operationalizes it, demonstrated on the Jòrda-Schularick-Taylor macrohistory panel.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个形式化的识别框架，证明金融危机是否永久性改变经济传导机制（"伤疤效应"）是一个可识别性受严格约束的问题。作者提出分层状态空间架构，精确定价了四种识别障碍，并通过前沿定理将所有伤疤问题划分为已解答、锚定、条件性和不可解答四类，最终通过五门协议在JST宏观历史面板上进行了实证演示。
AI.research_question: 金融危机是否只是暂时性冲击（之后经济回归原有传导机制），还是永久性地改变（"伤疤"）了经济的传导算子（law of propagation）？即危机后产出持续损失究竟是冲击的持续性结果，还是经济结构本身被改变了。
AI.motivation: 大量文献记录了金融危机后产出持续损失的"持久性"事实，但持久性本身无法区分"是冲击持续作用"还是"经济的传导机制被永久改变"。回答这一问题对于政策制定（是否需要结构性改革）、历史解释和理论建模具有根本意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层状态空间架构（layered state-space architecture）：包括冲击激活、内部传导、测量读出三个层次，其转移算子本身是状态变量。核心数学工具包括：稳定子轨道（stabilizer orbit）、交叉冲击泛函（cross-shock functional）、有限射流插值（finite-jet interpolation）、条件可交换性（conditional exchangeability）等。
AI.method: 形式化识别分析：精确定价四种识别障碍；(1) 锚定模糊性（operator motion需要声明anchor）；(2) 交叉冲击泛函分离出固定仿射类，危机交互无法区分伤疤与非线性状态依赖；(3) 有限射流插值证明伤疤与无约束状态依赖在单向危机路径上观测等价；(4) 事件归因的条件可交换性假设及循环定时的可证操纵性（certification manufacturing）。提出"前沿定理"将问题划分为四象限，并设计"五门协议"操作化实施。
AI.findings: (1) 点态算子运动无声明锚不可定义，残余模糊度为单一稳定子轨道，维度(n-J0)(n-K0)。(2) 伤疤与非线性状态依赖在单向危机路径上观测等价，仅在状态匹配比较下可分离，且有限分辨率下可判定当且仅当位移超过(1+√2)Lδ。(3) 事件归因在条件可交换性下有效，循环定时可证地制造认证，偏离带有可计算敏感性价格。(4) JST面板的应用将许多伤疤问题归入"不可解答"类，但部分可锚定或条件性回答。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"危机是否改变经济传导机制"这一基础问题提供了严格的识别理论，揭示了此前文献中未被认识的识别障碍（如稳定子轨道模糊性、与非线性状态依赖的观测等价性、循环定时的操纵性），建立了伤疤问题的分类学和可证界限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究者提供了"五门协议"操作化框架，指导在JST等宏观历史面板中如何合法地进行伤疤效应的因果推断，明确哪些问题可以回答、在什么条件下可以回答、哪些永远不可回答，避免了虚假的因果归因。

title: Reproducing and Extending a Panel Data Analysis of Anemia, Weight, and Height in Peruvian Children Under Five (2007–2025)

detail.title: Reproducing and Extending a Panel Data Analysis of Anemia, Weight, and Height in Peruvian Children Under Five (2007–2025)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Background: Childhood anemia remains a major public health concern in Peru, with implications for chronic malnutrition and developmental outcomes. Arizmendi et al. (2025) used Feasible Generalized Least Squares (FGLS) panel data methods on Peru's Demographic and Family Health Survey (ENDES, 2007-2022) to document improving trends in hemoglobin, weight, and height among children under five. Objective: This study (1) reproduces the original FGLS analysis using the same data and specification, and (2) extends the analysis through 2023-2025 to assess whether the documented improvements have persisted. Methods: ENDES microdata (2007-2025) were used to estimate FGLS regressions of hemoglobin on age, and of weight and height on hemoglobin, across five age bands (0-11, 12-23, 24-35, 36-47, 48-59 months). Results were compared against the original published coefficients. Because the World Health Organization revised its hemoglobin cutoff guideline in 2024, and Peru adopted this change, 2025 data are analyzed separately from 2007-2024 to avoid conflating a measurement-definition shift with a genuine health trend. Results: Of fifteen estimated coefficients in the 2007-2022 reproduction, fourteen matched the sign of the original published results. The weight-and height-hemoglobin relationships reproduced closely for four of five age bands each (generally within 0.3-5.7% of published values); in both relationships the 0-11 month band was a clear exception, with a roughly 1,800-observation sample gap relative to published in that band specifically appearing to be a contributing factor, consistent with the original authors' own acknowledgment that this age band is their least reliable. The hemoglobin-age relationship reproduced least consistently: only one age band (12-23 months) matched closely, while the other four diverged by 46-90%, with the 48-59 month band diverging most and doing so from a published value that is itself inconsistent with its own neighboring age bands. Extending the analysis to 2023-2024 using an identical specification showed all fifteen coefficients decline in magnitude relative to 2007-2022, including a loss of statistical significance in the youngest hemoglobin-age band. Separately analyzed 2025 data show further attenuation, though this cannot be cleanly distinguished from the concurrent WHO hemoglobin-cutoff guideline change. Conclusion: This study reproduces the general direction of Arizmendi et al.'s (2025) findings while identifying one likely anomaly in the original published table and documenting a previously unreported weakening of the hemoglobin-age, weight-hemoglobin, and heighthemoglobin relationships in ENDES data collected after the original study's 2022 cutoff. Whether this reflects a genuine stall in Peru's progress against childhood anemia, a data or measurement artifact, or some combination of the two remains an open question.

AI.tldr: 本研究复现并扩展了Arizmendi等人(2025)关于秘鲁5岁以下儿童贫血趋势的分析，发现2007-2022年结果基本可复现，但2023-2025年数据表明血红蛋白与年龄、体重、身高的关系出现普遍减弱，提示秘鲁儿童贫血改善趋势可能已停滞。
AI.research_question: （1）Arizmendi等人(2025)关于秘鲁儿童贫血改善趋势的FGLS分析结果是否可复现？（2）将分析扩展至2023-2025年后，先前记录的改善趋势是否持续存在？
AI.motivation: 儿童贫血是秘鲁重大公共卫生问题，Arizmendi等人(2025)报告了积极改善趋势，但该发现尚未经过独立复现验证，且数据截止于2022年，后续趋势未知。2024年WHO修订血红蛋白截断值标准也为趋势分析带来新挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Feasible Generalized Least Squares (FGLS)面板数据方法的复现与扩展分析框架，涉及血红蛋白与年龄、体重、身高之间的统计关系检验。
AI.method: 使用秘鲁人口与家庭健康调查(ENDES) 2007-2025年微观数据，采用FGLS回归估计血红蛋白与年龄、体重与血红蛋白、身高与血红蛋白的关系，按五个年龄段（0-11、12-23、24-35、36-47、48-59月）分别分析。2025年数据因WHO标准变更单独处理。
AI.findings: 2007-2022年复现中15个系数有14个符号一致；体重/身高-血红蛋白关系在4个年龄段复现良好（偏差0.3-5.7%），但0-11月龄段因样本量差异成为明显例外；血红蛋白-年龄关系复现较差，仅1个年龄段匹配，其余偏差46-90%。扩展至2023-2024年，全部15个系数数值下降，部分失去统计显著性；2025年数据进一步衰减。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了FGLS面板数据方法在儿童健康趋势分析中的可复现性边界，揭示了统计复现中对年龄分组和样本量差异的敏感性，并首次报告了秘鲁儿童贫血改善趋势可能已经停滞的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为秘鲁及其他发展中国家儿童贫血监测提供复现验证的方法论参考；提示政策制定者需关注2022年后贫血改善趋势减弱的问题；为WHO 2024年血红蛋白标准变更后的数据衔接分析提供案例借鉴。

title: Social Security, Endogenous Retirement and Intrahousehold Cooperation
affiliations: and Vancouver School of Economics, UBC

detail.title: Social Security, Endogenous Retirement and Intrahousehold Cooperation
detail.abstract: This paper studies the retirement incentives induced by the U.S. Social Security system in a framework which allows for different degrees of cooperation and strategic interaction between spouses. We develop a model in which spouses maximize joint household utility, subject to the additional constraint that neither partner finds it optimal to deviate from the best constrained household allocation. We show that accounting for "non-cooperative" behavior through this additional constraint can rationalize various choices of older couples observed in the 1932-42 cohort of the Health and Retirement Study. In particular non-cooperative behavior helps with two recurring puzzles in the retirement literature: (i) the clustering of benefit claiming at the early age of 62 despite significant gains associated to delayed claiming by husbands; and (ii) the joint benefit claiming of couples. We contrast our findings to those from a standard unitary model of the household, extended to include a process for declining health, and show that the latter can rationalize neither early nor joint claiming behavior if individuals can independently make benefit and labor force participation decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国社会保障体系在考虑配偶间不同合作程度和战略互动框架下对退休激励的影响，发现非合作行为能解释老年夫妇的提前领取养老金（62岁）和联合领取等行为，而传统单一家庭模型无法解释这些现象。
AI.research_question: 美国社会保障体系如何通过夫妻间的合作与非合作行为影响退休决策？
AI.motivation: 退休文献中存在两个难以解释的"谜题"：（1）尽管丈夫延迟领取养老金有显著收益，但人们仍倾向于在62岁早期集中领取；（2）夫妻常同时领取养老金。传统家庭模型无法解释这些现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭内部非合作博弈模型，在夫妻联合最大化家庭效用的基础上，附加约束条件以确保任何一方都没有偏离最优约束家庭分配的动机。
AI.method: 构建包含配偶间战略互动的理论模型，并使用健康与退休研究（HRS）中1932-42年出生队列的微观数据进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 非合作行为能够合理化老年夫妇的各种退休选择，尤其是62岁早期领取和夫妻联合领取行为；而标准单一家庭模型（即使加入健康衰退因素）无法解释这些现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 将家庭内部的非合作博弈引入社会保障退休行为分析，弥补了传统单一家庭模型在解释夫妻退休决策上的理论局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解社会保障制度如何影响夫妻退休决策提供更符合现实的框架，有助于优化养老金领取年龄设计。

title: Small Bias, Large Failure: Anchoring Collapses a Market of Language-Model Agents

detail.title: Small Bias, Large Failure: Anchoring Collapses a Market of Language-Model Agents
detail.abstract: Markets are supposed to discipline individual irrationality. I test whether they do when the traders are language-model agents carrying one bias, anchoring, into a five-seller market. Alone the bias is mild, moving an agreed price a few dollars on a sixty-dollar deal. The same onesentence anchor, given only to sellers, drops the market's efficiency from 96% to 15%. Every seller lifts its asking price to a common level above what most buyers will pay, so trade freezes; most of the damage is deals that never happen. Aggregation magnifies the bias rather than disciplining it: agents cloned from one model are too alike for any un-anchored seller to undercut the rest. The model that resists anchoring best one-on-one collapses the market hardest, so pairwise testing would clear the riskiest model. The collapse survives higher randomness in the agents and reverses under a one-line debiasing instruction.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究语言模型智能体在带有锚定偏差的情况下进行市场交易时，市场是否能够纠正个体非理性。结果发现，锚定偏差导致市场效率从96%骤降至15%，大量交易冻结，且市场聚合放大了偏差而非纠正它。最抵抗锚定的模型反而导致市场崩溃最严重，但通过一行去偏指令可以逆转这一现象。
AI.research_question: 当交易者是带有锚定偏差的语言模型智能体时，市场是否能够纠正个体的非理性行为？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学认为市场可以纠正个体非理性，但这一假设在AI语言模型作为交易者时是否成立尚不清楚。本研究旨在测试语言模型智能体在市场中的偏差聚合效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 锚定偏差（Anchoring Bias）、市场效率理论、偏差聚合效应、智能体同质性理论
AI.method: 在五个卖方市场中，让语言模型智能体携带锚定偏差进行交易实验，比较有无偏差情况下的市场效率，并测试不同模型对锚定的抵抗能力及其市场后果。
AI.findings: (1)锚定偏差使市场效率从96%降至15%；(2)所有卖方将要价提升到高于多数买方愿意支付的水平，导致交易冻结；(3)市场聚合放大了偏差而非纠正；(4)最抵抗锚定的模型反而导致市场崩溃最严重；(5)去偏指令可以逆转市场崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI智能体市场中偏差聚合的新机制：智能体的同质性使得市场无法通过套利纠正偏差，反而放大了偏差效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示使用AI智能体进行市场模拟或自动化交易时需谨慎评估偏差风险；简单的一行去偏指令即可有效缓解问题，为AI安全提供了低成本解决方案；表明传统的一对一测试不足以筛选出市场中最危险的模型。

title: Love as the Constitutive Principle of Existence: Limbic System Dynamics, Neuroplasticity, and the Ontological Foundation of Loving

detail.title: Love as the Constitutive Principle of Existence: Limbic System Dynamics, Neuroplasticity, and the Ontological Foundation of Loving
detail.abstract: This paper argues that love is not merely an emotional experience but the constitutive neurobiological, ontological, and evolutionary principle of existence. Drawing on limbic system neuroscience, placebo/nocebo dynamics, the hormonal cascade of oxytocin, dopamine, serotonin, and beta-endorphins, and the functional parallels between love and fundamental physical organizing principles, this study establishes three core propositions: (1) Loving is the primary act; being loved is its necessary neural and social consequence. (2) To exist is already an act of love-because every existence is the product of an orienting energy, a union. (3) The brain that knows how to love operates the limbic system in placebo mode; the brain that does not know how to love destroys itself and its environment through a nocebo cycle. The paper further introduces a three-layer analytical framework distinguishing empirical neurobiological claims, psychological model claims, and philosophical-ontological claims, and proposes three testable experimental protocols for future research. The precedence of love over existence is argued to be not 1 chronological but conditional: love comes first not in time, but logically and functionally, as the necessary condition for existence to become possible at all.

AI.tldr: 本文提出爱不仅是情感体验，而是构成存在的神经生物学、本体论和进化原则。爱在逻辑和功能上先于存在，是存在得以可能的必要条件。论文建立了三个核心命题，并提出了三层分析框架和可测试的实验方案。
AI.research_question: 爱是否以及如何构成存在的神经生物学、本体论和进化原则？爱在逻辑和功能上是否先于存在？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常将爱视为一种情感现象，本文试图重新定位爱为存在的构成性原则，整合神经科学、心理学和哲学本体论，以解释爱在人类生存和健康中的根本性作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边缘系统神经科学、安慰剂/反安慰剂动力学、催产素/多巴胺/血清素/β-内啡肽激素级联反应，以及爱与基本物理组织原则的功能平行性。
AI.method: 理论整合与概念分析，提出三层分析框架（经验神经生物学主张、心理学模型主张、哲学-本体论主张），并提出三个可测试的实验方案。
AI.findings: (1) 爱是首要行为，被爱是其神经和社会后果；(2) 存在本身就是爱的行为，因为存在是定向能量与结合的结果；(3) 懂得爱的大脑以安慰剂模式运作边缘系统，不懂爱的大脑通过反安慰剂循环毁灭自身与环境。爱的优先性是逻辑和功能上的，而非时间上的。
AI.theory_contributions: 将爱从情感现象重新定位为存在的构成性原则，建立了神经科学、心理学与本体论之间的跨学科理论桥梁，提出了"爱的逻辑优先性"概念以区分于时间优先性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了三个可测试的实验方案，为未来研究提供了实证路径；揭示了爱对身心健康（安慰剂/反安慰剂机制）的根本性影响，对医学、心理健康和教育实践具有指导意义。

title: How Robust is the Skill-Dispersion-Complementarity Hypothesis?
affiliations: University of British Columbia (UBC), Vancouver School of Economics, UBC and

detail.title: How Robust is the Skill-Dispersion-Complementarity Hypothesis?
detail.abstract: We explore the robustness of the hypothesis, …rst put forward by Grossman and Maggi (2000) (GM), that countries with higher skill dispersion specialize in the sector characterized by a submodular production function, i.e. the industry that cross-matches workers of di¤erent skills (henceforth referred to as SDC hypothesis). We relax the assumption of constant returns to skill, breaking the link between submodularity and the concavity of isoquants, a key feature in GM. We show that when a submodular sector displays convex isoquants, it no longer bene…ts from higher skill dispersion and higher skill dispersion countries may specialize in the supermodular sector. We investigate this theoretical possibility by performing a variety of simulations, based on empirical skill distributions, and …nd that in the vast majority of cases the SDC hypothesis is not violated.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了Grossman和Maggi（2000）提出的技能分散度假说（SDC假说）的稳健性，即技能分散度较高的国家会专业化生产具有次模生产函数的部门。作者放宽了技能回报不变的假设，发现当次模部门呈现凸等产量线时，高技能分散度国家反而可能专业化于超模部门。但通过基于经验技能分布的模拟，发现在绝大多数情况下SDC假说并未被违反。
AI.research_question: 技能分散度假说（SDC假说）在放宽关键假设后是否仍然稳健成立？
AI.motivation: 检验Grossman和Maggi（2000）提出的SDC假说的稳健性，特别是当打破次模性与等产量线凹性之间的关联时，该假说是否仍然成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技能分散度假说（SDC假说）、次模生产函数与超模生产函数、等产量线的凸凹性、技能回报变化假设。
AI.method: 理论建模（放宽GM的恒定技能回报假设）结合数值模拟（基于经验技能分布数据进行仿真）。
AI.findings: 当次模部门呈现凸等产量线时，高技能分散度国家可能专业化于超模部门；但基于真实技能分布的模拟表明，在绝大多数情况下SDC假说仍然成立，未被违反。
AI.theory_contributions: 修正了GM模型中对次模性与等产量线凹性之间关系的理解，拓展了技能分散度与国际贸易分工理论的分析边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解国家间技能分布差异对产业分工格局的影响提供了更稳健的理论基础，验证了原假说在现实数据中的适用性。

title: Tokenizing Real-World Assets
affiliations: , Carnegie Mellon University and National University of Singapore (NUS)

detail.title: Tokenizing Real-World Assets
detail.abstract: Tokenization of real-world assets (RWAs)—the representation of off-chain assets on a digital ledger—has gained momentum across money market funds, government bonds, gold, and private credit. It bridges traditional finance and on-chain markets while continuing to rely on traditional infrastructure for custody, legal enforcement, and price discovery. Tokenization promises efficiency gains in issuance, trading, and settlement and may facilitate secondary-market liquidity by making claims on otherwise illiquid assets more transferable. We distinguish three categories: tokenized liquid assets (e.g., gold and equities), money-like claims (e.g., stablecoins and tokenized deposits), and tokenized illiquid assets (e.g., loans and private credit). Tokenization of liquid assets integrates traditional markets with decentralized finance and reallocates liquidity across venues. Tokenization of illiquid assets, by contrast, facilitates secondary-market trading opportunities, but whether it creates meaningful liquidity depends on market design, investor participation, valuation quality, and asset opacity. This liquidity transformation inherits incentive problems familiar from banking and securitization while introducing new economic and operational risks related to custody, redemption design, and oracles. We argue that the trading speed of a tokenized claim should match the speed at which the underlying asset can be traded, valued, or redeemed—the speed-matching principle that organizes our policy framework. We propose a policy framework that ties regulatory requirements to the economic role tokens play and the speed and liquidity of their underlying markets rather than to the underlying technology, prioritizing clear legal foundations, credible redemption mechanisms, robust custody and audit standards, and sound oracle governance.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了真实世界资产（RWA）代币化的三类资产（流动性资产、货币类资产、非流动性资产），提出了“速度匹配原则”作为政策框架的核心，强调代币化资产的交易速度应与底层资产的交易、估值或赎回速度相匹配。
AI.research_question: RWA代币化如何影响市场效率与流动性？如何设计相应的监管政策框架？
AI.motivation: RWA代币化在传统金融与链上市场之间搭建桥梁，带来了效率提升潜力，但也引入了新型风险（托管、赎回设计、预言机等），需要系统的经济分析与政策指引。
AI.theoretical_framework: 速度匹配原则（speed-matching principle）、流动性转型理论（借鉴银行与证券化领域的激励问题）
AI.method: 概念性分类分析（三类资产）、理论推导与政策框架构建
AI.findings: 流动性资产的代币化有助于跨平台流动性再分配；非流动性资产的代币化虽创造了二级市场交易机会，但能否产生有意义的流动性取决于市场设计、投资者参与、估值质量和资产不透明度；流动性转型会继承银行和证券化中的激励问题，并引入新的运营风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“速度匹配原则”作为组织政策框架的核心准则；将代币化资产的经济功能与监管要求挂钩，而非基于技术本身。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了基于底层资产速度与流动性特征的分类监管框架；明确了托管、审计、预言机治理和赎回机制等关键领域的政策优先事项。

title: Non-Convexities in Dynamic Programming Problems
affiliations: Vancouver School of Economics, UBC and University College London

detail.title: Non-Convexities in Dynamic Programming Problems
detail.abstract: Models where agents choose over non-convex budget sets are commonly used in the analysis of economic problems with "extensive margin" decisions and fixed costs. Their solutions have interesting and distinctive features that are especially relevant in quantitative applications. We describe how problems with non-convex choice sets differ from standard problems and investigate under which circumstances the inclusion of random shocks makes their solution identical to the solution of standard problems. A simple framework is provided for the analysis of these problems and a numerical example is illustrated.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了非凸预算集下的经济选择模型，分析了其与标准模型的差异，探讨了随机冲击何时能使两者解等价，并提供了分析框架和数值示例。
AI.research_question: 在存在广泛边际决策和固定成本的经济问题中，非凸预算集选择模型与标准模型有何差异？随机冲击在何种条件下能使非凸问题的解与标准问题的解趋于一致？
AI.motivation: 非凸预算集模型广泛应用于涉及固定成本和广泛边际决策的经济问题（如劳动供给、消费选择等），但其解具有独特且复杂的特征，理解这些特征对定量分析至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非凸预算集理论、随机冲击下的选择问题等价性理论
AI.method: 理论分析（比较非凸与标准模型的差异）、数值示例
AI.findings: 非凸预算集问题的解具有与标准问题不同的特征；在某些条件下引入随机冲击可以使非凸问题的解等价于标准问题的解。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统阐释了非凸预算集选择模型与标准模型的差异边界，明确了随机冲击使两者等价的条件，为后续理论建模提供了指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为涉及固定成本和广泛边际决策的定量经济分析提供了一个简化分析框架，有助于实证研究中模型的选择与设定。

title: Bank Loan Portfolio, Crowding-Out, and Financial Risk *
affiliations: Utah State University and Queen's University

detail.title: Bank Loan Portfolio, Crowding-Out, and Financial Risk *
detail.abstract: We develop a tractable macroeconomic framework to study how banks' portfolio choices affect loan crowding-out, sectoral activity, and financial risk. In our model, banks optimally set the volumes of commercial vs. collateralized household loans. Monetary policy moves the tightness of the bank-lending constraint, thereby influencing sectoral allocation of credit. We analytically show that labor demand and supply endogenously determine steady-state inflation. Quantitatively, contractionary monetary policy reduces both commercial and collateralized household loans in the short and long run, while inducing a flight to safety as banks reallocate lending toward the latter. This reallocation mitigates financial risk but causes a negative spillover from construction to production.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个可处理的宏观经济模型，研究银行资产组合选择如何影响贷款挤出效应、部门活动和金融风险。模型显示，紧缩性货币政策会导致银行将贷款从商业贷款转向抵押贷款（安全资产迁移），从而降低金融风险但造成建筑部门向生产部门的负面溢出。
AI.research_question: 银行的资产组合选择如何影响贷款挤出效应、部门经济活动以及金融风险？
AI.motivation: 银行在商业贷款和抵押贷款之间的配置决策对宏观经济有重要影响，但现有文献缺乏一个可处理的一般均衡框架来系统分析这一机制及其与货币政策的互动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡宏观经济学框架；银行资产组合选择模型；银行信贷约束；劳动市场供需均衡决定稳态通胀。
AI.method: 理论建模（可处理的宏观经济学模型），结合定量分析。
AI.findings: (1) 紧缩性货币政策在短期和长期均减少商业贷款和抵押贷款；(2) 银行将贷款从商业贷款重新配置到抵押贷款，产生"安全资产迁移"效应；(3) 这种再配置降低了金融风险；(4) 但造成了建筑部门向生产部门的负面溢出效应；(5) 劳动市场的供需内生决定了稳态通胀水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在可处理的一般均衡框架下分析了银行资产组合选择、货币政策与部门间溢出效应的内在机制；揭示了货币政策的"安全资产迁移"渠道。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行理解货币政策的部门异质性效应提供理论依据；提示政策制定者关注紧缩政策下建筑部门对生产部门的负面溢出；为银行监管和宏观审慎政策设计提供参考。

title: Treasury Market as a Utility-Maximizer: A Novel Specialness Premia Specification and Regime Indicator

detail.title: Treasury Market as a Utility-Maximizer: A Novel Specialness Premia Specification and Regime Indicator
detail.abstract: Though many research efforts examining the "specialness" phenomenon in the Treasury market have economically justified on-the-run premia with arguments of higher liquidity and lower search frictions, little work has been done to derive and illustrate no-arbitrage specifications for on-the-run premia, taking into account both existing Heath-Jarrow-Morton yield constraints and the dynamics of specialness. Using stochastic control and framing the special Treasury market itself as an agent that endogenously minimizes penalties and maximizes rewards associated with on-the-run premia, we derive a no-arbitrage SDE specification for on-the-run premia of zero-coupon-bonds (ZCBs) and a regime function that indicates the market's utility gain from a special issue's high liquidity. We empirically illustrate the derived specification through maximum likelihood estimation and statistical comparison with realized on-the-run premia.

AI.tldr: 本文利用随机控制理论，将特殊的国债市场本身视为一个内生最小化惩罚和最大化与当前国债溢价相关收益的代理，推导出零息债券当前溢价的非套利随机微分方程规范，并通过最大似然估计和统计比较进行实证验证。
AI.research_question: 如何推导并实证检验零息债券当前溢价的非套利规范，同时考虑Heath-Jarrow-Morton收益率约束和特殊性动态？
AI.motivation: 现有研究虽从流动性和搜索摩擦角度解释了国债市场的"特殊性"现象及当前溢价，但鲜有研究在考虑HJM收益率约束和特殊性动态的前提下，推导和阐明当前溢价的非套利规范。
AI.theoretical_framework: Heath-Jarrow-Morton (HJM) 收益率约束框架；随机控制理论；非套利定价理论
AI.method: 随机控制建模（将特殊国债市场视为内生代理）；推导非套利SDE规范；最大似然估计（MLE）；统计比较分析
AI.findings: 推导出了零息债券当前溢价的非套利随机微分方程规范，以及一个指示市场从特殊发行的高流动性中获得效用增益的制度函数，并通过MLE和与实现溢价的统计比较进行了实证验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在HJM框架和特殊性动态约束下，推导出当前溢价的非套利SDE规范，填补了该领域的理论空白；将特殊国债市场建模为内生优化代理，提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场参与者提供了当前溢价的非套利定价规范，有助于更精确地理解国债市场的定价机制和流动性价值。

title: Managing Currency Risk in Volatile Markets with Bayesian Dynamic Hedge Ratios
affiliations: University of South Carolina - Darla Moore School of Business and University of North Florida

detail.title: Managing Currency Risk in Volatile Markets with Bayesian Dynamic Hedge Ratios
detail.abstract: We study dynamic currency hedging for a U.S. investor in international equities from 1988 to 2025. Under common zero-to-one hedge-ratio mandates, many emerging-market exposures are already clipped to a full hedge, leaving little room for estimator choice to improve the implemented position. Developed markets provide more active partial-hedge decisions. A Bayesian rule combining rolling return information with trade orientation, carry, and momentum improves implementation by reducing turnover where the hedge remains active. The rule also produces smoother hedge paths and posterior intervals that convert estimation uncertainty into a governance input for currency-hedging policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1988-2025年间美国投资者在国际股票中的动态货币对冲策略，发现新兴市场因零到一对冲比率限制已接近完全对冲，而发达市场提供了更多主动部分对冲的空间。一种结合滚动收益信息与交易倾向、利差和动量的贝叶斯规则，通过减少仍活跃对冲的换手率来改进实施，同时产生更平滑的对冲路径和后验区间，将估计不确定性转化为货币对冲政策的治理输入。
AI.research_question: 美国投资者在国际股票投资中如何进行动态货币对冲，特别是在不同市场（新兴市场与发达市场）的差异以及如何通过贝叶斯规则改进对冲策略的实施。
AI.motivation: 在零到一对冲比率授权下，新兴市场暴露已被限制为完全对冲，导致估计方法选择几乎无法改善实际持仓；而发达市场提供了更多主动部分对冲决策空间，但现有方法在减少换手率和治理不确定性方面存在不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币对冲理论、贝叶斯统计推断、动量与利差因子模型、投资组合风险管理理论。
AI.method: 1988-2025年实证分析，比较新兴市场与发达市场的对冲差异；构建结合滚动收益信息、交易倾向、利差和动量的贝叶斯规则；评估对冲路径平滑度、换手率降低效果及后验区间对政策治理的贡献。
AI.findings: （1）新兴市场因零到一对冲比率限制已接近完全对冲，估计方法选择空间有限；（2）发达市场存在更多主动部分对冲决策机会；（3）所提出的贝叶斯规则能有效减少活跃对冲的换手率；（4）产生更平滑的对冲路径；（5）后验区间能将估计不确定性转化为货币对冲政策的治理输入。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了动态货币对冲理论，将贝叶斯推断与多因子（滚动收益、交易倾向、利差、动量）结合，提出了一种新的对冲策略实施框架；揭示了不同市场特征下对冲策略的差异机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国投资者在国际股票投资中提供了更高效的货币对冲实施方法，减少交易成本（通过降低换手率），并提供了将估计不确定性系统纳入政策治理的实用工具。

title: How Does the SEC Respond to Reputation Shocks?
affiliations: and Arizona State University (ASU) - School of Accountancy

detail.title: How Does the SEC Respond to Reputation Shocks?
detail.abstract: We examine the investigative intensity of SEC regional offices in the aftermath of a professionalism scandal in which dozens of SEC employees were found to have repeatedly accessed internet pornography on work devices. We find that when the scandal was made public, the implicated offices ramped up investigative intensity, perhaps to repair their reputation. At the time, office-level investigation activity was observable to the SEC’s leadership and potentially to its congressional overseers, but not to the general public. We therefore interpret this response, through the lens of bureaucratic reputation theory, as reputation repair directed at the agency’s own hierarchy and its political principals, the audiences that could actually observe it. We similarly observe that the SEC headquarters office instigated more investigations after the scandal was publicized, but only in regions of implicated offices, in line with increased oversight and less confidence in scandal-implicated offices. These spikes in investigative intensity were short-lived, but scandal-implicated offices also handed down more AAERs after the scandal, consistent with these offices accelerating real, costly enforcement output rather than merely opening investigations. More broadly, our evidence suggests that reputation repair within a regulator can operate through internal accountability channels.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了SEC地方办公室在员工观看色情内容丑闻后的执法行为变化，发现涉事办公室通过增加调查强度来修复声誉，这种修复主要针对能观察到其行为的内部层级和政治委托人，而非公众。
AI.research_question: SEC地方办公室在发生职业丑闻后，是否会通过增加执法调查强度来修复声誉？这种声誉修复行为针对哪些受众？
AI.motivation: 探讨监管机构在内部丑闻曝光后的行为反应，特别是声誉修复机制如何通过内部问责渠道运作，而非直接面向公众。
AI.theoretical_framework: 官僚声誉理论（Bureaucratic Reputation Theory）
AI.method: 基于SEC地方办公室丑闻事件的实证分析，比较丑闻曝光前后涉事办公室与非涉事办公室的执法调查强度变化。
AI.findings: 1）丑闻曝光后，涉事办公室显著增加了调查强度；2）SEC总部也增加了对涉事办公室所在地区的调查，体现加强监督；3）调查强度增加是短期的，但涉事办公室发布了更多AAERs（会计和审计执法公告），表明实际执法产出增加而非仅仅开启调查。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了官僚声誉理论，揭示了监管机构内部的声誉修复机制可以通过内部问责渠道运作，而非仅面向公众。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构的治理和问责机制提供了实证依据，表明内部监督和层级问责可以有效驱动机构行为改变。

title: Is Mortgage Lock-In Responsible for Housing Market Tightness?
affiliations: Stanford Graduate School of Business and Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, Georgia State University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Is Mortgage Lock-In Responsible for Housing Market Tightness?
detail.abstract: Elevated mortgage rates discourage homeowners from moving, as relocating triggers a reset of mortgage terms-a phenomenon termed "lock-in." This paper examines whether elevated rates explain recent real estate market tightness: low transaction volumes, low time-on-market, and sustained price growth. Using transaction-level data, we estimate survival models of housing tenures-the probability of sale as a function of tenure and market conditions, including mortgage rate gaps. These estimates quantify missing sellers who have not entered the market due to elevated rates. We then calibrate a search and matching model measuring mortgage rate effects on buyers alongside seller lock-in effects. Results indicate lock-in causes sellers to withdraw, reducing transactions. However, buyers are more sensitive to mortgage rates than sellers are to lock-in, meaning a rate drop would increase sales volumes but not reduce market tightness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究抵押贷款利率上升如何通过"锁定效应"抑制房主搬家意愿，导致房地产市场供给紧缩（低交易量、低挂牌时间、价格持续上涨）。通过生存模型量化"缺失的卖方"，并校准搜索匹配模型后发现：卖方锁定效应减少了交易量，但买方对利率的敏感度高于卖方，因此利率下降虽能增加交易量，却无法缓解市场紧俏程度。
AI.research_question: 高抵押贷款利率是否以及如何解释近期房地产市场的紧俏现象（低交易量、短挂牌时间、价格持续上涨）？
AI.motivation: 近年来抵押贷款利率持续攀升，但房地产市场的价格并未如预期般下跌，反而呈现交易量萎缩与价格坚挺并存的"紧俏"特征。这一现象无法用传统供需模型充分解释，因此需要从"锁定效应"角度重新审视供给侧的衰减机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 锁定效应（Lock-in Effect）：房主因不愿承担重新抵押带来的更高利率成本而放弃卖房。2. 搜索匹配模型（Search and Matching Model）：刻画买卖双方在利率变化下的行为不对称性。
AI.method: 1. 交易层面数据 2. 生存模型（Survival Model）：估计住房持有期与销售概率的关系 3. 搜索匹配模型校准：分别量化利率对买方和卖方行为的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 锁定效应导致卖方退出市场，减少交易量。2. 买方对抵押贷款利率的敏感度高于卖方对锁定效应的敏感度。3. 利率下降会增加交易量，但不会降低市场紧俏程度（即价格仍保持上涨、挂牌时间仍短）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统量化了抵押贷款利率上升通过锁定效应影响房地产市场供给的机制。2. 揭示了买卖双方利率敏感度的不对称性，修正了传统搜索匹配模型中对供给弹性的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供预警：降息虽能刺激交易量，但无法解决结构性供给短缺导致的紧俏市场。2. 帮助房地产从业者理解当前市场"交易冷、价格热"的深层原因，避免误判市场周期。

title: Reset Value and Protection Restoration in Defined Outcome Overlays
affiliations: University of South Carolina - Darla Moore School of Business, University of North Florida and Duke University

detail.title: Reset Value and Protection Restoration in Defined Outcome Overlays
detail.abstract: Defined outcome strategies use option overlays to reshape equity exposure into capped participation, first-loss downside protection, and a scheduled reset. Buffer ETFs package that strategy into an investor-facing vehicle, yet the marketed expiration payoff says little about the live overlay an investor holds between reset dates. We ask when a seasoned overlay becomes inefficient relative to a freshly reset one. Listed annual buffer ETF families illustrate the basic trade-off, reducing volatility relative to SPY but surrendering enough participation to trail SPY on Sharpe ratios over the same sample period. This motivates a state-level analysis rather than a standalone evaluation of ETF performance. We develop a roll-versus-hold diagnostic that weighs a seasoned overlay against a fresh reset using its placement on the original strike map, remaining tenor, and the prevailing option-market environment. In a long simulated S&P 500 buffer panel, reset value measured by average roll-versus-hold return is modest and highly state dependent. The larger effect lies in protection restoration, where a reset can curb the give-back of accrued gains after rallies and limit further losses once the original buffer has been impaired or spent. The framework is a risk-management tool for seasoned defined-outcome exposures, not a mechanical trading rule.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了缓冲ETF（Buffer ETFs）在重置日之间持有的“ seasoned overlay”（成熟期权覆盖策略）相对于“ fresh reset”（全新重置）是否会产生效率损失。通过构建“roll-versus-hold”诊断框架，发现重置的价值（以平均滚动vs持有回报衡量）适中且高度依赖市场状态，但更重要的效应在于保护修复——重置可以遏制上涨后的收益回吐，并在原始缓冲被侵蚀后限制进一步损失。
AI.research_question: 当缓冲ETF的期权覆盖策略在两个重置日之间“成熟”时，相对于重新重置的策略，它何时会变得低效？
AI.motivation: 缓冲ETF市场宣传的到期收益曲线无法反映投资者在重置日之间实际持有的期权覆盖策略表现，因此需要评估“持有成熟覆盖”与“滚动至新覆盖”之间的权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 滚仓vs持有诊断（roll-versus-hold diagnostic），基于原始行权价图谱、剩余期限和期权市场环境来评估 seasoned overlay 相对于 fresh reset 的价值。
AI.method: 使用标普500缓冲ETF的长期模拟面板数据，比较滚动重置与持有成熟覆盖的回报差异，并分析不同市场状态下的表现。
AI.findings: （1）年度缓冲ETF相比SPY降低了波动性，但牺牲了足够的参与度，导致夏普比率落后于SPY；（2）重置的价值（滚动vs持有回报）适中且高度依赖市场状态；（3）更大的效应在于保护修复：重置可以遏制上涨后的收益回吐，并在原始缓冲被侵蚀后限制进一步损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 为评估缓冲ETF中 seasoned defined-outcome exposures 提供了基于状态的、动态的风险管理框架，而非简单的机械交易规则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了一种风险管理的工具，帮助判断何时应该滚动持有缓冲ETF的期权覆盖策略，而非机械地持有至到期。

title: Allocation Authority and the Dividend Puzzle

detail.title: Allocation Authority and the Dividend Puzzle

declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The dividend puzzle endures not because existing theories are wrong, but because agency, signaling, clienteles, catering, and life-cycle mechanisms generate overlapping empirical predictions with no common decision-theoretic foundation. This paper provides such a foundation. The Allocation Authority Theory of Payout (AATP) organizes existing explanations as parameter configurations of a single framework, in which the payout decision determines who has authority over marginal capital: the firm or the shareholder. The relevant primitive is the Expected Allocation Error (EAE), the expected decision loss from acting under an imperfect signal. Under Gaussian signals and quadratic loss, EAE decomposes into a noise component and a bias component, each with a closed-form expression. AATP nests existing payout theories as special cases: Modigliani-Miller irrelevance is the degenerate case EAE F = EAE S ; Jensen's free-cash-flow hypothesis is the proper subset b F > 0. Six testable hypotheses are derived from the comparative statics, three of which generate predictions in regions where standard single-mechanism theories are silent: payout increases in internal signal noise (H1), decreases in external signal noise in a direction opposite to bird-in-hand (H2), and opportunity-set quality predicts payout among well-governed firms where agency bias is low (H6). H6 is the paper's key identifying implication against pure agency explanations. The model delivers theoretical separability among mechanisms; the empirical companion addresses the more demanding question of empirical identification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"股利分配权理论"(AATP)，将现有股利理论统一在一个决策理论框架下，核心概念是预期分配误差(EAE)。该理论衍生了六个可检验假说，其中H6（治理良好公司的机会集质量预测股利）是区别于纯代理理论的关键识别含义。
AI.research_question: 如何为股利支付谜题提供一个统一的决策理论基础，将代理理论、信号理论、客户效应、迎合理论和生命周期理论等现有解释整合为一个共同框架？
AI.motivation: 现有股利理论各自解释部分现象但缺乏共同的决策理论基础，导致实证预测重叠且无法区分。需要一个统一框架来理解企业为何以及如何支付股利。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分配权理论(AATP)：股利决策决定谁拥有边际资本的分配权（企业还是股东）。预期分配误差(EAE)是在不完美信号下行动的期望决策损失，可分解为噪声分量和偏误分量。
AI.method: 理论建模：在高斯信号和二次损失函数下推导EAE的封闭形式，通过比较静态分析生成可检验假说。
AI.findings: AATP将MM不相关定理(EAE_F=EAE_S)和Jensen自由现金流假说(b_F>0)作为特例。六个假说中三个在标准理论静默区产生预测：H1(内部信号噪声↑→股利↑)、H2(外部信号噪声↑→股利↓，与鸟在手理论相反)、H6(治理良好且代理偏误低的公司，机会集质量正向预测股利)。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供股利决策的统一决策理论基础；实现机制间的理论可分性；识别出纯代理理论无法解释的新预测(H6)。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和管理者理解股利决策提供了更全面的分析框架；H6为实证研究提供了区分不同股利理论的关键检验标准。

title: Bargaining Power and the Optimal Sequence of Negotiation
affiliations: Frankfurt School of Finance & Management - Economics Department and University of Cologne

detail.title: Bargaining Power and the Optimal Sequence of Negotiation

declarations.funderStatement: Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation), Excellence Strategy, EXC 2126/1− 390838866.

detail.abstract: In most bargaining situations with multiple parties, the negotiation sequence is crucial for the efficiency of outcomes and the parties' success. However, the driving forces behind the socially and privately optimal sequences are poorly understood. To study these issues, we consider a general framework of bilateral negotiations between a principal and two agents with bargaining externalities. We show that the agents' bargaining strengths are essential for the determination of the sequence. The surplus is highest if the principal negotiates with the stronger agent first, regardless of externalities being positive or negative. The principal always chooses the efficient sequence if externalities are negative. Instead, if externalities are positive, the principal often prefers to negotiate with the weaker agent first. We show that our results extend to a general number of agents, demonstrate that the sequence can be non-monotonic in the externalities, and provide conditions for simultaneous negotiations to be optimal.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多边谈判中谈判顺序的决定因素及其效率。在一个委托人与两个代理人存在谈判外部性的双边谈判框架下，发现代理人谈判实力是决定顺序的关键：无论外部性正负，委托人先与强者谈判总剩余最高；外部性为负时委托人选择效率最优顺序，外部性为正时委托人则偏好先与弱者谈判。
AI.research_question: 在多边谈判中，谈判顺序如何决定？什么因素驱动社会最优顺序与私人最优顺序？
AI.motivation: 现实中的多边谈判中谈判顺序对效率和参与方成功至关重要，但对其背后的驱动因素理解不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双边谈判外部性理论；委托人-代理人谈判框架
AI.method: 理论建模与分析（主模型为委托人与两个代理人的双边谈判，扩展到一般数量代理人，考虑正/负外部性）
AI.findings: 1) 代理人的谈判实力是决定顺序的关键；2) 无论外部性正负，先与强者谈判总剩余最高；3) 外部性为负时，委托人选择效率最优顺序；4) 外部性为正时，委托人偏好先与弱者谈判；5) 顺序可能随外部性非单调变化；6) 提供同时谈判最优的条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了谈判实力与外部性方向共同影响谈判顺序的机制，补充了多边谈判顺序选择的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多边谈判中顺序策略选择提供指导：当外部性为正时委托人可能选择非效率顺序以最大化自身利益。

title: The Effect of AMMs on Price Bubble Formation in Cryptocurrency Markets under Proof-of-Work and Proof-of-Stake
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Effect of AMMs on Price Bubble Formation in Cryptocurrency Markets under Proof-of-Work and Proof-of-Stake
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how blockchain consensus mechanisms and market mechanisms of liquidity provision affect price bubble formation in cryptocurrency markets. Specifically, we compare Proof-of-Work (PoW) and Proof-of-Stake (PoS) under two trading environments: a Limit Order Market (LOM) and an Automated Market Maker (AMM). We conduct a controlled laboratory experiment following a 2×2 between-subject design, generating four treatments: PoW-LOM, PoW-AMM, PoS-LOM, and PoS-AMM. Market outcomes are evaluated using standard bubble measures, including RD, RAD, RDMAX, AMPLITUDE, and CRASH. The results show that AMM-based markets exhibit weaker bubble dynamics than LOM-based markets, with lower mispricing, smaller peak overvaluation, and less severe crashes. By contrast, the results do not support the hypothesis that bubble formation is lower under PoS than under PoW. Instead, in the experimental setting, PoS treatments display stronger bubble patterns than PoW treatments. Overall, our results show that the institutional design of cryptocurrency markets plays an important role in shaping speculative price dynamics and market stability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验室实验，比较了工作量证明（PoW）与权益证明（PoS）两种共识机制，以及限价订单市场（LOM）与自动化做市商（AMM）两种交易环境对加密货币市场价格泡沫形成的影响。研究发现，AMM市场比LOM市场表现出更弱的泡沫动态，而PoS反而比PoW产生更强的泡沫模式。
AI.research_question: 区块链共识机制（PoW vs. PoS）和流动性提供市场机制（LOM vs. AMM）如何影响加密货币市场的价格泡沫形成？
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场的价格泡沫问题日益受到关注，但尚缺乏对制度设计因素（共识机制与市场机制）如何影响泡沫形成的系统性研究。本文通过受控实验填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场微观结构理论、行为金融学的泡沫理论，以及区块链共识机制的经济学分析框架。
AI.method: 采用2×2双因素组间设计的受控实验室实验，生成四个实验处理组（PoW-LOM、PoW-AMM、PoS-LOM、PoS-AMM），并使用RD、RAD、RDMAX、AMPLITUDE、CRASH等标准泡沫指标评估市场结果。
AI.findings: （1）AMM市场的泡沫动态弱于LOM市场，表现为更低的错误定价、更小的峰值高估和更轻的崩盘；（2）未发现PoS比PoW更少泡沫的证据，相反PoS表现出更强的泡沫模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在受控实验环境中系统比较了共识机制和市场交易机制对加密货币泡沫形成的交互影响，丰富了区块链经济学和市场微观结构理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密货币交易平台的设计者和监管者提供了实证依据：AMM机制有助于缓解泡沫，而PoS共识机制可能并非如预期那样减少投机性定价，需谨慎对待。

title: Confused Managers? ESG Disagreement and Capital Allocation Efficiency
affiliations: , Shanghai International Studies University and University of Macau

detail.title: Confused Managers? ESG Disagreement and Capital Allocation Efficiency
detail.abstract: ESG ratings issued by different raters exhibit substantial discrepancies, which potentially alter the informativeness of stock prices and further change firms' investment behavior as managers learn from asset prices. Using ESG ratings assigned to Chinese firms during 2015-2022, we find robust evidence that firms with greater ESG rating disagreement exhibit a lower investment-to-price sensitivity. Channel analysis indicates that ESG disagreement impairs capital allocation efficiency through its negative effect on stock price informativeness, rather than through exacerbating firms' financial constraints. Our results are robust to the mitigation of endogeneity concerns and the use of alternative measurement of key variables. Overall, our findings suggest that ESG rating disagreement can have an adverse impact on capital allocation efficiency.

AI.tldr: ESG评级分歧通过降低股价信息含量，进而削弱企业投资对股价的敏感度，损害资本配置效率。
AI.research_question: ESG评级分歧如何影响企业的投资-to-价格敏感性？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: ESG评级机构之间普遍存在显著分歧，但这种分歧对企业实际投资行为及资本市场效率的影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 管理者从资产价格中学习的理论；股价信息含量与资本配置效率的关系。
AI.method: 基于2015-2022年中国A股上市公司数据，采用固定效应回归、渠道分析（中介效应）、内生性处理（如工具变量）及替代变量稳健性检验。
AI.findings: ESG评级分歧越大的企业，其投资-to-价格敏感性越低；机制在于ESG分歧降低了股价信息含量，而非加剧融资约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了ESG评级分歧的经济后果研究，将评级分歧与价格学习理论及资本配置效率联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构协调ESG评级标准提供依据，警示企业关注ESG信息不一致对投资决策的潜在负面影响。

title: Governing Trust in Attestation Streams: A Bounded-Autonomy Method for Deciding When a Signed Claim Can Be Relied Upon

detail.title: Governing Trust in Attestation Streams: A Bounded-Autonomy Method for Deciding When a Signed Claim Can Be Relied Upon

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an independent researcher and is associated with Kloud Voyager. The author may in future develop applications of the method described herein, including through affiliated ventures. No such application is currently deployed or commercially offered, and this paper makes no efficacy or commercial claim. The author declares no other financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involves no human participants, animal subjects, or personal data; all results derive from synthetic simulation.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external, grant, or institutional funding. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Contemporary provenance and attestation standards establish the origin and integrity of a record but not its correspondence to reality. This paper formalizes a method for governing that residual decision: given a stream of signed claims, when a claim may be relied upon and when it must be escalated to independent re-verification. The method instantiates the Chaos-Bound Autonomy (CBA) framework over attestation streams, computing a composite risk index ρ(t) and contracting autonomous acceptance as risk rises. We characterize a trust ecosystem as a bistable complex adaptive system and identify bounded autonomy as a stabilizing feedback between its high-and low-trust attractors. A synthetic Monte Carlo study characterizes the detector's operating behavior under varying measurement uncertainty, and a stylized agent-based model illustrates the layer's effect on ecosystem-level trust dynamics. The method complements existing provenance and measurement infrastructure and is illustrated on high-integrity carbon credit verification. Results are synthetic; empirical validation on held-out data is identified as future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在来源认证流上管理信任决策的形式化方法，通过计算复合风险指数ρ(t)并在风险上升时收缩自主接受阈值，实现了混沌边界自主（CBA）框架在认证流上的实例化。该方法将信任生态系统刻画为双稳态复杂适应系统，并通过蒙特卡洛研究和基于智能体的模型验证了其行为特征。
AI.research_question: 在已建立来源和完整性标准的前提下，如何形式化地管理"一个签名声明是否可以信赖"这一剩余决策问题？即何时应当依赖声明，何时必须升级为独立复核？
AI.motivation: 现有来源和证明标准仅能确定记录的来源和完整性，但无法判断记录与现实是否对应。这一"剩余决策"缺乏形式化的治理方法，导致信任决策依赖主观判断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混沌边界自主（Chaos-Bound Autonomy, CBA）框架；双稳态复杂适应系统（bistable complex adaptive system）；高低信任吸引子间的稳定反馈机制。
AI.method: 形式化方法定义风险指数ρ(t)和自主接受收缩规则；合成蒙特卡洛研究检测测量不确定性下的操作行为；基于智能体的模型（ABM）模拟生态系统层级的信任动态。
AI.findings: 该方法可在认证流上实现风险自适应的信任决策，在高完整性碳信用验证场景得到说明；但结果为合成数据，经验验证被列为未来工作。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信任生态系统建模为双稳态复杂适应系统；识别出有界自主（bounded autonomy）作为高低信任吸引子之间的稳定化反馈机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为碳信用等高完整性验证场景提供了可操作的风险治理方法，补充现有的来源和测量基础设施。

title: The EU Agri-Food Sector as a Lead Market for Green Hydrogen
affiliations: Research Institute for Sustainability - Helmholtz Centre Potsdam (RIFS), Research Institute for Sustainability - Helmholtz Centre Potsdam (RIFS), Research Institute for Sustainability - Helmholtz Centre Potsdam (RIFS) and Technische Universität Berlin (TU Berlin)

detail.title: The EU Agri-Food Sector as a Lead Market for Green Hydrogen
detail.abstract: The ramp-up of a market for green hydrogen continues to fall behind political targets and expectations, driven by a persistent cost gap with fossil-based alternatives and the resulting lack of firm offtake agreements. At the same time, supply-side subsidies are unlikely to be available at the scale required to close this gap. The targeted creation of lead markets through demand-side instruments that anchor demand for green hydrogen predictably in downstream sectors can play a critical role in overcoming these challenges. Nitrogenous fertilisers and their downstream agri-food markets are of particular relevance in this context as they represent the largest current industrial use of hydrogen. In this paper, we develop a systematic analytical framework for evaluating the suitability of selected agri-food products as entry-points for the development of lead markets for green nitrogenous fertilizers. Based on the EU consumer market, we evaluate agri-food sectors along the dimensions of scale, affordability, domestic market autonomy as well as administrative feasibility. We identify five priority entry points: meat processing, dairy manufacturing, animal feed manufacture, grain milling and oils and fats processing. A combination of meat, dairy and grain could anchor 1,269 kt H2 demand, corresponding to 71% of total fertiliser-derived hydrogen demand and equivalent to the EU’s 2030 targets for green hydrogen use in industry. Our results underscore the importance of targeted selection of product groups for effective demand-side hydrogen policy.

AI.tldr: 本文针对绿氢市场发展滞后问题，提出通过需求侧工具在氮肥及下游农食产品领域创建领先市场，并基于欧盟市场识别出五个重点切入领域，可锚定相当于欧盟2030年工业绿氢目标的氢需求。
AI.research_question: 哪些农食产品可以作为绿氢氮肥领先市场发展的最佳切入点？
AI.motivation: 绿氢市场发展落后于政策目标，成本差距难以仅靠供给侧补贴弥合，亟需通过需求侧工具创造确定性的市场需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领先市场理论（lead market theory），需求侧政策工具框架，基于规模、可负担性、国内市场自主性、行政可行性四个维度的系统性评估框架。
AI.method: 构建四维度系统性分析框架，以欧盟消费者市场为基准，对农食产品进行多维度评估筛选，识别优先切入领域。
AI.findings: 识别出五个优先切入点：肉类加工、乳制品制造、动物饲料制造、谷物碾磨、油脂加工。其中肉类、乳制品和谷物的组合可锚定1,269 kt氢气需求，占化肥衍生氢总需求的71%，相当于欧盟2030年工业绿氢目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 为需求侧氢能政策提供了系统的产品选择分析框架，将领先市场理论应用于绿氢氮肥领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的农食产品优先清单和需求量化依据，指导需求侧氢能政策资源的高效配置。

title: Why Banking's AI Governance Gap Is a Systemic Risk and the Case for Binding Regulation in India
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Why Banking's AI Governance Gap Is a Systemic Risk and the Case for Binding Regulation in India
detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence has become core infrastructure in global banking , deployed across credit underwriting, fraud detection, customer service, and algorithmic trading. Yet governance has not kept pace with adoption. As of 2025, 92% of global banks have deployed AI in at least one core function, while only 32% have formal AI governance programs in place. This governance gap between the speed of deployment and the maturity of oversight  is the central concern of this report.

This report employs a mixed methodology  pairing secondary quantitative data from RBI, BIS, McKinsey, Grant Thornton and Deloitte with qualitative policy analysis and structured case review  to map the AI risk landscape in banking and test how well existing regulation actually holds. Five cases anchor the analysis. Three come from outside banking, where the evidentiary record is more mature: the Optum Health racial bias case (USA, 2019, peer reviewed in Science), the Dutch SyRI welfare algorithm struck down by the Hague District Court (2020), and the UK DWP algorithm that wrongly flagged some 200,000 claimants (2024). Two come from inside finance: the Apple Card / Goldman Sachs episode (2019–21), in which a regulator found no unlawful bias yet still faulted the bank for being unable to explain its own decisions and the 2012 Knight Capital collapse, in which an automated system with no tested off-switch lost roughly $440 million in forty-five minutes. India’s digital lending crisis is treated as a regulatory precedent in Section 6. The pattern across all five is consistent, oversight arrives after the fact, decisions cannot be explained, and scale magnifies both the benefits and the failures.

A five category AI risk taxonomy is developed, covering, algorithmic bias and discrimination, explainability and accountability gaps, systemic and correlated risk from algorithmic coupling, data privacy and third party vendor concentration risk and regulatory arbitrage. The report benchmarks four major regulatory frameworks , the EU AI Act, MAS Singapore's FEAT principles and MindForge guidelines, the US SR 26-2 model risk framework, and India's RBI FREE-AI framework (August 2025) ,against each other, finding that India's framework is ambitious in principle but critically weak on enforcement, mandatory timelines, and independent audit infrastructure.

The report closes with eight recommendations for regulators, five for financial institutions, and three for third-party AI vendors, mapped to a phased 36 month implementation timeline. Its central argument is direct, the RBI should convert FREE-AI from advisory guidance into binding Master Directions within twelve months , before the next wave of deployment writes the next crisis into the system.

AI.tldr: 该报告指出，全球银行业AI部署率已达92%，但仅有32%的银行拥有正式AI治理框架。通过混合研究方法分析五个案例（医疗算法偏见、荷兰SyRI福利算法、英国DWP算法、Apple Card/Goldman Sachs事件、Knight Capital崩溃），建立五类AI风险分类法，并比较四大监管框架（EU AI Act、MAS FEAT、US SR 26-2、印度FREE-AI），最终提出16条建议，核心呼吁印度央行在12个月内将FREE-AI从指导性意见转为具有约束力的指令。
AI.research_question: 在银行业AI快速部署但治理滞后的背景下，现有监管框架能否有效管控AI风险？印度FREE-AI框架相较于全球主要监管框架有何不足？
AI.motivation: 截至2025年，92%的全球银行已在至少一个核心功能中部署AI，但仅32%拥有正式AI治理项目。这一部署速度与监管成熟度之间的治理差距是报告的核心关切。
AI.theoretical_framework: 五类AI风险分类法：算法偏见与歧视、可解释性与问责缺位、算法耦合带来的系统性及关联风险、数据隐私与第三方供应商集中风险、监管套利。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：结合RBI、BIS、McKinsey、Grant Thornton、Deloitte等机构的二手定量数据，质性政策分析，以及结构化案例回顾。五个案例（3个外部+2个金融内部）锚定分析。
AI.findings: 五个案例呈现一致模式：监管总是事后介入、决策无法解释、规模放大收益的同时也放大失败。印度FREE-AI框架在原则上有雄心，但在执行、强制时间表和独立审计基础设施方面存在严重不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地将多个领域的AI失败案例整合到银行业AI风险分析中，提出五类风险分类法，并首次将印度FREE-AI框架与全球四大主流框架进行横向对标分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 向监管机构提出8条建议、金融机构5条建议、第三方AI供应商3条建议，并配套36个月分阶段实施时间表。核心建议：印度央行应在12个月内将FREE-AI从咨询性指南转为具有约束力的《主指示》。

title: Attracting Talent to General Practice through Financial Incentives
affiliations: , Charles III University of Madrid and University of Barcelona

detail.title: Attracting Talent to General Practice through Financial Incentives
detail.abstract: Shortages of general practitioners (GPs) strain healthcare systems worldwide. We test whether wage incentives can attract higher-ability physicians using a 2022 reform in Catalonia, Spain, that granted incoming GP residents unconditional salary supplements of 26% to 47% of base pay across three tiers. Using administrative data on medical residency choices nationwide and a synthetic difference-indifferences design, we document two effects. First, the reform raised entrants' standardized exam scores by 0.067 standard deviations on average (0.174 in the highest subsidy tier) and increased the international resident share by nearly 30 percentage points. Second, GP vacancies emerged nationwide after 2022 but rose 4.4 percentage points less in Catalonia, drawing lower-scoring candidates to the newly filled slots and mechanically diluting the average score gain. Lee bounds correcting for this compositional shift raise the estimated effects to 0.088 and 0.191 standard deviations in a fully cleared market. Our findings show that salary supplements can improve the allocation of medical talent to shortage occupations, though their effectiveness depends on local labor-market tightness and physician supply.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2022年西班牙加泰罗尼亚地区全科医生（GP）住院医师薪酬改革，发现薪资补贴（26%-47%的工资涨幅）显著提高了高能力医生的流入（考试成绩提升0.067个标准差，最高补贴层级提升0.174），并增加了国际住院医师比例（近30个百分点）。但全国性GP职位空缺导致新填充岗位吸引低分候选者，稀释了平均成绩提升；修正后效果更强（0.088-0.191标准差）。研究显示薪酬激励能改善医疗人才配置，但效果受劳动力市场紧俏程度和医生供给影响。
AI.research_question: 薪酬激励能否吸引高能力的医生进入全科医生（GP）这一紧缺职业？
AI.motivation: 全球范围内全科医生短缺问题日益严峻，但关于工资激励是否能有效吸引高能力医疗人才进入紧缺岗位的因果证据有限。本文利用加泰罗尼亚2022年的一项自然实验，首次提供了薪酬补贴对医生质量（而非数量）影响的准实验证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动经济学中效率工资理论、补偿性工资差异理论以及人才配置（sorting）理论。
AI.method: 使用行政数据（全国住院医师选择数据），采用合成双重差分法（synthetic difference-in-differences）进行因果识别，并运用Lee边界法（Lee bounds）纠正因职位填补带来的组成性偏移。
AI.findings: （1）改革使加泰罗尼亚GP住院医师标准化考试成绩平均提高0.067个标准差（最高补贴层级提高0.174），国际住院医师比例增加近30个百分点；（2）全国GP职位空缺率在改革后上升，但加泰罗尼亚的空缺率比全国低4.4个百分点；（3）新填充岗位吸引了低分候选者，稀释了平均成绩提升，Lee边界校正后效果提升至0.088-0.191个标准差。
AI.theory_contributions: 为薪酬激励影响劳动力质量（而非仅数量）提供了因果证据；揭示了人才配置中的"稀释效应"机制，即市场出清过程会部分抵消激励效果；拓展了补偿性工资差异理论在医疗人才市场中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者应对全科医生短缺提供了基于证据的薪酬工具建议；提示薪酬补贴的有效性取决于劳动力市场紧俏程度和医生供给弹性；为设计差异化、分层次的薪酬激励方案提供了参考。

title: Thai Delivery Reimagined
affiliations: Institute of Asian Studies, Chulalongkorn University

detail.title: Thai Delivery Reimagined
detail.abstract: This report explores groundbreaking structural reforms within Thailand’s massive gig economy, focusing on "Tamsang-Tamsong"—a platform cooperative initiative developed by motorcycle taxi drivers and Chulalongkorn University with the support of the Thai Health Promotion Foundation. It analyzes a viable alternative to the heavily extractive commission fees and labor exploitation propagated by mainstream commercial food delivery giants. By examining two distinct operational models on Thailand’s southern coast—a worker-led, driver-owned cooperative framework in Surat Thani and a multi-stakeholder model tailored to the tourism economy in Phuket—this paper demonstrates how platform cooperatives can systematically reduce environmental waste, implement fair labor standards, and actively restore driver earnings, which have plummeted by nearly 50% under traditional corporate platform architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨泰国摩托车出租车司机与朱拉隆功大学联合发起的“Tamsang-Tamsong”平台合作计划，作为对主流外卖平台高抽成和劳动剥削的替代方案，并分析泰国南海岸两种运营模式如何减少环境浪费、实施公平劳动标准并恢复司机收入。
AI.research_question: 平台合作制如何作为主流商业外卖平台（高抽成、劳动剥削）的可行替代方案，在不同经济环境下实现环境可持续性、公平劳动和司机收入恢复？
AI.motivation: 主流商业外卖平台对司机的高额佣金抽成和劳动剥削严重，导致司机收入下降近50%，且造成环境浪费问题。亟需探索一种更公平、可持续的替代性平台经济模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台合作制（Platform Cooperativism）、替代性平台经济、多利益相关方治理模型
AI.method: 比较案例研究：分析泰国南海岸两种不同运营模式——素叻他尼的工人主导、司机所有的合作框架，以及普吉岛针对旅游经济量身定制的多利益相关方模式。
AI.findings: 平台合作制能够系统性地减少环境浪费、实施公平劳动标准，并有效恢复司机收入。不同经济环境（本地经济 vs 旅游经济）需要匹配不同的合作治理模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 为平台合作制在发展中国家（泰国）零工经济中的应用提供实证案例，丰富了替代性平台经济治理的理论框架，尤其是不同情境下合作制模式的适应性选择。
AI.practical_contributions: 为泰国乃至其他发展中经济体在外卖和零工经济领域推动公平劳动、减少浪费和恢复司机收入提供了可操作的路径参考。

title: Importing Fragility: Can China Dodge the Bullet?
affiliations: European University Institute - Economics Department (ECO) and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Importing Fragility: Can China Dodge the Bullet?
detail.abstract: This paper studies whether China is vulnerable to the fragility induced by large capital inflows. Using both a theory model and empirical evidence from a large sample of countries, we argue that the combination of (i) the current state of the economy and (ii) existing institutions are sufficient to maintain stability. We develop an open-economy banking model that integrates bank run and currency run mechanisms, generating a non-monotonic relationship between capital inflows and financial stability that depends on household leverage. Using crosscountry panel data for 105 economies from 1995-2024, we establish that capital inflows improve bank stability when household debt-to-GDP remains below approximately 80%, but become destabilizing at higher leverage levels. Applying these estimates to China, we find that the country's current household debt ratio of approximately 62% places it in the "safe" region. China's extensive capital controls, managed exchange rate, low foreign-depositor share, and credible implicit state guarantee jointly shift the fragility threshold outward. Continued institutional refinement will allow China to harness the efficiency gains of deeper financial openness while preserving its current stability margins.

AI.tldr: 本文研究中国是否容易受到大规模资本流入引发的脆弱性影响。通过理论模型和跨国数据实证分析，发现资本流入对金融稳定的影响取决于家庭杠杆率：当家庭债务/GDP低于约80%时，资本流入改善银行稳定性；超过该阈值则产生破坏作用。中国当前家庭债务率约62%，处于安全区域，加之资本管制、管理汇率、低外国存款人比例和隐性政府担保等措施，进一步提升了稳定性门槛。
AI.research_question: 中国是否容易受到大规模资本流入引发的金融脆弱性影响？
AI.motivation: 过往文献指出新兴市场国家面临大规模资本流入时易产生金融脆弱性，但中国作为全球第二大经济体，其独特制度环境是否能够抵御这种脆弱性尚未得到系统回答。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放经济银行模型，整合了银行挤兑和货币挤兑机制，揭示资本流入与金融稳定之间的非线性关系取决于家庭杠杆率。
AI.method: 理论模型构建+跨国面板数据分析（105个经济体，1995-2024年）
AI.findings: （1）资本流入对银行稳定性的影响呈倒U型：家庭债务/GDP低于80%时起改善作用，超过后转为破坏作用；（2）中国当前62%的债务率处于安全区域；（3）中国的资本管制、管理汇率、低外国存款人比例及隐性政府担保共同将脆弱性阈值向外推移。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了整合银行挤兑与货币挤兑双重机制的开放经济银行模型，揭示了资本流入与金融稳定之间的非线性关系及其微观机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国金融开放政策提供了量化安全边界参考（家庭债务阈值约80%），并指出继续完善制度环境可以在维持稳定的同时利用更深度金融开放的效率收益。

title: Paying for Parity: Incentivizing Men in Feminized Occupations
affiliations: , Charles III University of Madrid and University of Barcelona

detail.title: Paying for Parity: Incentivizing Men in Feminized Occupations
detail.abstract: We find that gender-neutral financial incentives increased the share of male General Practice (GP) residents by 30% in Catalonia, Spain. Exploiting a salary supplement policy for GP residents and a synthetic difference-indifferences design, we estimate an increase of 8.3 percentage points, with effects concentrated in areas receiving larger wage increases. We also document suggestive evidence of lower GP vacancy rates in treated regions after the policy, although this pattern cannot be interpreted causally. To our knowledge, these results provide the first causal evidence that gender-neutral financial incentives can attract men into a highly feminized occupation.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，在西班牙加泰罗尼亚地区，性别中立的财务激励措施使男性全科医生（GP）住院医师的比例提高了30%。通过利用全科医生住院医师的薪资补贴政策以及合成双重差分设计，研究估计这一比例增加了8.3个百分点，且效果集中在工资涨幅较大的地区。研究还提供了政策实施后处理地区全科医生职位空缺率降低的提示性证据，但这一模式不能被因果性地解释。据作者所知，这些结果首次提供了因果证据，表明性别中立的财务激励能够吸引男性进入一个高度女性化的职业。
AI.research_question: 性别中立的财务激励措施是否能够吸引男性进入高度女性化的职业（全科医学）？
AI.motivation: 在高度女性化的职业中，男性从业者比例偏低是一个普遍现象。以往研究多关注女性进入男性主导职业的障碍，但较少探讨如何吸引男性进入女性主导职业。此外，关于财务激励能否改变职业性别构成，缺乏因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力供给理论、职业性别隔离理论、补偿性工资差异理论
AI.method: 利用西班牙加泰罗尼亚地区全科医生住院医师的薪资补贴政策作为准自然实验，采用合成双重差分（synthetic difference-in-differences）方法进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 性别中立的薪资补贴使男性全科医生住院医师比例提高了8.3个百分点（约30%），效果集中在工资涨幅较大的地区；处理地区全科医生职位空缺率有所下降（但非因果性证据）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了性别中立的财务激励能吸引男性进入高度女性化职业的因果证据，拓展了职业性别隔离与劳动力供给理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了通过调整薪酬结构来改善职业性别平衡、缓解特定行业劳动力短缺的实证依据。

title: What Constitution? The Dual State Theory in Immigration Law & Practice
affiliations: University of Baltimore - School of Law

detail.title: What Constitution? The Dual State Theory in Immigration Law & Practice
detail.abstract:
Immigration law in the second Trump Administration has created profound disorientation and dissonance, where some legal matters proceed in largely familiar ways, and others seem to occur in an entirely new dimension. This Article avails itself of Ernst Fraenkel’s Dual State theory to examine this dissonance. It argues that a duality exists in U.S. immigration law today between the federal courts and the administrative immigration system. In Fraenkel’s terms, constitutional challenges to immigration policies and individual habeas cases demonstrate important features of the Normative State, one that is consistent with the Rule of Law. By contrast, the administrative system—comprising the Department of Justice’s immigration courts and the Department of Homeland Security’s enforcement apparatus—exhibits all of the hallmarks of Fraenkel’s all-powerful Prerogative State, where executive power is unbounded. 

This Article maps many of the key developments of the second Trump Administration onto the Normative and Prerogative States, but also identifes how, even within the federal courts, there are signs of an encroaching Prerogative State. This Article concludes that while the Dual State already exists in immigration law, it differs—for now—in a fundamental way from the system Fraenkel observed in 1930s Nazi Germany: There, the Normative State functioned in name only, and only in limited areas of law. Thus far, the federal courts in the United States have generally resisted the encroachment of the Prerogative State.The ending of this particular story remains unwritten, but the Dual State framework allows us to name every destructive turn as a strengthening of the Prerogative State without becoming acculturated to its incursions into the Rule of Law.

AI.tldr: 本文运用Ernst Fraenkel的"双重国家"理论分析特朗普第二任期的移民法，指出美国移民法中存在联邦法院的"规范国家"与行政系统的"特权国家"之间的二元对立，并警示特权国家正在侵蚀法治。
AI.research_question: 特朗普第二任期移民法中的"规范国家"与"特权国家"二元结构如何体现？联邦法院与行政系统在移民法中的角色差异何在？
AI.motivation: 特朗普第二任期移民法呈现令人困惑的不协调现象——部分法律运作如常，部分则如同进入全新维度。作者试图用Fraenkel的双重国家理论来解释这种分裂。
AI.theoretical_framework: Ernst Fraenkel的"双重国家"理论（Dual State theory），包括"规范国家"（Normative State，遵循法治）和"特权国家"（Prerogative State，行政权力不受约束）两个核心概念。
AI.method: 理论应用与案例映射分析：将特朗普第二任期的移民法关键发展映射到Fraenkel的规范国家与特权国家框架中。
AI.findings: 1. 联邦法院审理的宪法挑战和人身保护令案件体现规范国家特征；2. 司法部移民法院和国土安全部执法系统体现特权国家特征；3. 即使在联邦法院内部，也出现特权国家侵蚀的迹象；4. 与纳粹德国不同，美国联邦法院目前总体上抵御了特权国家的入侵。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Fraenkel的双重国家理论应用于当代美国移民法，证明该理论在分析行政权力扩张与法治关系方面的持续解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解和批判特朗普政府移民政策中的法治侵蚀提供了分析框架，使人们能够辨识每一次破坏性转向并将其命名为"特权国家的强化"，从而避免对法治侵蚀的习以为常。

title: Long Social Distancing
affiliations: ITAM - Business School,  and Stanford University

detail.title: Long Social Distancing
detail.abstract: Many working-age Americans plan to continue some forms of social distancing after the COVID-19 pandemic ends. We uncover this long social distancing phenomenon in our monthly Survey of Working Arrangements and Attitudes. It is stronger among older persons, the less educated, and those who live with or care for persons at high risk from infectious diseases. Regression models fit to individual-level data suggest that social distancing lowered labor force participation by 2.4 percentage points in 2022, 1.2 points on an earnings-weighted basis. These effects are highly concentrated among persons with long COVID experiences or daily interactions with at-risk persons. When combined with simple equilibrium models, our results imply that the participation drag reduced U.S. output by $205 billion in 2022, shrank the college wage premium by 2.1 percentage points, and modestly steepened the cross-sectional age-wage profile. The social-distancing drag on participation diminished by an estimated 1.6 percentage points from February 2022 to April 2023. Drawing on self-assessed causal effects in a separate analysis, infection worries lowered participation by an estimated one percentage point as of late 2022.

AI.tldr: 研究发现疫情后大量美国劳动年龄人口仍持续保持社交距离，导致2022年劳动参与率下降2.4个百分点，造成GDP损失2050亿美元，并缩小了大学工资溢价。
AI.research_question: 疫情结束后，持续社交距离行为如何影响美国劳动力市场参与率及宏观经济产出？
AI.motivation: 许多劳动年龄美国人计划在疫情结束后仍保持某种形式的社交距离，这一"长期社交距离"现象对劳动力市场的影响尚未被充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动供给理论、均衡模型、人力资本理论（年龄-工资曲线）
AI.method: 月度"工作安排与态度调查"（SWAA）面板数据；个体层面回归模型；结合简单均衡模型进行宏观推断；自我报告的因果效应分析。
AI.findings: 1）社交距离使2022年劳动参与率降低2.4个百分点（收入加权后为1.2个百分点）；2）影响集中在长新冠患者及日常接触高风险人群者；3）2022年GDP减少2050亿美元；4）大学工资溢价缩小2.1个百分点；5）年龄-工资曲线略微变陡；6）从2022年2月到2023年4月，参与率拖累减少了1.6个百分点；7）截至2022年末，感染担忧使劳动参与率降低约1个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次系统量化了后疫情时代"长期社交距离"对劳动参与率的持续影响；2）将流行病学行为变化纳入劳动经济学分析框架；3）揭示了社交距离对技能溢价和年龄工资结构的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者评估疫情长期经济后果提供量化依据（2050亿美元产出损失）；2）提示需要针对长新冠患者和高风险人群照护者设计定向劳动市场支持政策；3）指出疫情导致的社交距离行为变化可能加剧教育不平等（缩小大学溢价反而可能降低教育投资激励）。

title: Strategic Testing and Rank Equivalence *
affiliations: University of Warwick, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, University Bonn, Bar-Ilan University - Department of Economics and Stanford University - Stanford Graduate School of Business

detail.title: Strategic Testing and Rank Equivalence *
detail.abstract: We study selection contests in which initially uninformed candidates strategically choose the difficulty of pass-fail tests, and a principal selects a candidate based on observed test outcomes. We show that the expected rank of the selected candidate in the symmetric equilibrium is the same whether or not the principal observes failed candidates' test choices. Even more surprisingly, an optimally chosen uniform test for all candidates yields the same expected rank as these decentralized environments. As a corollary, restricting the set of admissible tests cannot improve the equilibrium selection value. By contrast, if the principal can discriminate across candidates, asymmetric testing procedures strictly improve selection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究选拔竞赛中，候选人策略性选择测试难度，委托人基于测试结果选拔候选人。对称均衡下，无论委托人是否观察到失败者的测试选择，被选中候选人的期望排名相同，且最优统一测试也能达到相同期望排名。限制测试集不能改善选拔效果，但歧视性测试程序可以严格改善选拔。
AI.research_question: 在选拔竞赛中，当候选人策略性地选择测试难度时，不同的信息结构和测试设计如何影响委托人选拔候选人的质量（期望排名）？
AI.motivation: 现实中选拔过程常涉及候选人自主选择测试难度（如考试科目、项目难度），委托人则根据结果选拔。理解这种分散决策机制下选拔效果，以及集中统一测试或歧视性测试能否改善选拔质量，具有重要理论价值和实践意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 选拔竞赛理论、信号博弈、机制设计理论、对称均衡分析。
AI.method: 博弈论建模与理论推导，比较不同信息结构（是否观察失败者测试选择）和不同测试设计（分散选择、统一测试、歧视性测试）下的均衡结果。
AI.findings: (1) 对称均衡下，委托人是否观察失败者的测试选择不影响被选中候选人的期望排名；(2) 最优统一测试与分散选择产生相同的期望排名；(3) 限制测试集不能改善选拔效果；(4) 歧视性（非对称）测试程序可以严格改善选拔质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了分散选拔机制与集中统一测试在期望排名上的等价性，并对"测试集受限能否改善选拔"这一理论问题给出了否定回答，同时证明了歧视性测试的优越性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织选拔设计（如考试制度、招聘流程）提供指导：统一标准化测试可以达到分散自选测试同样的选拔效果，但若允许针对不同候选人设计差异化测试，则可进一步提升选拔质量。

title: Portfolio Optimization of Thai Equities Using Modern Portfolio Theory (MPT)
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Portfolio Optimization of Thai Equities Using Modern Portfolio Theory (MPT)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that may have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study used publicly available financial market data and did not involve human participants or personal information.
declarations.funderStatement: This independent research project was conducted without external funding and was supported solely by the author's personal initiative and academic interest in Quantitative Finance and Financial Engineering.

detail.abstract: This research paper investigates the application of Modern Portfolio Theory (MPT) to the optimization of equity portfolios comprising Thai stocks listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET). Using historical return data from eight prominent Thai equities across diverse sectors, this study constructs the Efficient Frontier and identifies the optimal portfolio that maximizes the Sharpe ratio. The methodology employs mean-variance optimization techniques pioneered by Harry Markowitz (1952), utilizing expected returns, variances, covariances, and correlation matrices derived from historical price data. Through Monte Carlo simulation of 25,000 random portfolios, the study identifies the maximum Sharpe ratio portfolio achieving an expected annual return of 12.16% with a risk level of 15.71%, significantly outperforming both the minimum risk portfolio and the equal-weighted benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文运用马科维茨现代投资组合理论，基于泰国证券交易所8只股票的历史数据，通过均值-方差优化和蒙特卡洛模拟构建有效前沿，发现最优夏普比率组合能实现12.16%的年化预期收益和15.71%的风险水平，显著优于最小风险组合和等权重基准。
AI.research_question: 现代投资组合理论（MPT）如何应用于优化泰国股票投资组合？能否通过均值-方差优化方法在泰国股市中找到优于基准的最优投资组合？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦于发达市场，对新兴市场尤其是泰国股市的MPT应用研究不足。投资者需要系统性的资产配置方法以在新兴市场中实现风险收益平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现代投资组合理论（MPT）——Harry Markowitz（1952）提出的均值-方差优化框架，核心概念包括有效前沿、夏普比率最大化、资产收益率的协方差与相关性矩阵。
AI.method: 采用均值-方差优化方法，基于8只泰国股票的预期收益率、方差、协方差和相关性矩阵；通过蒙特卡洛模拟生成25,000个随机投资组合来勾勒有效前沿，并识别最大化夏普比率的最优组合。
AI.findings: 最优夏普比率组合可实现12.16%的年化预期收益率和15.71%的风险水平；该组合表现显著优于最小风险组合和等权重基准。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了MPT在新兴市场（泰国股市）的有效性；提供了MPT在有限股票数量条件下构建有效前沿的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为泰国及类似新兴市场的投资者提供了可操作的投资组合优化方法；展示了蒙特卡洛模拟在实际资产配置中的具体应用；证明了系统性优化优于简单等权重策略。

title: Market Discounting States

detail.title: Market Discounting States
detail.abstract: I construct the Market Discounting Index (MDX), a daily state variable beginning in 1927 that measures how intensely markets incorporate information into prices. The MDX cycles between periods of kinesis, in which investors actively incorporate information into prices, and periods of stasis, in which investors incorporate information only weakly. Markets underreact to negative economic surprises during stasis, which I interpret as most consistent with ambiguity aversion. The MDX does not require a pre-specified information event, which I illustrate with the 2007 Quant Quake and the 2022 Jackson Hole Economic Symposium.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了市场贴现指数（MDX），这是一个始于1927年的日度状态变量，用于衡量市场将信息纳入价格的程度。MDX在活跃期（投资者积极将信息纳入价格）和停滞期（投资者仅微弱地将信息纳入价格）之间循环。在停滞期，市场对负面经济冲击反应不足，作者将其解释为最符合模糊厌恶理论。MDX不需要预设的信息事件，作者以2007年量化地震和2022年杰克逊霍尔经济研讨会为例进行了说明。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够衡量市场将信息纳入价格程度的状态变量，并研究其在不同时期对信息反应的影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏一个持续、无需预设事件的市场信息处理效率度量指标，作者希望通过构建MDX来填补这一空白，并理解市场在不同状态下对信息的反应差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模糊厌恶理论（Ambiguity Aversion）——在停滞期市场对负面经济冲击反应不足的现象最符合该理论解释。
AI.method: 构建Market Discounting Index (MDX)日度指标，基于1927年以来的历史数据，通过市场对信息的吸收程度来区分活跃期（kinesis）和停滞期（stasis）。
AI.findings: MDX在活跃期和停滞期之间循环；在停滞期，市场对负面经济冲击反应不足；该现象最符合模糊厌恶理论的解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新的市场信息处理效率理论框架，将模糊厌恶理论与市场信息吸收的动态过程联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个实用的日度市场状态指标（MDX），可用于识别市场信息吸收效率的阶段性变化，帮助投资者理解市场在不同状态下对信息的反应模式。

title: Who Takes the Hit? The Uneven Impacts of Generative AI on Labor Demand across Countries
affiliations: , World Bank, World Bank and World Bank

detail.title: Who Takes the Hit? The Uneven Impacts of Generative AI on Labor Demand across Countries
detail.abstract: Has generative AI begun to displace workers globally, or only in high-income countries? This paper exploits the November 2022 release of ChatGPT as a technology shock and applies difference-indifferences and event study designs to 555 million Lightcast job postings spanning 84 countries from 2021Q1 to 2025Q2, comparing labor demand across occupations with high versus low AI-substitution vulnerability. In high-income countries, postings for above-median vulnerability occupations declined by 5.8 percent on average relative to less substitutable occupations-after controlling for GenAI exposure and monetary policy sensitivity-with effects intensifying over time. In middle-and low-income countries, the impact is much smaller and statistically insignificant. Crosscountry analysis suggests that certain channels may have driven this divergence: displacement is larger in higher-income countries and, conditional on GDP per capita, in countries with greater GenAI adoption, more years of schooling, stronger English proficiency, and greater specialization in digital services trade. Together, these findings suggest that limited AI adoption, the absence of complementary factors for adoption, and potentially less exposure to digital services trade have so far muted the labor displacement effects in middle-and low-income countries.

AI.tldr: 本文利用ChatGPT在2022年11月的发布作为技术冲击，基于84个国家5.55亿条招聘数据（2021Q1-2025Q2），采用双重差分和事件研究方法发现：高收入国家中，高AI替代脆弱性职业的招聘需求平均下降5.8%，且效应随时间增强；而中低收入国家的影响较小且统计不显著。这种差异可能源于AI采用率、教育水平、英语熟练度和数字服务贸易专业化的不同。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI是否已经开始在全球范围内取代工人，还是仅局限于高收入国家？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦于AI对发达经济体劳动力市场的影响，缺乏对全球不同收入水平国家（特别是中低收入国家）AI替代效应的系统性比较分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI替代脆弱性理论；技术采用与互补要素理论；国际贸易中的数字服务专业化理论。
AI.method: 以ChatGPT 2022年11月发布作为外生技术冲击，使用双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences）和事件研究法（Event Study），分析84个国家5.55亿条Lightcast招聘职位数据（2021Q1-2025Q2），比较高AI替代脆弱性与低AI替代脆弱性职业之间的劳动力需求变化。
AI.findings: 高收入国家中，高AI替代脆弱性职业的招聘需求相对低替代性职业平均下降5.8%，且效应随时间累积增强；中低收入国家的影响更小且统计不显著。跨国家分析表明，这种差异与GDP水平、AI采用率、教育年限、英语熟练度和数字服务贸易专业化程度密切相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了生成式AI劳动力替代效应的异质性，提出了"AI替代效应在全球范围内并非均匀分布"的理论观点，并识别了导致国家间差异的潜在机制（AI采用率、互补要素、数字服务贸易专业化）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国政策制定者理解AI对劳动力市场的影响提供了基于全球数据的实证证据，提示中低收入国家在制定AI相关政策时需考虑本国AI采用水平、教育基础和数字贸易专业化程度等因素。

title: Non-linear Effects in Shot Quality and Goal Probability: A Generalized Additive Model Analysis of Open Bundesliga Tracking and Event Data
affiliations: Wesley College of Education and Wesley College of Education

detail.title: Non-linear Effects in Shot Quality and Goal Probability: A Generalized Additive Model Analysis of Open Bundesliga Tracking and Event Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This study compared linear and non-linear modelling approaches to examine shot quality and goal probability using open-source tracking and event data from the German Bundesliga. Shot-level data (n = 164) were extracted from seven matches of the Integrated Spatiotemporal and Event dataset (IDSSE), including spatial, contextual, and defensive features such as distance, angle, defensive pressure, and number of defenders. Vendor-provided expected goals (xG) were modelled via linear regression and generalized additive models (GAMs) with smooth terms, while goal outcome was modelled via logistic regression (GLM) and a GAM incorporating a random intercept for match. Model performance was assessed using the Akaike information criterion (AIC), five-fold cross-validated area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), and the Brier score. For xG, the GAM revealed significant non-linear effects of shot angle (effective degrees of freedom = 1.8, p < 0.001) and number of defenders (edf = 2.5, p < 0.001), yielding improved AIC compared to the linear model (-293.0 vs.-284.3), while defensive pressure was linearly associated with lower xG. For goal probability, only the number of defenders approached significance (p = 0.08), and GAM smooth terms largely reduced to linear; The goal-prediction GAM achieved moderate discrimination (AUC = 0.73, SD = 0.08) and good calibration (Brier score = 0.088, SD = 0.025). Non-linear modelling modestly enhanced the explanation of vendor-provided shot quality (xG) but provided limited gain for goal prediction in this small elite sample. The findings highlight the value of open data for reproducible football analytics and underscore the complexity of goal scoring beyond spatial and defensive metrics. The study is limited by a modest sample of seven matches, and the goal-level findings should be interpreted with caution.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用德国德甲联赛的开源追踪和事件数据，比较了线性和非线性建模方法在评估射门质量（预期进球xG）和进球概率上的表现。尽管非线性模型在解释xG方面略有改进（如射门角度和防守人数呈现非线性效应），但在预测实际进球方面增益有限（AUC=0.73）。研究强调了开放数据对可复现足球分析的价值，同时指出了射门得分预测的复杂性。
AI.research_question: 线性和非线性建模方法在评估射门质量（xG）和预测进球概率方面表现如何？
AI.motivation: 足球分析中，xG模型广泛用于评估射门质量，但多数模型采用线性假设。本研究希望通过比较线性回归/逻辑回归与广义加性模型（GAM），检验射门特征（如角度、防守压力、防守人数）与xG及进球之间是否存在非线性关系，从而评估非线性建模的增量价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预期进球（xG）模型、广义加性模型（GAM）、逻辑回归（GLM）、线性回归、信息准则（AIC）、AUC、Brier评分。
AI.method: 数据来源：德国德甲7场比赛的IDSSE开放数据集，共164次射门。特征包括空间变量（距离、角度）、情境变量和防守变量（防守压力、防守人数）。建模方式：xG采用线性回归和GAM（含平滑项）；进球概率采用逻辑回归（GLM）和GAM（含比赛随机截距）。评估指标：AIC、五折交叉验证AUC、Brier评分。
AI.findings: 1. xG模型：GAM显著优于线性模型（AIC: -293.0 vs -284.3），射门角度（edf=1.8, p<0.001）和防守人数（edf=2.5, p<0.001）呈现显著非线性效应，防守压力为线性负向影响。2. 进球概率模型：仅防守人数接近显著（p=0.08），GAM平滑项基本退化为线性；GAM区分能力中等（AUC=0.73），校准良好（Brier=0.088）。3. 非线性建模对xG解释有适度提升，但对实际进球预测增益有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 实证检验了射门特征与xG之间的非线性关系，发现射门角度和防守人数存在显著非线性效应，丰富了xG建模的理论基础。2. 指出在精英比赛的小样本情境下，非线性建模对进球预测的边际贡献有限，说明进球预测的复杂性超越了空间和防守指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 验证了开源数据（IDSSE）在足球分析中的可复现价值，为其他研究者提供了方法参考。2. 为足球数据分析师提供了建模建议：在评估射门质量（xG）时可考虑非线性效应，但预测实际进球时简单的线性模型可能已足够。3. 提醒学界和业界注意小样本下模型评估的谨慎性。

title: Stable and Fair Random Allocations in a Two-Sided Discrete-Concave Market
affiliations: University of Tokyo and Chuo University

detail.title: Stable and Fair Random Allocations in a Two-Sided Discrete-Concave Market
detail.abstract: Random allocations are widely used to handle ties and indifferences in two-sided environments. In such environments, commonly used procedures such as random tie-breaking may fail to ensure stability and fairness from an ex ante perspective. We show that when agents have discrete concave (M ♮-concave) valuations, there exists an ex ante stable and fair allocation. To establish this result, we relate our framework to the model of stability introduced by Alkan and Gale.
