The study concludes that central bank independence in Suriname has been predominantly de jure rather than de facto, and that sustainable fiscal policies, credible fiscal rules, and stronger institutional frameworks are essential for preserving monetary credibility and macroeconomic stability. The findings contribute to the literature on fiscal-monetary interactions in small commodity-dependent economies and offer policy recommendations for strengthening economic resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2000-2025年苏里南财政政策与央行独立性的关系，发现财政主导（fiscal dominance）严重制约了央行实际独立性，尽管法律上有保障，但央行独立性更多是名义上的（de jure）而非事实上的（de facto）。
AI.research_question: 在苏里南这一小型商品依赖型经济体中，财政政策如何影响央行独立性？财政主导在多大程度上制约了货币政策的自主性与宏观经济稳定？
AI.motivation: 苏里南作为小型商品依赖型经济体，长期面临财政赤字和公共债务问题，这可能导致央行被迫为财政融资，从而损害货币政策独立性。现有文献对这类经济体的财政-货币互动关注不足，亟需实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政主导理论（Fiscal Dominance Theory）；央行独立性理论（Central Bank Independence）；制度经济学分析框架。
AI.method: 采用多维分析框架，综合运用机构分析、央行资产负债表指标和宏观经济变量；计量方法包括普通最小二乘法（OLS）、自回归分布滞后模型（ARDL）、向量自回归模型（VAR）以及结构断点模型。
AI.findings: （1）财政失衡历史性地增加了对央行融资的依赖；（2）这导致了货币扩张、通货膨胀压力和汇率贬值；（3）财政主导严重制约了苏里南央行的有效操作独立性；（4）央行独立性更多是名义上的（de jure）而非事实上的（de facto）。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了财政-货币互动文献，特别是在小型商品依赖型经济体情境下验证了财政主导理论；揭示了发展中国家"名义独立但实际受制"的央行独立性悖论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出政策建议：需实施可持续的财政政策、建立可信的财政规则、强化制度框架以维护货币可信度和宏观经济稳定，为增强经济韧性提供政策参考。

title: Effects of Parents' Health on the Economic Outcomes of Children: Evidence in Korea
affiliations: National Pension Research Institute and St. Lawrence University

detail.title: Effects of Parents' Health on the Economic Outcomes of Children: Evidence in Korea

declarations.declarationOfInterest: no conflicts of interest

detail.abstract: This study examines how unexpected parental health shocks when children are aged between 15 and 20 affect children's labor market and social outcomes, using data from the Korea Labor and Income Panel Study (KLIPS). To address potential selection bias and identify causal effects, we employ the Heckman two-step selection model that controls for unobservables. Our findings show that parental health problems have a statistically significant negative impact on children's four-year college enrollment and graduation, employment status, and future wages. Interestingly, these effects vary by birth order and gender; firstborn children, in particular, suffer a greater penalty as they step in to fill the caregiving gap. These findings suggest that unexpected household health shocks can induce inequality among siblings and serve as a key mechanism that hinders intergenerational socioeconomic mobility.

AI.tldr: 本文利用韩国劳动与收入面板研究数据，发现父母在子女15-20岁期间发生的意外健康冲击会显著降低子女的四年制大学入学/毕业率、就业率和未来工资，且这种负面效应因出生顺序和性别而异，长子/长女因承担照护责任而遭受更大惩罚。
AI.research_question: 父母在子女青少年晚期（15-20岁）发生的意外健康冲击，如何影响子女的劳动力市场结果和社会结果？这种影响是否因出生顺序和性别而存在差异？
AI.motivation: 家庭健康冲击可能引发代际不平等，但现有研究对健康冲击发生在子女关键教育-职业过渡期的影响关注不足，尤其缺乏对兄弟姐妹间不平等机制的探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、家庭资源稀释理论、代际传递理论、性别角色分工理论
AI.method: 使用韩国劳动与收入面板研究(KLIPS)数据，采用Heckman两步选择模型纠正样本选择偏误，识别因果效应。
AI.findings: (1)父母健康冲击显著降低子女的四年制大学入学率、毕业率、就业率和未来工资；(2)效应因出生顺序和性别而异，长子/长女（尤其是第一胎）因填补照护缺口而承受更大惩罚；(3)家庭健康冲击是加剧兄弟姐妹间不平等、阻碍代际社会经济流动的关键机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 从家庭健康冲击视角拓展了代际不平等与兄弟姐妹间差异的研究，揭示了出生顺序作为家庭内部资源分配调节变量的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供依据：应针对遭遇父母健康冲击的家庭中的长子/长女群体提供教育支持、照护补贴和就业援助，以缓解代际不平等。

title: The Klip Disconnect Magnitude II (KDM-2): A Two-Axis, Persistence-Weighted, and Survival-Calibrated Framework for Detecting Institutional Cognitive Capture in Late-Cycle Equity Manias
affiliations: Universidad Anahuac Mexico

detail.title: The Klip Disconnect Magnitude II (KDM-2): A Two-Axis, Persistence-Weighted, and Survival-Calibrated Framework for Detecting Institutional Cognitive Capture in Late-Cycle Equity Manias

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declaration of interests: The author received no external funding for this work and has no financial or non-financial relationships with any organization that could be construed as influencing it. The Micron Technology prediction stated in the prior paper (KDM 1.0) remains open at the time of writing; the author may discuss publicly traded securities mentioned herein but provides no investment advice. AI-assisted tools were used for drafting and editorial refinement, as disclosed in the author’s note.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper names a publicly traded company (Micron Technology) and states a falsifiable prediction of a price decline. It is offered for hypothesis-testing only, is not investment advice, and analyzes institutional incentives rather than imputing bad faith to any individual analyst.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces KDM-2, a substantially revised indicator of late-cycle cognitive capture in equity markets that addresses three structural weaknesses in the original Klip Disconnect Magnitude1 (KDM 1.0): its reliance on a single-day snapshot, its blindness to the terminal phase of a mania, and its lack of a base rate. KDM-2 makes four changes. First, it generalizes the binary rating gate into a continuous bullishness weight. Second, it adds a persistence weight, so that a disconnect counts only insofar as it survives the time analysts need to update. Third, and most important, it adds a second axis—the revision disconnect—defined as the growth of analysts’ own price targets in excess of the growth of their own forward earnings estimates. This second axis is shown to equal the rate of multiple expansion that analysts embed in their targets, and it remains informative precisely when the first axis collapses. Fourth, all components are standardized crosssectionally, placing the base rate inside the metric. Finally, the paper reformulates the indicator as a set of time-varying covariates in a Cox proportional-hazards model for the event of a large peak-totrough drawdown, a formulation that forces the construction of a control group and yields falsifiable, out-of-sample hypotheses. The transition of Micron Technology between May 26 and June 15, 2026—during which the original KDM fell from 0.2851 to roughly 0.20 even as the mania intensified, because analysts raised targets faster than price—is presented as a live illustration of exactly the failure mode KDM-2 is built to capture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KDM-2指标，通过加入持续性权重、修正分歧轴和横截面标准化等四项改进，解决了原KDM 1.0在捕捉认知偏差方面的三个结构性缺陷，并将其嵌入Cox比例风险模型以生成可证伪的预测假设。
AI.research_question: 如何改进股市周期后期的认知偏差捕捉指标（KDM），使其更准确、更稳健地识别市场狂热期的结构性弱点？
AI.motivation: 原KDM 1.0存在三个系统性缺陷：依赖单日快照（忽略持续性）、对狂热末期视而不见（分析师修正目标价反而压低指标）、缺乏基准率。这些缺陷导致指标在关键时期失效，如Micron Technology案例中指标下降而狂热反而加剧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知偏差与市场脱节理论、分析师目标价与盈利预测的联动机制、Cox比例风险模型。
AI.method: KDM-2进行四项改进：1) 将二元评级门限泛化为连续看多权重；2) 增加持续性权重，要求脱节现象在分析师更新信息所需时间内持续才计入；3) 引入"修正分歧"轴——分析师目标价增长率超过自身盈利预测增长率的部分，该轴等于分析师隐含的倍数扩张率；4) 所有指标横截面标准化，内置基准率。最终将指标作为Cox比例风险模型的时变协变量，预测大幅回撤事件。
AI.findings: KDM-2在KDM 1.0失效时仍能保持信息含量：当第一轴（价格分歧）崩溃时，第二轴（修正分歧）依然有效；Micron Technology案例证明，KDM 1.0在5月26日至6月15日期间从0.2851降至约0.20（因分析师提目标价速度快于股价），而狂热实际在加剧，KDM-2则能正确识别这一状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"修正分歧"作为衡量分析师隐含倍数扩张的新维度；将市场脱节指标从静态快照升级为考虑时间持续性的动态系统；通过Cox模型框架将描述性指标转化为可检验的预测理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和监管者提供了更可靠的狂热末期识别工具；通过构建对照组和可证伪假设，提高了指标在使用前的可信度检验能力；对Micron Technology的实况分析为市场参与者提供了具体的应用案例。

title: The Spatial Support Problem in Public Spending Data: Evidence from Defense IT Procurement

detail.title: The Spatial Support Problem in Public Spending Data: Evidence from Defense IT Procurement
detail.abstract: The evaluation of regional economic policy and spatial analysis heavily relies on how geographic data is extracted and assembled from public administrative systems before any interpretation occurs. Such records routinely embed more than one geographic field, each produced for a distinct institutional purpose, so that the selection among administratively valid geographies is an analytical decision rather than a clerical detail, with measurable consequences for county-level totals, rankings, and the spatial structure of the resulting fields. The argument is developed in the setting of U.S. federal procurement, where prime-award records report both a recipient county and a reported place-of-performance county. Using Department of Defense contract actions in NAICS 541511 (Custom Computer Programming Services) for fiscal years 2019-2022, the paper introduces the Spatial Divergence Index (SDI), a 0-100 bounded measure of the normalized absolute difference between recipient-side and reported-performance obligations at county-year support, and a signed counterpart D that distinguishes recipient-hub from performance-importer countyyears. In the canonical continental U.S. analytic file, USD 13.08 billion in positive obligations are used for measurement. Of these dollars, 40.8 percent are assigned to different counties and 33.9 percent to different states under the two administrative geographies. The selection also reorders the procurement geography itself: recipient-and performance-based county totals exhibit a Spearman rank correlation of 0.462, and 75.0 percent of counties change decile. Complete divergence (SDI = 100) is common in the baseline panel but concentrates in low-activity county-years; restricting to county-years with at least ten counted transactions reduces the SDI = 100 share from 46.0 to 7.5 percent. The principal contribution is this dollarweighted reallocation and rank-shift evidence, which is robust to the activity-threshold and accounting-measure audits reported below. A complementary and deliberately exploratory spatial analysis shows that the signed field D carries small (Moran's I point estimates 0.08-0.13), statistically detectable, but specification-sensitive positive autocorrelation in fiscal years 2020-2022 under k-nearest-neighbor weights with Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and that the directional classification of counties is highly persistent from year to year. The performance-importer (High-High) local clusters are strongly associated with the presence of major Department of Defense installations-80 percent of these clusters host one, against 14 percent of non-clustered counties-confirming the administrative-reporting interpretation of the directional measure. The spatial autocorrelation attenuates under Queen contiguity and under restriction to high-activity county-years and is therefore reported as a secondary, exploratory characterization rather than as the load-bearing result. The contribution is conceptual rather than algebraic: SDI is a county-year application of the normalized absolute difference from the dissimilarity-index family, and the paper documents its empirical and spatial behavior when applied to administrative procurement records where geography selection is consequential and currently unaudited.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析美国联邦采购数据，发现行政记录中不同地理字段（接收方县与履约县）的选择会显著改变县级采购总额、排名及空间分布格局。作者构建了空间差异指数（SDI）来量化这种差异，并发现超过40%的采购资金在两种地理口径下被分配到不同县，履约导向的空间聚类与国防部军事基地高度相关。
AI.research_question: 在美国联邦采购行政记录中，选择不同的行政地理字段（接收方县 vs. 履约县）如何影响县级经济指标的汇总值、排名以及空间结构？
AI.motivation: 区域经济政策评估和空间分析严重依赖行政数据中地理信息的提取方式。行政记录通常包含多个地理字段，每个字段服务于不同的制度目的，因此地理字段的选择是一个分析决策而非技术细节。目前这一选择对结果的影响尚未得到充分关注和审计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间差异指数（SDI），基于相异度指数族中的归一化绝对差异；空间自相关分析（Moran's I）；局部聚类分析（LISA）。
AI.method: 使用美国国防部2019-2022财年NAICS 541511（定制计算机编程服务）的合同数据，构建0-100分制的空间差异指数（SDI）及其有符号版本D，通过统计描述、秩相关分析、空间自相关分析和局部聚类分析，结合活动阈值与会计计量稳健性检验。数据总规模为130.8亿美元正向义务支出。
AI.findings: （1）40.8%的资金在两种地理口径下被分配到不同县，33.9%被分配到不同州；（2）两种口径的县级总额Spearman秩相关系数仅为0.462，75%的县改变十分位排名；（3）完全差异（SDI=100）在低活动量县-年集中，设置交易笔数阈值后从46%降至7.5%；（4）有符号差异D在2020-2022财年存在微弱但显著的正空间自相关；（5）履约导入型（High-High）局部聚类中80%拥有大型国防部军事基地，而非聚类县仅14%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将相异度指数族中的归一化绝对差异引入行政地理选择效应的量化分析，提出SDI作为一个概念性工具来测度地理字段选择对经济指标的影响，而非提供新的数学推导。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了联邦采购行政记录中地理字段选择的重大影响，提醒政策评估者和空间分析人员注意地理数据提取决策的后果；为采购数据的审计和标准化提供了实证依据；证明了国防部军事基地位置可以解释履约导向型聚类的地理模式。

AI.tldr: 本文通过苏里南2020-2022年的债务危机案例，论证了政策可信度是主权债务可持续性的决定性因素，而不仅仅是传统的债务-GDP比率等量化指标。可信度作为一种战略性的宏观金融资产，能够影响主权融资条件和私人部门投资行为。
AI.research_question: 主权债务可持续性与政策可信度之间存在怎样的关系？可信度如何影响债务动态，其作用如何超越传统财政指标？
AI.motivation: 传统上，公共债务可持续性主要通过债务-GDP比率、财政余额和偿债能力等量化指标来评估。然而，近期文献越来越强调政策可信度作为主权债务可持续性的关键决定因素，但该领域缺乏深入的案例研究，尤其是针对小型开放经济体的实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间不一致性理论、主权风险理论、债务可持续性理论、财政主导理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，以苏里南（一个小型开放、依赖大宗商品的经济体）为研究对象，分析其在2020-2022年期间经历的宏观经济与债务危机。
AI.findings: (1) 债务可持续性不仅取决于公共债务水平，还取决于管理债务的机构可信度；(2) 财政和货币可信度的侵蚀导致主权风险溢价上升、市场准入丧失、汇率不稳定和融资约束加剧；(3) 债务重组结合可信的财政调整、加强的货币治理和透明度提升，有助于恢复市场信心并改善长期可持续性前景；(4) 可信度是一种战略性的宏观金融资产，塑造主权融资条件和私人部门投资行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 将可信度概念系统性地整合到债务可持续性分析框架中，超越了传统量化指标的局限性，提出了"可信度作为战略性宏观金融资产"的理论观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为小型开放经济体提供了有效的债务管理框架建议：财政纪律、透明的债务治理、中央银行独立性、国内资本市场发展和机构间政策协调。

title: Built on Fault Lines: Mandatory ESG Disclosure and the Discovery of Value
affiliations: , Central Bank of Chile, affiliation not provided to SSRN and

detail.title: Built on Fault Lines: Mandatory ESG Disclosure and the Discovery of Value

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human subjetcs
declarations.funderStatement: Fondo de Investigacion con Impacto, School of Business Universidad Adolfo Ibanez

detail.abstract: Mandatory ESG disclosure improves firm profitability. We establish this causal claim by exploiting Chile's NCG 461 regulation-which imposed ESG reporting requirements on listed firms above discrete asset thresholds-in a sharp Regression Discontinuity Design across multiple cutoff years. The staggered implementation generates a natural temporal experiment: a pre-treatment placebo (2021) validates the design, the main treatment year (2023) identifies the causal effect, and a persistence test (2024) confirms that gains endure. Using administrative IFRS data from Chile's financial regulator (CMF) for 268-293 non-financial listed firms, we find that firms just above the disclosure threshold exhibit higher Return on Assets and higher Return on Equity, and a lower cost of debt, than firms just below it-profitability effects that are positive, statistically significant, and robust across specifications, and a cost-of-debt effect that is negative, significant, and robust. These effects are absent in the placebo year, emerge at the treatment cutoff, andin the persistence test-broaden into eighteen significant coefficients spanning contemporaneous, lagged, and two-year-lagged horizons. The temporal gradient is the signature of a causal mechanism. Simultaneously, treated firms cut intangible investment sharply, both before and after disclosure, while improving returns on existing assets: the operational efficiency channel. Three identification tests-McCrary density at every cutoff, MSE-optimal bandwidth diagnostics, and a battery of bandwidth-kernelpolynomial-selector variations-confirm that the design is not driven by manipulation, sample size, or specification choice. Wave 1 firms (above the 20 million UF threshold) show lower cost of debt but no profitability gain; Wave 2 firms (above the 1 million UF threshold) show both. Two mechanisms coexist-information asymmetry and operational efficiency-operating on different firms through different pathways. The evidence challenges the view that ESG regulation in emerging markets imposes net costs on firms: in an OECD member with IFRS accounting, credible enforcement, and an institutional investor base, mandatory disclosure pays for itself through the inefficiencies it forces firms to discover. A battery of seven functional-form and bandwidth specifications, evaluated across lagged, contemporaneous, and forward horizons, demonstrates that the plausible profitability effects are robust-the lagged measurement-channel effects most of all-while the largest contemporaneous return-on-equity estimates are not.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用智利NCG 461法规在资产阈值处的断点回归设计，发现强制ESG披露能提高企业盈利能力（ROA和ROE上升、债务成本下降），并通过运营效率渠道发挥作用，挑战了新兴市场ESG监管增加企业净成本的传统观点。
AI.research_question: 强制ESG披露是否能提升企业盈利能力？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场ESG监管常被认为会为企业带来净成本，本研究旨在利用智利NCG 461法规的准自然实验，检验强制ESG披露对企业盈利能力的因果效应及其传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论（降低债务成本）、运营效率理论（削减无形资产投资、提高现有资产回报率）
AI.method: 利用智利NCG 461法规在多个资产阈值年份的阶梯式实施，采用断点回归设计（RDD），结合McCrary密度检验、MSE最优带宽诊断和多种带宽-核函数-多项式-选择器组合的稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）阈值上方企业ROA和ROE显著更高，债务成本显著更低；（2）效应在安慰剂年份（2021年）不存在，在治疗年份（2023年）出现，并持续至2024年；（3）处理企业显著削减无形资产投资，同时提高现有资产回报率；（4）第一波企业（高阈值）仅降低债务成本，第二波企业（低阈值）同时获得盈利提升和债务成本降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 为强制ESG披露与企业盈利能力的因果关系提供了新兴市场的因果证据；揭示了信息不对称和运营效率两条并存的机制路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 挑战了新兴市场ESG监管必然增加企业净成本的观点，表明在具有IFRS会计、可信执法和机构投资者基础的OECD成员国中，强制披露可通过倒逼企业发现低效环节而实现自我补偿。

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces Sociotopography, a multi‑dimensional framework for modelling behavioural fragility and systemic pressure. The framework is grounded in established research across behavioural economics, cognitive psychology, systems theory, complexity science, and resilience studies. It proposes that behaviour should be understood as both trait and state, shaped by an individual’s position within a dynamic behavioural landscape.

The landscape is defined by three core dimensions: Economic Capacity (EC), Time and Cognitive Load (TCL), and Psychosocial Stress (PSS). These dimensions create a behavioural terrain with basins, ridges, and cliffs that influence how individuals respond to pressure.

Using a case study of South African taxi commuters before and after a diesel price shock, the paper demonstrates how Sociotopography reveals hidden fragility and population movement that traditional metrics fail to capture. The analysis shows that average scores may remain stable even as the underlying behavioural terrain shifts, increasing the risk of sudden behavioural change.

The paper outlines practical applications for organisations seeking to understand and anticipate behavioural instability. It argues that Sociotopography provides a more accurate representation of behaviour in complex environments and offers a foundation for improved decision‑making, policy design, and predictive modelling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"社会地形学"（Sociotopography）框架，通过经济能力、时间与认知负荷、社会心理压力三个维度构建行为景观，用以建模行为脆弱性与系统性压力。以南非出租车通勤者为案例，揭示了传统指标无法捕捉的隐性脆弱性和人群迁移。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个多维框架来建模行为脆弱性和系统性压力，并揭示传统指标无法捕捉的隐性行为风险？
AI.motivation: 传统行为指标（如平均值）无法捕捉行为地形的潜在变化，导致对行为脆弱性的误判。需要一种更准确的框架来理解复杂环境中的行为不稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会地形学（Sociotopography）；行为经济学、认知心理学、系统理论、复杂性科学、韧性研究。
AI.method: 概念框架构建 + 案例研究（南非柴油价格冲击前后的出租车通勤者行为变化）。
AI.findings: 即使平均得分保持稳定，潜在行为地形可能已发生剧烈变化，增加了突发行为转变的风险。传统指标无法捕捉这种隐性脆弱性和人群迁移。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合多维度的行为地形框架，将行为同时视为特质和状态，为行为脆弱性研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织理解与预测行为不稳定性提供了实用工具，有助于改进决策制定、政策设计和预测建模。

title: Mapping the Global Evolution of Environmental, Social, and Governance Regulations: A Comprehensive Institutional Analysis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, and Central Bank of Chile

detail.title: Mapping the Global Evolution of Environmental, Social, and Governance Regulations: A Comprehensive Institutional Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts of Interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human Subjects
declarations.funderStatement: Fondo de Investigacino con Impacto, Shcool of Business Universidad Adolfo Ibanez

detail.abstract:
This study presents the first comprehensive global analysis of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) regulatory frameworks, examining 226 regulations across 58 countries from 2001 to 2024. Grounded in institutional theory (DiMaggio & Powell, 1983), we identify three phases: Early (2001-2010), Growth (2011-2019), and Acceleration (2020-2024). Europe leads with 51.8% of regulations, followed by Asia-Pacific (27.9%); mandatory frameworks dominate at 71.2%. Kaplan-Meier event history analysis of projected ISSB adoption (66 countries, 40 expected adopters, 26 right-censored) confirms the Brussels Effect: EU member states show substantially higher projected ISSB adoption than non-EU countries (log-rank χ² = 18.08, p < 0.001), confirming coercive isomorphism as the primary diffusion mechanism. Findings advance understanding of transnational regulatory convergence and inform ISSB harmonisation through 2030. 
Practitioner Points
  ESG regulation has crossed an institutional threshold from which there is no return. The 2019-2020 structural break marks a qualitative regime change, not a cyclical upturn: 83.2% of all global ESG regulations were enacted in just five years. Organisations still treating ESG as a reputational exercise or voluntary commitment are operating on an outdated model of the regulatory environment. 
 Mandatory disclosure is the norm, not the endpoint. Across all three phases of ESG regulatory development, binding requirements dominated from the outsetvoluntary frameworks appeared only as complements to mandatory ones, never as precursors. Corporate governance structures, audit processes, and board oversight mechanisms should be designed around mandatory disclosure as the baseline, not as an eventual destination.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对全球ESG监管框架进行系统分析，涵盖2001-2024年58个国家的226项法规，发现ESG监管已进入不可逆的制度化阶段，强制性披露成为主流，欧盟通过"布鲁塞尔效应"推动全球监管趋同。
AI.research_question: 全球ESG监管框架如何演变？不同地区的监管模式有何差异？监管扩散的核心机制是什么？
AI.motivation: ESG监管在全球范围内快速发展，但缺乏对其整体格局、演变阶段和扩散机制的系统性实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论（DiMaggio & Powell, 1983），特别是强制性同构、模仿性同构和规范性同构机制；布鲁塞尔效应理论。
AI.method: 系统文献综述（226项法规，58个国家，2001-2024年）；Kaplan-Meier事件史分析（66个国家，40个预期采纳者，26个右删失数据）；对数秩检验。
AI.findings: (1) ESG监管分三阶段：早期(2001-2010)、增长期(2011-2019)、加速期(2020-2024)；(2)欧洲占51.8%，亚太占27.9%；(3)强制性框架占71.2%；(4)2019-2020年结构性断裂，83.2%的法规在最近五年颁布；(5)欧盟成员国对ISSB的采纳显著高于非欧盟国家（log-rank χ²=18.08, p<0.001），证实强制性同构是主要扩散机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度理论的强制性同构机制应用于全球ESG监管扩散分析，实证验证"布鲁塞尔效应"在ESG监管领域的适用性，揭示监管趋同的制度化路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示企业ESG监管已进入不可逆阶段，强制性披露是当前常态而非终极目标；企业应重新设计治理结构、审计流程和董事会监督机制，以满足强制性披露要求。

title: AI-Assisted Works: Copyrightability in the United States, China, and the EU , and Implications for Academic Integrity

detail.title: AI-Assisted Works: Copyrightability in the United States, China, and the EU , and Implications for Academic Integrity
detail.abstract: This article explores the legal aspects of the copyrightability of AI-assisted works in the U.S., China, and the EU, within the context of a fundamental principle shared across these jurisdictions: only creations involving meaningful human creative choices are eligible for copyright protection. The article also presents comparative insights from court rulings – including those in China and the U.S. – that reinforce the requirement of human authorship for copyright protection and the legal and ethical implications of using generative artificial intelligence (AI) in academic work, with a focus on academic integrity, authorship, and copyright compliance. It analyzes recent developments in legislation, case law, and internal university regulations in jurisdictions including the European Union, the United States, China, and selected EU Member States. The central thesis is that AI-generated content cannot be regarded as an outcome of independent scholarly work if it replaces the creative process – particularly the development of a research concept and first draft. While AI tools offer efficiency and support in technical tasks such as grammar correction or literature searches, their unauthorized or undisclosed use in substantive academic writing constitutes a breach of academic ethics and may lead to the invalidation of academic degrees. Moreover, it emphasizes the growing need for universities to adopt AI detection policies that respect the presumption of innocence and align with data protection law. Ultimately, the article argues for preserving academic authorship as an intellectual process that cannot be outsourced to machines – lest scientific credibility itself be undermined.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国、中国和欧盟在AI辅助作品版权性方面的法律问题，核心观点是只有包含有意义的人类创造性选择的成果才符合版权保护条件。文章认为AI生成内容若取代了研究构思和初稿撰写等创造性过程，则不能被视为独立学术工作成果，并强调大学需制定兼顾无罪推定和数据保护法的AI检测政策，捍卫学术作者身份作为不可外包的智力过程。
AI.research_question: 在美、中、欧三大法域中，AI辅助作品的版权性如何界定？在学术写作中未经授权或未披露使用AI工具的法律与伦理后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI在学术写作中的广泛应用，亟需厘清"人类创造性选择"这一版权核心原则在AI辅助作品中的适用边界，以及学术诚信与版权合规之间的张力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人类创作要件（human authorship requirement）：三大法域共享的基本原则——只有包含有意义的人类创造性选择的成果才享有版权保护；学术诚信与作者身份理论：学术作者身份是不可外包的智力创造过程。
AI.method: 比较法分析：对比美、中、欧及部分欧盟成员国的立法、判例法和大学内部规章制度，并结合中美相关法院判决进行案例研究。
AI.findings: （1）AI生成内容若取代了研究概念开发和初稿撰写等创造性过程，不能被视为独立学术工作成果；（2）未经授权或未披露在实质性学术写作中使用AI构成学术伦理违规，可能导致学位被撤销；（3）大学需制定尊重无罪推定且符合数据保护法的AI检测政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了"人类创造性选择"标准在AI辅助作品中的具体适用边界，将版权法的人类创作要件理论与学术诚信规范有机结合，为理解AI时代学术作者身份的不可替代性提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学和学术机构制定AI使用政策提供了法律与伦理框架参考；警示学者和学生未经披露使用AI进行实质性学术写作的法律风险；为立法者和司法者在AI版权案件中提供了比较法视角的决策参考。

title: A Standalone Spatial Decoding Pipeline and Multi-Format Avian Diversity Dataset Derived from Japanese National Breeding Bird Survey Open Data
affiliations: Nanzan University

detail.title: A Standalone Spatial Decoding Pipeline and Multi-Format Avian Diversity Dataset Derived from Japanese National Breeding Bird Survey Open Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Citizen science biodiversity surveys generate spatially extensive datasets but are structurally prone to compounding observer biases—spatial undersampling of remote habitats, taxonomic over-representation of conspicuous species, and heterogeneous observer skill—that limit their direct utility for ecological analysis and evidence-based policymaking. We present a two-stage, open-source R pipeline and multi-format dataset derived from the National Breeding Bird Survey of Japan (2016–2021), designed to address these challenges without dependency on external GIS infrastructure. Stage 1 performs encoding sanitization, standalone mathematical decoding of six-digit second-order regional mesh codes (JIS X 0410; ∼20 km × 20 km) into WGS 84 bounding box coordinates, and application of an Inverse Mesh Frequency (IMF) rarity-weighting algorithm adapted from the information-theoretic TF-IDF framework to objectively identify grid cells harboring locally rare taxa that conventional species richness counts suppress. Stage 2 deploys the pre-compiled outputs in a lightweight Shiny–Leaflet WebGIS application enabling dynamic species richness filtering and clickable IMF-ranked species popups via leafletProxy differential updates, stable on free-tier cloud infrastructure. Curated outputs are distributed in three complementary formats—CSV (cross-platform tabular), RDS (R-native binary), and GeoPackage (OGC spatial vector; EPSG:4326)—archived at Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20739666; CC BY 4.0) with a live interactive map at https://moteki.shinyapps.io/avian_diversity/. The standalone mesh decoding logic and IMF pipeline are immediately transferable to any Japanese administrative grid dataset, providing a generalizable template for reproducible spatial analysis in social science, regional planning, and biodiversity informatics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套两阶段开源R管道和多格式数据集，通过编码清洗、网格码解码和逆网格频率（IMF）稀有性加权算法，解决公民科学鸟类调查数据中的观测者偏差问题，并提供交互式可视化工具和多格式开放数据。
AI.research_question: 如何利用开源方法解决公民科学鸟类调查数据中的观测者偏差（空间采样不足、分类学过度代表、观测者技能异质性），生成可用于生态分析和循证决策的高质量数据集？
AI.motivation: 公民科学产生的生物多样性数据集虽空间覆盖广泛，但存在多种观测者偏差，限制了其直接用于生态分析和政策制定。现有方法依赖外部GIS基础设施，缺乏可转移的轻量级解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 逆网格频率（IMF）稀有性加权算法（基于信息论TF-IDF框架）；JIS X 0410六位数二级区域网格码解码标准；Shiny–Leaflet WebGIS动态交互可视化。
AI.method: 两阶段开源R管道：阶段一包括编码清洗、独立数学解码（JIS X 0410→WGS 84边界框）及IMF稀有性加权算法；阶段二部署轻量级Shiny–Leaflet WebGIS应用，支持动态物种丰富度筛选和IMF排名弹出窗口。
AI.findings: 成功生成了多格式（CSV、RDS、GeoPackage）开放数据集，实现了无需外部GIS基础设施的网格码解码和IMF稀有性加权，并构建了可在免费云基础设施上稳定运行的交互式地图应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信息论的TF-IDF框架创新性地适配应用于生态学物种稀有性加权（IMF算法），为公民科学数据偏差校正提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供完全开源、可复现的R管道和多格式数据集；独立网格码解码逻辑可迁移至任何日本行政网格数据；为社会科学、区域规划和生物多样性信息学提供了可泛化的空间分析模板。

title: States, Not the FDA, Are Winning the Drug War

detail.title: States, Not the FDA, Are Winning the Drug War

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: President Trump's January 2026 executive order directing federal agencies to finalize the rescheduling of cannabis from Schedule I to Schedule III marks a watershed moment in American drug policy-and one whose lessons reach well beyond cannabis. This essay argues that the cannabis story exposes a misconception that has guided much of the psychedelics field: that the surest route to federal drugpolicy reform runs through the FDA's approval pipeline. Drug rescheduling can follow two distinct paths: the "FDA backdoor," under which agency approval of a specific formulation triggers rescheduling of that product alone (as with Marinol, XYWAV, and Epidiolex), and a federalist track in which state-level deregulation generates the political and empirical evidence base that eventually moves federal law. Cannabis ultimately moved on the federalist track, not the medicalized onedespite Marinol's FDA approval nearly forty years ago. Drawing on the early data from Oregon's, Colorado's, and New Mexico's state psilocybin programs, and on the FDA advisory committee's 2024 rejection of MDMA-assisted therapy, the essay argues that psychedelic-policy reformers should treat state experimentationnot FDA approval-as the primary lever for substantive drug-policy change, with the medicalized pathway serving as a complementary rather than a leading strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析大麻从Schedule I重新分类至Schedule III的过程，揭示了美国毒品政策改革中的一个常见误解：即FDA审批是改革的最可靠路径。文章指出，毒品重新分类存在两条路径——"FDA后门"和"联邦主义路径"，而大麻最终是通过后者（州级合法化推动）实现改革的。基于各州迷幻药项目数据和FDA对MDMA疗法的拒绝，作者主张迷幻药政策改革应以州级实验为主要杠杆，而非FDA审批。
AI.research_question: 毒品政策改革应依赖FDA审批路径还是州级联邦主义路径？迷幻药政策改革可以从大麻重新分类的经验中学到什么？
AI.motivation: 纠正迷幻药领域普遍存在的"FDA审批是毒品政策改革最可靠路径"这一误解，为迷幻药政策改革提供更有效的策略指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 毒品重新分类的两条路径理论：FDA后门路径（FDA批准特定制剂触发该产品的重新分类）与联邦主义路径（州级去监管化产生政治和实证证据基础，最终推动联邦法律变革）。
AI.method: 案例分析法：以大麻重新分类作为核心案例，辅以俄勒冈州、科罗拉多州、新墨西哥州等州级迷幻药项目早期数据，以及FDA咨询委员会2024年拒绝MDMA辅助治疗的决策分析。
AI.findings: 大麻最终是通过联邦主义路径（而非医疗化路径）实现重新分类的，尽管Marinol早在近四十年前就获得了FDA批准。FDA对MDMA辅助治疗的拒绝进一步印证了医疗化路径的局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了毒品政策改革的双路径理论框架（FDA后门 vs. 联邦主义路径），并论证联邦主义路径是更有效的改革杠杆。
AI.practical_contributions: 为迷幻药政策改革者提供战略建议：应将州级实验而非FDA审批作为实质性政策变革的主要杠杆，医疗化路径应作为补充策略而非主导策略。

title: Attracting Talent to General Practice through Financial Incentives
affiliations: Charles III University of Madrid - Department of Business Administration, University of Barcelona and

detail.title: Attracting Talent to General Practice through Financial Incentives
detail.abstract: Shortages of general practitioners (GPs) strain healthcare systems worldwide. We test whether wage incentives can attract higher-ability physicians using a 2022 reform in Catalonia, Spain, that granted incoming GP residents unconditional salary supplements of 26% to 47% of base pay across three tiers. Using administrative data on medical residency choices nationwide and a synthetic difference-indifferences design, we document two effects. First, the reform raised entrants' standardized exam scores by 0.067 standard deviations on average (0.174 in the highest subsidy tier) and increased the international resident share by nearly 30 percentage points. Second, GP vacancies emerged nationwide after 2022 but rose 4.4 percentage points less in Catalonia, drawing lower-scoring candidates to the newly filled slots and mechanically diluting the average score gain. Lee bounds correcting for this compositional shift raise the estimated effects to 0.088 and 0.191 standard deviations in a fully cleared market. Our findings show that salary supplements can improve the allocation of medical talent to shortage occupations, though their effectiveness depends on local labor-market tightness and physician supply.

AI.tldr: 本文利用西班牙加泰罗尼亚2022年改革（为全科医生住院医师提供26%-47%的薪资补贴），采用合成双重差分法发现：薪资激励能吸引更高能力的医生（考试成绩提升0.067个标准差，最高补贴组达0.174），并增加国际医生比例近30个百分点；但全国性职位空缺导致评分较低的候选人填补新增岗位，稀释了平均成绩提升，经Lee边界校正后效果更高（0.088-0.191个标准差）。
AI.research_question: 薪资激励能否吸引更高能力的医生进入全科医生短缺岗位？
AI.motivation: 全球全科医生短缺问题严峻，但关于工资激励能否吸引高能力医生的因果证据有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场匹配理论、薪资补偿差异理论以及人才配置效率理论。
AI.method: 采用合成双重差分法（synthetic difference-in-differences），使用全西班牙医疗住院医师选择的行政数据，并进行Lee边界校正以处理组成性偏移。
AI.findings: 1) 改革使全科医生住院医师标准化考试成绩平均提高0.067个标准差（最高补贴组0.174）；2) 国际医生比例增加近30个百分点；3) 全国全科医生职位空缺率在加泰罗尼亚低4.4个百分点；4) 新填补的职位吸引了较低分的候选人，稀释了平均分提升；5) Lee边界校正后效应提升至0.088-0.191个标准差。
AI.theory_contributions: 为薪资激励对高能力人才进入短缺职业的因果效应提供了严谨证据，揭示了劳动力市场紧密度对政策效果的调节作用，提出了组成性偏移的识别与校正方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗人力资源政策制定提供依据：薪资补贴可有效吸引高能力医生，但效果受限于当地劳动力市场紧张程度和医生供给。
