detail.title: Attracting Talent to General Practice through Financial Incentives Lucía Cobreros UAM
detail.abstract: Shortages of general practitioners (GPs) strain healthcare systems worldwide. We test whether wage incentives can attract higher-ability physicians using a 2022 reform in Catalonia, Spain, that granted incoming GP residents unconditional salary supplements of 26% to 47% of base pay across three tiers. Using administrative data on medical residency choices nationwide and a synthetic difference-indifferences design, we document two effects. First, the reform raised entrants' standardized exam scores by 0.067 standard deviations on average (0.174 in the highest subsidy tier) and increased the international resident share by nearly 30 percentage points. Second, GP vacancies emerged nationwide after 2022 but rose 4.4 percentage points less in Catalonia, drawing lower-scoring candidates to the newly filled slots and mechanically diluting the average score gain. Lee bounds correcting for this compositional shift raise the estimated effects to 0.088 and 0.191 standard deviations in a fully cleared market. Our findings show that salary supplements can improve the allocation of medical talent to shortage occupations, though their effectiveness depends on local labor-market tightness and physician supply.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2022年西班牙加泰罗尼亚地区对全科医生住院医师实施的大幅工资补贴改革，发现该政策提升了高能力医师的进入比例（考试成绩提高0.067-0.174个标准差）并吸引了更多国际医生，但全国范围内的职位空缺导致低分候选人的补充进入稀释了平均效果，经Lee边界校正后效应更大。
AI.research_question: 工资激励能否吸引高能力的医生进入全科医生这一短缺职业？
AI.motivation: 全科医生短缺给全球医疗系统带来压力，如何通过政策手段（如工资补贴）改善医疗人才配置是一个重要的现实问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场激励理论，探讨工资水平如何影响高能力人才的职业选择与地域配置，同时考虑劳动力市场紧俏程度和供给约束的调节作用。
AI.method: 利用西班牙全国医疗住院医师选择的行政数据，采用合成双重差分法（synthetic difference-in-differences）进行因果推断，并使用Lee边界（Lee bounds）修正因职位空缺填补带来的样本构成变化偏差。
AI.findings: 改革使进入者的标准化考试成绩平均提高0.067个标准差（最高补贴档次为0.174），国际住院医师比例增加近30个百分点；全国全科医生职位空缺率在加泰罗尼亚降低了4.4个百分点，但低分候选人的补充进入稀释了平均分数提升；Lee边界校正后，在完全出清市场中效应提升至0.088和0.191个标准差。
AI.theory_contributions: 为工资激励如何影响高能力人才在短缺职业中的配置提供了因果证据，揭示了劳动力市场条件（如职位空缺率）对政策效果的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明了大幅工资补贴可以有效提升全科医生的人才质量，但政策效果受限于劳动力市场紧俏程度和整体医生供给；为医疗系统应对全科医生短缺提供了可参考的政策工具及条件约束分析。

title: AI Adoption, Workplace Collaboration, and Mean Field Games

detail.title: AI Adoption, Workplace Collaboration, and Mean Field Games
detail.abstract: This paper studies generative AI adoption inside firms as a finite-type network mean field game with adaptive expectations. Workers are heterogeneous agents whose states-AI capability and task-specific human capital-evolve through own AI use, learning, and collaboration with AIcapable coworkers. Types summarize positions in the workplace collaboration structure, such as degree, team role, or exposure to AI-capable peers, and a row-stochastic mixing matrix maps type-level distributions into local peer environments. Managerial clarity enters through the perceived return to AI-enabled output and the speed of belief updating. The model yields a backward Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation for each worker type, a forward Fokker-Planck equation for the type-specific distributions, and consistency conditions linking optimal policies to aggregate AI capability, collaboration, and perceived returns. A numerical exercise provides an illustrative finite-population network approximation designed to isolate the mechanism implied by the model. Managerial clarity can operate like a control parameter, shifting collaboration as an order parameter and accelerating convergence to the AI-capability frontier.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个有限类型网络平均场博弈模型，研究企业内部生成式AI采纳过程中，异质性工人的AI能力与任务特定人力资本如何通过自身使用、学习以及与AI能力同事的协作实现演化。管理清晰度通过影响AI产出感知回报和信念更新速度发挥作用，数值实验表明其可作为控制参数加速企业向AI能力前沿收敛。
AI.research_question: 企业内部生成式AI采纳过程中，工人异质性行为与协作网络结构如何影响AI能力的扩散与收敛？管理清晰度在这一过程中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在企业中的采纳呈现显著的异质性和网络效应，现有研究缺乏能够刻画工人类型差异（如岗位角色、协作网络位置）、AI能力动态演化以及管理因素对采纳过程影响的统一理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限类型网络平均场博弈（Finite-type Network Mean Field Game）、自适应期望（Adaptive Expectations）、Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程、Fokker-Planck方程
AI.method: 构建包含后向HJB方程（刻画工人最优策略）、前向Fokker-Planck方程（刻画类型分布演化）以及一致性条件的理论模型，并通过有限人口网络近似进行数值模拟。
AI.findings: 管理清晰度可作为一个控制参数，改变协作这一序参量，并加速企业向AI能力前沿的收敛过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 将平均场博弈理论引入组织内AI采纳研究，为分析异质性工人通过网络协作进行能力演化提供了统一框架，并揭示了管理清晰度作为控制参数的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了如何通过提升管理清晰度（如明确AI产出的回报、加速信念更新）来促进企业内部AI采纳和协作效率的实践指导。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Misinformation, and Ideological Bias: Evidence From a News Classification Experiment

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, Misinformation, and Ideological Bias: Evidence From a News Classification Experiment
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how ideological bias and classification errors vary across AI-mediated information environments. We conduct an incentivized laboratory experiment in which participants classify news items as true or false across three withinsubject phases: a human-written baseline, an AI-generated misinformation phase in which the role of AI is not made explicit, and an AI-detection phase in which participants receive an explicit AI probability signal. Average classification accuracy does not differ significantly across phases. The central result is instead that errors are strongly structured by ideological congruence: participants are more likely to accept congruent false news as true and to reject incongruent true news as false. The AI-detection phase suggests greater skepticism toward information, reflected in a higher false-negative rate. This skepticism seems to be selectively applied: the relation between congruence and classification errors becomes stronger when AI is introduced explicitly. The analysis of detector responsiveness points to non-selective partial mistrust of AI signals. Overall, AI-based verification does not mechanically correct ideologically structured classification errors.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验室实验发现，AI辅助的信息环境并未提升新闻真伪分类的准确率，反而强化了意识形态一致性导致的分类错误，AI信号被参与者部分且非选择性地不信任。
AI.research_question: AI中介信息环境中，意识形态偏见和分类错误如何变化？AI概率信号是否修正了基于意识形态的分类错误？
AI.motivation: AI生成错误信息和AI检测工具日益普及，但人们对AI如何影响信息判断中的意识形态偏见知之甚少，需要实证检验AI检测工具的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 意识形态一致性理论（确认偏误）、信号信任理论、AI中介信息处理模型
AI.method: 激励性实验室实验，三阶段被试内设计：人类撰写的基线阶段、AI生成错误信息未明示阶段、AI检测概率信号明示阶段。
AI.findings: 1）三阶段平均分类准确率无显著差异；2）错误分类与意识形态一致性强相关（接受一致的假新闻、拒绝不一致的真新闻）；3）AI检测阶段假阴性率升高，表明整体怀疑增强；4）AI信号的引入强化了意识形态一致性与错误分类之间的关系；5）参与者对AI信号存在非选择性的部分不信任。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI验证工具无法机械修正意识形态驱动的分类错误，反而可能强化确认偏误；提出"非选择性部分不信任"概念，丰富了信号信任理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 对AI事实核查系统的设计提出警示：仅提供概率信号不足以纠正偏见，需考虑用户心理机制和意识形态因素的干预设计。

title: From Funding Gap to Governing Rationalities: Six Archetypes of Resource Mobilisation for Climate and Biodiversity Action
affiliations: and Utrecht University - School of Economics

detail.title: From Funding Gap to Governing Rationalities: Six Archetypes of Resource Mobilisation for Climate and Biodiversity Action

declarations.funderStatement: This research has been carried out within the NATURESCAPES project. The NATURESCAPES project is funded by the European Union under Grant Agreement No 101084341. Views and opinions expressed are those of the authors only and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Union. Neither the European Union nor the granting authority can be held responsible for them.

detail.abstract:
The dominant ‘funding gap’ narrative for climate and biodiversity action foregrounds market-based
resource mobilisation logics while underplaying non-monetary, cross-sectoral, and place-based
resourcing strategies. This integrative literature review develops six resource mobilisation archetypes,
aimed at sub-national actors - hybrid, multi-scalar, policy-led, revenue-based, cross-sectoral and mosaic
– that can support long-term urban transformations. We characterise each archetype by its governing
rationality and evaluate its potential for long-term outcomes. We document, for each of them, the
diverse structural tensions between the enabling conditions required to realise a resourcing strategy and
the strategy's effectiveness for long-term transformation. The archetypes most distant from market-
based logic (mosaic assemblages and cross-sectoral reconfigurations) show the strongest evidence for
ecological adequacy and distributional equity, yet receive the least policy attention. Resource
mobilisation processes durably reshape sub-national governance, and sequencing matters: building
institutional foundations for more relational archetypes may be a precondition for ensuring external
capital serves locally defined outcomes. Our framework offers a diagnostic tool for aligning resourcing
strategies for sub-national climate and biodiversity action with long-term transformation objectives -
rather than the short-term objective of capital volume.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了主流的"资金缺口"叙事，通过整合性文献综述提出六种资源动员原型，帮助次国家级行动者实现长期城市气候与生物多样性转型。研究发现，远离市场逻辑的原型（如马赛克组合和跨部门重组）在生态充分性和分配公平性上表现最佳，但获得的政策关注最少。
AI.research_question: 次国家级行动者如何通过多样化的资源动员策略（超越市场导向的资金逻辑）实现长期的气候与生物多样性城市转型？
AI.motivation: 主流"资金缺口"叙事过度强调市场化资源动员逻辑，忽视了非货币性、跨部门和基于地方的资源策略，导致次国家级行动者的转型路径被窄化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源动员理论、城市转型治理理论、制度逻辑视角
AI.method: 整合性文献综述（Integrative Literature Review），提炼六种资源动员原型并进行比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）六种原型可分为混合型、多尺度型、政策主导型、收入型、跨部门型和马赛克型；（2）远离市场逻辑的原型（马赛克组合、跨部门重组）生态充分性和分配公平性最强，但政策关注度最低；（3）资源动员过程会持久重塑次国家级治理；（4）顺序很重要：建立关系型原型的制度基础是确保外部资本服务于地方目标的前提。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了主流的"资金缺口"叙事，提出了超越市场逻辑的资源动员分析框架，揭示了资源动员策略与长期转型目标之间的结构性张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为次国家级行动者提供诊断工具，帮助其将资源动员策略与长期转型目标（而非短期资本规模）对齐；为政策制定者识别哪些原型值得更多政策关注。

title: Chess Signatures of Play
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and University of Chicago

detail.title: Chess Signatures of Play
detail.abstract: A game of chess is a stream: a time-ordered sequence of moves, each carrying an engine evaluation, a measure of accuracy, a measure of position complexity, and a clock reading. We model a game as a multivariate path and apply the signature transform of rough-path theory to obtain a reparametrization-invariant, graded feature set that records the order and interaction of in-game events without a parametric likelihood. We show that a player's law of play is identifiable from the expected signature up to tree-like equivalence, construct a signature-kernel two-sample test on path space, and recast cheating detection as an anytime-valid sequential test: a signature conformance score becomes an e-process whose error is controlled for every sample size at once by Ville's inequality, with fluctuations calibrated on the moderate-deviation scale. The discriminating information lives in the signature's Lévy areas, which measure whether accuracy rises precisely when positions become hard, the fingerprint of engine assistance that aggregate match-rate statistics discard. In a controlled study the test holds exact type-I control and detection power rises from negligible for subtle assistance to 0.98 for blatant assistance, with a median detection time matching the growth-rate prediction log(1/α)/c. Calibrated to Magnus Carlsen's documented elite accuracy, the monitor does not flag world-champion-level play; and we exhibit cheating strategies that leave every aggregate statistic, including the best-move-frequency z-score of the Regan system, exactly unchanged yet are caught cleanly by the signature, making precise how an order-aware, anytime-valid test strengthens the prevailing approach to chess anti-cheating.

AI.tldr: 本文利用粗路径理论中的签名变换，将国际象棋对局建模为多变量路径流，提出了一种顺序感知、随时有效的作弊检测方法。签名特征集（特别是Lévy区域）能捕捉到准确率随局面复杂度同步上升这一引擎辅助指纹，而传统聚合统计量会丢失这一信息。受控实验展示了精确的I类错误控制和从0到0.98的检测效力，且能识别出绕过Regan系统等现有检测手段的作弊策略。
AI.research_question: 如何利用粗路径理论的签名变换，从对局的时间序列路径特征中识别国际象棋作弊行为，并构建一个顺序感知、随时有效的统计检测方法？
AI.motivation: 现有国际象棋反作弊系统（如Regan系统）主要依赖聚合统计量（如最佳走法频率的z分数），这些方法忽略了事件的时间顺序和交互信息，容易被针对性的作弊策略绕过。需要一种能够捕捉路径顺序结构、不依赖参数似然假设、且能在任意样本量下控制错误的新方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 粗路径理论（Rough Path Theory）及其签名变换（Signature Transform）；Ville不等式与e-process（随时有效序列检验）；中度偏离标度（Moderate-Deviation Scale）；Lévy区域（Lévy Areas）的几何解释。
AI.method: 将每盘棋的原始棋盘序列转化为多变量路径流（引擎评估、准确率、局面复杂度、时钟读数）；引入签名变换获得重新参数化不变的分级特征集；定义签名保形度得分（signature conformance score）构建e-process；利用Ville不等式控制任意样本量下的错误率；在受控实验和Magnus Carlsen真实精英级水平数据上进行校准与验证。
AI.findings: (1) 玩家的对局法则可由期望签名精确识别至树等价性；(2) 签名核双样本检验可在路径空间上有效区分；(3) 检测效力从辅助极微弱的近0到明显辅助的0.98，中位检测时间与log(1/α)/c的理论预测一致；(4) 经卡尔森精英级准确率校准后，不会将世界冠军级水平误报；(5) 传统Regan系统捕捉不到的作弊策略（保持所有聚合统计量不变）能被签名方法干净捕获。
AI.theory_contributions: 将粗路径理论的签名变换引入行为识别和反作弊领域，证明了玩家"法则"可由期望签名确定至树等价性；建立了签名保形度作为e-process的理论框架，将序列检验与路径特征相结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种比现有聚合统计量方法更鲁棒的实时反作弊监测工具，能够发现传统方法遗漏的隐蔽作弊行为（如绕过Regan z-score的作弊策略），且具有严格的统计错误控制保证。

title: Model-Adjusted Volatility Proxy for ARMA-GARCH Forecast
affiliations: Finance and Risk Engineering, NYU Tandon School of Engineering

detail.title: Model-Adjusted Volatility Proxy for ARMA-GARCH Forecast
detail.abstract: Since asset price volatility is a latent variable and its forecasting accuracy depends on "imperfect volatility proxies" (Patton, 2011), we suggest that using standalone volatility models is unproductive for two related reasons. First, the conventional volatility proxy, i.e., realized volatility (RV), is calculated using equally-weighted price shocks for some past, arbitrarily chosen (though popular) time periods, which ignores nonstationary nature of financial time series. Second, the standalone volatility models neglect possible price autocorrelation effects and, hence, may yield biased estimates. In our view, volatility is just another feature of the price dynamics models. Comparative accuracy of these models (e.g., ARMA-GARCH) should be tested out-of-sample using observable variables, i.e. returns. Then, the relevant RV (called here model-adjusted RV (MARV)) can be calculated for the past time period where the optimal ARMA-GARCH model has non-zero ARMA lags. Here, we offer an example of this approach using the AIC-based and BIC-based optimal ARMA-GARCH and ARMA-GJR-GARCH models for the S&P 500 returns in all one-year periods within 2000-2024. We found that the MARV-based EWMA can be a more accurate volatility proxy than the MARV itself for the samples with pronounced autocorrelations.

AI.tldr: 本文批评传统波动率模型忽视价格自相关性和非平稳性，提出将波动率视为价格动态模型的特征，基于最优ARMA-GARCH模型构建"模型调整已实现波动率"(MARV)，并发现MARV驱动的EWMA在样本具有显著自相关时是更优的波动率代理。
AI.research_question: 如何改进波动率代理变量的构造方法，以克服传统已实现波动率(RV)的局限性？
AI.motivation: 传统已实现波动率使用等权重价格冲击计算，忽视了金融时间序列的非平稳性；且独立波动率模型忽略价格自相关效应，可能产生有偏估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Patton (2011)的"不完美波动率代理"理论；ARMA-GARCH模型；AIC/BIC模型选择准则；指数加权移动平均(EWMA)。
AI.method: 利用AIC和BIC准则选择最优ARMA-GARCH和ARMA-GJR-GARCH模型，对S&P 500在2000-2024年间所有一年期样本构建MARV，并与EWMA进行比较。
AI.findings: 基于MARV的EWMA在样本存在显著自相关时，比MARV本身是更准确的波动率代理。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"模型调整已实现波动率"(MARV)这一新概念，将波动率从独立变量重新概念化为价格动态模型的内生特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为波动率预测提供一种新的代理变量构建方法，该方法考虑时间序列非平稳性和价格自相关；实证表明MARV驱动的EWMA在自相关显著的样本中表现更优，有助于提升波动率预测精度。

title: MacroModelClaw: An AI-Collaborative Workflow for DSGE Model Development
affiliations: City University of Macau and The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)

detail.title: MacroModelClaw: An AI-Collaborative Workflow for DSGE Model Development
detail.abstract: Translating a macroeconomic theory into a numerically solvable DSGE model is a persistent bottleneck in quantitative macroeconomics. We introduce MacroModelClaw, a multi-agent workflow for Claude Code that enforces information barriers across the full DSGE development pipeline. The user supplies a single structured model document (model-doc.md); ten specialized agents—named after foundational economists—parse, calibrate, code, solve, run, validate, and review the model without sharing each other’s instructions. The paper makes three contributions: (i) a Dynare workflow architecture that encodes practitioners’ tacit knowledge as an enforced multi-agent system, including automatic timingconvention checking and Blanchard-Kahn error routing; (ii) a self-accumulating knowledge base of Dynare error diagnostics with confidence scoring and modelcontext indexing; and (iii) a numerical solver library covering seven algorithm families for nonlinear steady-state systems, with automatic selection and fallback sequencing. We demonstrate the approach on three applications of increasing complexity: a New Keynesian model, a two-sector housing DSGE, and a partial HANK steady-state computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MacroModelClaw，一个基于Claude Code的多智能体工作流，通过信息隔离机制将宏观经济学理论自动转化为可数值求解的DSGE模型。用户提供结构化模型文档后，十个专业智能体分工完成解析、校准、编码、求解、运行、验证和评审全流程。论文贡献包括Dynare工作流架构、自积累错误诊断知识库和包含七类算法的数值求解器库。
AI.research_question: 如何将宏观经济学理论自动、可靠地转化为可数值求解的DSGE模型，以解决定量宏观经济学中的瓶颈问题？
AI.motivation: 将宏观经济理论转化为可数值求解的DSGE模型是定量宏观经济学中的持续性瓶颈，这一过程高度依赖研究者的隐性知识和手工操作，容易出错且效率低下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多智能体工作流理论、信息隔离机制、Dynare工作流架构、自积累知识库、数值求解器算法族
AI.method: 设计并实现多智能体工作流MacroModelClaw，包含十个以著名经济学家命名的专业智能体，各智能体之间通过信息隔离机制相互独立。系统自动执行时序约定检查、Blanchard-Kahn错误路由、错误诊断置信评分与模型上下文索引，并配备七类算法族（含自动选择和回退机制）的数值求解器库。
AI.findings: 该方法在三个复杂度递增的应用（新凯恩斯模型、两部门住房DSGE、部分HANK稳态计算）上得到了验证，证明了工作流架构的有效性和可扩展性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将隐性知识编码为可强制执行的多智能体系统，提出自动时序约定检查和Blanchard-Kahn错误路由机制，构建自积累的Dynare错误诊断知识库。
AI.practical_contributions: 为定量宏观经济学家提供自动化的DSGE模型开发流水线，降低手动编码错误，加速模型迭代，并通过数值求解器库（七类算法族自动选择与回退）提高非线性稳态系统的求解效率与鲁棒性。

title: Learning the Central Bank's Inflation Response in Financial Markets

detail.title: Learning the Central Bank's Inflation Response in Financial Markets
detail.abstract: Using nominal Treasury yields and Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities inflation compensation, this paper estimates a daily market-based index of how investors perceive the Federal Reserve's inflation response. The index allows for term, convenience, liquidity, and relative liquidity components, and is validated with professional forecasts, household expectations, maturity-specific event reactions, and Federal Open Market Committee surprise measures. The perceived response is low in 2021 and 2022, rises during the tightening cycle, and remains stable when the 20-year maturity is excluded. A stronger perceived response is associated with lower long-run professional inflation expectations, lower household inflation expectations at short and medium horizons, and lower disagreement; event-specific revisions also comove positively with clean monetary policy surprises. The results imply that marketbased policy benchmarks are conditional on beliefs about how the central bank reacts to inflation, so fixed-rule interpretations can confound credibility learning with other market components.

AI.tldr: 本文利用名义国债和TIPS数据，构建了一个衡量投资者对美联储通胀反应感知的每日市场指数，发现该感知在2021-2022年较低、紧缩周期中上升，且更强的感知与更低的通胀预期和分歧相关，表明市场基准取决于对央行反应的信念。
AI.research_question: 投资者如何感知美联储对通胀的反应？这种感知如何随时间变化并影响通胀预期？
AI.motivation: 在通胀高企和货币政策收紧的背景下，市场参与者对央行反应函数的信念至关重要，但缺乏一个高频、基于市场的衡量指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于名义国债和TIPS通胀补偿的分解，包含期限溢价、便利性、流动性及相对流动性成分，构建隐含的政策反应感知指数。
AI.method: 利用每日名义国债收益率和TIPS数据，通过模型分解出市场隐含的通胀反应感知指数，并通过专业预测、家庭预期、事件研究和FOMC surprise measures进行验证。
AI.findings: 感知反应在2021-2022年较低，在紧缩周期中上升，排除20年期后保持稳定；更强的感知反应与较低的专业和家庭通胀预期及更低的分歧相关；事件驱动的修正与货币政策 surprise 正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了市场基准条件依赖于投资者对央行通胀反应的信念，固定规则的解释会混淆可信度学习与其他市场成分。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个每日更新的市场感知指数，可用于监测央行可信度和通胀预期，帮助政策制定者和市场参与者更好地理解货币政策传导机制。

title: Same Firms, Different Verdicts: ESG Rating Choice and the Measurement of Greenwashing
affiliations: New York University Stern School of Business and

detail.title: Same Firms, Different Verdicts: ESG Rating Choice and the Measurement of Greenwashing
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the Aggregate Confusion hypothesis (Berg, Kölbel, and Rigobon, 2022) at the firm level by measuring the Disclosure-Performance Gap (DPG), defined as the standardised divergence between a firm's voluntary environmental disclosure ("Talk") and its realised emissions performance ("Walk"). The sample comprises 200 large European firms drawn from the Energy, Materials, Industrials, and Utilities sectors of the STOXX Europe 600 in fiscal year 2023, the final cross-section of the voluntary reporting era before the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive. The estimated model is identified through a systematic six-stage model selection process, namely candidate assembly, Pearson correlation screening, multicollinearity filtering by Variance Inflation Factor, stepwise forward search across five variable pools under the corrected Akaike Information Criterion, Cook's distance influence screening, and HC3 re-estimation, which evaluates 421 candidate specifications. The selected model is estimated by ordinary least squares with HC3 robust standard errors on the full sample of 200 firms. The strongest predictor of a wider gap is flagship index membership (β = +0.78, p < 0.01), consistent with institutional ceremonial conformity; Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) endorsement is also positive (β = +0.86, p < 0.05) but is identified off a small group of non-supporting firms and is read as directional rather than as a precise magnitude. Two substantive commitments significantly narrow the gap, renewable energy use (β =-0.31, p < 0.01) and environmental capital expenditure (β =-0.22, p < 0.05), consistent with signalling theory. Governance and monitoring variables carry no explanatory power. The core findings are stable under influence trimming, under a rank-based recoding of the ordinal disclosure score, and when the TCFD variable is removed. Replacing the CDP Climate Score with the LSEG Environmental Pillar Score on the identical firms eliminates the index-membership effect while the renewable-energy effect survives, showing that detected greenwashing is conditional on the rating lens applied.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了企业层面“披露-绩效差距”（DPG），发现旗舰指数成员身份和TCFD背书显著扩大差距，而可再生能源使用和环境资本支出显著缩小差距。绿色washing的检测依赖于所使用的评级视角。
AI.research_question: 在企业层面，哪些因素驱动环境披露与实际排放绩效之间的“披露-绩效差距”（DPG）？
AI.motivation: 检验Aggregate Confusion假说（即ESG披露与绩效之间存在系统性的不一致）是否在企业层面成立，并识别影响这种差距的关键因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论（仪式性合规）、信号理论（实质性承诺传递真实信号）
AI.method: 六阶段系统模型选择过程（包括候选变量组装、Pearson相关筛选、VIF多重共线性过滤、逐步向前搜索、Cook距离影响筛选、HC3稳健标准误重估），最终采用OLS+HC3稳健标准误估计，样本为200家大型欧洲企业。
AI.findings: （1）旗舰指数成员身份是DPG最强的正向预测因子（β=+0.78），支持制度仪式性合规假说；（2）TCFD背书正向但估计精度有限；（3）可再生能源使用（β=-0.31）和环境资本支出（β=-0.22）显著缩小DPG，支持信号理论；（4）治理与监控变量无解释力；（5）改用LSEG环境支柱评分后，指数成员身份效应消失，说明绿色washing检测依赖于评级视角。
AI.theory_contributions: 在企业层面验证了Aggregate Confusion假说，区分了仪式性合规与实质性信号两种行为机制，并揭示了评级视角对绿色washing检测的依赖性，为ESG评级不一致性提供了微观层面的解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和政策制定者提供了识别企业绿色washing的实证依据；提示应关注企业的实质性减排投入（可再生能源、环境资本支出）而非仅关注其披露行为或ESG评级。

title: The Effect of School Disruptions on Parental Labor Supply: Evidence from Canadian Panel Data
affiliations: Ohio State University (OSU) - Department of Human Sciences, San Diego State University - Department of Economics, Dalhousie University and Dalhousie University

detail.title: The Effect of School Disruptions on Parental Labor Supply: Evidence from Canadian Panel Data
detail.abstract: This study explores the effects of COVID-19 school closures on labor market outcomes of Canadian parents of school-aged children. Using newly collected data on grade-level-specific school closures across 141 Canadian cities along with individual-level panel data from the Labour Force Survey, difference-in-differences estimates provide robust evidence that restrictions on in-person schooling reduced employment among partnered mothers of school-aged children by approximately 2 percentage points. For fathers, labor supply adjustments are much weaker and concentrated on single fathers. Finally, auxiliary analyses using administrative tax records provide suggestive evidence that school closures increased public benefit receipt among single parents.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用加拿大141个城市的年级特定学校关闭数据和劳动力调查面板数据，发现学校关闭使学龄儿童已婚母亲的就业率下降约2个百分点，对父亲的影响较弱且集中在单亲父亲身上，同时单亲父母的公共福利领取增加。
AI.research_question: COVID-19学校关闭如何影响加拿大在校儿童父母（尤其是母亲和父亲）的劳动力市场结果？
AI.motivation: 疫情导致的学校关闭对家庭劳动供给的影响存在性别差异，但此前缺乏基于详细学校关闭数据和个体面板数据的因果证据，尤其缺少对加拿大情境的分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动供给理论、性别角色分工理论以及育儿责任对父母劳动市场参与的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（DID），结合加拿大141个城市的年级特定学校关闭数据（新收集数据）与劳动力调查（LFS）个体层面面板数据；辅助分析使用行政税收记录。
AI.findings: (1) 学校关闭使有学龄儿童的已婚母亲就业率下降约2个百分点；(2) 对父亲劳动供给的调整较弱，且主要集中在单亲父亲；(3) 学校关闭增加了单亲父母的公共福利领取。
AI.theory_contributions: 为疫情冲击下育儿责任对劳动供给的性别差异影响提供了因果证据，丰富了劳动经济学和家庭经济学中关于照料责任与劳动力市场结果关系的理论文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估学校关闭的隐性成本（特别是对女性就业的负面冲击）提供依据，并提示在公共卫生危机中需考虑对单亲家庭的社会保障支持。

title: Minimum Fisher Information, Geometric Priors and the Horseshoe
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and

detail.title: Minimum Fisher Information, Geometric Priors and the Horseshoe
detail.abstract:
Four threads in sparse Bayesian estimation — Mallows’ conjecture on minimum Fisher information for discrete normal-location mixtures, the Bickel-Collins theorem, the Mukherjee-Johnstone minimax predictive density, and the horseshoe prior — are unified by a single variational principle: minimise the Fisher information of the induced mixture density over a structured prior class subject to a variance constraint. The minimiser is the geometric distribution on the lattice and the half-Cauchy in the continuous global-local setting. 
The core of the paper is a four-way equivalence theorem (Theorem 3.13): within the lattice-mixture class, the geometric prior simultaneously minimises Fisher information, minimises integrated posterior variance (via the Tweedie formula), minimises the expected KL divergence from posterior to prior (the inverse Sanov theorem), and maximises KL predictive difficulty. Each of these four characterisations gives a distinct operational interpretation of why the geometric distribution is extremal, and the inverse Sanov perspective — that the geometric prior is the one from which data reveal the least, in the KL sense — is the deepest.
 Beyond the equivalence theorem we contribute: a corrected proof of Mallows’ conjecture addressing a gap in Bickel and Collins (1983); a complete Fisher information–KL duality for all variance ratios r > 0; a proof that geometric decay is necessary as well as sufficient for minimax KL optimality; and a demonstration that the horseshoe prior is the continuous realisation of the same four-way equivalence.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个统一的变分原理——在方差约束下最小化诱导混合密度的Fisher信息——将稀疏贝叶斯估计中的四条线索（Mallows猜想、Bickel-Collins定理、Mukherjee-Johnstone极小极大预测密度、马蹄先验）统一起来。核心定理（定理3.13）证明：在格点混合类中，几何先验同时最小化Fisher信息、最小化积分后验方差、最小化后验到先验的期望KL散度（逆Sanov定理），并最大化KL预测难度。马蹄先验则是该四重等价在连续情形下的实现。
AI.research_question: 如何通过一个统一的变分原理，将稀疏贝叶斯估计中看似不同的四条理论线索（Mallows猜想、Bickel-Collins定理、Mukherjee-Johnstone极小极大预测密度、马蹄先验）联系起来？
AI.motivation: 稀疏贝叶斯估计中存在多条独立发展的理论线索，它们分别从不同角度刻画了最优先验的性质，但缺乏统一的底层原理。本文旨在揭示这些线索背后的共同变分结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 变分原理（最小化Fisher信息）；Tweedie公式；逆Sanov定理（KL散度视角）；Fisher信息–KL对偶性。
AI.method: 数学证明与理论推导，包括：修正Mallows猜想的证明（填补Bickel & Collins 1983的漏洞）；建立四重等价定理（定理3.13）；推导Fisher信息–KL对偶性；证明几何衰减的充分必要性；将等价框架推广至连续情形（马蹄先验）。
AI.findings: （1）格点混合类中，几何先验是满足方差约束下Fisher信息最小的唯一解；（2）该先验同时实现最小化积分后验方差、最小化后验到先验的期望KL散度、最大化KL预测难度四重最优性；（3）几何衰减不仅是充分条件也是必要条件；（4）马蹄先验是连续情形下这四重等价的对应物。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）统一了稀疏贝叶斯估计中四条独立的理论线索；（2）建立了Fisher信息与KL散度之间的完整对偶性；（3）提出了逆Sanov定理这一新视角——最优先验是从中数据揭示最少的先验；（4）完整修正了Mallows猜想的证明。
AI.practical_contributions: 为稀疏估计中先验选择提供了统一的变分指导原则；揭示了马蹄先验的理论最优性根基；为实践者在离散和连续场景下选择最优稀疏先验提供了理论依据。

title: Disentangling Generative AI and Monetary Policy Shocks in the AI-Electric Vehicle Nexus
affiliations: Ecole Superieure des Sciences Economiques et Commerciales de Tunis (ESSECT),  Université de Tunis

detail.title: Disentangling Generative AI and Monetary Policy Shocks in the AI-Electric Vehicle Nexus
detail.abstract: This paper disentangles the effects of two concurrent macro-technological shocks, the Federal Reserve tightening cycle and the launch of ChatGPT, on systemic connectedness within the artificial intelligence and electric-vehicle (AI-EV) financial nexus. Using daily data on eight variables spanning May 2018 to June 2026, we identify three structural regimes via Bai-Perron break tests: a pre-ChatGPT baseline (P1), a monetary-tightening era (P2), and a generative-AI era (P3). The Diebold-Yilmaz generalized forecast-error variance decomposition reveals high systemic integration across all regimes, with a total connectedness index of approximately 7.7 percent in the baseline period. To capture distributional heterogeneity, we apply the quantile VAR framework of Ando, Greenwood-Nimmo and Shin (2022). At the median market state, the GenAI shock reduces connectedness roughly four times more than the monetary shock (-0.76 versus-0.18 percentage points). Monetary dominance re-emerges at the right tail, where the Federal Reserve effect reaches +1.40 percentage points against-0.56 for GenAI, suggesting that systemic stress amplifies the role of conventional macroeconomic policy. A horse-race difference-indifferences design confirms that the ChatGPT event dummy outperforms the Federal Reserve dummy in magnitude across all equity specifications. These results indicate that the AI-EV nexus is primarily governed by technological-regime shifts under normal market conditions, while monetary forces reassert themselves during episodes of tail risk. The findings carry implications for innovation forecasters, ESG portfolio managers, and policymakers navigating the concurrent transitions in energy and artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美联储加息周期和ChatGPT发布两个宏观技术冲击对AI-电动汽车金融网络系统关联性的影响，发现在正常市场条件下技术冲击主导，而在尾部风险时期货币政策重新占据主导地位。
AI.research_question: 美联储紧缩周期和ChatGPT发布这两个并发的宏观技术冲击如何影响AI与电动汽车金融网络的系统关联性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究较少同时考察货币政策冲击和生成式AI技术冲击对新兴技术金融网络的差异化影响，尤其是在不同市场状态（正常vs尾部风险）下的动态变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性关联性理论、分位数VAR框架、Bai-Perron结构断点检验、Diebold-Yilmaz广义预测误差方差分解
AI.method: 使用2018年5月至2026年6月的八变量日度数据，通过Bai-Perron断点检验识别三个结构区间，运用Diebold-Yilmaz方差分解和Ando等人（2022）的分位数VAR模型，并结合双重差分设计进行竞争性检验。
AI.findings: 总关联性指数约7.7%；中位数市场状态下GenAI冲击降低关联性约是货币冲击的4倍（-0.76 vs -0.18个百分点）；右尾风险下货币政策效应达+1.40个百分点而GenAI为-0.56个百分点；ChatGPT虚拟变量在所有权益规格中均优于美联储虚拟变量。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了技术冲击与货币政策冲击对系统关联性的差异化影响机制，揭示了市场状态对冲击相对重要性的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创新预测者、ESG投资组合管理者和政策制定者在能源与人工智能双重转型期提供决策参考。

title: Themes and Trends in Artificial Intelligence in Finance: A Bibliometric and Multi-Method Topic Modelling Analysis
affiliations: , The University of Texas at Arlington and University of Texas at Arlington - Department of Finance and Real Estate

detail.title: Themes and Trends in Artificial Intelligence in Finance: A Bibliometric and Multi-Method Topic Modelling Analysis
detail.abstract: This study maps the intellectual structure and evolution of artificial intelligence (AI) research in finance using a corpus of 1,579 articles indexed in the Web of Science between 2012 and 2025. We combine bibliometric analysis with three complementary topic modeling approaches-Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), BERTopic, and Bunka-to identify the dominant and emerging themes shaping the literature. The bibliometric evidence documents rapid growth in AI-finance research, led primarily by the United States and China, with increasing concentration in topics related to machine learning, sustainability, FinTech, and large language models. Across the three topic modeling approaches, we identify 39 distinct research themes and nine consensus themes consistently detected across all methods, including sustainability and green finance, natural language processing and sentiment analysis, cryptocurrency markets, investment management, auditing, and labor-market effects of AI adoption. The findings indicate that AI-finance scholarship has evolved beyond traditional applications such as credit risk prediction and fraud detection toward broader questions involving governance, digital transformation, and human-AI interaction in financial services. Cross-method comparison further shows that probabilistic, neural, and LLM-augmented topic models provide complementary perspectives on the field's intellectual structure. We also identify several underexplored areas, including AI governance and regulation, behavioral dimensions of AI adoption in finance, emerging-market applications, and causal research designs. The study contributes to the growing literature on AI and finance by providing an integrated map of the field's thematic evolution and by outlining directions for future research.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过1,579篇文献的文献计量与三种主题建模方法，绘制了2012-2025年AI在金融领域研究的智力结构与演化，识别出39个研究主题和9个共识主题，发现该领域已从传统应用向治理、数字化转型和人机交互等更广泛问题演进。
AI.research_question: AI在金融领域研究的智力结构如何？该领域的研究主题如何随时间演化？不同主题建模方法在揭示该领域结构上有何差异？
AI.motivation: AI在金融领域的研究快速增长，但缺乏对其智力结构和演化路径的系统性梳理，尤其缺乏对多种主题建模方法比较的综合分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量分析、潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）、BERTopic、Bunka主题建模方法
AI.method: 采用1,579篇Web of Science索引文献（2012-2025），结合文献计量分析与三种互补的主题建模方法（LDA、BERTopic、Bunka）进行综合分析。
AI.findings: AI-金融研究由美国和中国主导，快速增长；识别出39个研究主题和9个跨方法共识主题（包括可持续金融、自然语言处理与情感分析、加密货币、投资管理、审计、AI采纳的劳动力市场效应等）；该领域已从信贷风险预测和欺诈检测等传统应用，向治理、数字化转型和人机交互演进。同时识别出AI治理与监管、行为维度、新兴市场应用、因果研究设计等未被充分探索的领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI与金融交叉领域提供了综合性的主题演化地图；比较了概率型、神经网络型和LLM增强型三种主题建模方法的互补性视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者和从业者提供了AI在金融领域的研究全景和未来方向指引；指出了AI治理、行为金融、新兴市场等值得深入探索的空白领域。

title: Privacy-Protected Spatial Pipeline and Pedestrian Crash Risk Landscape Dataset Derived from Administrative Traffic Accident Records: Tokai City, Aichi Prefecture, Japan
affiliations: Nanzan University

detail.title: Privacy-Protected Spatial Pipeline and Pedestrian Crash Risk Landscape Dataset Derived from Administrative Traffic Accident Records: Tokai City, Aichi Prefecture, Japan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Pedestrian-vehicle traffic accidents pose a persistent urban safety challenge in Japan, yet directly applying raw administrative records to local risk analysis raises concerns about stochastic noise, privacy exposure, and complex data taxonomies. This study presents a spatial data pipeline implemented in R that transforms the 2021 National Police Agency (NPA) open traffic accident dataset into two outputs for Tokai City, Aichi Prefecture. The first is a masked attribute dataset in RDS format for secondary statistical analysis; the second is a privacy-protected GeoPackage representing a continuous pedestrian crash risk landscape for deployment in desktop GIS environments. Privacy is operationalized through spatial abstraction: individual accident locations are dissolved into 500-meter buffer zones, making reverse identification structurally impossible while preserving macro-level risk distributions. The deliberate use of FY2021 data provides a further ethical safeguard, reducing psychological and legal risks to those involved. The resulting dataset is designed for data-driven policy formation in public safety, community safety workshops, and spatial overlay analyses with local demographic or infrastructure data. The pipeline and dataset together provide an ethically grounded model for regional pedestrian crash risk assessment applicable to other municipalities using administrative traffic accident records.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于R语言的空间数据管道，将日本2021年警察厅公开交通事故数据转化为隐私保护的空间数据集，用于爱知县东海市的步行者碰撞风险评估。通过500米缓冲区空间抽象实现隐私保护，生成可用于GIS分析的风险景观数据。
AI.research_question: 如何将日本行政交通事故记录转化为既保护隐私又可用于地方步行者碰撞风险分析的空间数据产品？
AI.motivation: 日本步行者-车辆交通事故构成持续的城市安全挑战，但直接使用原始行政记录进行地方风险分析存在随机噪声、隐私暴露和数据分类复杂等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间隐私保护理论（通过空间抽象实现去识别化）、城市交通安全风险评估框架
AI.method: 基于R语言的空间数据管道，将原始事故点数据通过500米缓冲区溶解实现空间抽象，生成掩码属性数据集（RDS格式）和隐私保护的连续碰撞风险景观（GeoPackage格式）。
AI.findings: 通过500米缓冲区空间抽象，在使反向识别在结构上不可能的同时，保留了宏观层面的风险分布；使用FY2021数据提供额外的伦理保障。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种可用于市政交通行政记录的、以伦理为基础的区域步行者碰撞风险评估模型，平衡了数据效用与隐私保护。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共安全政策制定、社区安全研讨会以及人口/基础设施数据的空间叠加分析提供了可直接部署的数据产品；该管道可推广至其他城市。

title: The Labor Market Effects of Expanding Overtime Coverage
affiliations: University of Southern California

detail.title: The Labor Market Effects of Expanding Overtime Coverage
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the labor market effects of overtime coverage in the United States, where salaried workers are covered for overtime if their base pay falls below a legislated salary threshold. Using an event-study design with administrative payroll data and state-level threshold changes from 2014-2021, I find evidence against conventional models of overtime. Contrary to the historical intent of policymakers, firms do not increase employment by substituting more workers for fewer hours. However, contrary to compensating differential models, firms also do not offset the costs of overtime by lowering workers' base pays. Instead, employers raised salaries above the threshold to keep workers exempt from overtime, indicating that monitoring and adjusting workers' hours is costly for firms. Taken together, these results suggest that expanding overtime coverage increases workers' earnings without negatively impacting employment.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国加班政策对劳动力市场的影响，发现企业通过提高薪资使员工免于加班，而非减薪或增加雇佣，表明加班覆盖扩大能提高工人收入而不损害就业。
AI.research_question: 美国加班费覆盖政策对劳动力市场（就业、薪资、工时）有何影响？
AI.motivation: 传统加班模型存在争议：政策制定者期望通过加班费促使企业增加雇佣、减少工时；但补偿性差异模型则认为企业会降低底薪来抵消加班成本。本文试图用真实数据检验这些理论预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: ①传统加班模型：加班费促使企业用更多工人替代更长工时；②补偿性差异模型：企业通过降低底薪来抵消加班成本；③监控成本理论：企业调整和监督工人工时存在成本。
AI.method: 事件研究法（event-study design），使用2014-2021年美国行政工资单数据及州级薪资阈值变动进行分析。
AI.findings: ①企业未通过增加雇佣来替代工时（与传统模型预测相反）；②企业未通过降低底薪来抵消加班成本（与补偿性差异模型相反）；③企业通过提高薪资使工人超过加班豁免门槛；④加班覆盖扩大提高了工人收入，且未对就业产生负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: ①推翻了传统加班模型和补偿性差异模型在现实中的适用性；②支持了"监控-调整工时成本高昂"的理论解释；③揭示了企业应对加班政策的实际行为模式。
AI.practical_contributions: ①为政策制定者提供实证依据：扩大加班覆盖范围可提高工人收入而不损害就业；②挑战了关于加班政策可能导致就业损失的传统担忧；③对劳动保护法规的设计具有重要参考价值。

title: Huber, Sanov and Shannon, Merging Robust Statistics with Information Theory
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and

detail.title: Huber, Sanov and Shannon, Merging Robust Statistics with Information Theory
detail.abstract: We show that the Huber distribution f c is the unique fixed point of four information-theoretic minimisation principles over the ε-contaminated normal class F ε : Shannon minimax KL risk (Polson, 1988), Kolmogorov description length, Wallace's Minimum Message Length (MML), and Rissanen's Normalised Maximum Likelihood. An eleven-way Equivalence Theorem shows all four reduce to one Fisher-entropy duality: f c simultaneously minimises Fisher information and maximises Shannon entropy over F ε. The saddle-point equality is established via Sion's theorem with an explicit O(log n/n) rate from the Polson-Clarke-Barron expansion (Polson, 1988, 1992; Clarke and Barron, 1990). The MML equivalence is new: strict MML estimation under F ε is exactly Huber M-estimation, threshold determined by the Wallace-Freeman constant. Via the inverse Sanov theorem of Ganesh and O'Connell (1999), f c generates the flattest posterior large-deviation rate simultaneously across the BvM, moderate-deviation, large-deviation, and Cramér-Chernoff regimes. A universal theorem covers TV balls, Hellinger balls, Wasserstein neighbourhoods, and exponential family contamination. A simulation study confirms finite-sample threshold convergence and near-oracle MSE.

AI.tldr: 本文证明Huber分布是ε-污染正态类上四种信息论最小化准则的唯一不动点，建立了十一重等价定理，揭示了Fisher-熵对偶性，并证明MML估计与Huber M估计等价。
AI.research_question: Huber分布在信息论最小化准则下是否具有唯一性和最优性？
AI.motivation: 统一理解Huber分布在不同信息论框架下的理论基础，建立Fisher信息与Shannon熵之间的对偶关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: Shannon最小化KL风险、Kolmogorov描述长度、Wallace最小消息长度（MML）、Rissanen归一化最大似然、Fisher-熵对偶、Sanov大偏差定理
AI.method: 利用Sion定理建立鞍点等式，通过Polson-Clarke-Barron展开获得O(log n/n)收敛速率，运用Ganesh-O'Connell逆Sanov定理推导后验大偏差率。
AI.findings: Huber分布同时最小化Fisher信息并最大化Shannon熵；严格MML估计等价于Huber M估计；Huber分布在Bernstein-von Mises、中偏差、大偏差和Cramér-Chernoff四种 regimes 中产生最平的后验大偏差率。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了十一重等价定理，统一了四种信息论准则；揭示了Fisher-熵对偶性；证明了MML与Huber M估计的等价性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为稳健统计中的阈值选择提供了信息论依据；模拟验证了有限样本下的阈值收敛性和近Oracle的均方误差表现。

title: Can the Anomaly Zoo Speak with One Voice? Consensus, Reliability, and Expected Returns
affiliations: Rutgers Business School - Rutgers University

detail.title: Can the Anomaly Zoo Speak with One Voice? Consensus, Reliability, and Expected Returns
detail.abstract: Using 212 signed Chen-Zimmermann/Open Asset Pricing predictors, this paper studies whether the anomaly zoo contains a common real-time expected-return signal and whether that signal has measurable reliability states. The empirical design starts in 1963, uses expanding training windows with fixed twelve-year validation windows, and predicts returns from 1985 through 2024. The robust consensus, denoted C * , aggregates a family of legitimate consensus makers rather than selecting a single winning model. C * predicts next-month stock returns in Fama-MacBeth regressions and value-weighted portfolio sorts. A value-weighted high-minuslow portfolio earns an FF5-plus-momentum alpha of 1.06 percent per month. The premium is systematically conditioned by model agreement, signal-profile shape, support quality, higher moments, attention, information resolution, limits-to-arbitrage states, and the location of information across industries and peers. The evidence shows that high-dimensional anomaly information is organized by both consensus and reliability. The anomaly zoo contains a common expected-return component, and the reliability state behind that component changes how the signal should be interpreted in asset-pricing tests and portfolio choice.

AI.tldr: 本文利用212个资产定价异象因子，研究异象动物园是否存在共同的实时预期收益信号，以及该信号是否具有可测量的可靠性状态。研究发现，稳健共识（C*）能有效预测月度股票收益，其高减低投资组合月均alpha达1.06%。共识和可靠性共同组织高维异象信息，且可靠性状态影响信号在资产定价检验和投资组合选择中的解读。
AI.research_question: 异象动物园中的众多预测因子是否包含一个共同的实时预期收益信号？该信号是否具有可测量的可靠性状态？
AI.motivation: 现有文献发现大量异象因子，但这些因子的共同信息结构和时变可靠性尚不清楚，研究者需要理解高维异象信息如何组织及其在预测中的可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 稳健共识（C*）聚合方法、模型一致性理论、信号轮廓形态、支持质量、高阶矩、注意力、信息分辨率、套利限制状态、行业与同行信息位置等。
AI.method: 使用212个Chen-Zimmermann/Open Asset Pricing异象预测因子，从1963年开始，采用扩展训练窗口（固定12年验证窗口），预测1985年至2024年的收益。通过聚合一组合法的共识制造者（而非选择单一模型）构建稳健共识C*，使用Fama-MacBeth回归和价值加权投资组合排序进行检验。
AI.findings: C*能有效预测下月股票收益；价值加权高减低投资组合在FF5+动量因子调整后月均alpha为1.06%；该溢价受到模型一致性、信号轮廓形态、支持质量、高阶矩、注意力、信息分辨率、套利限制状态以及行业与同行信息位置的系统调节。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明高维异象信息由共识和可靠性共同组织；异象动物园中存在共同的预期收益成分；可靠性状态改变了信号在资产定价检验和投资组合选择中的解读方式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了一种基于共识的实时收益预测方法；揭示了可靠性状态对投资组合构建和风险管理的重要性；帮助市场参与者更好理解异象因子的时变预测能力。

title: Forecast Loss or Portfolio Loss? Objective Reliability in High-Dimensional Expected-Return Portfolios
affiliations: Rutgers Business School - Rutgers University

detail.title: Forecast Loss or Portfolio Loss? Objective Reliability in High-Dimensional Expected-Return Portfolios
detail.abstract: This paper studies whether high-dimensional expected-return portfolios should be selected by stock-level forecast loss or by portfolio-level payoff objectives. Using 212 Chen-Zimmermann/Open Asset Pricing characteristics, delisting-adjusted CRSP returns, and an annual validation-refit design for target years 1985-2024, I compare objective rankings across long-short, long-only active, and proxy-residualized long-short portfolio maps. Forecast loss is difficult to beat in unconstrained long-short portfolios: the validation-selected rule earns 45.9 percent annually, while the forecast-loss benchmark earns 47.7 percent. Portfolio objectives affect selection, objective-family dispersion, and implemented portfolio composition more when the map changes the payoff object, although they do not uniformly improve average returns. The contribution is to make objective reliability, the transfer of validation-window objective rankings into target-year portfolio outcomes, an empirical object of asset-pricing validation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在选择高维期望收益组合时，应基于股票层面的预测损失还是投资组合层面的收益目标。利用212个特征和1985-2024年的数据，发现预测损失在无约束多空组合中难以被击败（47.7% vs 45.9%），但组合目标在改变收益对象时影响更大。贡献在于将目标可靠性作为资产定价验证的实证对象。
AI.research_question: 高维期望收益组合的选择应基于股票层面的预测损失还是投资组合层面的收益目标？
AI.motivation: 现有研究在选择投资组合时存在方法选择上的分歧，即应该基于预测误差最小化还是直接优化投资组合的收益目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于验证窗口的目标排名向目标年份投资组合结果的转移，即目标可靠性（objective reliability）。
AI.method: 使用212个Chen-Zimmermann/Open Asset Pricing特征、去退市调整的CRSP收益率，采用年度验证-再拟合设计，比较多空、纯多头主动和代理残差化多空组合映射下的目标排名。
AI.findings: （1）预测损失在无约束多空组合中难以被击败（47.7% vs 45.9%）；（2）组合目标在改变收益对象时对选择、目标家族分散度和投资组合构成影响更大；（3）组合目标并未一致地提高平均收益率。
AI.theory_contributions: 将目标可靠性（objective reliability）——即验证窗口的目标排名向目标年份投资组合结果的转移——确立为资产定价验证的实证对象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资组合构建提供了方法选择依据：在无约束多空组合中可优先考虑预测损失方法，而在改变收益对象的组合映射中需关注组合目标的影响。

title: Fair Hearings: Accuracy First
affiliations: University of Oxford - Faculty of Law and

detail.title: Fair Hearings: Accuracy First
detail.abstract: There are two conflicting approaches to fair hearings in English law. One line of cases says that fairness or justice requires a hearing only when it stands to contribute to a more accurate overall decision. The other says that fairness requires a hearing independently of its contribution to an overall decision. Recently, many commentators have championed the second approach, usually based on an appeal to non-instrumental process values, such as respect and autonomy. Here we defend the first, accuracycentred approach. Others who do so tend to deny that there are process values. Our strategy is different: we show that the existence of process values is consistent with an accuracy-centred approach.

AI.tldr: 本文针对英国法律中关于公平听证权的两种冲突观点展开分析。一种观点认为公平听证仅当其有助于提升裁决准确性时才必要；另一种则认为听证本身具有独立价值。作者为前一种（以准确性为中心）立场辩护，但不同于否定程序价值的学者，本文论证了程序价值与准确性中心方法可以兼容。
AI.research_question: 英国法律中公平听证权的正当性基础是什么？公平听证是否仅仅服务于决策准确性，还是具有独立的非工具性价值？
AI.motivation: 近年来许多评论者基于尊重、自主性等非工具性程序价值支持听证权的独立地位，而以往为准确性中心立场辩护的学者往往否认程序价值的存在。作者试图填补这一空白，证明程序价值可以与准确性中心方法共存。
AI.theoretical_framework: 程序价值理论（工具性价值 vs. 非工具性价值）；法律正当程序理论；决策准确性与公平性的关系理论。
AI.method: 规范分析方法，通过梳理和对比英国判例法中的两条对立进路，进行逻辑论证与概念分析。
AI.findings: 程序价值的存在并不必然否定以准确性为中心的公平听证实务；程序价值可以与准确性中心方法兼容，从而调和两种看似冲突的立场。
AI.theory_contributions: 为准确性中心方法提供了新的辩护路径，证明该方法不必否认程序价值的存在，推进了关于程序正义的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为英国法律实务中公平听证权的适用范围和正当性判断提供了更清晰的理论指引，有助于法院在具体案件中平衡程序价值与决策效率。

title: The Global Flow System: A Genetic Description of a Dynamic Structure Temporal Warfare I

detail.title: The Global Flow System: A Genetic Description of a Dynamic Structure Temporal Warfare I

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an independent geostrategic theorist and a reserve senior non-commissioned officer (főtörzsőrmester, OR-8) of the Hungarian Defence Forces. This paper is independent scholarly work representing the author's own analysis alone, not the position of the Hungarian Defence Forces or any other institution. The author has no commercial or financial relationship bearing on this study and declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a theoretical and analytical study in geostrategy and international political economy. It involves no human or animal participants, no clinical or experimental data, and no personal data. Ethics approval is therefore not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or funding from any agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper describes the Global Flow System not in one of its states but through its genesis, on the premise that a dynamic system can be described truthfully only through the way it came to be: its present shape is a cross-section of an ongoing motion, not a separate, standing object. The account begins from the field-nature of the political unit. Community, Country, and State are not solid bodies but fields at different degrees of organization, and the fixed border is the most derivative term of all, the frozen imprint of two State-fields meeting where neither could expand further. From this ontology the paper derives the constitutive role of flow, the Neolithic proto-valve, the field-law, the growth axiom, and the historical pattern of the valve. The genesis runs into the present structure: three flow-constitutions, four interlocking layers, a single measuring layer that prices everything as the price of time, and a saturated field. One law holds at every scale. A flow-organized system fills its field, the filling saturates it, and in the saturated field tension seeks release; within closed space release is destructive, and only an extensive opening is not, until the new space fills in turn. The paper fixes the system's dynamic nature and its genesis, and hands the elaboration to the remaining chapters of the cycle.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种以"生成"而非"状态"来描述全球流动系统的本体论框架，认为政治单元（社区、国家）本质上是不同组织程度的场域，固定边界是场域相遇的冻结印记。从这一本体论出发，推导出流动的构成性作用、新石器时代的原始阀门、场域定律、增长公理及阀门的历史模式，并最终呈现当前系统的三层结构：三种流动宪法、四个嵌套层级、一个将一切定价为时间价格的单一衡量层，以及饱和场域。系统遵循"填充-饱和-张力释放"的循环规律。
AI.research_question: 如何从本体论层面理解全球流动系统的生成过程与动态本质？
AI.motivation: 现有研究将全球流动系统视为静态对象进行描述，忽略了其动态生成过程。作者主张只有通过系统的生成路径才能真正理解其当前形态，因此需要构建一个从场域本体论出发的流动系统发生学框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 场域本体论（政治单元作为不同组织程度的场域）、流动构成论、阀门理论、场域定律、增长公理、饱和场域与张力释放机制
AI.method: 理论演绎与概念推演，从场域本体论的基础前提出发，推导出流动系统的构成性规则和历史模式。
AI.findings: (1) 政治单元是场域而非固体，边界是场域相遇的冻结印记；(2) 流动具有构成性作用；(3) 存在新石器时代的原始阀门机制；(4) 系统遵循增长公理与场域定律；(5) 当前系统包含三种流动宪法、四个嵌套层级和一个以时间定价的单一衡量层；(6) 系统处于饱和状态，遵循"填充-饱和-释放"的循环规律。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了以"生成"替代"状态"的动态系统描述范式；构建了场域本体论下的政治单元新理解；建立了流动系统的发生学理论框架；发现了跨尺度的统一场域定律。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解当代全球流动系统的结构性矛盾（饱和场域中的张力释放问题）提供了分析工具；对国际关系、全球治理和政策制定具有启发意义。

detail.title: Disrupting the Inevitability of Autonomous Vehicles
