publicationDetails.detailsText: This is a pre-print manuscript submitted to the forthcoming book, Thomas W. Sanchez, Xinyue Ye (eds) 2026. The De Gruyter Handbook of Disruptive Urban Technologies and Society.

detail.abstract: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) have become central to visions of urban mobility. While AVs are often portrayed as an inevitable disruption, ongoing experiments reveal their unfinished nature and raise questions of responsible governance. In this chapter, we explore the implications of AVs and AV experiments for urban life and ask: what is meant to be disrupted, which mobility regimes are destabilized, and who participates in shaping the future trajectory of mobility innovation? We argue that current developments are not disruptive enough to transform unsustainable and unjust patterns of urban mobility. Rather than demonstrating inevitable autonomous systems, experiments could instead serve to open debate on the often ignored social, infrastructural, and regulatory dimensions of AVs, as well as on alternative options. Prioritizing local mobility needs over assumptions of universal scalability has the potential to make AVs beneficial for a broader public. We conclude that responsible governance in experiments and beyond needs to reconsider how AVs might disrupt incumbent mobility regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了自动驾驶汽车（AVs）实验对城市出行的影响，认为当前发展不足以颠覆不可持续和不公平的出行模式，强调实验应关注被忽视的社会、基础设施和监管维度，并优先考虑本地出行需求而非普适规模化。
AI.research_question: 自动驾驶汽车及其实验对城市生活有何影响？意图颠覆什么？哪些出行体制被 destabilized？谁参与了塑造未来出行创新轨迹？
AI.motivation: 尽管AV常被描绘为不可避免的颠覆性技术，但持续的实验揭示其未完成性，并引发了负责任治理的问题，促使作者重新审视AV实验的真正意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 颠覆性创新理论、负责任治理框架、城市出行体制理论
AI.method: 概念分析/理论论证，基于对AV实验的批判性审视
AI.findings: 当前AV发展不足以颠覆不可持续和不公平的城市出行模式；AV实验应服务于开放社会辩论而非展示技术必然性；负责任治理需优先考虑本地出行需求而非普适规模化。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了AV作为必然颠覆性技术的主流叙事，提出了AV实验应作为社会辩论平台而非技术演示的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和实验设计者提供了负责任治理的建议：关注社会、基础设施和监管维度，优先本地出行需求，重新思考AV如何颠覆现有出行体制。

title: Capacity-Constrained Demand Pressure as a Parsimonious Predictor of Inflation: An Occam's Razor Approach
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Capacity-Constrained Demand Pressure as a Parsimonious Predictor of Inflation: An Occam's Razor Approach

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None at present time
declarations.ethicsApproval: No studies were conducted involving patients / participants in the development of this paper. I would like to outwardly disclose that Claude Opus 4.6 was utilized throughout the research process, in every instance - the input data, frameworks and prompts were entirely my own and no external proprietary / confidential data was incorporated in the process.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Capacity-Constrained Demand Pressure (CPDP) model as a parsimonious, single-factor leading indicator for U.S. inflation as measured by the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index. In contrast to the multi-factor Phillips Curve variants, DSGE frameworks, and machine learning ensembles that dominate contemporary inflation forecasting, the CPDP model exploits a single structural insight: inflation is fundamentally a capacity utilization phenomenon with a transmission lag. The model's predictive power is strongly regime-dependent: using 162 realized monthly forecastoutcome pairs from November 2012 through April 2026, the post-COVID subsample (2020-2026) achieves R2 = 0.440 (block bootstrap p = 0.049), while the preceding lowvariance period (2012-2020) yields R2 = 0.171 (p = 0.09), not statistically distinguishable from noise at conventional levels. A Chow test confirms a structural break at March 2020 (F = 52.40, p < 0.001), with the capacity-to-inflation transmission coefficient rising from β = 0.18 pre-COVID to β = 0.53 post-COVID. The pooled full-sample relationship (73.3% correlation, 53.7% R2, block bootstrap p = 0.002) benefits substantially from the highvariance inflation cycle and should be interpreted as a statistical average over two distinct regimes rather than a stable structural parameter. The CPDP model subsumes the unemployment gap's predictive content in the full sample and post-COVID regime: in a bivariate Phillips Curve comparison (N = 153), adding the unemployment gap to CPDP yields a statistically insignificant improvement (ΔR² = 0.003, F = 1.09, p = 0.30), while adding CPDP to the Phillips Curve yields a massive gain (ΔR² = 0.528, F = 173.4, p < 0.001). However, this subsumption is regime-specific: in the preCOVID low-volatility period (N = 79), the Phillips Curve retains independent predictive  content (R² = 0.283) above CPDP (R² = 0.207), and the unemployment gap adds significantly to CPDP (F = 12.07, p < 0.001). The 'sufficient statistic' characterization applies primarily to the post-COVID regime and full sample. The effective independent sample size of approximately 10 non-overlapping 16-month forecast windows - spanning roughly 1.5 inflation cycles of meaningful amplitude - represents a fundamental limitation on generalizability claims. The model is best understood as a conditional forecasting tool: it identifies the direction and magnitude of capacity pressure with high accuracy during regime shifts, but its signal-to-noise ratio deteriorates in low-volatility environments where all parsimonious models struggle. We argue this represents an Occam's Razor result: the simplest model consistent with the data should be preferred, particularly when complex alternatives offer marginal improvement at the cost of interpretability, robustness, and real-time applicability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出产能约束需求压力（CPDP）模型，利用产能利用率作为单一因子预测美国PCE通胀。模型在后COVID时期（R²=0.44）表现显著优于低波动时期（R²=0.171），且能吸收失业缺口的大部分预测信息，但存在明显的体制依赖性和有限独立样本的限制。
AI.research_question: 能否用一个基于产能利用率的单一因子简约模型（CPDP）来有效预测美国PCE通胀？其预测能力在不同宏观经济体制下是否具有稳健性？
AI.motivation: 现有通胀预测模型（多因子菲利普斯曲线、DSGE、机器学习集成）复杂度高、可解释性差、实时应用受限。作者试图检验一个简单假设：通胀本质上是一种产能利用率现象，且存在传导时滞。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产能约束需求压力（CPDP）模型：将通胀视为产能利用率现象，核心逻辑是产能压力经过传导滞后最终表现为价格变化。与菲利普斯曲线进行对比检验。
AI.method: 单因子回归模型，使用162个月度预测-结果配对样本（2012.11-2026.04）。采用分块自助法（block bootstrap）检验统计显著性，Chow检验识别体制断点，并与菲利普斯曲线进行嵌套模型比较（F检验）。
AI.findings: 1. CPDP模型预测能力具有强体制依赖性：后COVID时期R²=0.44（p=0.049），低波动时期R²=0.171（p=0.09）；2. Chow检验确认2020年3月存在结构性断点，传导系数从β=0.18升至β=0.53；3. 全样本中CPDP吸收失业缺口预测信息（ΔR²=0.003，p=0.30），但此效果局限于后COVID时期；4. 有效独立样本仅约10个非重叠16个月预测窗口，约1.5个通胀周期。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出并验证了简约单一因子通胀预测模型的可行性与边界条件；2. 揭示通胀预测模型的体制依赖性，识别了"低波动困境"；3. 对菲利普斯曲线的预测内容进行了条件性吸收检验；4. 引入奥卡姆剃刀原则作为模型选择的论证框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供了一个简洁、可实时应用的通胀方向预测工具；2. 明确了该工具的最佳使用场景（体制转换期）和局限性（低波动环境）；3. 提醒实务界注意复杂模型可能带来的边际收益递减和稳健性损失。

title: Is Immigration a Problem for Europe?

detail.title: Is Immigration a Problem for Europe?
detail.abstract: This article examines whether immigration constitutes "a problem" for Europe on the basis of evidence published in academic journals. Priority is given to meta-analyses, literature reviews, reforms, assignment rules, discontinuities, and other designs capable of distinguishing causal effects from selection. The evidence supports neither the view that immigration is harmless nor the view that it automatically produces benefits. Average effects on native wages and employment are generally small, but local and short-run losses occur among closely substitutable workers, and some quasi-experimental shocks produce sizeable declines in local employment. Skilled immigration can expand firms, capital, productivity, and innovation, although this evidence is concentrated in particular flows and regions. Refugees exhibit larger employment gaps and higher initial fiscal costs; employment bans, administrative delays, dispersal policies, and the nonrecognition of credentials causally aggravate those gaps. At the meso level, housing, schools, health care, and public safety display heterogeneous effects: housing may become more expensive where supply is rigid; high school concentration can impair outcomes; and although reviews find no uniform increase in total crime, several European designs detect increases in property or violent offences under unemployment, exclusion, or refugee inflows. At the macro level, immigration raises total output and may improve output per capita, employment, and demographic indicators, but fiscal conclusions depend fundamentally on age, employment, wages, household composition, time horizon, and accounting rules. The aggregate evidence on asylum is too narrow to support a universal claim. The balance is conditional and asymmetric: there is no basis for describing all immigration as an intrinsic general burden on Europe, but neither is there a basis for assuming that every volume or composition will be benign. The most robust problems are distributive, territorial, transitional-fiscal, and institutional; their magnitude depends on which flow arrives, how rapidly, where it settles, and under which housing, employment, education, legal-status, and municipal-financing rules.

AI.tldr: 本文基于学术证据系统评估移民对欧洲的影响，发现移民既非无害也非自动有益，其影响具有条件性和不对称性，最突出的问题集中在分配、地域、转型财政和制度层面。
AI.research_question: 移民是否构成"欧洲的问题"？
AI.motivation: 移民问题在欧洲存在广泛争议，但缺乏基于因果识别证据的系统性评估，本文旨在弥合这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场替代效应理论、财政吸收理论、制度摩擦理论、空间经济学
AI.method: 系统性文献综述，优先纳入元分析、文献回顾、准实验设计（如改革、分配规则、断点回归）等能够区分因果效应与选择效应的研究。
AI.findings: 移民平均工资和就业效应较小，但本地和短期损失存在于高度可替代的工人群体中；技能移民可促进企业扩张和创新；难民就业缺口大、财政成本高；住房、学校、公共安全等层面呈现异质性效应；宏观上移民提高总产出但财政结论取决于多种条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"条件性与不对称性"分析框架，整合了劳动力市场、财政、制度等多维度理论，揭示了移民效应的条件依赖性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了基于因果证据的决策参考，指出了移民政策的关键调节变量（流入类型、速度、定居地点、住房/就业/教育/法律地位/市政融资规则）。

title: Artificial Intelligence: What Drives Adoption in EU Countries?
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence: What Drives Adoption in EU Countries?

declarations.funderStatement: Financial support for this research was provided by Neoma Business School “Business Dynamics, Productivity, Employment, and Human Resources” research chair

detail.abstract: This paper uses results from successive waves of the Eurostat survey on 'ICT usage and e-commerce in enterprises' to study the determinants of AI adoption in a country/industry/time panel covering 17 countries and 24 industries of the European Union over 2021-2025. We relate adoption to several potential drivers: the perceived obstacles to adoption, the business environment (such as investment in organizational capital), the policy context (such as policies affecting the capabilities and incentives to adopt and use AI technologies) and demography (shares of different age groups within employees). We summarize some of the potential drivers using Principal Components Analyses and take a diff-in-diff approach to highlight how the influence of nationwide drivers of adoption differs depending on industry exposure to them. We find robust statistical associations of both adoption and the extent of AI use (at least three AI technologies) with mismatch obstacles (data availability, expertise, technological incompatibility, or AI's perceived lack of usefulness for the firm) whose significance has increased over time, as well as with costs and personal concerns (legal uncertainty, ethical and privacy concerns) whose significance has decreased over time. Human capabilities (such as ICT skills and organizational capital) and innovation policies are positively related to AI adoption, while policies curbing either workforce flexibility or competition in industries that are key providers of intermediate inputs are inversely related to adoption. Finally, we find evidence of an inverted U-curve between workforce age and AI adoption, with adoption being weaker where the age distribution is tilted towards young or elderly workers; however, higher AI exposure in an industry moderates these demographic effects, perhaps due to skillleveling effect of the new technology.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2021-2025年欧盟17国24个行业的面板数据，研究了企业采用人工智能的影响因素，发现技能错配障碍、人力资本与创新政策促进AI采用，而成本与隐私担忧的影响随时间减弱，劳动力年龄与AI采用呈倒U型关系。
AI.research_question: 在欧盟国家与行业层面，哪些因素驱动了企业对人工智能技术的采用？这些驱动因素的作用如何随时间变化？
AI.motivation: 人工智能被视为具有变革性的通用技术，但企业对AI的采用率存在显著差异。理解AI采用的驱动因素对于政策制定和企业战略具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采用理论、人力资本理论、创新政策理论；采用主成分分析和双重差分方法分析行业暴露度的调节作用。
AI.method: 基于Eurostat"ICT使用与企业电子商务"调查数据，构建覆盖2021-2025年17国24个行业的面板数据。使用主成分分析降维潜在驱动因素，采用双重差分方法分析全国性驱动因素对不同行业的影响差异。
AI.findings: 1. 技能错配障碍（数据可用性、专业知识不足、技术不兼容、AI缺乏实用性）与AI采用显著正相关，且其重要性随时间上升；2. 成本与个人担忧（法律不确定性、伦理与隐私顾虑）的影响随时间下降；3. 人力资本（ICT技能、组织资本）和创新政策促进AI采用；4. 限制劳动力灵活性或关键中间投入行业竞争的政策抑制AI采用；5. 劳动力年龄与AI采用呈倒U型曲线，但高AI暴露行业可缓解年龄效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了AI采用障碍的动态变化特征，区分了"错配障碍"与"成本担忧"两类障碍的不同时间趋势；2. 发现了劳动力年龄结构的非线性效应及其被行业AI暴露度调节的机制，提出技能平衡效应（skill-leveling effect）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供差异化政策建议：应重点解决数据、技能等错配问题，而非过度关注成本与隐私障碍；2. 提示企业应关注组织资本和ICT技能投资；3. 指出劳动力市场政策与竞争政策对AI采用的外溢效应；4. 提醒关注不同年龄段劳动力的AI技能适配问题。

title: Fairness-Accuracy Trade-offs and Calibration Mechanisms in Machine Learning-Based Subprime Credit Scoring
affiliations: George Washington University, Renming University of China and

detail.title: Fairness-Accuracy Trade-offs and Calibration Mechanisms in Machine Learning-Based Subprime Credit Scoring
detail.abstract: The use of machine learning in subprime loans has significantly improved the ability to detect default, but it can also amplify structural differences between groups in the process of approving and pricing. Using real world business data from a US subprime auto lender, we have compiled some 120,000 application and repayment samples to compare the fairness and prediction performance of logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost, and multilayered perceptrones.This study uses AUC, KS, default detection rate, and portfolio returns as assessment measures to measure demographic equity, equal opportunities, and individual equity. The results indicate that XGBoost has the best prediction precision, but shows the greatest differences between races, ages, and sexes; logistic regression has a lower overall precision but shows a relatively stable equity performance.Addressing the high retraining and deployment costs associated with traditional fair constraints, a correction strategy is proposed that combines group-specific threshold adjustment with postprocessing calibration. With no change in the structure of the core model, this approach reduces the difference metrics by 27.4%, but the AUC is reduced by only 0.3 percentage points, and the aggregate gain remains substantially the same. This approach is more suitable for rapid deployment in existing loan schemes than for a simple modification of the loss function or the application of a single threshold. The results of the study show that equity and profitability are not mutually exclusive, and a more robust balance between risk control, profitability, and compliance can be achieved by appropriate calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文基于美国次级汽车贷款机构的12万条真实数据，比较了逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost和多层感知机在贷款审批中的公平性与预测性能。XGBoost预测精度最高但群体差异最大，逻辑回归精度较低但公平性更稳定。研究提出了一种结合分组阈值调整与后处理校准的修正策略，在不改变核心模型结构的情况下，将差异指标降低了27.4%，而AUC仅下降0.3个百分点。
AI.research_question: 机器学习模型在次级贷款审批中如何平衡预测性能与群体公平性？能否在不牺牲核心模型结构的前提下，通过后处理校准策略有效降低算法歧视？
AI.motivation: 机器学习在次级贷款中能提升违约预测能力，但也可能放大种族、年龄、性别等群体间的结构性差异。传统公平约束方法存在再训练和部署成本高的问题，亟需一种低成本、可快速部署的公平性修正策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公平性理论（人口公平、机会均等、个体公平）、机器学习预测模型（逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost、多层感知机）、后处理校准方法。
AI.method: 基于美国次级汽车贷款机构约12万条真实申请与还款数据，使用AUC、KS、违约检测率和投资组合收益作为评估指标，比较四种模型的预测性能与公平性表现。提出分组阈值调整结合后处理校准的修正策略，并评估其对公平性、预测精度和整体收益的影响。
AI.findings: （1）XGBoost预测精度最高，但在种族、年龄、性别维度上表现出最大的群体差异；（2）逻辑回归整体精度较低，但公平性表现相对稳定；（3）提出的分组阈值调整结合后处理校准策略，在不改变核心模型结构的情况下，将差异指标降低27.4%，AUC仅下降0.3个百分点，整体收益基本保持不变。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了预测性能与公平性之间的权衡关系，证明了高精度模型（如XGBoost）更容易放大群体差异；验证了后处理校准策略在保持模型核心结构不变的前提下显著提升公平性的可行性，为公平性-效率权衡提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一种低成本、可快速部署的公平性修正策略（分组阈值调整+后处理校准），比修改损失函数或使用单一阈值更适用于现有贷款方案；证明公平性与盈利能力并非互斥，通过适当的校准可以在风险控制、盈利能力和合规要求之间实现更稳健的平衡，为金融机构提供了可直接应用的实操方案。

title: Predictive Minimaxity, the GLX Connecting Formula and the Horseshoe Prior
affiliations: Virginia Tech, University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, George Mason University and

detail.title: Predictive Minimaxity, the GLX Connecting Formula and the Horseshoe Prior
detail.abstract: Zhai and Ročková (2026) prove that the horseshoe is the first continuous prior to achieve the exact Mukherjee and Johnstone minimax KL predictive constant in the sparse Gaussian sequence model. We develop a framework (the George, Liang and Xu (GLX) connecting formula and the Datta Polson, Sokolov and Zantedeschi (DPSZ) Moderate Deviation Principle) that simultaneously simplifies their proofs, extends their results to the horseshoe+ prior, and weakens their conditions. The GLX formula equates excess KL predictive risk to α 2 times excess quadratic estimation risk; it converts the noise-case argument to a one-line bound, identifies horseshoe spectroscopy as conditional GLX plus Jensen, and eliminates three of their four adaptive lemmas. We prove the horseshoe+ achieves the same exact constant with a strictly faster sub-leading correction governed by its log-squared spike. The theta-min condition is weakened  to the MDP detection threshold and shown to be the sharpest achievable condition for any adaptive continuous-prior predictor. All results extend to sparse regression via SVD reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GLX连接公式和DPSZ中偏差原理框架，简化了Zhai和Ročková（2026）关于horseshoe先验达到Mukherjee-Johnstone极小极大KL预测常数的证明，将结果推广到horseshoe+先验，并弱化了条件。证明horseshoe+达到相同精确常数且具有更快的次领先修正，并将theta-min条件弱化为MDP检测阈值。
AI.research_question: Horseshoe和horseshoe+先验在稀疏高斯序列模型中能否达到精确的Mukherjee-Johnstone极小极大KL预测常数？
AI.motivation: Zhai和Ročková（2026）证明horseshoe是首个达到精确Mukherjee-Johnstone常数的连续先验，但其证明复杂且条件较强。本文旨在简化证明、扩展到horseshoe+先验、并弱化条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: GLX连接公式（将过剩KL预测风险与α²倍过剩二次估计风险等价）、DPSZ中偏差原理、horseshoe光谱学（条件GLX加Jensen不等式）
AI.method: 理论推导：通过GLX公式将KL风险转化为估计风险，利用DPSZ中偏差原理处理检测阈值，通过SVD缩减扩展到稀疏回归。
AI.findings: (1) GLX公式将噪声情况证明简化为一行的界限，消除了三个自适应引理；(2) horseshoe+达到相同的精确常数，且具有更快的次领先修正（由log平方尖峰控制）；(3) theta-min条件被弱化为MDP检测阈值，且证明这是任何自适应连续先验预测器可达到的最严格条件；(4) 所有结果通过SVD缩减扩展到稀疏回归。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了GLX连接公式这一理论工具，统一了稀疏贝叶斯预测的风险分析框架；将horseshoe的最优性结果扩展到horseshoe+；刻画了theta-min条件的最优性边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 简化了最优贝叶斯收缩先验的理论证明，为实际应用中更高效地选择和使用horseshoe类先验提供了理论依据；horseshoe+更快的次领先修正意味着在有限样本下可能具有更好的预测性能。

title: GDP Nowcasting in Mauritania using Machine Learning and Satellite Data
affiliations: Economist at the Central Banque of Mauritania

detail.title: GDP Nowcasting in Mauritania using Machine Learning and Satellite Data
detail.abstract: This paper examines the role of satellite data and machine learning techniques in improving the nowcasting of real GDP in Mauritania, a context characterized by limited data availability and delays in official statistics. By combining traditional macroeconomic indicators with satellite-based variables such as Nighttime Lights and the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), the study develops a framework capable of capturing real-time economic dynamics. The results show that the inclusion of satellite data improves predictive accuracy, particularly when using non-linear models such as XGBoost. In particular, XGBoost records a reduction in RMSE from 0.019 to 0.017 and an increase in R² from 0.372 to 0.483 when satellite variables are included. Nighttime Lights are strongly correlated with economic activity, while NDVI exhibits more limited explanatory power. Overall, the findings highlight the potential of integrating alternative data sources and machine learning methods to enhance economic monitoring and support decisionmaking in data-constrained environments.

AI.tldr: 本文利用卫星数据（夜间灯光和NDVI）与机器学习方法（XGBoost）提升毛里塔尼亚实际GDP的即时预测精度，在数据稀缺的环境下显著改善了预测表现。
AI.research_question: 在数据有限且官方统计滞后的背景下，卫星数据与机器学习技术如何改善毛里塔尼亚实际GDP的即时预测（nowcasting）？
AI.motivation: 毛里塔尼亚等发展中国家面临数据可及性差、官方统计发布延迟的困境，传统宏观经济指标难以实时反映经济动态，亟需探索替代数据源和先进方法来提升经济监测能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 卫星数据的经济相关性理论（夜间灯光与经济活动的强关联性、NDVI与农业经济的关联）、机器学习预测理论（非线性模型对复杂经济关系的捕捉能力）。
AI.method: 将传统宏观经济指标与卫星变量（夜间灯光、NDVI）相结合，采用线性模型与非线性模型（XGBoost）进行对比分析，并通过RMSE和R²评估预测性能。
AI.findings: (1) 加入卫星数据显著提升了预测精度；(2) XGBoost在加入卫星变量后，RMSE从0.019降至0.017，R²从0.372提升至0.483；(3) 夜间灯光与经济活动的相关性较强，NDVI的解释力相对有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了卫星数据（尤其是夜间灯光）在数据稀缺的发展中国家GDP即时预测中的有效性，并证明了非线性机器学习模型（XGBoost）优于传统线性模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据受限国家的经济监测和决策支持提供了可行方案，展示了整合替代数据源与机器学习方法的实际价值。

title: Survival-Implied Cost of Capital: An Unlevered Ku from Sectoral Business-Mortality Curves, with an Illustrative Application to U.S. Establishment Data

detail.title: Survival-Implied Cost of Capital: An Unlevered Ku from Sectoral Business-Mortality Curves, with an Illustrative Application to U.S. Establishment Data
detail.abstract: Standard estimation of the cost of equity for privately held targets - a routine requirement in M&A and purchase-price-allocation work - leans on a beta that, for the great majority of such targets, is not observable. Practitioners typically substitute comparable-company betas or ad hoc build-up premiums. This paper develops an alternative: an unlevered cost of capital (Ku) derived directly from sectoral business-survival curves, fit with a two-parameter Weibull hazard model. We argue this quantity is conceptually distinct from beta - it prices total (business, Porterian) risk rather than covariance with a diversified market portfolio - and is therefore appropriate for the single-owner, undiversified-investor setting that characterizes most private-firm valuation, while remaining reconcilable with conventional WACC through standard unlevering/relevering (Modigliani-Miller Proposition II) and Adjusted Present Value (APV) machinery. We derive a closed-form survival-implied Ke, extend it to age-conditional survival (relevant because M&A targets are rarely newborn firms), and illustrate the approach on publicly available U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Business Employment Dynamics (BED) establishment-survival cohorts. The illustration also surfaces an important data-granularity limitation: at the 2-digit NAICS sector level publicly available from BLS, cross-sector dispersion in fitted hazard parameters is compressed relative to what a finer, firm-registry-based table (e.g., 4-digit classification) would likely reveal. We discuss this limitation together with the paper's other simplifying assumptions and lay out an empirical validation agenda - testing the survival-implied Ke against realized private-market transaction multiples - reserved for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于行业企业生存曲线（使用Weibull风险模型）直接推导非杠杆资本成本（Ku）的方法，用于评估私募股权目标公司的权益成本，替代了传统依赖可比公司贝塔或构建溢价的做法。
AI.research_question: 如何为非上市目标公司（私募股权交易中）估计权益成本，特别是当贝塔系数不可观测时？
AI.motivation: 在并购和购买价格分配工作中，标准权益成本估计依赖不可观测的贝塔系数，而实践中的替代方法（如可比公司贝塔或构建溢价）存在概念和实证上的缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. Weibull两参数风险模型（用于拟合行业生存曲线）；2. 非杠杆资本成本（Ku）概念，定价总商业风险（Porterian风险）而非市场协方差风险；3. Modigliani-Miller Proposition II（无杠杆/再杠杆）；4. 调整现值（APV）框架。
AI.method: 使用美国劳工统计局（BLS）商业就业动态（BED）数据集中2位数NAICS行业级的企业生存队列数据，拟合Weibull风险模型，推导生存隐含的权益成本（Ke），并扩展到年龄条件生存分析。
AI.findings: 1. 推导出了生存隐含的Ke的闭式解，并扩展到年龄条件生存情况；2. 基于公开BED数据进行了初步实证说明；3. 发现2位数NAICS层级的数据粒度限制较大，跨行业风险参数分散度被压缩，更细的4位数分类可能揭示更多差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了与贝塔概念上不同的Ku概念——定价总企业风险而非市场系统性风险；2. 将生存分析与资本成本估计相结合；3. 为单所有者、非多元化投资者情境下的非上市公司估值提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为从业者提供了一种不依赖可比公司贝塔的新估值方法；2. 可与传统WACC和APV框架兼容；3. 适用于并购交易中多数为非新设企业的实际情况（年龄条件生存）。

title: Monetary Policy and Functional Income Distribution: Aggregate-Level Evidence from Türkiye's Negative Real Interest Rate Regime
affiliations: Bahcesehir University

detail.title: Monetary Policy and Functional Income Distribution: Aggregate-Level Evidence from Türkiye's Negative Real Interest Rate Regime
detail.abstract: The paper examines the aggregate-level transmission of monetary policy to functional income distribution in Türkiye. The mechanism operates through the interaction of low policy ratetriggered exchange rate movements, inflation, and the sluggish adjustment of nominal wages. A six-variable structural VAR is estimated on quarterly data for 1998Q1-2023Q3, with a recursive identification suited to the unconventional low and negative real interest rate (LNRIR) policy episode of 2017-2022, during which the Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye cut the policy rate despite rising inflation. Results show that a 10% depreciation shock in currency reduces the labor share significantly, with the peak decline within four quarters; the response of the labor share is roughly 1.5 times larger in the LNRIR sub-sample. A 250 bps policy rate cut works in the same direction with a more modest magnitude. Real wages recover within six to eight quarters while the labor share remains depressed. Moreover, the historical decomposition indicates that most of the variation in the labor share is driven by output and price shocks rather than by monetary shocks. The aggregate-level mechanism rooted in nominal wage rigidity therefore captures only a limited transmission of monetary policy to the functional distribution of income. The persistent compression of the labor share instead points to a production-side channel operating through material costs examined in the author's PhD dissertation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究土耳其货币政策对功能性收入分配的传导机制，发现货币贬值降低劳动份额，低利率政策加剧这一效应，但货币冲击对劳动份额变化的解释力有限，持续的劳动份额压缩更多源于生产成本渠道。
AI.research_question: 货币政策如何通过汇率-通胀-名义工资粘性机制传导至功能性收入分配（劳动份额）？
AI.motivation: 土耳其2017-2022年出现低甚至负实际利率（LNRIR）非常规货币政策，政策利率在通胀上升时反而下降，为研究货币政策对收入分配的影响提供了独特情境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于名义工资粘性的宏观传导机制：低政策利率→汇率贬值→通胀上升→名义工资调整滞后→劳动份额压缩。
AI.method: 六变量结构向量自回归（SVAR），使用递归识别，基于土耳其1998Q1-2023Q3季度数据，并针对LNRIR子样本进行子样本分析。
AI.findings: （1）10%货币贬值冲击显著降低劳动份额，峰值在四个季度内出现；（2）LNRIR子样本中劳动份额响应幅度约为全样本的1.5倍；（3）250个基点的政策利率下调同样压缩劳动份额但幅度较小；（4）实际工资在6-8个季度恢复，但劳动份额持续低迷；（5）历史分解显示劳动份额变动主要由产出和价格冲击驱动，货币冲击贡献有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在非常规货币政策环境下，基于名义工资粘性的宏观传导机制对收入分配的解释力有限，指出需关注生产成本渠道（如材料成本）的微观传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场经济体央行提供政策启示：低利率政策对劳动份额的压缩效应在非常规时期更强，且传统工资粘性渠道对收入分配的影响弱于产出和价格冲击。

title: Job Security and Effort in Major League Baseball
affiliations: and University of Michigan

detail.title: Job Security and Effort in Major League Baseball

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no relevant financial or non-financial interests to disclose.

detail.abstract: This study uses Major League Baseball (MLB) player data to test for impacts of job security on worker effort. Using variation in job security across the duration of multi-year player contracts, prior studies have found mixed evidence, with recent studies finding an inverse relationship between job security and worker production. Prior studies use measures of worker production as proxies for effort, though production depends on effort, ability, and luck. With the advent of improved tracking technology with Statcast in baseball, more direct measures of player effort are now available. In this study we test for how job security impacts measures of production, effort, and luck by estimating player fixed effects regressions on a panel of MLB hitters from 2016 to 2024. In line with recent literature, we find that increased job security leads to diminished production. In advancing the literature, we also find evidence that increased job security leads to diminished effort. We do not find any evidence of job security influencing luck. These findings have implications for how teams may use player tracking to incentivize player effort in the face of high job security. The finding also has implications for employment settings outside of sport.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用美国职业棒球大联盟(MLB)2016-2024年的数据，通过Statcast追踪技术区分了产出、努力和运气，发现工作安全感增加会降低球员努力水平和产出，但对运气无显著影响。
AI.research_question: 工作安全感如何影响工人的努力程度？具体而言，在职业体育情境下，工作安全感的提高是否会降低球员的产出、努力和运气？
AI.motivation: 以往研究对工作安全感与工人产出之间的关系结论不一，且大多使用产出作为努力的代理变量，未能将努力、能力和运气区分开来。随着Statcast等追踪技术的出现，研究者可以更直接地测量工人的努力水平，从而更准确地检验工作安全感对努力的真实影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作安全感与工人努力之间的关系（道德风险/偷懒理论）；产出=努力+能力+运气的分解框架。
AI.method: 采用球员固定效应回归模型，利用MLB 2016-2024年球员面板数据，通过Statcast追踪技术区分产出、努力和运气指标，分析多赛季合同期间工作安全感变化的影响。
AI.findings: （1）工作安全感提高会导致产出下降（与近期文献一致）；（2）工作安全感提高显著导致球员努力水平下降；（3）工作安全感对运气无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次使用更直接的努力测量指标（而非产出代理变量）检验工作安全感对努力的影响，证实了工作安全感与努力之间的负向关系，为道德风险理论提供了更精确的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 对体育团队如何利用球员追踪技术在高工作安全感环境下激励球员努力具有管理启示；对体育领域以外的雇佣情境中如何设计激励合同以应对工作安全感带来的偷懒问题也有借鉴意义。

title: Stress Analyzer: A Machine Learning Approach to Predict Student Stress Levels for Early Intervention

detail.title: Stress Analyzer: A Machine Learning Approach to Predict Student Stress Levels for Early Intervention

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses a publicly available dataset; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors

detail.abstract: The "Stress Analyzer" project is targeted to reflect a high level of stress among university students, which may have negative consequences for their well-being and performance, often turning into further problems connected with anxiety or depression. Currently, no means exist to predict the level of individual stress by personal variables, including academic load, sleep, and social support. This research project tackles developing a machine learning-based predictor of stress levels that would allow universities to detect students at possible risk because of high-stress levels and thus provide timely intervention. The following models were trained: Random Forest, Decision Tree, and Linear Regression. All models were trained to predict the level of Freddy-low, medium, and high-alpha datasets of over 1,000 student responses. Among the highly influential causes of stress among students are those pertaining to academic workload versus quality sleep and economic issues. The University will benefit from the stress analyzer through specific insights into the stressors of students, and appropriate early interventions that enhance student wellbeing for a healthier academic environment.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种基于机器学习的压力水平预测工具（Stress Analyzer），利用随机森林、决策树和线性回归模型，通过学业负担、睡眠质量、社会支持等个人变量预测大学生的压力水平，帮助大学识别高风险学生并及时干预。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习模型通过个人变量（学业负担、睡眠、社会支持等）预测大学生的压力水平？
AI.motivation: 大学生中高压力水平普遍存在，且可能导致焦虑、抑郁等负面后果，但目前缺乏能够通过个人变量预测个体压力水平的有效工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 压力理论；机器学习预测模型（随机森林、决策树、线性回归）
AI.method: 收集超过1000份学生问卷数据，训练随机森林、决策树和线性回归三种模型，将压力水平分为低、中、高三个等级进行预测。
AI.findings: 学业负担、睡眠质量和经济问题是影响学生压力的重要因素；机器学习模型能有效预测学生压力水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 将机器学习方法应用于压力预测领域，验证了个人变量对压力水平的可预测性，为压力研究的量化分析提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学提供了识别高风险学生的工具，有助于早期干预和针对性支持，改善学生福祉和学术环境。

title: The Conditional Productivity Effect of Generative AI: A Systematic Review and Descriptive Meta-analytic Synthesis of Knowledge-worker Studies (2022-2026)
affiliations: Virginia Commonwealth University

detail.title: The Conditional Productivity Effect of Generative AI: A Systematic Review and Descriptive Meta-analytic Synthesis of Knowledge-worker Studies (2022-2026)
detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is widely discussed as a productivity tool for knowledge work, yet empirical findings vary across occupations, tasks, and study designs. This systematic review with descriptive meta-analytic synthesis examined empirical research released from January 2022 through June 18, 2026, on GenAI and knowledge-worker productivity. Eligible studies involved professional or professional-like tasks, GenAI systems, and measurable productivity outcomes such as completion time, throughput, completed tasks, issues resolved per hour, work volume, or time saved. Eleven studies met the available-source inclusion criteria across professional writing, customer support, software development, consulting, public-sector work, enterprise productivity-suite use, open-source software, and innovation tasks. The synthesis indicates that GenAI is most consistently associated with productivity gains in structured, reviewable tasks, while mixed or negative effects appear when work requires specialized context, data interpretation, mature codebase knowledge, or substantial review. The review advances a task-contingent productivity model and includes an AI Research Evaluation Framework to help readers assess the strength and applicability of productivity claims.

AI.tldr: 这篇系统综述整合了2022年1月至2026年6月间11项实证研究，发现生成式AI对知识工作者生产力的提升效果高度依赖于任务特征：在结构化、可复核的任务中效果一致积极，而在需要专业背景、数据解读或复杂代码库知识的任务中效果混合甚至为负。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）对知识工作者生产力的影响如何？这种影响在不同职业、任务和研究设计间是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 尽管GenAI被广泛视为知识工作的生产力工具，但现有实证研究结果差异较大，缺乏系统性的整合与分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 任务权变生产力模型（Task-Contingent Productivity Model）；AI研究评估框架
AI.method: 系统综述结合描述性元分析综合法；检索2022年1月至2026年6月18日间的实证研究；筛选标准包括专业或类似专业任务、GenAI系统、可测量的生产力指标
AI.findings: GenAI在结构化、可复核的任务中与生产力提升最为一致；而在需要专业知识、数据解读、成熟代码库知识或大量复核工作的任务中，效果混合甚至为负。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"任务权变生产力模型"，解释了为何不同任务场景下GenAI的效果存在差异；提供了AI研究评估框架以帮助评估生产力主张的强度与适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织部署GenAI提供指导：应优先应用于结构化、可复核的任务场景；为研究者和实践者提供评估生产力研究质量的标准化框架。

title: UPI Credit Risk Intelligence Index (UCRII): An Explainable Artificial Intelligence Framework for Real-Time Retail Lending Risk Assessment in India’s Digital Payment Ecosystem

detail.title: UPI Credit Risk Intelligence Index (UCRII): An Explainable Artificial Intelligence Framework for Real-Time Retail Lending Risk Assessment in India’s Digital Payment Ecosystem

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: his study is based on conceptual, analytical, and secondary data sources. No human participants, personal data, or animal subjects were involved. Therefore, formal ethical approval was not required for this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
With the quick growth of the Unified Payments Interface (UPI) and unprecedented amounts of transaction information that comes with the altered digital economy of India, traditional ways to assess credit, such as historical credit scores, earnings reports, and security value-as well as an individual’s banking relations-do not sufficiently capture the ability to handle credit from a first-time borrower or an digitally active person who has no history with loans. The framework suggested here includes what is known as the UPI Credit Risk Intelligence Index (UCRII)-a mechanism based on an Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) model that provides assessments of retail borrower repayment capacity based on their behaviour as digital payment transaction activity. Five dimensions of UPI activity are analysed-transaction volume, regular payments, stable finances, variety of traders, and the stability of resources.

Using a machine learning approach, a clear-cut prediction score is obtained in order to better inform lenders, regulators, and other interested parties on each borrower’s financial situation.

An information balance can also help, as does increasing access to loans. It also takes into account what goes wrong with previous credit scoring models. The study uses a simulated set of data to indicate the success of the model and how its behaviour of customers and transaction-related data can be analysed to understand default patterns. Analysis suggests that such indicators hold a substantial prediction capacity.

This research is helpful for banks, nonbanking financial companies (NBFCs), fintech firms, or policymakers involved with loans as it reveals effective methods of increasing access to credit in the digital economy of India.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于UPI（统一支付接口）交易行为的信用风险评估框架（UCRII），利用可解释人工智能（XAI）模型，通过分析数字支付交易数据来评估零售借款人的还款能力，旨在解决传统信用评分无法覆盖首次借款人或无贷款历史的数字活跃用户的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何利用UPI数字支付交易数据，通过可解释人工智能模型构建一个能够有效评估零售借款人还款能力的信用风险指标？
AI.motivation: 随着印度UPI的快速发展，大量数字交易信息产生，但传统信用评估方法（如历史信用分数、收入报告、抵押品价值等）无法充分评估首次借款人或无贷款历史的数字活跃用户的信用能力，因此需要一种基于数字支付行为的新型信用评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: UPI信用风险智能指数（UCRII）；可解释人工智能（XAI）；基于UPI交易行为的五维度分析（交易量、定期支付、财务稳定性、商户多样性、资源稳定性）。
AI.method: 基于机器学习的可解释人工智能模型，对UPI交易数据的五个维度进行分析，生成预测评分；使用模拟数据集验证模型效果。
AI.findings: 基于UPI交易行为的指标具有显著的预测能力，能够有效分析客户行为和交易数据以理解违约模式，为贷款机构、监管机构等提供借款人财务状况的清晰预测评分。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了UCRII这一新型信用风险评估框架，将数字支付行为数据与传统信用评估相结合，扩展了信用风险管理的理论边界，并引入XAI增强模型的可解释性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行、非银行金融公司（NBFCs）、金融科技公司和政策制定者提供了有效的信贷准入方法，有助于在印度数字经济中扩大信贷覆盖范围，特别惠及缺乏传统信用记录的数字活跃用户。

title: The Eurasian Iron Cage, the Table of Ranks, and "Kormlenie": A Historical Institutionalist Explanation of the Russian Autocratic Matrix and Its Endogenous Entropy
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Eurasian Iron Cage, the Table of Ranks, and "Kormlenie": A Historical Institutionalist Explanation of the Russian Autocratic Matrix and Its Endogenous Entropy
detail.abstract: This study constructs a historical institutionalist and principal-agent framework—the "Autocratic Matrix and Endogenous Entropy Model"—to explain the structural evolution, path dependency, and ultimate collapse of the Russian autocratic system (samoderzhavie) from the Muscovite consolidation to the late Romanov Dynasty. This paper argues that the rise of Russian autocracy and state serfdom was not an inevitable cultural trajectory, but an endogenous "wartime mobilization architecture" forced by the structural combination of a rigid Eurasian Iron Cage (borderless plains with severe multi-vector geopolitical exposure) and intense zero-sum survival pressures. Moving beyond environmental determinism, we trace how this system permanently institutionalized its wartime extraction mechanisms internally (wartime internalization), consolidating a totalitarian state slavery structure that dissolved all private law boundaries (Jus Privatum). Utilizing Principal-Agent Theory, this study conceptualizes the "Dictator's Dilemma" wherein the Tsar (principal) implemented extreme economic and dignitary dual deprivation over the noble bureaucracy (agent) through the Table of Ranks and institutionalized sub-living wages. This optimization strategy inevitably drove the administrative apparatus to alienate, adopting systemic corruption (Kormlenie / informal asset-skimming) and strategic administrative slackness as its rational mechanisms of hidden political retaliation. Supported by empirical 19th-century fiscal audit data and symmetric historical analysis of the Romanov Dynasty’s internal decay during the Crimean War, this study demonstrates that endogenous entropy fatally hollowed out state capacity, demonstrating that a constitutional framework protecting private property rights remains the most sustainable path to break the autocratic deadlock.

AI.tldr: 本文构建"独裁矩阵与内生熵模型"，从历史制度主义和委托-代理视角解释俄罗斯专制体制从莫斯科公国到罗曼诺夫王朝的结构演化与最终崩溃，认为专制并非文化必然，而是地缘压力下的战时动员架构，其内部制度化剥削导致代理人腐败与行政懈怠，最终掏空国家能力。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯专制体制（samoderzhavie）为何以及如何从莫斯科公国时期的结构形成、路径依赖，最终走向罗曼诺夫王朝的崩溃？
AI.motivation: 超越环境决定论与文化必然论，从制度变迁与委托-代理的机制层面解释俄罗斯专制体制的内生性衰败逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史制度主义（路径依赖）、委托-代理理论（Principal-Agent Theory）、"独裁矩阵与内生熵模型"（Autocratic Matrix and Endogenous Entropy Model）、"独裁者困境"（Dictator's Dilemma）。
AI.method: 历史制度分析、委托-代理理论建模、19世纪财政审计数据实证分析、克里米亚战争的对称历史分析。
AI.findings: 专制体制是地缘压力下的"战时动员架构"；沙皇通过官阶表（Table of Ranks）和制度性低薪对贵族官僚实施极端剥夺，导致代理人采取系统性腐败（Kormlenie）和行政懈怠作为隐性政治报复；内生熵（endogenous entropy）最终掏空国家能力，导致体制崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 将委托-代理理论引入专制体制研究，提出"内生熵"概念解释威权体制的自我耗损机制，超越环境决定论与文化决定论。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示保护私有产权的宪政框架是打破独裁僵局的可持续路径，为理解威权体制的脆弱性提供分析工具。

title: Extending Premerger Notification to Labor Markets
affiliations: University of Chicago - Law School and University of Rochester

detail.title: Extending Premerger Notification to Labor Markets

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago Law School, Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper No. 26-8
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Chicago Law School, Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: US antitrust law requires mergers above a certain size to be reported to the federal antitrust agencies for review prior to consummation. For decades, this premerger notification process and subsequent merger review focused nearly exclusively on product markets. In the last few years, the agencies have also begun to challenge mergers on their effects on labor markets. But the agencies’ ability to detect potential labor market harms is hampered by an absence of labor market information at the premerger notification stage. This article proposes specific types of information that the agencies could collect about labor markets in order to put labor market competition on an equal footing with product market competition in merger review. We make proposals for both the initial premerger notification required for all mergers above the size threshold (the HSR Form) and the additional information requested by the agencies when a preliminary analysis reveals potential concerns about competition (the Second Request). The majority of our proposals have direct analogs in product market information that has been sought for decades, raising the probability that courts will uphold them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出修改美国并购申报制度，要求企业在合并审查中提交劳动力市场信息，以使劳动力市场竞争与产品市场竞争在反垄断审查中获得同等重视。
AI.research_question: 如何在并购审查中收集劳动力市场信息，使劳动力市场竞争与产品市场竞争处于同等地位？
AI.motivation: 美国反垄断机构近年才开始基于劳动力市场影响挑战并购案，但由于缺乏并购前申报阶段的劳动力市场信息，机构识别潜在劳动力市场损害的能力受限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反垄断法中关于合并审查的劳动力市场竞争理论；并购通知制度（HSR法案）的信息收集框架。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析：提出具体的制度修改建议，包括初始申报表（HSR表格）和补充信息要求（二次请求）中应新增的劳动力市场信息类型。
AI.findings: 提出了多项劳动力市场信息收集的具体建议，这些建议大多有产品市场信息的直接对应物，增加了法院支持的可能性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将劳动力市场竞争纳入并购反垄断审查的理论框架，填补了现有制度忽视劳动力市场的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断执法机构提供了可操作的信息收集方案，有助于识别和预防并购对劳动力市场的竞争损害。

title: The Citizens Standard: Governance and the Political Economy of the Parameters — Who Sets the Dials, the Dividend Ratchet, and the Constitutional Lock as a Commitment Technology
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Citizens Standard: Governance and the Political Economy of the Parameters — Who Sets the Dials, the Dividend Ratchet, and the Constitutional Lock as a Commitment Technology
detail.abstract: Every other paper in the series takes the constitutional parameters — k1, k2, kappa_d, kI — as given and asks what the issuance engine computes once they are set. This paper asks the prior question the engine paper explicitly defers (Neo-Solon 2026i, §7.4): who sets them, and what stops the setting from being captured. The argument has three moves. First, the parameters are not a single monetary instrument but a joint monetary–distributional instrument: kappa_d literally decides who gets what, so the dials are at once a price-level tool and a transfer schedule, which makes them a richer object of political contest than a central bank's single policy rate. Second, a universal, salient dividend creates its own constituency, and once it is paid, tightening imposes a concentrated, visible loss — a political inflation ratchet that operates even when the engine is mechanically neutral. Third, the framework's answer, a constitutional lock on the parameters, is a commitment technology, and the binding question is its credibility, not its design on paper. Three empirical literatures discipline the argument: the central-bank-independence record (commitment devices can work, but are themselves reversible); the Alaska Permanent Fund Dividend (a universal dividend that became a political "third rail" yet could not be constitutionally locked); and the IMF record on fiscal rules (the closest analog to a parameter lock, complied with only about half the time, yet acting as an attractor that pulls policy toward the rule even in breach). The capture incentive and the dividend ratchet are modelled as directional political-economy claims, not theorems, and a layered commitment design is proposed whose realistic claim is bounded: the lock raises the cost and visibility of capture, it does not abolish it. Observability of breach — not a promise that the lock binds — is the framework's falsifiable commitment.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了Neo-Solon货币发行引擎中宪法参数（k1, k2, kappa_d, kI）由谁设定、如何防止被政治俘获的问题。核心论点是：这些参数既是货币政策工具又是分配工具，普遍分红会产生政治通胀棘轮效应，宪法锁定作为承诺技术的可信度取决于违约的可观察性而非不可违反性。
AI.research_question: 谁设定货币发行引擎的宪法参数，以及什么机制能阻止这些参数设定被政治俘获？
AI.motivation: 同一系列的其他论文均将宪法参数视为给定值，探讨参数设定后的发行引擎计算结果。本文提出了这些参数"由谁设定、如何防止俘获"这一被明确搁置的先决问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学框架，结合承诺技术理论；政治通胀棘轮效应模型；宪法锁定作为承诺机制的可信度分析。
AI.method: 理论论证（三步推理）+ 比较制度分析 + 三个经验文献的约束性检验：央行独立性记录、阿拉斯加永久基金分红经验、IMF财政规则执行记录。
AI.findings: 宪法参数是联合货币-分配工具（kappa_d直接决定谁获得什么）；普遍分红会创造政治选区，紧缩政策造成集中可见的损失，形成政治通胀棘轮；宪法锁定的可信度问题在于其违约的可观察性而非不可违反性；三个经验案例表明承诺机制可以发挥作用但本身可逆，锁定仅能提高俘获成本与可见性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将货币政策参数重新概念化为"联合货币-分配工具"；提出"政治通胀棘轮"机制；将承诺技术的分析从不可违反性转向违约的可观察性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出分层承诺设计方案；指出宪法锁定的现实边界——提高俘获成本与可见性而非消灭俘获；为货币制度设计的政治可行性提供约束条件。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Risk-sensitive Investment Management: a Free Energy-Entropy Duality Approach
affiliations: and University of Padova, Department of Mathematics

detail.title: Reinforcement Learning for Risk-sensitive Investment Management: a Free Energy-Entropy Duality Approach
detail.abstract: This paper develops a reinforcement-learning approach to continuous-time risk-sensitive benchmarked asset allocation in a partly model-based setting. The benchmarked problem does not directly fit the standard Markovian stochastic-control template: the state is uncontrolled, whereas the terminal reward contains a controlled Itô integral. We use free energy-entropy duality to reformulate the problem as a linear-quadratic-Gaussian stochastic differential game under an equivalent probability measure, yielding explicit finite-and infinite-horizon saddle-point solutions. This structure guides a continuous-time q-learning actor-critic method: the quadratic value function motivates the critic, while the affine saddle-point controls motivate deterministic actors for the portfolio allocation and adversarial control. The learned allocation admits an economic interpretation through fractional Kelly decompositions. A proof-of-concept implementation calibrated to U.S. equity data shows that the actors learn the optimal policy with high accuracy and reveals a favorable asymmetry: the portfolio actor receives a cleaner learning signal than the auxiliary adversarial actor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的连续时间风险敏感基准化资产配置方法，利用自由能-熵对偶将问题转化为线性二次高斯随机微分博弈，并通过Q学习演员-评论家方法求解。在美国股票数据上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何在部分基于模型的环境中，使用强化学习解决连续时间风险敏感基准化资产配置问题？
AI.motivation: 基准化资产配置问题不直接符合标准的马尔可夫随机控制模板（状态不可控，终端奖励包含受控伊藤积分），需要新的方法框架进行求解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自由能-熵对偶、线性二次高斯随机微分博弈、风险敏感控制、Q学习演员-评论家方法、分数凯利分解。
AI.method: 利用自由能-熵对偶将问题重述为等价概率测度下的线性二次高斯随机微分博弈，得到显式有限和无限时域鞍点解；基于此设计连续时间Q学习演员-评论家方法，其中二次值函数驱动评论家，仿射鞍点控制驱动投资组合配置和对抗性控制的确定性演员。
AI.findings: 校准至美国股票数据的概念验证实现表明，演员能以高精度学习最优策略，并揭示了一个有利的不对称性：投资组合演员获得的训练信号比辅助对抗性演员更清晰。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自由能-熵对偶应用于风险敏感基准化问题，建立了与线性二次高斯随机微分博弈的等价关系，提供了显式鞍点解的理论基础；连续时间Q学习框架为动态资产配置提供了新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 所学习的资产配置可通过分数凯利分解进行经济解释，为实际投资组合管理提供了可解释的强化学习解决方案。

reference: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1197; https://doi.org/10.59576/sr.1197
title: The International RBC Model Finally Works!
affiliations: University of Melbourne,  and

detail.title: The International RBC Model Finally Works!

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1197
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We show that incorporating uninsurable countercyclical income risk into a standard international RBC model can qualitatively and quantitatively account for the quantity puzzles in open-economy macro, namely (i) the Backus-Smith puzzle, (ii) the Backus-Kehoe-Kydland puzzle, and (iii) the weak correlation between the trade balance and the exchange rate. We also show that our model can simultaneously account for the Fama puzzle and the evidence that high interest rate countries have stronger currencieswhich representative-agents models that rely only on financial or demand shocks cannot jointly account for. Crucially, our model resolves all these puzzles while relying solely on productivity shocks and thus generates the observed domestic and crosscountry macroeconomic comovement.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将不可保险的反周期收入风险引入标准国际RBC模型，成功解释了开放经济宏观中的多个数量之谜，包括Backus-Smith之谜、Backus-Kehoe-Kydland之谜、贸易余额与汇率弱相关之谜、Fama之谜以及高利率国家货币更强之谜，且仅依赖生产率冲击就能产生观察到的国内和跨国宏观经济联动。
AI.research_question: 如何通过引入不可保险的反周期收入风险来解释开放经济宏观中的多个"数量之谜"？
AI.motivation: 标准国际RBC模型在解释开放经济宏观中的一些关键谜题（如Backus-Smith之谜、Fama之谜等）方面存在不足，现有依赖金融或需求冲击的代表性代理人模型无法同时解释这些谜题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准国际实际经济周期（RBC）模型 + 不可保险的反周期收入风险（uninsurable countercyclical income risk）
AI.method: 理论建模与数值模拟，将不可保险的反周期收入风险嵌入标准的国际RBC模型框架中。
AI.findings: 该模型能够定性和定量地解释（i）Backus-Smith之谜、（ii）Backus-Kehoe-Kydland之谜、（iii）贸易余额与汇率弱相关之谜，以及（iv）Fama之谜和高利率国家货币更强的证据。所有这些谜题的解决仅依赖于生产率冲击，同时还能产生与观测一致的国内和跨国宏观经济联动。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次证明仅通过引入不可保险的反周期收入风险这一单一机制，就能同时解释开放经济宏观中的多个经典谜题，且无需依赖金融或需求冲击，为国际宏观经济学提供了更简洁的理论解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解汇率、贸易余额、利率与宏观经济波动之间的关系提供了新的理论视角，有助于政策制定者更好地理解开放经济中的经济联动机制。

title: The Citizens Standard: Comparison with Alternative Monetary and Distributional Systems — A Common-Axes Framework Placing the Architecture Among Universal Basic Income, Social Security, Sovereign Wealth Funds, and Georgism
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Citizens Standard: Comparison with Alternative Monetary and Distributional Systems — A Common-Axes Framework Placing the Architecture Among Universal Basic Income, Social Security, Sovereign Wealth Funds, and Georgism
detail.abstract: Twelve papers in this series answer the question "can it work." This one answers the question outside economists actually ask first: why this rather than the alternative they already favour. The paper sets a common set of evaluation axes — funding source and its sustainability, what the system builds (an income flow or a wealth stock), coverage, whether it carries a built-in price-stability mechanism, capture-resistance, and demonstrated maturity — and places the Citizens Standard (CS) on them alongside its genuine distributional cousins: universal basic income, social security, the sovereign-wealth-fund / Alaska model, and Georgist land-value taxation. The stance is deliberately even-handed: the paper concedes, axis by axis, where a rival dominates. Universal basic income is simpler and faster to implement; social security and the sovereign-wealth-fund model are proven at national scale; Georgism's land-value-tax base is more allocatively efficient than any other funding source considered. CS's claim is not that it wins on every axis but that it occupies a distinctive cell none of the others do: among universal systems it is the only one that is at once self-financing (funded by growth-tied money issuance rather than taxation), wealth-building (a locked, compounding stock rather than only a transfer), and equipped with an explicit inflation-control mechanism. The paper also clears away three frequent but mistaken comparisons: full-reserve banking is not a rival but a component CS adopts; central-bank digital currency is a payment technology orthogonal to the distributional question; and Modern Monetary Theory is a macro-accounting framework whose inflation-control problem CS answers with a rule rather than discretion. The comparative advantage is stated conditionally, not absolutely: it rests on sustained growth and on a price-stability mechanism that holds under stress — both of which the crisis paper (Neo-Solon 2026l) shows to be real vulnerabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多轴对比评估框架，系统比较了公民标准（CS）与全民基本收入、社会保障、主权财富基金/阿拉斯加模式、乔治主义土地价值税等分配方案，指出CS的独特定位在于它是唯一同时具备自融资性（通过增长挂钩的货币发行而非税收）、财富积累性（锁定复利存量而非仅转移支付）和内置通胀控制机制的统一分配体系，并澄清了与全额准备金银行、央行数字货币、现代货币理论的常见混淆。
AI.research_question: 在众多已存在的分配方案中，为什么应该选择公民标准（CS）而非其他替代方案？CS的独特比较优势是什么？
AI.motivation: 经济学家在实际研究中首先问的问题不是"某个方案能否运作"，而是"为什么选这个而非他们已偏好的替代方案"。现有文献缺乏一个系统的、多轴的比较框架来评估不同分配方案，导致政策讨论常陷入碎片化比较或错误类比。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多轴评估框架（资金来源及可持续性、系统构建的是收入流还是财富存量、覆盖范围、内置价格稳定机制、抗俘获性、成熟度）；公民标准作为一种自融资、财富积累、具有通胀控制机制的统一分配制度。
AI.method: 比较制度分析：设定统一的评估轴，将公民标准与其四个真正具有分配属性的竞争对手（全民基本收入、社会保障、主权财富基金/阿拉斯加模式、乔治主义土地价值税）进行逐轴比较，承认各方案的优势与劣势。
AI.findings: 全民基本收入更简单、实施更快；社会保障和主权财富基金模式已在国家规模上得到验证；乔治主义的土地价值税基在配置效率上优于任何其他资金来源。CS的独特定位在于：在统一分配体系中，它是唯一同时具备自融资性、财富积累性和通胀控制机制的制度。CS的比较优势是有条件的，依赖于持续增长和在压力下仍能保持的价格稳定机制——而这两点正是危机论文揭示的脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个系统的、多轴对比框架来评估不同分配方案；澄清了CS与全额准备金银行、央行数字货币、现代货币理论之间的关系（非竞争对手而是组件、正交技术、被CS回答的框架）；构建了CS的独特理论定位——自融资、财富积累、通胀控制三合一的统一分配体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了在不同分配方案之间进行选择的系统性比较工具；明确了CS的适用条件和风险（依赖持续增长和价格稳定机制）；纠正了常见的错误类比和混淆，有助于更精准的政策讨论。

AI.research_question: 本文未明确提出研究问题，主要是对BILETA协会及其年度会议的介绍性说明。
AI.motivation: 向读者介绍BILETA协会的成立背景、宗旨以及即将举办的年度会议信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无明确的理论框架。
AI.method: 描述性/介绍性方法。
AI.findings: BILETA成立于1986年4月，旨在促进英国和爱尔兰法律教育中的技术应用，且具有国际影响力；2013年的年会由利物浦大学于4月10日至12日主办。
AI.theory_contributions: 无理论贡献。

title: How Might Fiscal Policy Respond to the Rise of Artificial Intelligence?
affiliations: Harvard University, Harvard Kennedy School and Brookings Institution

detail.title: How Might Fiscal Policy Respond to the Rise of Artificial Intelligence?
detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence will probably generate major changes in the US economy, although the nature, timing, and magnitude of those changes are highly uncertain. We analyze a set of long-term scenarios involving different combinations of faster productivity growth, greater income inequality, job displacement, and a higher capital share of income. For each scenario, we assess the implications for federal debt and potential policy responses related to faster economic growth, the distribution of income, support for workers who are laid off, and taxation and ownership of capital. Given the uncertainty surrounding AI’s economic effects, policies that are robust to different scenarios would be especially valuable.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了人工智能可能对美国经济产生的长期影响，构建了四种不同情景（生产率增长、收入不平等、岗位替代、资本份额上升），并评估了每种情景对联邦债务的影响以及可能的政策应对措施，强调需要制定具鲁棒性的政策。
AI.research_question: 人工智能将如何影响美国经济的长期发展？不同情景下联邦债务和政策应对方案是什么？
AI.motivation: 人工智能的经济效应具有高度不确定性，但可能对美国经济产生重大变革，有必要提前分析不同情景下的财政和政策影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生产率增长、收入不平等、岗位替代和资本收入份额变化四种组合情景的经济影响分析框架。
AI.method: 构建长期情景分析，对不同组合情景进行模拟，评估联邦债务和政策应对方案。
AI.findings: 不同情景下联邦债务和政策需求差异显著，需要制定能够应对多种不确定情景的鲁棒性政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解AI对宏观经济和财政政策的系统性影响提供了多维情景分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了针对AI驱动经济变革的备选政策方案，强调鲁棒性政策设计的重要性。

title: Do Monetary Policy Rates Reach Borrowers? Evidence from Household and Firm Loans in 96 Countries
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - Wharton School of Business - Business Economics and Public Policy Department and University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School

detail.title: Do Monetary Policy Rates Reach Borrowers? Evidence from Household and Firm Loans in 96 Countries
detail.abstract:
We harmonize survey data on interest rates paid by approximately 15,000 small and medium enterprises across 125 firm surveys and 285,000 households across 83 household surveys spanning developing and rich countries to study the relationship between monetary policy rates and borrowing costs faced by SMEs and households. Using within-country variation in policy rates over time, we find that pass-through to firm and household borrowing rates is stronger in richer countries than in poorer ones.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过整合125项企业调查（约1.5万家中小企业）和83项家庭调查（约28.5万户）的数据，研究货币政策利率向中小企业与家庭借贷成本的传导效应，发现富裕国家的传导强度显著高于贫穷国家。
AI.research_question: 货币政策利率向中小企业和家庭借贷成本的传导效应是否存在国别差异？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多聚焦于发达经济体，对发展中国家中小企业与家庭的借贷成本传导机制了解不足，且缺乏大规模的跨国可比数据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利率传导机制理论；货币政策传导的信贷渠道
AI.method: 整合125项企业调查（约1.5万家中小企业）和83项家庭调查（约28.5万户）数据，覆盖发达与发展中国家，利用各国政策利率的随时间变动进行面板数据分析。
AI.findings: 货币政策利率向企业和家庭借贷利率的传导效应在富裕国家显著强于贫穷国家。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了货币政策传导效率因国家发展水平不同而存在系统性差异，丰富了利率传导机制领域的跨国比较研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家制定货币政策及改善信贷传导渠道、降低中小企业和家庭融资成本提供实证依据。

title: Choice Between Public and Private Healthcare Systems: Evidence from Veterans
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin, University of California, Berkeley and

detail.title: Choice Between Public and Private Healthcare Systems: Evidence from Veterans
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the choice between public and private healthcare systems among elderly veterans, who are dually eligible to obtain care through the publicly operated Veterans Health Administration (VA) and through private providers financed by Medicare. We analyze health system choice among veterans who move across areas with differing rates of VA utilization to quantify the relative importance of individual-specific factors (e.g., preferences, income, health) and place-specific factors (e.g., local access, quality, and convenience). Our estimates indicate that 50–60% of geographic variation in VA use is attributable to demand-side individual factors, with the remainder explained by place-based factors. We also document important heterogeneity across types of care, with place-based factors playing a larger role for inpatient and emergency care than for outpatient and primary care. Additional analysis suggests that the supply-side features emphasized in recent legislation—distance to VA facilities and wait times—explain only a small share of estimated place effects. These findings highlight the importance of individual factors in health system choice and have implications for policies aimed at reducing geographic disparities in VA utilization.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了双重资格（VA+Medicare）的老年退伍军人在公立VA系统与私立医疗系统之间的选择，发现50-60%的地理差异源于个体因素，其余归因于地方因素；地方因素对住院和急诊影响更大，但距离和等待时间仅解释一小部分地方效应。
AI.research_question: 在双重资格的老年退伍军人中，公立VA系统与私立Medicare系统的选择，其地理差异在多大程度上归因于个体因素（偏好、收入、健康等）vs. 地方因素（可及性、质量、便利性等）？
AI.motivation: 已有研究关注VA利用的地理差异，但未明确分离个体因素与地方因素的相对重要性。了解这一分解对于政策制定（如减少VA利用的地理差异、优化资源配置）至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗服务选择理论；需求侧（个体偏好、健康需求、收入约束）与供给侧（地方可及性、质量、等待时间）的二元分析框架。
AI.method: 利用老年退伍军人跨地区迁移的自然实验，比较迁移前后VA利用的变化，通过固定效应模型分解个体因素与地方因素的贡献度。
AI.findings: （1）50-60%的VA利用地理差异由个体因素解释，其余由地方因素解释；（2）地方因素对住院和急诊服务的作用大于对门诊和初级保健；（3）距离和等待时间等供给侧特征仅解释了地方效应的一小部分。
AI.theory_contributions: 量化了医疗服务选择中个体因素与地方因素的相对重要性，为医疗系统选择的分解研究提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者：减少VA利用地理差异应更多关注个体因素（如患者偏好、信息不对称），而非仅仅改善供给侧的可及性（距离、等待时间）。

title: The Citizens Standard: Crisis Behaviour and Failure Modes Under Extreme Conditions — How the Architecture Behaves Across Depression, Stagflation, Crash, Pandemic, and Secular Stagnation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Citizens Standard: Crisis Behaviour and Failure Modes Under Extreme Conditions — How the Architecture Behaves Across Depression, Stagflation, Crash, Pandemic, and Secular Stagnation
detail.abstract: A monetary architecture earns credibility less by performing well in normal times than by behaving understandably when things go wrong. This paper runs the Citizens Standard (CS) issuance engine — the same audited engine that produces the series' historical counterfactual — through the hardest conditions in the modern record and through adversarial scenarios: the Great Depression, 1970s stagflation, the 2008 crash, the COVID shock, a decade-long growth stall, and a banking panic. The goal is not to show the system is invulnerable; it is to map precisely how it behaves at the edges, and to state where it fails. Four findings are quantified on the real engine. First, the dividend is procyclical by construction: because issuance equals max(0, real growth) × M2, the dividend and floor-accumulation fall to zero in every contraction year — half the years of the Depression, 40% of the stagflation decade, and the COVID-2020 year — so the income stream is weakest exactly when households are most stressed, partially but not fully offset by the counter-cyclical per-citizen endowment. Second, the locked floor carries sequence-of-returns risk: a crash in the two years before retirement cuts a representative cohort's realized floor by roughly half ($209,942 → $102,114), a tail the smoothed central path conceals. Third, under a transient growth stall the floor stock survives nearly intact (−4% over a lost decade, because compounding dominates) while the dividend flow goes to zero throughout — a stock-flow asymmetry that becomes a genuine vulnerability only under permanent secular stagnation, where the growth-dividend never materialises. Fourth, the rule cuts the other way in a pandemic: CS could not have executed the discretionary 2020–22 money surge, issuing roughly one-fifth as much (8.7% vs 40.5% of M2), structurally avoiding the overshoot the validation paper links to the 9% inflation peak — at the cost of providing no emergency fiscal capacity. Under full reserve the payment system cannot experience a deposit run, removing bank-panic risk from the transaction circuit while leaving market risk in the asset circuit that holds the floors. The honest synthesis: the payment system, the price discipline, and the floor stock are robust; the dividend flow, the floor for trough-retiring cohorts, and the response to secular stagnation are where the architecture strains or fails.

AI.tldr: 本文通过模拟最严酷的历史和对抗性场景，检验了"公民标准"（CS）货币发行引擎的极端表现，量化了其分红顺周期性、锁仓底部的序列回报风险、增长停滞下的存量-流量不对称、以及疫情下无法提供紧急财政能力等四类脆弱性。结论是：支付系统、价格纪律和底部存量是稳健的，但分红流、退休低谷群体的底部安全垫以及应对长期停滞的能力是系统的薄弱环节。
AI.research_question: 在极端经济压力情景下，基于规则的"公民标准"（CS）货币发行架构会如何表现？它在哪些条件下会失效？
AI.motivation: 一种货币架构的可信度不是靠正常时期的表现赢得的，而是靠它在出问题时如何被理解。因此需要将该架构置于历史上最严酷的条件和对抗性场景中进行压力测试，以精确刻画其边缘行为并明确其失效边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于规则的货币发行制度（CS引擎）；顺周期与逆周期机制设计；序列回报风险理论；存量-流量不对称；全额准备金制度下的银行挤兑风险消除。
AI.method: 使用经审计的CS发行引擎进行历史反事实模拟，覆盖大萧条、1970年代滞胀、2008年金融危机、COVID冲击、十年增长停滞和银行恐慌六类极端情景，量化四个关键发现。
AI.findings: （1）分红具有结构性顺周期性：发行量=max(0,实际增长率)×M2，导致收缩期分红和底部积累归零；（2）锁仓底部存在序列回报风险：退休前两年发生崩盘会使代表群体的实际底部削减约一半；（3）暂时性增长停滞下底部存量几乎完好（-4%），但分红流归零，存量-流量不对称仅在长期停滞下成为真正脆弱性；（4）疫情下CS仅发行了M2的8.7%（对比实际40.5%），结构性地避免了通胀超调，但代价是未提供紧急财政能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地在极端压力场景下对CS货币发行引擎进行定量压力测试，精确刻画了顺周期分红机制、序列回报风险、存量-流量不对称和危机应对能力不足等四类理论边界条件，为基于规则的货币架构设计提供了失效边界的理论图谱。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了CS架构在极端条件下的行为地图：支付系统、价格纪律和底部存量是可靠的；但分红流、退休低谷群体的安全垫和应对长期停滞的能力需要额外设计补充机制，例如跨周期平滑机制或紧急财政通道。

title: Risk Design: AI and Prediction Beyond Screening in Insurance Markets
affiliations: Harvard University

detail.title: Risk Design: AI and Prediction Beyond Screening in Insurance Markets
detail.abstract:
I study insurance markets in which scalable prediction, like AI, designs residual risk rather than merely classifies fixed risk. A complete-contracting benchmark shows that if prevention is observable, contractible, competitively supplied, and fully priced, it does not matter whether consumers, insurers, or vendors supply it. Adverse selection breaks such irrelevance. When high-risk consumers are more "AI-treatable," efficient prevention makes low-risk contracts attractive to them. A contract intended for low-risk consumers faces a risk-design trilemma: separate, prevent efficiently, or avoid cross-subsidy, but not all three. The result extends Rothschild-Stiglitz from distorted coverage to distorted risk-control technology and offers market design insights of AI in insurance markets.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI等可扩展预测技术如何在保险市场中设计残差风险，而非仅仅对固定风险进行分类。在逆向选择下，针对低风险消费者的合同面临“风险设计三难困境”：分离、有效预防或避免交叉补贴三者不可兼得。该结果将Rothschild-Stiglitz模型从扭曲的保险覆盖扩展到扭曲的风险控制技术。
AI.research_question: 可扩展预测（如AI）如何在保险市场中设计残差风险？当预防可观察、可缔约且竞争性供给时，不同主体（消费者、保险公司、供应商）提供预防是否等价？逆向选择如何影响这一结论？
AI.motivation: 传统保险经济学假设风险是固定的，AI仅用于分类。但现实中AI可改变风险分布（如通过个性化预防措施设计残差风险），这一重要经济含义尚未被充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 完整契约基准模型、逆向选择模型、Rothschild-Stiglitz框架扩展
AI.method: 理论建模与均衡分析
AI.findings: （1）完全契约下，预防由谁提供无关紧要；（2）逆向选择下，若高风险者更具“AI可治疗性”，有效预防会使低风险合同对高风险者具有吸引力；（3）低风险合同面临“风险设计三难困境”：分离、有效预防、避免交叉补贴三者不可兼得。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Rothschild-Stiglitz模型从扭曲的保险覆盖扩展到扭曲的风险控制技术；提出“风险设计三难困境”概念；揭示AI在保险市场中设计风险的经济学含义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保险市场中AI应用提供市场设计洞见，帮助理解个性化预防措施对保险市场均衡的影响。

title: Organizational Incentives and the Returns to Technology Adoption
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD), Good Business Lab, University of California, Santa Cruz, University of Hawaii at Manoa and University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business

detail.title: Organizational Incentives and the Returns to Technology Adoption
detail.abstract:
Misaligned incentives within organizations may explain why firms fail to adopt or fully benefit from productive technologies. We conducted a randomized controlled trial in Indian garment factories in which units received an anonymous worker-management communication technology, this technology paired with incentives for HR managers to communicate effectively with workers, or neither (control). We find that the technology alone had no impacts relative to control. But pairing the technology with HR incentives increased productivity by 5%, reduced absenteeism by 13%, and raised worker earnings by 3%. Impacts were driven by greater HR responsiveness and increased worker reporting of production-related issues.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 在印度服装工厂的随机对照试验中，仅引入匿名工人-管理层沟通技术没有效果，但配合HR激励措施后，生产率提高5%、缺勤率降低13%、工人收入增加3%，效果源于HR响应性提升和工人更多上报生产问题。
AI.research_question: 为什么企业未能采用或充分受益于生产性技术？组织内部的激励错位是否解释了这一现象？
AI.motivation: 许多企业未能采用或充分利用能提升生产效率的技术，可能原因在于组织内部的激励错位（misaligned incentives），但缺乏因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 激励错位理论：技术采用效果取决于组织内部的激励机制是否与技术进步相匹配，仅引入技术而缺乏对管理者的适当激励可能无法释放技术潜力。
AI.method: 在印度服装工厂进行随机对照试验（RCT），设置三组：匿名工人-管理层沟通技术（仅技术组）、技术+HR激励组、控制组，通过实地实验收集生产率和工人行为数据。
AI.findings: （1）仅引入匿名沟通技术对生产率、缺勤率和工人收入无显著影响；（2）技术配合HR激励后，生产率提升5%、缺勤率降低13%、工人收入提高3%；（3）效果机制是HR响应性增强以及工人更多上报生产相关问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"激励错位阻碍技术采用效果"提供了因果证据，揭示了技术与组织激励机制互补性的重要性，拓展了对企业内部效率障碍的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示企业在引入新技术时需同步设计配套的管理激励措施，否则技术可能沦为无效投资；为管理者提供基于实证的改善工人沟通、提升生产率的操作方案。

reference: FRB of Cleveland Working Paper No. 26-15; https://doi.org/10.26509/frbc-wp-202615
title: Measuring Overtime Exemption Status: A Task-based Approach

detail.title: Measuring Overtime Exemption Status: A Task-based Approach

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Cleveland Working Paper No. 26-15
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper introduces new measures of the overtime exemption status of individual tasks measured by O*NET. Task-based measures reveal that about 60 percent of salaried workers are in occupations in which either all or no O*NET tasks are exempt. While workers with higher earnings tend to be employed in occupations in which a larger share of tasks are exempt, there is substantial variation in exempt task shares across occupations at all levels of earnings. The task content of job ads shows a similar pattern. Incorporating task-based exemption measures into extensions of prior work reveals that workers in high-exemption occupations were more likely to transition out of salaried jobs affected by changes to state overtime rules, and managerial jobs just above the federal salary level test threshold have exempt task content similar to those just below it.

AI.tldr: 本文利用O*NET数据构建了基于任务层面的加班豁免衡量指标，发现约60%的受薪员工从事的职业中，所有O*NET任务要么全部豁免、要么全部不豁免；高收入工人更可能从事豁免任务占比高的职业，但在各收入水平上职业间仍存在显著差异；将任务层面的豁免指标纳入以往研究后，发现高豁免职业的工人在州级加班规则变化时更可能离开受薪岗位，而联邦薪资测试阈值附近的经理岗位其豁免任务内容相似。
AI.research_question: 如何构建基于任务层面的加班豁免衡量指标，并利用这些指标考察加班豁免状态在不同收入水平工人间的分布特征及其对劳动力流动和职业分类的影响？
AI.motivation: 传统的加班豁免衡量多基于职业大类或薪资阈值，忽略了同一职业内部不同任务在豁免状态上的异质性。作者希望利用O*NET的任务级数据构建更精细的衡量指标，以更准确地刻画工人的实际豁免状态，并揭示这一衡量方式对已有研究结论的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动经济学中的加班豁免制度理论、任务分析方法（task-based approach）、职业分类与劳动力市场分割理论。
AI.method: 利用O*NET数据对每项任务标注豁免状态，构建任务层面的豁免比例指标；结合人口调查数据描述不同收入水平工人的豁免任务占比分布；利用职位广告数据进行外部验证；在已有研究框架中引入任务层面的豁免指标，重新检验州级加班规则变化对工人离职行为的影响，以及联邦薪资测试阈值附近经理岗位的豁免特征。
AI.findings: （1）约60%的受薪员工从事的职业中，所有O*NET任务要么全部豁免、要么全部不豁免；（2）高收入工人趋向于从事豁免任务占比更高的职业，但各收入水平上职业间仍存在显著差异；（3）职位广告中的任务内容呈现类似模式；（4）在面临州级加班规则变化时，高豁免职业的工人更可能离开受薪岗位；（5）联邦薪资测试阈值附近的经理岗位，其豁免任务内容相似。
AI.theory_contributions: 将任务层面的异质性引入加班豁免分析，弥补了传统职业大类或薪资阈值衡量方法的不足；深化了对加班豁免制度如何影响劳动力流动和职业分类的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估加班豁免规则的公平性和有效性提供了更精细的分析工具；帮助企业和管理者更准确地理解不同岗位的豁免属性，优化薪酬和用工策略。

title: Unruly by Design: Fee Volatility and Strategic Attacks in Bitcoin Mining
affiliations: Center for Innovative Finance, University of Basel,  and New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: Unruly by Design: Fee Volatility and Strategic Attacks in Bitcoin Mining
detail.abstract:
We develop a model of aberrant behavior by Bitcoin miners and test it with a new 2017-2025 dataset. Miners’ rewards, comprised partly of user fees, exhibit variability across blocks of transactions. When large reward disparities exist between adjacent blocks, miners have incentives to attempt alternative versions of prior blocks and claim other miners’ rewards for themselves. Regression analysis shows that fee differentials are associated with these attacks and longer waiting times between blocks. These patterns imply potential destabilization of the Bitcoin blockchain as future mining rewards become more volatile due to gradual withdrawal of fixed block subsidies.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了比特币矿工的异常行为，发现区块间交易手续费差异会激励矿工发动攻击，可能导致区块链不稳定。
AI.research_question: 比特币矿工的异常行为（如区块重组攻击）是否受区块间手续费差异驱动，以及这种行为对区块链稳定性的影响。
AI.motivation: 随着比特币固定区块补贴逐渐减少，矿工收入越来越依赖交易手续费，手续费波动性增加可能诱发矿工的攻击行为，威胁区块链安全。
AI.theoretical_framework: 矿工理性选择理论：矿工作为利润最大化主体，在相邻区块奖励差异较大时，有激励尝试重写前序区块以夺取他人奖励。
AI.method: 构建矿工异常行为理论模型，并使用2017-2025年的新数据集进行回归分析。
AI.findings: 1) 区块间手续费差异与矿工攻击行为显著正相关；2) 手续费差异越大，区块间等待时间越长；3) 随着固定补贴逐步退出，未来挖矿奖励波动加剧可能进一步 destabilize 区块链。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将矿工攻击行为与手续费差异联系起来，揭示了比特币经济激励结构变化对区块链安全性的潜在威胁。
AI.practical_contributions: 为比特币协议设计者和监管者提供了预警：随着区块补贴减少，需关注手续费波动引发的安全风险，可能需调整共识机制或交易费结构。

title: Measuring the Value of Disability Insurance from Take-Up Decisions
affiliations: NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Economics and University of Calgary

detail.title: Measuring the Value of Disability Insurance from Take-Up Decisions
detail.abstract:
The central trade-off for designing Disability Insurance (DI) is between providing insurance to those in need while maintaining incentives to work. This paper develops a novel revealed-preference approach to identify the insurance value of DI benefits. We show that comparing the DI take-up response to a change in benefits versus a change in wages identifies the insurance value. Implementing our framework in Canada, we estimate that increasing DI benefits by $1 creates an additional disincentive cost of $0.60 but creates an insurance value of $2.20. Thus, our approach suggests that DI benefits are not overly generous in the Canadian context.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的显示偏好方法，用于识别伤残保险（DI）的保险价值。通过比较DI参保率对福利变化与工资变化的响应，估算出保险价值。在加拿大背景下，增加1美元DI福利会产生0.60美元的抑制工作成本，但创造2.20美元的保险价值，表明加拿大DI福利并不过度慷慨。
AI.research_question: 如何识别伤残保险（DI）的保险价值，并评估福利水平是否过度慷慨？
AI.motivation: 伤残保险设计面临的核心权衡是：为有需要的人提供保障与维持工作激励之间的矛盾。现有方法难以直接量化保险价值，因此需要新的识别策略来评估DI福利的合理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 显示偏好理论（Revealed Preference Approach）；通过比较DI参保对福利变化的弹性与对工资变化的弹性来识别保险价值。
AI.method: 利用加拿大行政数据，对比DI福利变化和工资变化对DI参保率的影响，从而估计保险价值与抑制工作的边际成本。
AI.findings: 增加1美元DI福利产生0.60美元的抑制工作成本，但创造2.20美元的保险价值；保险价值超过抑制成本，表明加拿大DI福利并不过度慷慨。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一种新的显示偏好方法，在不依赖强参数假设的情况下识别伤残保险的保险价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估伤残保险福利水平的合理性提供了实证依据，支持加拿大DI福利并不过度慷慨的政策结论。

title: Intergovernmental Grants to School Districts and Educational Outcomes During the COVID-19 Pandemic
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - University of California, San Diego, University of California, San Diego (UCSD) and American Enterprise Institute

detail.title: Intergovernmental Grants to School Districts and Educational Outcomes During the COVID-19 Pandemic
detail.abstract:
The federal government appropriated $189.5 billion in pandemic aid to school districts through the Elementary and Secondary School Emergency Relief (ESSER) fund. We evaluate their impact on schools with district poverty shares near 5%, where a threshold-driven increase in funds enables us to implement a difference-in-discontinuities design. Federal funds were passed on to residents through reductions in local revenue collections, including property taxes, and did not result in increased per-pupil expenditures by school districts. We find no evidence that additional funds mitigated the declines in test scores. We provide suggestive evidence that political engagement, especially from parents, increased in districts that qualified for additional funds. This combination of engagement and reduced taxation may explain the greater enrollment and faster reopening we observe in such districts.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了美国联邦政府通过ESSER基金向学区拨付的1895亿美元疫情救助资金的效果。利用贫困份额接近5%的学区断点，采用差异断点回归设计，发现联邦资金被转化为地方税收减免，并未增加生均支出或改善考试成绩，但提高了家长政治参与度、学校 enrollment 和复课速度。
AI.research_question: 联邦政府通过ESSER基金向学区拨付的疫情救助资金，对学区财政行为、学生学业表现以及家长政治参与产生了怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 美国联邦政府通过ESSER基金拨付了1895亿美元的疫情救助资金，这是历史上最大规模的联邦教育专项拨款之一。评估这些资金的实际效果，对于理解政府大规模干预的有效性以及优化未来政策设计具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政联邦主义理论、公共选择理论（公共资金可能被用于替代地方税收而非增加教育支出）、家长政治参与理论。
AI.method: 采用差异断点回归设计（difference-in-discontinuities design），以学区贫困份额接近5%的阈值作为断点，比较阈值附近学区的差异，从而识别因果效应。
AI.findings: 1. 联邦资金被转化为地方税收减免（包括财产税），并未增加生均支出。2. 额外资金未能缓解学生考试成绩的下降。3. 获得额外资金的学区家长政治参与度提高。4. 这些学区 enrollment 更高、复课速度更快。
AI.theory_contributions: 为财政联邦主义中"财政替代效应"提供了实证证据，即上级政府转移支付可能被下级政府用于减税而非增加公共服务支出；丰富了公共选择理论中关于利益集团（家长）政治参与的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要警示：大规模教育救助资金的效果取决于资金使用机制设计，单纯的联邦拨款可能被地方政府用于减税而未能真正惠及学生教育；建议未来救助资金应附加更严格的使用条件，确保资金真正用于教育支出。

title: The Uneven Impact of Industrial Zones on Formal Job Creation in Vietnam
affiliations: Wilfrid Laurier University - School of Business & Economics, Tufts University - Department of Economics, The World Bank and George Mason University

detail.title: The Uneven Impact of Industrial Zones on Formal Job Creation in Vietnam
detail.abstract:
Industrial zones are a widely used industrial policy tool, yet their effects vary enormously. Matching the timing and location of zone establishment to firm-level data in Vietnam, we estimate that a new zone raises formal employment by 2,000 workers within seven years. This average masks extreme skewness: a handful of zones generate the gains while the rest produce almost none. Zones near major trade hubs account for most of the effect, driven by export-oriented foreign manufacturers. Accounting for spillovers, domestic firms face agglomeration shadows nearby but gain farther out, while foreign manufacturers operate as enclaves, generating few local linkages.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 越南工业区的建立使正式就业平均增加2000人，但效果极不平衡：少数靠近贸易枢纽、以出口导向型外资为主的工业区贡献了绝大部分就业增长，而多数工业区几乎没有效果。国内企业面临邻近集聚阴影，但远距离受益；外资企业则形成飞地，本地关联有限。
AI.research_question: 工业区政策的效果如何？其异质性来源是什么？不同类型企业（国内 vs. 外资）如何受到空间溢出效应的影响？
AI.motivation: 工业区是广泛使用的产业政策工具，但其效果差异巨大，现有文献对其异质性来源及空间溢出效应的理解不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集聚经济学（agglomeration economies）、集聚阴影（agglomeration shadows）、飞地经济（enclave economy）、空间溢出效应
AI.method: 匹配工业区建立的时间和地点与企业级面板数据，采用计量经济学方法估计因果效应及空间溢出效应。
AI.findings: （1）工业区平均使正式就业增加约2000人，但分布极不均衡；（2）靠近主要贸易枢纽的工业区效果最显著，由出口导向型外资驱动；（3）国内企业在邻近工业区受到集聚阴影，但在更远距离受益；（4）外资制造商形成飞地，与本地经济关联有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了工业区效应的极端异质性及其空间分布规律；区分了国内企业与外资企业的不同空间溢出模式，丰富了集聚经济学和飞地经济理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家工业区政策的选址与目标定位提供实证依据：靠近贸易枢纽且吸引出口导向型外资的工业区更可能成功；需警惕国内企业被挤出及外资飞地化问题。

title: The International RBC Model Finally Works!
affiliations: Government of Canada - Bank of Canada,  and

detail.title: The International RBC Model Finally Works!
detail.abstract:
We show that incorporating uninsurable countercyclical income risk into a standard international RBC model can qualitatively and quantitatively account for the quantity puzzles in open-economy macro, namely (i) the Backus-Smith puzzle, (ii) the Backus-Kehoe-Kydland puzzle and (iii) the weak correlation between the trade balance and the exchange rate. We also show that our model can simultaneously account for the Fama puzzle and the evidence that high interest rate countries have stronger currencies—which representative-agents models that rely only on financial or demand shocks cannot jointly account for. Crucially, our model resolves all these puzzles while relying solely on productivity shocks, and thus generates the observed domestic and cross-country macroeconomic comovement.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文将不可对冲的反周期收入风险纳入标准国际RBC模型，成功解释了开放经济宏观中的“数量之谜”（Backus-Smith谜题、Backus-Kehoe-Kydland谜题、贸易余额与汇率弱相关）以及Fama谜题和高利率货币走强现象，且仅依赖生产率冲击即可实现。
AI.research_question: 如何解释开放经济宏观中的多个经典“谜题”（数量谜题和价格谜题）？
AI.motivation: 现有代表性代理人模型仅依靠金融冲击或需求冲击无法同时解释Fama谜题和高利率货币走强现象，且无法解释一系列开放经济宏观数量谜题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际实际经济周期（IRBC）模型；不可对冲的反周期收入风险；异质性代理人框架
AI.method: 将不可对冲的反周期收入风险嵌入标准国际RBC模型，仅依靠生产率冲击进行定量模拟分析。
AI.findings: 1）模型定性和定量解释了Backus-Smith谜题（消费与汇率的相关性）；2）解释了Backus-Kehoe-Kydland谜题（跨国商业周期共动性）；3）解释了贸易余额与汇率的弱相关性；4）同时解释了Fama谜题（远期贴水之谜）以及高利率国家货币走强的现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一框架，仅用生产率冲击就能同时解释开放经济宏观中的多个经典谜题，挑战了以往依赖多种冲击（如金融冲击、需求冲击）的建模思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解汇率、贸易余额与宏观经济波动的复杂关系提供了新视角，对国际资产定价和货币政策制定具有启示意义。

title: AI Premium
affiliations: LUISS University - Department of Economics and Finance, Yale University, Yale University - Cowles Foundation and University of Rochester

detail.title: AI Premium
detail.abstract:
Using 380 trillion tokens of realized AI consumption across more than four hundred large language models from the licensed proprietary OpenRouter dataset covering approximately 2 percent of current global monthly AI token consumption, we analyze how AI affects firms, markets, and workers. Leveraging the unprecedented size, scope and granularity of this data, we construct the AI Factor from growth in tokens, dollars, and users, estimate firm-level AI Betas from stock return comovement, and characterize the AI Premium. First, we build a high-frequency AI factor and decompose it into salient components. Second, we show that firms whose returns covary more positively with the AI factor—high AI beta firms—earn higher subsequent returns, and the AI premium is large and heterogeneous. A value-weighted longshort strategy earns 64.1 basis points per week, and the premium is large for loadings on the intensive, frontier-oriented margin of AI consumption—closed-source models, paying and seasoned users, and long prompts—but not on casual or open-weight use.
