Third, the premium reaches beyond technology firms into consumer-facing and capital-heavy parts of the economy, but is absent in emerging markets, including China. Fourth, the AI exposure is more positive in nonroutine interactive work and more negative in analytical, scientific, and operations-control skills—an occupation one standard deviation higher in interaction-and-communication content has 0.36-standard-deviation higher market-implied AI exposure. Additionally, we provide early evidence of the rise of the agentic economy.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 基于覆盖全球约2%月度AI Token消费量的专有数据集（涵盖400多个大语言模型、380万亿Token），本文构建了AI因子，发现高AI Beta公司获得更高后续收益（价值加权多空策略周收益64.1个基点），AI溢价集中于封闭模型、付费用户等集约边际，并延伸到非科技行业，同时揭示了AI对职业技能的差异化影响及智能体经济的早期证据。
AI.research_question: AI如何影响企业、市场和工人？具体而言，AI暴露程度（AI Beta）是否能够预测股票收益？AI溢价在不同使用模式、行业和职业间的分布如何？
AI.motivation: 尽管AI在经济中的渗透日益广泛，但缺乏大规模、细粒度的实际AI消费数据来量化其对金融市场和劳动力市场的系统性影响。现有研究多依赖公告或调查数据，本文利用独一无二的超大规模高质量数据集填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产定价中的因子模型（AI因子）；风险溢价与协方差框架（AI Beta与预期收益）；职业任务框架（非例行交互工作 vs. 分析/科学/运营控制技能）。
AI.method: 从Token、美元和用户增长三个维度构建高频AI因子；通过股票收益与AI因子的时间序列回归估计企业层面的AI Beta；构建多空组合检验AI溢价；按模型类型、用户类型、提示长度等维度分解AI消费的集约边际；按行业和职业技能分类进行横截面分析。
AI.findings: ①高AI Beta企业获得更高后续收益，价值加权多空策略周收益64.1个基点；②AI溢价主要来自集约边际——封闭模型、付费用户、长期用户和长提示，而非开放权重模型或随意使用；③AI溢价延伸至消费类和资本密集型非科技行业，但在新兴市场（包括中国）不显著；④AI暴露对非例行交互工作为正，对分析/科学/运营控制技能为负；⑤提供智能体经济兴起早期证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次利用实时微观消费数据构建AI因子，将AI的经济影响纳入资产定价框架；揭示了AI风险溢价的异质性来源（集约边际vs.粗放边际）；建立了AI暴露与职业技能分类之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了基于AI暴露程度的可交易策略（周收益64.1个基点）；为企业管理者理解AI对其所在行业和职业的风险敞口提供了量化工具；为政策制定者识别AI影响的经济部门和劳动力技能类别提供了实证依据。

title: Bundling Trades In Over-The-Counter Markets
affiliations: Wisconsin School of Business and

detail.title: Bundling Trades In Over-The-Counter Markets
detail.abstract:
In the canonical view of over-the-counter markets, dealers intermediate single-asset trades one at a time. We study a complementary role: when investors trade several assets at once, dealers absorb the joint position into inventory, insuring against execution risk. Using data on the near-universe of Canadian fixed-income trades, we find that bundled transactions account for 20 percent of investor volume. We develop a simple model of why, when, where, and at what prices investors bundle, and use it to explain three patterns. Switches—a purchase paired with a sale—transact at a discount, while uni-directional bundles—all buys or sells—transact at a premium, because a switch’s legs hedge within the dealer’s book while a uni-directional bundle’s compound. Bundling rises with volatility, when insurance against execution risk is most valuable, and the two types sort asymmetrically across bilateral and electronic venues. Together, these patterns reveal a dimension of intermediation the single-asset view overlooks, and one likely to grow in importance.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了场外交易市场中做市商在投资者同时交易多种资产时提供的“捆绑交易”中介服务，发现捆绑交易占加拿大固定收益市场交易量的20%，且不同类型的捆绑交易（对冲型与单向型）存在显著的价格差异和交易模式差异。
AI.research_question: 在场外交易市场中，当投资者同时交易多种资产时，做市商如何通过将联合头寸纳入库存来提供执行风险保险？捆绑交易的定价、时机和渠道有何特征？
AI.motivation: 传统的场外交易研究聚焦于做市商单次中介单资产交易，忽略了投资者同时交易多种资产时做市商面临的执行风险保险角色。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于场外市场做市商库存模型，引入多资产捆绑交易情境，区分“对冲型捆绑”（一买一卖）和“单向型捆绑”（全买或全卖）两种类型，分析其在做市商账簿中的风险对冲与叠加效应。
AI.method: 使用加拿大固定收益市场近乎全量的交易数据，结合理论模型，对捆绑交易的发生率、定价、波动性敏感性及交易渠道进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）捆绑交易占投资者交易量的20%；（2）对冲型捆绑（买卖配对）以折扣价成交，单向型捆绑（全买或全卖）则以溢价成交，原因在于前者在账簿内对冲风险、后者则叠加风险；（3）波动性上升时捆绑交易增加；（4）两种捆绑类型在双边与电子交易平台上的分布存在不对称性。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了传统单资产视角下被忽视的做市商中介维度——多资产捆绑交易中的执行风险保险功能，拓展了场外市场交易理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者理解捆绑交易的成本与收益提供了理论依据；为监管者和市场参与者评估做市商角色及市场流动性质量提供了新视角，尤其是随着未来多资产交易增长，这一研究具有重要实践意义。

title: Financial Sanctions and the Global Payments Network
affiliations: and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Financial Sanctions and the Global Payments Network
detail.abstract:
Financial sanctions are widely viewed as a powerful tool of economic statecraft, yet direct evidence on their effects remains limited. We study how sanctions affect access to global payment networks using data on correspondent banking relationships, which link banks across countries and currencies to enable cross-border transactions. We first show that the dollar and euro networks offer the broadest global connectivity, supported by a small number of key hubs in the U.S. and Europe. Sanctions that restrict access to these hubs are therefore potentially powerful. We then show how financial sanctions imposed during 2021-2025 – a period of rapid growth in sanctions – reduced targeted banks' access to major-currency networks by severing correspondent relationships. Sanctioned institutions often retained access but only through longer, indirect, and more fragile chains of intermediaries. Finally, in countries where sanctions expanded sharply, non-sanctioned banks also lost connectivity to Western networks, likely reflecting de-risking. These banks reoriented toward alternatives, particularly the Chinese yuan. Outside these heavily sanctioned economies, shifts away from the dollar and toward the yuan remain minimal on average.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用代理行关系数据，分析了2021-2025年金融制裁如何切断目标银行进入主要货币（美元、欧元）全球支付网络的渠道，并导致非制裁银行的"去风险化"行为，促使其转向人民币网络。
AI.research_question: 金融制裁如何影响银行进入全球支付网络（特别是美元和欧元网络）的渠道？制裁对目标银行及非制裁银行产生了哪些溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 尽管金融制裁被广泛视为经济治国的重要手段，但其对全球支付网络的实际影响缺乏直接的实证证据。尤其是近年来（2021-2025年）制裁数量快速增长，亟需系统评估其效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以代理行关系（correspondent banking relationships）理论为基础，结合全球支付网络的"中心-外围"结构（美元和欧元网络由少数美国与欧洲枢纽银行主导），分析制裁如何通过切断枢纽连接来产生影响力。
AI.method: 利用代理行关系数据，对比2021-2025年制裁前后，目标银行和非制裁银行在主要货币（美元、欧元、人民币）网络中的连接变化。
AI.findings: （1）美元和欧元网络由少数美国与欧洲枢纽银行支撑，提供最广泛的全球连接；（2）制裁切断了目标银行与主要货币网络的直接代理行关系，但目标银行往往通过更长、间接、更脆弱的链式中介保留部分连接；（3）在制裁大幅扩大的国家，非制裁银行也失去了与西方网络的连接（去风险化效应）；（4）这些非制裁银行转向替代方案，尤其是人民币网络；（5）在制裁不严重的国家，从美元转向人民币的转变仍然极小。
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融制裁的传导机制提供了微观层面的直接实证证据，揭示了制裁如何通过代理行关系网络发挥作用，并识别了"去风险化"的溢出效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估金融制裁的有效性与非预期后果（如推动人民币国际化）提供了实证依据；对银行风险管理及跨境支付网络布局具有参考价值。

title: Zoning: Externalities or Misallocation?
affiliations: Harvard University, University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, Institute of Economics, Academia Sinica and Washington University in St. Louis

detail.title: Zoning: Externalities or Misallocation?
detail.abstract:
We study how residential-commercial zoning affects the allocation of urban space. Using property-level data from Taipei and 34 U.S. metropolitan areas, we infer neighborhood-level zoning wedges from the allocation of residents, workers, and floor space. We find substantially greater dispersion in these wedges in U.S. cities than in Taipei, where mixed-use development is pervasive. The inferred wedges increase neighborhood specialization and reduce welfare. We then evaluate whether zoning is aligned with the neighborhood characteristics that would justify intervention. Although zoning is systematically related to comparative advantage, comparative advantage explains only a small fraction of the variation in zoning. The dominant effect of zoning in American cities is therefore not to promote efficient land use, but to increase the segregation of residential and commercial activity across neighborhoods.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了住宅-商业分区如何影响城市空间配置。利用台北和34个美国大都市区的物业级数据，推断出社区级分区楔子，发现美国城市的分区楔子离散度远大于台北（混合用途开发普遍）。分区楔子增加了社区专业化并降低了福利。虽然分区与比较优势系统相关，但比较优势仅解释了分区变异的很小部分。美国城市分区的主要效果不是促进高效土地利用，而是增加住宅和商业活动在社区间的隔离。
AI.research_question: 住宅-商业分区如何影响城市空间配置？分区是否与促进高效土地利用的社区特征相匹配？
AI.motivation: 城市分区政策广泛存在，但对其经济效率的量化评估不足。特别是，分区是否真正服务于帕累托最优的土地利用，或更多导致隔离，缺乏实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于空间均衡理论，引入"分区楔子"概念（即分区导致的住宅和商业用地价格差异），结合比较优势理论分析分区与社区特征的关系。
AI.method: 利用台北和34个美国大都市区的物业级数据，通过结构估计方法推断社区层面的分区楔子，并分析其与社区特征的关联。
AI.findings: 1. 美国城市分区楔子的离散度远大于台北（混合用途城市）。2. 分区楔子增加社区专业化并降低福利。3. 分区与比较优势系统相关，但比较优势仅解释分区变异的很小部分。4. 美国城市分区的主要效果是增加住宅与商业活动的隔离，而非促进效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并量化了"分区楔子"概念，为城市经济学中土地利用效率与隔离的权衡提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者提供了实证证据：当前美国分区政策更多导致隔离而非效率提升，提示需要重新审视混合用途开发的潜力。

title: Trade Dynamics in Sovereign Debt Crises
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Strategy Policy and Review Department, International Monetary Fund (IMF) - Research Department, University of Wisconsin-Madison and Keio University

detail.title: Trade Dynamics in Sovereign Debt Crises
detail.abstract: Sovereign debt restructurings have large impacts on trade. We empirically show that trade dynamics depend on two dimensions: whether restructurings preempt a default or take place after missed payments, and the debtor's economy dependence on trade. Debtors experience significantly higher import compression, higher export expansion, and larger trade balance improvement following a default than when restructurings are preemptive. This is consistent with the need for a larger external adjustment in post-default restructurings. Debtors with initial trade deficits experience decline in imports and exports with larger import decline, while exports and imports expand when there is an initial trade surplus.

AI.tldr: 本文实证研究主权债务重组对贸易的影响，发现重组是否发生在违约前后以及债务人经济对贸易的依赖程度是关键决定因素。违约后的重组会导致更大的进口压缩、出口扩张和贸易平衡改善，而初始贸易状况（顺差或逆差）也会显著影响贸易动态。
AI.research_question: 主权债务重组如何影响贸易动态？不同的重组时机（违约前预emptive vs. 违约后）以及债务人经济的贸易依赖程度是否会导致不同的贸易结果？
AI.motivation: 主权债务重组对贸易有重大影响，但现有研究对贸易动态在不同重组情境下的差异缺乏深入分析，特别是预emptive重组与违约后重组的区别尚未被充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外部调整理论：违约后重组需要更大的外部调整（通过进口压缩和出口扩张来改善贸易平衡）；贸易依赖度理论：债务国经济的贸易依赖程度影响重组对贸易的冲击程度。
AI.method: 实证分析方法，利用主权债务重组的历史数据，比较不同类型重组（预emptive vs. 违约后）以及不同初始贸易状况（逆差 vs. 顺差）下的贸易动态差异。
AI.findings: (1) 违约后重组相比预emptive重组，债务人经历更显著的进口压缩、出口扩张和贸易平衡改善；(2) 初始贸易逆差的债务国在违约后进口和出口双双下降，但进口降幅更大；(3) 初始贸易顺差的债务国则在违约后出口和进口均扩张。
AI.theory_contributions: 将主权债务重组的类型（预emptive vs. 违约后）与贸易动态联系起来，丰富了外部调整理论在主权债务领域的应用，揭示了重组时机对贸易调整路径的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供主权债务重组对贸易影响的预测框架，有助于在债务重组谈判中更准确地评估不同重组策略对贸易的潜在影响，尤其是对依赖贸易的债务国经济。

title: Competition and Anomalies Redux: Evidence from U.S. Auto Dealers
affiliations: Cornell University, Washington University, Saint Louis - John M. Olin School of Business , Cornell University - Department of Economics and Middlebury College

detail.title: Competition and Anomalies Redux: Evidence from U.S. Auto Dealers
detail.abstract:
We examine a choice between bonus contracts offered to dealers of a U.S. auto manufacturer. In our data, dealers select the non-profit-maximizing option in 20 percent of observations, costing the mistaken dealers $18,453 per year on average. We examine how the propensity to make this mistake varies with competition, identified both cross-sectionally and within dealers over time. Both analyses show that greater competition substantially lowers the rate of mistakes. However, even in the most competitive markets, consequential mistakes persist. Our results suggest that competition disciplines mainly through within-dealer changes in behavior rather than entry and exit.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究美国汽车制造商经销商在奖金合同选择中的非利润最大化行为，发现20%的经销商选错，年均损失$18,453。竞争越激烈，错误率越低，但即使在高竞争市场仍有显著错误。竞争主要通过改变经销商行为而非进入退出机制来降低错误率。
AI.research_question: 经销商在奖金合同选择中，竞争如何影响其非利润最大化决策错误的概率？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学假设市场竞争能够淘汰非利润最大化行为，但现实中持续存在此类错误。本文通过独特数据集在经销商层面检验竞争对错误决策的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场竞争淘汰机制理论、行为经济学中的有限理性决策理论。
AI.method: 利用美国汽车制造商的经销商合同选择数据，横截面维度与经销商时间序列维度双重识别竞争效应，比较不同竞争程度下错误率差异。
AI.findings: 20%的经销商选择非利润最大化合同，年均损失$18,453；竞争越激烈，错误率越低；竞争主要通过改变经销商行为（而非进入退出）降低错误率；即使在高竞争市场，重大错误依然存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 为市场竞争筛选机制理论提供微观证据，揭示竞争通过行为改变（而非市场选择）发挥作用的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为厂商设计经销商激励合同提供参考，表明仅靠市场竞争不足以完全消除非理性决策，需要辅助培训或合同简化。

title: Banking on a Corporate Rebrand
affiliations: Santa Clara University - Leavey School of Business - Economics Department, Utah State University - Huntsman School of Business and Oesterreichische Nationalbank (Eurosystem)

detail.title: Banking on a Corporate Rebrand
detail.abstract:
Firms often rebrand to counter negative shocks, but can it work? Using a historical natural experiment, we analyze a large sample of companies from the same industry (banking) that shared very similar names, but overwhelmingly decided to change them in response to a common, negative news shock. U.S. entry into World War I in 1917 created a sudden anti-German backlash against anything that invoked an association with the now enemy. The shock itself was thus orthogonal to bank fundamentals and pre-existing trends, but pushed banks to reconsider their brands. After 1917, the few German-named banks that kept their tainted names saw significant declines in assets, deposits, and market share relative to other banks. However, German-named banks that rebranded mitigated much of the negative shock. Specifically, German-named banks that adopted a new non-ethnic brand name avoided between 75% and 85% of the anti-German effect, and those that adopted a new patriotic brand name were able to neutralize it completely. Overall, we find that “crisis rebranding” paid off in our historical setting regardless of the chosen brand, with patriotic rebranding proving the most effective at offsetting the exogenous shock.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用一战期间美国反德情绪这一历史自然实验，发现银行通过改名（尤其是改用爱国名称）能有效抵御负面冲击带来的品牌损害，危机重塑品牌总体上是值得的。
AI.research_question: 企业能否通过品牌重塑（rebranding）来应对负面冲击？
AI.motivation: 现实中企业常面临负面冲击，但关于品牌重塑是否以及如何有效缓解冲击的因果证据十分匮乏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌资产理论、信号理论、组织合法性理论——负面冲击损害品牌资产，改名是重新传递信号、重建合法性的策略。
AI.method: 历史自然实验：以1917年美国参加一战导致的突然反德情绪为外生冲击，对比保留德国名称的银行与改名的银行在资产、存款、市场份额等方面的差异。
AI.findings: 保留德国名称的银行在资产、存款和市场份额上显著下降；改用非族裔名称的银行避免了75%-85%的负面效应；改用爱国名称的银行完全抵消了冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 为品牌重塑在危机情境下的有效性提供了因果识别证据，区分了不同改名策略（非族裔 vs. 爱国）的差异效果，拓展了对品牌韧性的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业面临声誉危机时的品牌管理策略提供了实证依据：危机时改名有效，且选择契合社会情绪的爱国名称效果最佳。

title: Job Ads as Signals: Evidence from a Priced Amenity and Worker Beliefs
affiliations: University of Oxford, Regent's Park College, Bank of England, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), IZA and Cornell  University,  Ithaca,  New  York

detail.title: Job Ads as Signals: Evidence from a Priced Amenity and Worker Beliefs
detail.abstract:
Discrete choice experiments are widely used to estimate workers’ willingness to pay (WTP) for job amenities under the assumption that varying an attribute does not change workers’ beliefs about other job attributes. We test this assumption by embedding an amenity with a known market price—a popular monthly public transport pass—in a largescale discrete choice experiment with German workers. Many workers, including public transport users, overvalue the ticket by more than 100%, despite WTP for other attributes aligning with the literature. A complementary belief-elicitation experiment shows that advertising an amenity, such as the pass but also common amenities like work from home, causally shifts beliefs about unlisted attributes of the job. Posted wages similarly signal unlisted attributes so that wage variation, the money metric for WTP calculation, is itself contaminated by belief spillovers—such as higher pay signaling heightened stress. These spillovers imply that discrete choice estimates capture perceived bundles rather than isolated attributes, and distort current estimates of non-wage compensation and monopsony power.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过大规模离散选择实验发现，工人在评估工作属性时存在“信念溢出”效应——广告某一工作福利（如交通卡、远程办公）会改变工人对未列明属性的信念，导致其支付意愿被高估100%以上。工资信号同样被污染，使得传统离散选择估计扭曲了对非工资补偿和买方垄断力的测算。
AI.research_question: 当离散选择实验改变某一工作属性时，工人对该属性的信念是否会溢出到其他未列明属性，从而污染支付意愿估计？
AI.motivation: 离散选择实验广泛用于估计工人对工作福利的支付意愿，但其核心假设——改变某一属性不影响工人对其他属性的信念——从未被严格检验。若该假设不成立，大量关于非工资补偿和劳动力市场垄断力的实证结论将面临偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信念溢出理论（Belief Spillover）：广告或改变某一工作属性会诱发工人对未列明属性（如工作压力、企业文化）的推断；工资信号理论：工资水平本身作为信号，也会触发对非货币属性的信念更新。
AI.method: 大规模离散选择实验（德国工人样本），嵌入已知市场价格的月票作为福利；辅以信念诱发实验（Belief Elicitation Experiment），检验广告福利对未列明属性信念的因果影响。
AI.findings: 1. 工人（包括公共交通使用者）对交通月票的估值高出市场价格100%以上；2. 广告一项福利（交通卡或远程办公）显著改变工人对未列明属性的信念；3. 工资变化同样会污染对非货币属性的信念，高工资被解读为高压力的信号。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了离散选择实验中的“信念溢出”机制，挑战了该方法的经典独立性假设；提出工资信号本身也会被污染，拓展了对支付意愿估计偏差来源的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 对使用离散选择实验评估非工资补偿的政策制定者和研究者提出警示，现有估计可能高估福利价值；2. 对劳动力市场买方垄断力的测算可能被扭曲，影响反垄断政策的制定依据；3. 建议在实验设计中纳入信念测量或采用更干净的识别策略。

title: Multi-Project Collaborations
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and

detail.title: Multi-Project Collaborations
detail.abstract:
We analyze collaborative experimentation across multiple independent domains. Each domain contains infinitely many potential projects with asymmetric benefits. In each period and in each domain, two players can idle, jointly explore a new project, or jointly exploit a known one, with voluntary transfers. For intermediate discount factors, treating domains as independent during experimentation is suboptimal. The optimal experimentation policy exhibits common features of collaborative experimentation: lengthy exploration, temporary project exploitation, recall of past projects, and inefficient initial or terminal idling within certain domains. We connect these findings to research on buyer-supplier dynamics and persistent productivity differences.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多个独立领域中的合作实验问题。每个领域有无限潜在项目且收益不对称。两玩家在每个时期可闲置、共同探索新项目或共同开发已知项目，并可进行自愿转移。在中等级别的折现因子下，将各领域独立对待进行实验是次优的。最优实验政策呈现合作实验的共同特征：漫长的探索、临时项目开发、召回过去项目，以及某些领域内初始或终期的低效闲置。
AI.research_question: 在多个独立领域中，两个玩家如何通过自愿转移进行最优的合作实验？
AI.motivation: 现实中的合作关系（如买方-供应商关系）往往涉及多个领域的合作实验，但现有文献多聚焦于单一领域。理解跨领域协作实验的最优策略，有助于解释企业间长期合作中的探索与开发模式以及生产率差异的持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态博弈与契约理论；多领域协作实验模型；折现因子对合作效率的影响。
AI.method: 理论建模与博弈论分析，构建多领域、多期合作实验的动态模型，分析不同折现因子下的均衡策略。
AI.findings: 1）中等级别折现因子下，将各领域独立对待是次优的；2）最优实验政策包含：漫长的探索期、临时项目开发、项目召回、以及某些领域的初始或终端闲置。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了合作实验理论从单领域到多领域的情境，揭示了跨领域协作的最优动态策略特征，为理解合作中的探索-开发权衡提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为买方-供应商关系管理、研发合作、以及解释企业间生产率差异的持续性提供了理论指导。

title: Should We Tax Trade? A Pigouvian Perspective
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics, University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - Department of Economics and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Should We Tax Trade? A Pigouvian Perspective
detail.abstract:
We develop a simple and intuitive Pigouvian perspective on optimal trade policy. Our approach unifies a wide range of rationales for taxing trade, from the classical optimal tariff argument to contemporary debates about global carbon emissions and geopolitics. We also clarify when trade policy intervention is warranted and when alternative domestic instruments should be used instead.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个简单直观的庇古视角来分析最优贸易政策，统一了从传统最优关税理论到全球碳排放和地缘政治等当代议题的多种贸易税理论，并澄清了何时应使用贸易政策干预、何时应改用国内政策工具。
AI.research_question: 如何从庇古税视角构建一个统一的最优贸易政策分析框架？
AI.motivation: 现有贸易政策理论分散于不同领域（传统最优关税、碳关税、地缘政治等），缺乏一个统一的理论视角来整合这些看似不同的贸易干预理由，同时也需要厘清贸易政策与国内政策工具的边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 庇古税理论（Pigouvian taxation）——通过税收矫正外部性，将外部成本内部化。
AI.method: 理论建模与演绎推理，基于庇古税框架推导最优贸易政策。
AI.findings: 庇古视角可以统一解释多种贸易干预理由；明确了贸易政策适用的边界条件，即当贸易本身是外部性的来源或传导渠道时适用，否则应使用国内政策工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 为贸易政策理论提供了一个统一的分析框架（庇古视角），将古典最优关税、全球碳税、地缘政治贸易工具等纳入同一理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了清晰的决策准则：何时采用贸易政策（关税、出口税等）vs. 何时采用国内政策（碳税、补贴等），有助于避免政策错配。

title: Long-Run Intergenerational Effects of Social Security
affiliations: Dartmouth College, University of Virginia - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Long-Run Intergenerational Effects of Social Security
detail.abstract:
Both historically and today, support of aging parents has largely taken the form of in-kind transfers that require physical proximity, such as housing and caregiving. If Social Security substitutes for such support, it can relax constraints on where recipients' children live and work. We investigate the long-run intergenerational effects of the early Social Security program, exploiting within-occupation, cross-industry differences in coverage and a new dataset linking parents to their children's later-life outcomes. We find that sons whose parents had greater predicted coverage moved farther from their childhood homes, earned more, and lived in better neighborhoods late in life. We find no such effects for daughters, who tended to provide forms of support less easily replaced by Social Security. The gains considerably exceeded the associated Social Security benefits for the average family, with migration to better-matched labor markets a likely key driver. We propose that the early program enabled families to realize gains from migration that were back-loaded, uncertain, and difficult to contract on.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用早期社会保障覆盖的职业-行业差异，发现社会保障通过替代需要物理距离的代际支持（如养老照料），放松了子女的居住和工作地点约束，使儿子（而非女儿）迁移更远、收入更高、居住社区更好，其收益远超社保福利本身，关键在于迁移带来更优的劳动力市场匹配。
AI.research_question: 早期社会保障（Social Security）如何通过替代代际间的实物转移（如住房、照料），影响子女的居住迁移选择和长期经济成果？
AI.motivation: 历史上和如今，赡养年迈父母多以需要物理接近的实物转移（如住房和照料）形式进行。如果社会保障替代了这种支持，就可以缓解子女居住和工作地点的约束。作者旨在探究这一机制的长期间际效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际转移理论、社会保障替代实物代际支持的机制、劳动力市场匹配与迁移决策理论。
AI.method: 利用早期社会保障覆盖在职业内部、行业之间的差异作为外生变异，构建新的父母-子女关联数据集，追踪子女晚年结果，进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）父亲预测覆盖率越高的儿子，离开童年家乡的距离越远、收入越高、晚年居住社区质量越好；（2）对女儿无显著影响，因为女儿更倾向于提供社会保障难以替代的支持形式；（3）迁移至更匹配的劳动力市场是收益的关键驱动因素；（4）平均家庭获得的收益远超其缴纳的社会保障福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示社会保障制度通过替代非正式代际支持，对子女的长期迁移决策和劳动力市场结果产生显著影响，拓展了对社会保障间接福利效应的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社会保障制度的跨代际经济效应提供实证依据，提示政策制定者考虑社会保障对家庭迁移、劳动力配置和代际福利的长期影响。

title: Mind the KF* Gap: EME Vulnerabilities to Global Shocks
affiliations: Loyola University Maryland - Department of Economics, University of Virginia - Darden Business School and Darden Business School

detail.title: Mind the KF* Gap: EME Vulnerabilities to Global Shocks
detail.abstract:
Emerging market economies (EMEs) have historically been vulnerable to external shocks. Recently the global economy has experienced several major shocks yet EMEs have been remarkably resilient. Some of this improved performance can be attributed to prudent policies and stronger economic fundamentals, but the existing literature points to an overperformance mystery by some EMEs with weaker fundamentals. We evaluate an alternative measure of vulnerability based on the concept of a natural level of capital flows (KF*). Specifically, we hypothesize that EMEs are more vulnerable when prior to a large global shock capital flows—portfolio inflows, to be specific—exceed KF*. Results indicate that for major global shocks over the past two decades the pre-shock gap between actual portfolio and KF* has substantial predictive power for the post-shock performance of EMEs.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于资本流动自然水平（KF*）的新脆弱性指标，发现大型全球冲击前实际投资组合流入超过KF*的程度，能显著预测新兴市场经济体在冲击后的表现。
AI.research_question: 如何解释部分基本面较弱的新兴市场经济体在全球冲击后表现异常坚韧（“表现优异之谜”）？是否存在基于资本流动自然水平（KF*）的替代脆弱性指标可以预测冲击后的经济表现？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为新兴市场经济体易受外部冲击，但近年全球经历多次重大冲击后，许多EME表现出超预期韧性，现有文献甚至发现了“表现优异之谜”——部分基本面较弱的EME反而表现更好。这促使作者寻找新的解释机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本流动自然水平（KF*）理论。核心逻辑：当实际资本流入（尤其是投资组合流入）超过其自然水平时，经济体面临过度融资和“热钱”积累，脆弱性上升；冲击前的流入缺口（实际流入-KF*）越大，冲击后调整压力越大，经济表现越差。
AI.method: 实证研究。利用过去二十年重大全球冲击事件（如全球金融危机、新冠疫情等），测度EME在冲击前实际投资组合流入与KF*的缺口，检验该缺口对冲击后经济表现的预测能力。
AI.findings: 冲击前实际投资组合流入与KF*的缺口大小对冲击后EME的经济表现具有显著的预测能力。缺口越大（即资本流入过度），冲击后经济表现越差；反之，缺口越小甚至为负（资本流入不足），冲击后表现更具韧性，这解释了部分基本面较弱但资本流入未过度的EME的“优异表现之谜”。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出并验证了基于资本流动自然水平（KF*）的脆弱性新度量，弥补了传统基本面指标的不足。2. 为“表现优异之谜”提供了理论解释——不是基本面强，而是资本流入未过度。3. 拓展了资本流动与宏观经济脆弱性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了监控EME脆弱性的新工具（KF*缺口），可用于早期预警。2. 提示新兴经济体应关注资本流入是否过度，而非仅关注基本面指标。3. 对资本账户管理和宏观审慎政策具有直接政策含义。

title: From Stocks to Flows: Debt Service and Fiscal Sustainability
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley,  and University Côte d'Azur

detail.title: From Stocks to Flows: Debt Service and Fiscal Sustainability
detail.abstract:
We revisit fiscal sustainability through the lens of the government’s budget constraint. What constrains fiscal policy is not the stock of outstanding liabilities per se, but the fiscal cost of servicing debt. Using two centuries of U.S. fiscal data (1800–2023) and a long-run panel of advanced economies, we show that primary surpluses are systematically more closely associated with debt-service burdens, while debt ratios lose explanatory power when debt service is taken into account. Fiscal responses intensify when financing conditions deteriorate, specifically when the interest-growth differential is positive. We rationalize these findings using a simple flow-based framework in which debt stabilization depends on the responsiveness of fiscal surpluses to financing pressures. The results suggest that fiscal sustainability depends less on debt thresholds than on financing regimes and governments’ ability to absorb debt-service burdens.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两百年美国数据（1800-2023）和发达国家面板数据，提出财政可持续性的核心约束不是债务存量，而是偿债负担（debt-service burden）。研究发现，财政盈余与偿债成本关联更紧密，而债务比率在考虑偿债成本后解释力下降。当融资条件恶化（尤其是利率-增长率差为正）时，财政反应显著增强。结论：财政可持续性更取决于融资体制和政府吸收偿债负担的能力，而非债务阈值。
AI.research_question: 财政可持续性的真正约束是什么？是债务存量本身，还是偿债负担（debt-service burden）？
AI.motivation: 传统文献聚焦于债务/GDP比率等存量指标来评估财政可持续性，但现实中政府的预算约束是流量性的——真正限制财政政策的应是每期需要支付的偿债成本，而非债务总量。作者试图用历史数据和跨国面板验证这一直觉。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政府预算约束下的流量框架（flow-based framework），强调债务稳定取决于财政盈余对融资压力（financing pressures）的反应弹性，核心变量是利率-增长率差（interest-growth differential）。
AI.method: 使用美国1800-2023年两百年财政数据，以及发达经济体的长期面板数据，进行实证分析，比较基础盈余与偿债负担、债务比率之间的关联强度。
AI.findings: （1）基础盈余与偿债负担的系统性关联更强；（2）在加入偿债负担后，债务比率的解释力显著下降；（3）当融资条件恶化（利率-增长率差为正）时，财政反应明显加强；（4）财政可持续性更取决于融资体制和偿债负担吸收能力，而非债务阈值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将财政可持续性分析从存量视角（债务比率）转向流量视角（偿债负担），提出"融资压力反应函数"概念，重新定义了财政约束的本质。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了新的财政可持续性评估指标（偿债负担而非债务比率），提示应关注融资体制和利率-增长动态，而非机械地盯住债务阈值目标。

title: Long Term Care and Cognitive Impairment in Spain
affiliations: London School of Economics, Universitat Pompeu Fabra (UPF), , University of Murcia and Foundation for Applied Economic Research (FEDEA)

detail.title: Long Term Care and Cognitive Impairment in Spain
detail.abstract:
The growing prevalence of cognitive impairment (CI) is one of the main drivers of age-related demand for health and long-term care (LTC). In Spain, CI is estimated to affect 18.5% of Spaniards over 65, and 45.3% in those aged 85 and above. This paper draws on a pooled pre-COVID data from a longitudinal sample of individuals aged 65+ to examine the effect of CI and physical limitations on health and long-term care utilisation, estimates its costs, and financial burden. We report four sets of findings. First, we find that socioeconomic status at older age to be the strongest predictor of CI. Second, while both CI and physical limitations increase health and care adult care use, physical impairment is a stronger predictor of overall care utilisation (73% versus 55% for CI alone) and nursing home residence (2.0% versus 0.9%). Third, informal caregiving constitutes the overwhelming majority of dementia costs, accounting for 69–81% of the total. Finally, we estimate that the replacement cost of informal care would exhaust the full budget of Spain’s LTC system (SAAD).

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用西班牙65岁以上老年人纵向数据，研究了认知障碍（CI）和身体机能限制对医疗与长期护理服务使用、成本及经济负担的影响。主要发现：社会经济地位是CI的最强预测因子；身体限制比CI更能预测整体护理使用（73% vs 55%）和入住养老院（2.0% vs 0.9%）；非正式护理占痴呆症总成本的69-81%；其替代成本将耗尽西班牙长期护理系统的全部预算。
AI.research_question: 认知障碍和身体机能限制如何影响65岁以上老年人的健康与长期护理服务使用、成本及经济负担？
AI.motivation: 认知障碍患病率随人口老龄化不断上升（西班牙65岁以上18.5%，85岁以上45.3%），但其对卫生和长期护理系统造成的经济负担尚缺乏系统量化分析，尤其是非正式护理的成本及其与正式护理系统的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于健康资本需求理论和长期护理服务使用行为模型，分析认知障碍与身体机能限制对正式与非正式护理利用的差异化影响。
AI.method: 利用COVID之前的西班牙65岁以上纵向追踪样本数据，采用多元回归分析估计CI和身体限制对护理利用的影响，并基于替代成本法估算非正式护理的经济成本。
AI.findings: 1）社会经济地位是CI的最强预测因子；2）身体限制比CI更能预测整体护理利用（73% vs 55%）和养老院居住（2.0% vs 0.9%）；3）非正式护理占痴呆症总成本的69-81%；4）非正式护理的替代成本将耗尽西班牙长期护理系统（SAAD）全部预算。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统区分了认知障碍与身体机能限制对长期护理利用的差异化影响机制，为理解两种失能类型的护理需求模式提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了非正式护理在痴呆症照护中的核心地位及其对公共财政的巨大压力，为西班牙及类似老龄化国家的长期护理政策改革（如SAAD预算调整、非正式照护者支持政策）提供了量化依据。

title: What Do Asset Prices in April 2025 Say About Demand for the Dollar?
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley and Princeton University - Bendheim Center for Finance

detail.title: What Do Asset Prices in April 2025 Say About Demand for the Dollar?
detail.abstract:
We interpret exchange rate and yield curve responses to the April 2, 2025 U.S. tariff announcement through the lens of an equilibrium model capturing the portfolio balance mechanism. Disciplined by price elasticities from QE announcements, a 3-12% decline in the demand for dollar bonds (relative to annual U.S. GDP) accounts for the dollar depreciation and rise in dollar yields during this episode. News of a gradual rebalancing out of dollar bonds is consistent with immediate price impact since asset prices are forward-looking. Lower dollar bond demand was accompanied by higher risk aversion, which explains the cross-section of responses across currencies.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用投资组合平衡模型，分析了2025年4月2日美国关税公告对汇率和收益率曲线的影响。研究发现，美元债券需求下降3%-12%（相对于美国年度GDP）可以解释美元贬值和美元收益率上升，同时风险厌恶情绪上升解释了不同货币之间的横截面差异。
AI.research_question: 2025年4月2日美国关税公告如何影响汇率和收益率曲线？背后的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解关税公告这种重大政策事件对全球资产价格（尤其是汇率和债券收益率）的传导机制，以及投资组合再平衡在其中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资组合平衡模型（Portfolio Balance Mechanism），结合量化宽松公告中的价格弹性作为约束条件。
AI.method: 构建一个均衡模型，用量化宽松公告期间的价格弹性来约束模型参数，模拟美元债券需求冲击对汇率和收益率的影响。
AI.findings: 美元债券需求下降3%-12%（相对美国年度GDP）可以解释美元贬值和美元收益率上升；风险厌恶情绪上升解释了不同货币之间的横截面差异；市场预期未来逐步再平衡会立即产生价格影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将投资组合平衡机制应用于关税公告事件分析，证明了该机制在重大政策事件中的解释力；区分了债券需求冲击和风险厌恶情绪在汇率变动中的不同作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者理解关税公告对全球资产价格的传导机制提供了分析框架；对美元资产持有者的风险管理具有重要参考价值。

title: Supply and Demand with Market Heterogeneity
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics, University of Chicago, University of Chicago, University of Chicago and Harvard University

detail.title: Supply and Demand with Market Heterogeneity
detail.abstract:
We revisit the classic identification problem of separating supply and demand for a homogeneous good using data from multiple markets. We allow markets to be heterogeneous according to unobservables, a feature that arises if there are unobservable differences in consumer preferences or firm technology. We develop a new identification analysis based on hypothetical market types. We use this analysis to show how nonparametric, economically motivated assumptions carry empirical restrictions for a wide range of target parameters, including elasticities, but also welfare parameters, such as consumer surplus. Then, we develop computationally tractable methods for implementing partially identified linear random coefficients models in which the slopes of supply and demand are heterogeneous. We apply these methods to estimate the welfare impact and incidence of sales taxes in the United States.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了同质商品供需分离的经典识别问题，允许市场存在不可观测的异质性，发展了基于假设市场类型的非参数识别方法，并应用于估计美国销售税的福利影响和归宿。
AI.research_question: 如何在允许市场存在不可观测异质性（消费者偏好或企业技术差异）的条件下，识别同质商品的供需函数及其相关福利参数？
AI.motivation: 传统供需识别方法通常假设市场同质或依赖工具变量，但现实中市场存在不可观测的异质性，这会导致识别偏差。作者希望发展一套新的识别框架来应对这一挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于假设市场类型（hypothetical market types）的非参数识别分析；线性随机系数模型（linear random coefficients models）的部分识别方法。
AI.method: 提出基于假设市场类型的识别策略，利用非参数、经济激励驱动的假设来推导实证限制；开发计算上可行的部分识别方法，用于估计具有异质性斜率的供需线性随机系数模型；以美国销售税为案例进行实证应用。
AI.findings: 非参数、经济动机假设能够对包括弹性、消费者剩余在内的广泛目标参数施加实证限制；所提出的部分识别方法在计算上可行，可用于估计销售税的福利影响和归宿。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将市场不可观测异质性纳入供需识别的经典框架；2. 发展基于假设市场类型的非参数识别新分析方法；3. 将识别分析从弹性拓展到福利参数（如消费者剩余）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供计算上可行的部分识别方法用于线性随机系数模型；2. 实证估计美国销售税的福利影响和税负归宿，为税收政策评估提供方法论支持。

title: Women in the Platform Economy: Descriptive Evidence from Drivers in India and Indonesia
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD), IDinsight, IDinsight, IDinsight, Independent, Independent, IDinsight, IDinsight and IDinsight

detail.title: Women in the Platform Economy: Descriptive Evidence from Drivers in India and Indonesia
detail.abstract:
We provide descriptive evidence on women's experiences in platform-based driving and delivery work using survey and administrative data from India and Indonesia. Partnering with major two-wheeler platforms, we study representative samples of drivers, oversampling women to examine gender differences (India: 404 women, 2,153 men; Indonesia: 892 women, 2,114 men). Female participation is extremely low -- 0.8% in India and 1.5% in Indonesia -- consistent with barriers related to safety concerns, cultural norms, and limited access to required assets. Among women who do enter, platform work is used differently than by men: women work fewer hours, are more likely to log in during free time, and place greater value on flexibility and supplemental earnings. Women earn less per hour than men -- by 6-8% in India and 8-22% in Indonesia -- differences that align with gendered choices over working times, locations, and service types, likely shaped by safety and domestic constraints. Women also face distinct challenges: higher reported harassment in both countries and, in Indonesia, widespread customer discrimination and higher accident rates. At the same time, a disproportionate share of women were unemployed before joining the platform, and women are more likely than men to report higher current earnings relative to prior work. Together, the evidence highlights how flexibility coexists with persistent gender-specific risks, constraints, and unequal returns in location-based platform work in low- and middle-income country contexts.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用印度和印度尼西亚的平台调查与行政数据，研究了女性在基于位置的平台驾驶与配送工作中的经历。研究发现女性参与率极低（印度0.8%，印尼1.5%），且面临安全担忧、文化规范、资产获取限制等多重障碍。女性工作时长更短、更看重灵活性和补充收入，但时薪低于男性6-22%，同时面临更高的骚扰、歧视和事故风险。
AI.research_question: 在印度和印度尼西亚的低收入与中等收入国家背景下，女性在基于位置的平台驾驶和配送工作中面临怎样的性别差异、参与障碍以及收益与风险？
AI.motivation: 平台经济常被宣传为能够为女性提供灵活就业机会，但关于女性在平台工作中的实际经历，尤其是在低收入和中等收入国家背景下的系统性描述证据不足。本研究旨在填补这一空白，提供关于女性参与率、工作模式、收入差距以及面临的具体挑战的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别与劳动市场分层理论、工作灵活性理论、安全与空间限制理论、平台经济的双重性（灵活性与风险并存）
AI.method: 使用调查数据和行政数据，与印度和印尼的两大两轮车平台合作，抽取代表性司机样本（印度：404名女性、2153名男性；印尼：892名女性、2114名男性），对女性进行过度抽样以分析性别差异。
AI.findings: 1）女性参与率极低（印度0.8%，印尼1.5%），障碍包括安全担忧、文化规范、资产获取限制。2）女性工作时长更短、更常在空闲时间登录、更看重灵活性和补充收入。3）女性时薪低于男性6-22%，差异与性别化的工作时间、地点和服务类型选择相关，这些选择受安全和家庭约束影响。4）女性面临更高骚扰报告、客户歧视和更高事故率。5）女性在加入平台前失业比例更高，且更可能报告当前收入高于之前工作。
AI.theory_contributions: 为平台经济中的性别不平等提供了来自低收入和中等收入国家的新证据，揭示了灵活性如何与持续的性别风险、约束和不平等回报并存，拓展了关于平台劳动性别分层的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台企业、政策制定者和国际发展机构提供了关于如何改善女性在平台工作中的安全、减少歧视和缩小收入差距的实证依据，有助于设计更具包容性的平台政策和干预措施。

title: Housing Price Downward Rigidity in Korea: An Empirical Analysis of Dual Administrative Prices

detail.title: Housing Price Downward Rigidity in Korea: An Empirical Analysis of Dual Administrative Prices

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study used publicly available administrative and market transaction data and did not involve human participants. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This study examines the relationship between Korea’s dual administrative prices—Official Housing Prices (OHP) and Official Land Prices (OLP)—and housing price downward rigidity. Previous studies have primarily explained housing price downward rigidity through behavioral and market microstructure perspectives, including loss aversion, reservation prices, information asymmetry, and thin market conditions. However, relatively limited attention has been paid to the role of administrative prices in housing market adjustment processes. To address this issue, this study constructs a long-run panel dataset tracking the same apartment complexes from 2006 to 2025. The dataset simultaneously includes Market Sale Prices (MSP), Official Housing Prices (OHP), and Official Land Prices (OLP), covering 44 apartment complexes and 880 apartment-year observations. The empirical results show substantial differences between market prices and administrative prices during housing market downturns. While MSP declined significantly during downturn periods, OHP exhibited only limited downward adjustment and OLP continued to record positive growth. The average growth rates of OHP were +6.87% during expansion periods and −1.70% during downturn periods, whereas OLP recorded average growth rates of +6.02% and +4.37%, respectively. The analysis further shows that overall ratchet intensity reached 72.3%, with stronger ratchet patterns observed in active markets (87.0%) than in thin markets (68.5%). In addition, asymmetric OHP adjustment patterns were observed in 42 of the 44 apartment complexes (95.5%), while persistent OLP rigidity was observed in 38 complexes (86.4%). Lagged correlation analysis revealed a significant positive relationship between past MSP movements and subsequent OHP adjustments (r = 0.626, p < 0.01), whereas the reverse relationship was statistically insignificant. Overall, the findings indicate that administrative prices exhibit adjustment patterns that differ from those observed in market prices during housing market downturns. The results suggest that housing price downward rigidity in Korea may be associated not only with behavioral factors and market conditions, but also with persistent differences between market prices and administrative prices.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2006-2025年韩国44个公寓小区880个观测值的面板数据，发现官方住房价格和官方土地价格在市场下行期间存在显著向下刚性，且棘轮效应强度达72.3%，表明行政价格是解释房价下行刚性的重要因素。
AI.research_question: 韩国的双重行政价格（官方住房价格和官方土地价格）与房价下行刚性之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 以往研究主要从行为和市场微观结构角度解释房价下行刚性，但对行政价格在住房市场调整过程中的作用关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 房价下行刚性理论、棘轮效应、行政价格与市场价格差异理论
AI.method: 构建2006-2025年长期面板数据集，涵盖44个公寓小区、880个公寓-年观测值，同时包含市场销售价格、官方住房价格和官方土地价格；采用相关性分析、滞后相关分析等方法。
AI.findings: （1）市场下行期间，市场销售价格显著下降，但官方住房价格仅有限调整，官方土地价格仍保持正增长；（2）官方住房价格在扩张期平均增长+6.87%，下行期仅-1.70%；官方土地价格分别为+6.02%和+4.37%；（3）整体棘轮强度达72.3%，活跃市场（87.0%）高于冷清市场（68.5%）；（4）95.5%的公寓小区呈现不对称调整，86.4%呈现持续性土地价格刚性；（5）过去市场销售价格变动显著正向预测后续官方住房价格调整（r=0.626），反向关系不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行政价格纳入房价下行刚性的解释框架，补充了以往仅关注行为因素和市场条件的理论视角，揭示了行政价格作为房价下行刚性新机制的理论价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解韩国住房市场价格机制、评估行政定价体系的影响、以及设计更有效的住房市场调控政策提供实证依据。

title: Apportionment and a Gini Coefficient for the U.S. House

detail.title: Apportionment and a Gini Coefficient for the U.S. House

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: The U.S. House of Representatives has what we will call a representational Gini coefficient of 0.0213, computed by treating each seat as a notional share of national output and measuring per-capita representation across states. Wyoming citizens hold the equivalent of $116,000 in representation; Delawareans, $68,000. This dispersion arises almost entirely from the 1929 statutory cap on House size rather than from the integer or one-seat-minimum constraints in the Constitution: holding the apportionment method fixed, the representational Gini falls as the number of seats rises, and roughly 98 percent of the current value is attributable to the cap. At a House of about 1,200 (the 1929 representation ratio) the representational Gini is 62 percent lower; at 692 seats (the cube-root figure) it is 36 percent lower; at the roughly 11,000 seats implied by Madison's one-per-30,000 proposal it is essentially zero. The level of representational inequality in the modern House is thus a function of a statutory parameter rather than a constitutional one.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建"代表性基尼系数"，量化分析了美国众议院席位分配中的不平等问题，发现当前不平等几乎完全源于1929年设定的众议院规模法定上限（435席），而非宪法约束。若恢复1929年的代表比例（约1200席），不平等程度可降低62%。
AI.research_question: 美国众议院席位分配中的代表权不平等程度有多大？这种不平等主要源于宪法约束还是法定上限？
AI.motivation: 传统研究关注选区划分不公（gerrymandering），但较少量化分析众议院规模固定化导致的系统性代表权不平等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代表性基尼系数（Representational Gini Coefficient）；基于各州人均代表权（per-capita representation）的分配不平等测量。
AI.method: 构建代表性基尼系数，将每个席位视为国家产出的名义份额，测量各州人均代表权的差异。通过反事实分析，比较不同众议院规模下的基尼系数变化。
AI.findings: 当前代表性基尼系数为0.0213；怀俄明州居民代表权（$116,000）远高于特拉华州（$68,000）；约98%的不平等归因于1929年的435席上限；若增至1200席，不平等降低62%；若按麦迪逊每3万人一席的方案（约11,000席），不平等几乎为零。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"代表性基尼系数"这一量化工具，将收入不平等测量方法引入代表权分配研究；区分了宪法约束与法定参数对政治不平等的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示众议院规模法定上限是代表权不平等的根源，为改革提供了明确的政策杠杆——扩大众议院规模可显著降低不平等，且无需修宪。

title: Social Insurance with Imperfect Eligibility Screening: Theory and Evidence from Pandemic UI
affiliations: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Tax Analysis (OTA), George Washington University and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia

detail.title: Social Insurance with Imperfect Eligibility Screening: Theory and Evidence from Pandemic UI
detail.abstract:
This paper studies social insurance with imperfect eligibility screening, focusing on Unemployment Insurance (UI) during its expansion in 2020 and 2021. We study the extent of imperfect screening by identifying anomalous payments using administrative tax data and UI policies, finding $214 billion in potentially-improper payments—concentrated in the Pandemic Unemployment Assistance (PUA) program—with approximately half detectable ex-ante through improved federal-state data sharing. There is substantial geographic variation, and a border design shows this is partly due to policy decisions made by states. To assess the implications for optimal policy, we first conduct simulations that replace PUA with means-tested, lump-sum transfers, finding that these transfers would have better insured against income losses at lower administrative cost. Second, we develop a model of opt-in versus automatic transfers that shows the targeting advantage of opt-in programs can reverse when ineligible recipients pass the benefit screen. Calibrated to 2020 UI, the model implies that shifting toward automatic transfers would have increased social welfare.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2020-2021年UI扩张期间因资格筛查不完善导致的2140亿美元潜在不当支付，发现PUA项目问题集中，并探讨了通过改善联邦-州数据共享、转向自动转移支付等方式优化政策的路径。
AI.research_question: 失业保险资格筛查不完善的程度如何？如何通过政策设计改进社会失业保险的效率和福利效果？
AI.motivation: 2020-2021年UI大规模扩张期间出现了大量不当支付，动机在于量化这一问题的规模、识别其来源，并为最优政策设计提供理论和实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: "opt-in"（自愿申请）与自动转移支付的社会福利比较模型；最优保险理论；资格筛查的成本-收益分析。
AI.method: 使用行政税务数据和UI政策识别异常支付；边界设计识别州级政策差异的影响；模拟分析比较PUA与定向转移支付；构建理论模型比较opt-in与自动转移机制。
AI.findings: 发现2140亿美元潜在不当支付，集中在PUA项目；约一半可通过联邦-州数据共享事先避免；存在显著地理差异且部分源于州政策选择；定向转移支付能以更低行政成本提供更好保障；当不合格者通过筛查时，opt-in项目的瞄准优势会逆转，转向自动转移可提高社会福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了资格筛查不完善情境下opt-in与自动转移支付机制的社会福利比较新结论，即opt-in的瞄准优势在不合格者通过筛查时可能逆转。
AI.practical_contributions: 为失业保险设计提供了实证证据和政策建议，包括改善联邦-州数据共享、考虑用定向转移支付替代部分UI项目、转向自动转移机制等。

title: Modeling Office and Retail Rents with Explainable Spatio-Temporal Machine Learning
affiliations: University of Basel, Fahrländer Partner Raumentwicklung, Fahrländer Partner Raumentwicklung, ETH Zürich and Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts

detail.title: Modeling Office and Retail Rents with Explainable Spatio-Temporal Machine Learning
detail.abstract: Accurate modeling of commercial rents is essential for understanding property values, investment incentives, and urban development dynamics. Standard hedonic models typically assume a linear effect of, potentially transformed, covariates and ignore any unaccounted dependence across space and time. In this paper, we develop a hybrid statistical machine learning approach for commercial real estate rent modeling that combines gradient tree-boosting with Gaussian process (GP) random effects. We use a non-separable spatio-temporal covariance structure, allowing spatial and temporal dependence to interact, thereby providing a more realistic representation of rental dynamics. Using a nationwide dataset of office and retail rental listings in Germany, we compare the predictive performance of the proposed model with linear hedonic models, linear GP models, and standalone boosting approaches. The proposed hybrid model consistently achieves the highest out-of-sample predictive accuracy. At the same time, the results highlight important differences across market segments: spatial dependence plays a substantially stronger role in the retail market, where even linear GP models outperform standalone boosting approaches. In addition, we construct a SHAP-based location score that aggregates the contribution of observable locational covariates and complement it with GP random effects capturing latent, spatially continuous variation. This decomposition provides an econometrically interpretable separation between observed and unobserved location effects, offering new insights into how measurable amenities and latent spatial processes jointly determine commercial rents.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种混合统计机器学习方法，将梯度树提升与高斯过程随机效应相结合，用于商业地产租金建模。使用非可分离的时空协方差结构，在德国全国办公和零售租赁数据集上，该混合模型在预测准确性上优于线性特征模型、线性高斯过程模型和单独提升方法。研究还构建了基于SHAP的位置评分，分离了可观测与不可观测的位置效应。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够同时捕捉非线性协变量效应和复杂时空依赖性的商业地产租金预测模型？
AI.motivation: 标准特征模型假设协变量线性效应且忽略时空依赖性，无法准确刻画商业地产租金的复杂动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 梯度树提升（捕捉非线性效应）、高斯过程随机效应（捕捉时空依赖性）、非可分离时空协方差结构、SHAP可解释性方法。
AI.method: 混合模型：梯度树提升 + 高斯过程随机效应，采用非可分离时空协方差结构，在德国全国办公和零售租赁数据集上进行实证比较。
AI.findings: (1) 混合模型在预测准确性上始终优于线性特征模型、线性高斯过程模型和单独提升方法；(2) 零售市场中空间依赖性的作用显著大于办公市场；(3) 零售市场中，即使线性高斯过程模型也优于单独提升方法；(4) SHAP位置评分有效分离了可观测与不可观测位置效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将梯度树提升与高斯过程随机效应融合，提出一种可解释的混合时空建模框架；引入非可分离时空协方差结构到商业地产租金模型中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商业地产估值提供更高精度的租金预测工具；通过SHAP位置评分分离可观测与不可观测位置效应，为投资者和政策制定者提供更透明的区位价值分解。

title: Neo-conglomerates and EU regulatory perimeter challenges – state of play and evaluation of policy options
affiliations: European Central Bank,  and

detail.title: Neo-conglomerates and EU regulatory perimeter challenges – state of play and evaluation of policy options
detail.abstract: This paper examines the implications of the provision, in the European Union, of bank-like services, including payment services, by large non‑bank groups (i.e. groups that do not comprise entities with a banking licence), and evaluates policy options to address the emergence of so-called neo-conglomerates by recalibrating the regulatory perimeter. Drawing on five EU case studies (a messaging app white‑label arrangement, a complex multi‑partner “super‑app” model, a systemic payment group, a borderless financial technology firm (fintech) and a bank) – this paper illustrates how financial services may be delivered through digital unbundling and re-bundling, embedded distribution and white‑label partnerships. It maps the business models, licensing structures, fintech partnership chains and data frictions that may obscure group‑wide risks and complicate home‑host supervisory cooperation. The cases were included for illustrative purposes only, and implying no judgement at all on the soundness or governance of the firms concerned, nor on the effectiveness or adequacy of the actions taken by the relevant supervisory authorities. The paper also identifies potential “blind spots” in the regulatory frameworks applicable at the time of writing and misalignments in prudential, conduct and operational objectives. Building on guidance from standard‑setting bodies and international organisations on supervisory approaches to financial innovation, fintech and Big Tech, the paper identifies four priority areas for consideration, with a view to limit regulatory arbitrage and systemic interdependencies, while at the same time preserving innovation. [...]

AI.tldr: 本文研究欧盟境内大型非银行集团提供银行类服务（如支付服务）的监管影响，通过五个案例（消息应用白标安排、多伙伴超级应用、系统性支付集团、无国界金融科技公司及传统银行）分析数字解绑与再绑定的商业模式，识别监管盲区，并提出四个优先政策领域以限制监管套利与系统性依赖，同时保持创新空间。
AI.research_question: 欧盟境内大型非银行集团提供银行类服务（如支付服务）时，现有监管框架存在哪些盲点与错位？如何通过重新校准监管边界来应对新兴"新 conglomerates"（neo-conglomerates）带来的挑战？
AI.motivation: 大型非银行集团（如科技公司、金融科技企业）越来越多地提供传统银行类服务，但缺乏银行牌照，导致现有监管框架可能无法充分覆盖其集团层面的风险，存在监管套利和系统性风险隐患。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字解绑与再绑定（digital unbundling and re-bundling）、嵌入式金融（embedded finance）、白标合作（white-label partnerships）、监管边界校准（regulatory perimeter recalibration）、集团层面风险识别（group-wide risk identification）
AI.method: 五个欧盟案例研究：消息应用白标安排、复杂多伙伴超级应用模型、系统性支付集团、无国界金融科技公司、传统银行。通过映射商业模式、牌照结构、金融科技合作伙伴链和数据摩擦来识别监管盲点。
AI.findings: 现有监管框架存在"盲点"：商业模式、牌照结构、合作伙伴链和数据摩擦可能掩盖集团层面的风险，并复杂化母国-东道国监管合作；审慎、行为和运营目标之间存在错位；需在限制监管套利和系统性依赖的同时保持创新。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地将"数字解绑与再绑定"等商业模式概念纳入监管框架分析；提出"新 conglomerates"这一概念以描述大型非银行集团提供银行类服务的新现象；识别监管盲点的具体类型（商业模式、牌照结构、合作伙伴链、数据摩擦）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟及国际监管机构提供四个优先政策领域建议，以限制监管套利和系统性依赖；为监管机构重新校准监管边界提供案例基础和分析框架；对国际标准制定机构和组织的金融创新监管指导进行补充。

title: Oil Price Uncertainty and Financial Statement Comparability
affiliations: University of Texas Rio Grande Valley (UTRGV) (Formerly University of Texas-Pan American), Valdosta State University and Morgan State University

detail.title: Oil Price Uncertainty and Financial Statement Comparability
detail.abstract: This study examines the effect of oil price uncertainty (OPU) on financial statement comparability. We find that OPU is significantly negatively associated with multiple proxies of comparability, suggesting that heightened oil market uncertainty impairs the consistency and alignment of firms’ financial reporting practices. We further show that the effect is asymmetric and shock-dependent. Uncertainty during oil price declines and supply-driven shocks reduces comparability, whereas uncertainty associated with oil price increases and demand-driven shocks enhances comparability, implying that underlying economic conditions and incentive structures jointly determine reporting alignment. The results are robust to entropy balancing, instrumental variable (IV), and difference-in-differences (DiD) approaches, alternative OPU measures, additional macroeconomic controls, and controls for the financial crisis and COVID-19 period. Overall, this study extends the literature by identifying commodity price uncertainty as an important macroeconomic determinant of financial reporting comparability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了石油价格不确定性（OPU）对财务报表可比性的影响，发现OPU显著降低可比性，且该效应具有非对称性，取决于油价涨跌和供需冲击类型。
AI.research_question: 石油价格不确定性如何影响企业的财务报表可比性？
AI.motivation: 已有文献较少关注大宗商品价格不确定性这一宏观经济因素如何影响企业财务报告的可比性，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不确定性理论、财务报告可比性理论、非对称冲击理论
AI.method: 采用多元回归分析，结合熵平衡法、工具变量法（IV）和双重差分法（DiD）进行因果识别，并进行了多种稳健性检验。
AI.findings: OPU与财务报告可比性显著负相关；油价下跌和供给驱动冲击下的不确定性降低可比性，而油价上涨和需求驱动冲击下的不确定性则增强可比性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将大宗商品价格不确定性识别为影响财务报告可比性的重要宏观经济决定因素，拓展了可比性影响因素的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、分析师和监管者理解能源市场波动如何影响财务报告质量提供了实证依据，有助于改善决策和监管。

title: Quantifying the Effectiveness of Electricity Demand Flexibility Programs: Evidence from Switzerland
affiliations: University of Konstanz - Faculty of Economics and Statistics, Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology and Swiss Federal Institute for Forest, Snow and Landscape Research WSL

detail.title: Quantifying the Effectiveness of Electricity Demand Flexibility Programs: Evidence from Switzerland
detail.abstract: Demand flexibility programs are a promising solution for balancing residential electricity demand and renewable electricity supply but projecting their effectiveness requires an in-depth understanding of how many and which households participate and under which conditions. We use data from a nationwide survey of 1,772 tenants from different regions of Switzerland to predict how effective flexibility programs would be at shifting daily peaks in domestic electricity demand. Combining an econometric estimation of households' compensation expectations in exchange for electricity demands restrictions with data on their appliance ownership and usage patterns demonstrates a substantial potential of flexibility programs for managing residential electricity demand. For Switzerland as a whole, we estimate that one to four terawatt-hours of residential electricity demand could be shifted away from daily peaks over the course of one year at a cost of between 23 million and 2 billion Swiss francs. We evaluate program efficiency and highlight alternative solutions.

AI.tldr: 基于瑞士全国1772名租户调查数据，结合经济计量估计与家电使用模式，评估需求弹性项目在转移住宅用电日高峰方面的潜力，预计每年可转移1-4太瓦时，成本在2300万至20亿瑞士法郎之间。
AI.research_question: 有多少家庭、哪些家庭在何种条件下会参与需求弹性项目？这些项目对转移住宅用电日高峰的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 需求弹性项目是平衡住宅用电需求与可再生能源供给的有前景方案，但预测其有效性需要深入理解家庭参与情况与条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济计量估计（ households' compensation expectations）、需求弹性理论
AI.method: 基于瑞士全国1772名租户调查数据，结合经济计量估计家庭补偿期望与家电拥有及使用模式数据。
AI.findings: 瑞士全国每年可转移1-4太瓦时住宅用电日高峰，成本在2300万至20亿瑞士法郎之间。
AI.theory_contributions: 将家庭补偿期望的经济计量估计与家电使用数据相结合，量化了需求弹性项目的潜在效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和电力公司评估需求弹性项目的效率及替代方案提供了实证依据。

title: Resource-led Development in Transition: A Comprehensive Analysis of Namibia's Path toward Inclusive and Sustainable Growth

detail.title: Resource-led Development in Transition: A Comprehensive Analysis of Namibia's Path toward Inclusive and Sustainable Growth
detail.abstract: This study presents a comprehensive analysis of Namibia's economic development trajectory, examining the intersection of resource-led growth, environmental sustainability, and inclusive development. By extending Amavilah's analytical framework through the incorporation of environmental dynamics and local economic participation mechanisms, we develop an integrated model of sustainable resourceled development. Our findings indicate that successful transition from traditional extractive industries to clean energy minerals requires simultaneous advancement along three dimensions: institutional capacity, local economic participation, and environmental sustainability. Using three decades of post-independence data and comprehensive mathematical modeling, we demonstrate that properly structured resource-led development can support inclusive growth while maintaining environmental integrity. The paper contributes to development economics literature by providing both theoretical foundations and empirical evidence for analyzing resourcedependent economies in transition, while offering practical policy recommendations with detailed implementation frameworks and cost-benefit analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文通过扩展Amavilah分析框架，构建了可持续资源主导型发展的综合模型，利用纳米比亚独立后三十年数据，论证了制度能力、地方经济参与和环境可持续性三个维度的协同推进是实现从传统采掘业向清洁能源矿产转型的关键，为资源依赖型经济体的包容性增长提供了理论与实证支持。
AI.research_question: 资源依赖型经济体如何通过制度能力、地方经济参与和环境可持续性的协同发展，实现从传统采掘业向清洁能源矿产的成功转型，并达成包容性增长与环境可持续性？
AI.motivation: 资源依赖型经济体面临"资源诅咒"与环境退化的双重困境，亟需探索一条既能实现经济增长又能维持环境完整性的发展路径，而现有理论框架未能充分整合环境动态与地方经济参与机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展的Amavilah分析框架，整合了环境动态与地方经济参与机制，构建了可持续资源主导型发展的三维模型（制度能力、地方经济参与、环境可持续性）。
AI.method: 基于纳米比亚独立后三十年数据，结合综合数学建模方法进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 从传统采掘业向清洁能源矿产的成功转型需要制度能力、地方经济参与和环境可持续性三个维度的协同推进；得当的资源主导型发展可以在维持环境完整性的同时支持包容性增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展经济学文献提供了分析转型中资源依赖型经济体的理论基础和实证证据，扩展了既有分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了实用的政策建议，包括详细的实施框架和成本效益分析。

title: Does Domain Preference Explain Gender Gaps in Self-Evaluation?
affiliations: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (RPI) and University of Exeter

detail.title: Does Domain Preference Explain Gender Gaps in Self-Evaluation?
detail.abstract: We study whether the estimated gender gaps in confidence and self-evaluation in male-stereotyped domains are mitigated when accounting for domain preference. We run a near-replication of Exley and Kessler (2022) where participants can additionally reveal their preference for a math & science domain. All participants then complete a math & science test and provide selfevaluations. We replicate the findings of Exley and Kessler (2022) where women have lower confidence and provide harsher self-evaluations compared to equally performing men. We additionally report two novel results. First, we find that men indicate a stronger preference for a math & science domain than women do, even controlling for ability. Second, we show that controlling for this domain preference gap does not mitigate the gender gaps in confidence and self-evaluation. Our findings are consistent with an interpretation that other characteristics of the domain itself (e.g., task stereotypes) may be primary drivers of these observed gender gaps.

AI.tldr: 本研究复制了Exley & Kessler (2022)的实验，发现男性比女性更偏好数学与科学领域，但控制这一偏好差异后，性别在自信和自我评价上的差距并未缩小。这表明领域本身的特征（如任务刻板印象）可能是性别差距的主要驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 在男性刻板化领域中，考虑领域偏好后，性别在自信和自我评价方面的差距是否会缩小？
AI.motivation: 以往研究（Exley & Kessler, 2022）发现女性在男性刻板化领域自信更低、自我评价更严苛，但未考察领域偏好的作用。本研究旨在检验领域偏好能否解释这一性别差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别差异理论、刻板印象威胁理论、自我评价偏差理论
AI.method: 近复制实验设计：参与者可额外表明对数学与科学领域的偏好，随后完成数学与科学测试并进行自我评价。
AI.findings: （1）复制了Exley & Kessler (2022)的发现：女性自信更低、自我评价更严苛；（2）男性比女性更偏好数学与科学领域，即使控制能力后仍存在；（3）控制领域偏好后，性别在自信和自我评价上的差距并未缓解。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了领域偏好不能解释性别自信与自我评价差距，支持了任务刻板印象等领域特征作为主要驱动因素的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示在干预性别自信差距时，应关注领域刻板印象而非仅调整个人偏好；对教育和职场中性别平等的实践有参考意义。

title: A First Discussion of Power and Value in International Relations from a Generative Relational Perspective

detail.title: A First Discussion of Power and Value in International Relations from a Generative Relational Perspective
detail.abstract:
Theories of international politics measure power, aggregate it, and ask what follows from its
distribution. They seldom ask why there is any. Power admits of derivation. A process that
generates must differentiate, since a generation that leaves the world indistinguishable from
what it was has generated nothing; what it differentiates includes the capacity to supply the
terms on which coordination proceeds; and a relation whose terms are supplied by one of
its parties is a relation with a direction. Asymmetry is therefore a condition of relations in
which something is made, rather than a corruption of them, and it resists removal that leaves
generation standing. The question of justice cannot then be how to eliminate asymmetry,
and becomes instead what the asymmetry does to the relation in which it stands.
Answering that question in international politics runs into an obstacle that the available
frameworks do not meet. A state supplies technology and receives recognition, supplies
a guarantee and receives basing rights. Between such goods there is no ratio, and for the
account to close, something must be made to count as repayment for something of another
kind. That operation requires a rate, and the rate is not given by the values it settles. It is
posited, and there is no correct one. Three evasions are closed. Monetisation performs the
conversion it claims to avoid; categorial separation forbids the question it claims to answer;
subjective satisfaction consults the effect of the rate as the test of the rate.
That the setting of a common metric among unlike things is a mode of power belongs to the
sociology of commensuration and is inherited here rather than claimed. But that literature
theorises the boundary: a metric advances upon a sphere held apart from it, and resistance
takes the form of refusing the metric outright. Refusal presupposes a position from which
one may withdraw and remain what one was. A state that cannot withdraw without ceas-
ing to count as a party has no such position, and is settled against notwithstanding its objec-
tion. Where refusal is foreclosed, commensuration ceases to be a contested boundary and
becomes a constitutive condition of the relation, so that the international case is not one
further instance of the sociological phenomenon but its limit, at which the phenomenon
changes character.
Two consequences follow. The colony whose material ledger runs positive, a case on which
generative justice, unequal exchange, and the sociology of commensuration are alike silent,
is diagnosed: the injustice lies neither in the flow nor in the unfairness of the rate but in
the foreclosure of any position from which the rate might be reopened. And the normative
condition of a settlement is located in the contestability of its rate, which is not a procedu-
ralist retreat but the residue of resistance once refusal has been foreclosed. The argument
surrenders the classical vocabulary of exploitation, which requires a common measure that
the goods of international politics do not admit. The paper closes on the question it does
not answer, which is who reorganises a loop from which no party may withdraw.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨国际政治中权力的产生本质，认为不对称是生成性关系的必然条件而非腐败，并提出国际政治中的通约问题是权力运作的核心，殖民地的正向物质差额恰恰揭示了不公正的根源在于无法重新打开兑换比率的位置被剥夺。
AI.research_question: 国际政治中权力的不对称如何产生？这种不对称在缺乏共同度量标准的情况下如何运作？以及在这种条件下，公正意味着什么？
AI.motivation: 现有国际政治理论衡量和加总权力，但很少追问权力从何而来。本文试图填补这一空白，揭示权力生成与不对称的必然关系，并挑战传统剥削理论在国际政治中的适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生成性不对称理论、通约社会学（commensuration）、殖民主义批判、规范性政治理论
AI.method: 概念分析、逻辑推演、批判性理论建构，通过对通约（commensuration）概念的重新审视，提出国际政治作为通约社会学的极限案例。
AI.findings: 1. 不对称是生成性关系的条件而非腐败；2. 国际政治中不同质的物品（如技术、承认、安全保障）之间不存在可比性比率，比率是被设定的而非由价值给定；3. 货币化、范畴分离、主观满足三种逃避方式均不成立；4. 国际政治中的通约不再是边界争论，而成为关系的构成性条件；5. 殖民地的正向物质差额中，不公正在于无法重新打开兑换比率，而非流量或不公平本身。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将通约社会学的边界理论推进至极限案例，揭示了国际政治中通约从"争论的边界"变为"构成性条件"的质变；2. 放弃了传统剥削理论的词汇，提出基于比率可争议性的规范性条件；3. 对殖民地正向物质差额提供了新的诊断框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际政治中的不对称关系提供了一种新的公正评判标准——不在于消除不对称或追求公平比率，而在于当事人是否有能力重新打开比率的设定。

title: An Efficient Uncertainty-Gated Mixed Residual Targeting Strategy for Continuous Optimization
affiliations: Northwest A&F University

detail.title: An Efficient Uncertainty-Gated Mixed Residual Targeting Strategy for Continuous Optimization
detail.abstract: Continuous black-box and engineering design optimization require methods that use a fixed function-evaluation budget effectively, not only by improving final solution quality but also by limiting computational overhead and unstable search behavior. Elite-guided target construction in success-history differential evolution provides strong exploitation, but atomic elite targets may contract too early, whereas distributional or residual guidance can be unreliable when used indiscriminately. This paper proposes uncertainty-gated mixed residual targeting (UGMRT), an efficient target-construction strategy within a success-history DE framework. UGMRT forms an attention-weighted virtual elite mean, measures elite residual uncertainty, activates residual targeting only when uncertainty and stagnation jointly indicate that reorientation is useful, and adaptively mixes raw and orthogonal residual guidance. The evaluation combines CEC2017/2020/2022 benchmark functions, a same-family DE/SHADE stress test, constrained engineering design problems, runtime analysis, and controlled ablation. On 102 CEC cases, UGMRT obtains the best overall average rank among the reported cross-family comparator set and is significantly better than each selected cross-family competitor under Friedman-Holm analysis. In the same-family DE/SHADE stress test, UGMRT ranks second by final-objective average rank behind jSO, but obtains the best average time rank and the second-largest Top-3 count. On eight engineering cases, it reaches the best or equivalent-best mean on seven cases, with saturated tied optima interpreted conservatively. The controlled ablation supports a consistent but statistically non-significant trend in favor of the complete mechanism. Overall, the evidence supports UGMRT as a robust soft-computing optimization strategy with a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off, rather than as an accuracy-dominant replacement for the strongest same-family competitors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为UGMRT的不确定性门控混合残差目标构建策略，用于成功历史差分进化框架，在102个CEC基准测试和8个工程优化问题中表现出良好的精度-效率权衡。
AI.research_question: 如何在固定函数评估预算下，在连续黑箱与工程优化中实现高效且稳定的目标构建策略？
AI.motivation: 精英引导的目标构建在成功历史差分进化中具有较强的利用能力，但原子精英目标可能过早收缩，而分布性或残差引导若不加区分地使用则不可靠，需要一种更鲁棒、自适应的目标构建方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成功历史差分进化（SHADE）框架；不确定性门控机制；混合残差目标构建；注意加权虚拟精英均值；正交残差引导。
AI.method: 提出UGMRT策略，构建注意加权的虚拟精英均值，测量精英残差不确定性，仅当不确定性和停滞共同指示重定向有用时激活残差引导，并自适应混合原始残差与正交残差引导。在CEC2017/2020/2022基准函数、同族DE/SHADE压力测试、约束工程优化问题、运行时间分析和消融实验上进行评估。
AI.findings: 在102个CEC案例中，UGMRT获得跨族比较器中最佳整体平均排名，Friedman-Holm检验显示显著优于各跨族竞争者。同族压力测试中按最终目标平均排名位列第二，但获得最佳平均时间排名。8个工程案例中7个达到最佳或等效最佳均值。消融实验支持完整机制的一致性趋势（未达统计显著）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出不确定性门控的混合残差目标构建机制，为差分进化中的目标构建提供了自适应调节利用与探索的新理论思路。
AI.practical_contributions: UGMRT在精度-效率权衡上表现出色，适合固定预算下的连续黑箱优化和工程设计优化，计算开销低且搜索行为稳定。

title: Work-related Anger Triggers and Negative Outcomes in Public Administration: An Exploratory Analysis of Differential Predictors
affiliations: Berlin School of Economics and Law and Berlin School of Economics and Law

detail.title: Work-related Anger Triggers and Negative Outcomes in Public Administration: An Exploratory Analysis of Differential Predictors

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n.a.
declarations.ethicsApproval: n.a.
declarations.funderStatement: no funding

detail.abstract: Employees in public administration operate in complex organisational and political environments that may elicit anger. Drawing on Affective Events Theory, this exploratory study examines whether domain-specific anger trigger tendencies (i.e., anger reactivity to typical work situations) are differentially associated with negative work-related outcomes and whether coping adds incremental explanatory value. We surveyed 169 employees from Berlin-based federal and state authorities. Anger trigger tendencies were assessed across seven domains (political fit, red tape/procedural constraint, IT hassles, work-non-work boundary violations, task demands, distributive injustice in equipment/workload allocation, and social interaction). Outcomes were measured with single items capturing motivation loss, dissatisfaction, turnover intention, work-to-home spillover, and impaired collegial relations. Hierarchical regressions (effective N = 153) revealed differentiated associations: task-related anger predicted motivation loss and dissatisfaction; distributive injustice was most strongly associated with spillover; and social interaction-related anger predicted impaired collegial relations. Coping indicators did not add incremental explanatory value. Distinguishing anger trigger domains may help to explain specific negative outcomes in public administration and inform targeted organisational interventions.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于情感事件理论，调查了公共行政员工在七个特定领域的愤怒触发倾向与五种负面工作结果的关系。结果显示，不同领域的愤怒与不同结果有差异化关联，如任务相关愤怒预测动机丧失和不满，分配不公预测工作-家庭溢出，社交相关愤怒预测同事关系受损。应对方式无额外解释力。
AI.research_question: 公共行政领域中，不同领域的愤怒触发倾向是否与特定的负面工作结果存在差异化关联？应对方式能否增加额外的解释价值？
AI.motivation: 公共行政员工处于复杂的组织与政治环境中，容易引发愤怒情绪。现有研究较少关注愤怒触发领域与具体负面结果之间的差异化关联，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 情感事件理论（Affective Events Theory）
AI.method: 对169名柏林联邦及州政府员工进行问卷调查，使用分层回归分析（有效样本N=153），评估七个愤怒触发领域与五种负面结果的关系。
AI.findings: (1) 任务相关愤怒预测动机丧失和不满；(2) 分配不公最强烈地预测工作-家庭溢出；(3) 社交互动相关愤怒预测同事关系受损；(4) 应对方式无额外解释力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将情感事件理论应用于公共行政领域，揭示了愤怒触发领域的差异化效应，拓展了对工作中愤怒情绪结果的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 区分愤怒触发领域有助于公共管理部门识别具体问题根源，制定针对性的组织干预措施，以减轻特定负面工作结果。

title: The Von Neumann Bottleneck: Data Movement, Arithmetic Intensity, and Bayesian Computation
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, University of Oxford - Mathematical Institute, George Mason University and University of Chicago, Booth School of Business, Students

detail.title: The Von Neumann Bottleneck: Data Movement, Arithmetic Intensity, and Bayesian Computation
detail.abstract: The binding constraint on modern Bayesian computation is data movement, not arithmetic. The von Neumann bottleneck, the separation of memory from compute across a shared channel, reappears on accelerators as the memory wall between high bandwidth memory and the arithmetic units. The governing quantity is arithmetic intensity, operations per byte moved, and the roofline model splits kernels into memory bound and compute bound at a single ridge. By this measure Markov chain Monte Carlo is a worst case: sequential, latency bound, low intensity. Several methods move inference into the compute bound regime. Generative Bayesian computation replaces the chain with parallel simulation and a learned transport map trained by dense matrix products. Conjugate augmentation, through Polya-Gamma and global-local shrinkage, reduces the inner loop to high intensity linear algebra. An error budget in which Monte Carlo error dominates rounding justifies reduced precision. We then show that softmax attention is exactly the Nadaraya-Watson kernel estimator, so the transformer's quadratic cost is the cost of forming a kernel matrix, and that quasi-Monte Carlo feature maps from Halton sequences point to how the next generation of models can lower it. We close with design principles for a communication aware complexity theory of statistics.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现代贝叶斯计算的瓶颈在于数据移动而非算术运算，并提出通过生成式贝叶斯计算、共轭增强、低精度计算等方法将MCMC从内存受限转变为计算受限，最后讨论了Transformer注意力机制与核估计的关系及通信感知的统计复杂度理论。
AI.research_question: 如何克服冯·诺依曼瓶颈和内存墙对现代贝叶斯计算（尤其是MCMC）的限制，将推理从内存受限转变为计算受限？
AI.motivation: MCMC作为贝叶斯推断的核心方法，因其顺序性、延迟敏感和低算术强度的特性，在加速器上受到内存墙的严重制约。随着数据规模增大，数据移动而非算术运算成为主要瓶颈，亟需新的计算范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算术强度（每字节移动的操作数）与屋顶线模型（roofline model）；冯·诺依曼瓶颈与内存墙；蒙特卡洛误差主导的误差预算理论；准蒙特卡洛（QMC）与Halton序列；核方法与注意力机制的联系（Nadaraya-Watson核估计）。
AI.method: 1) 生成式贝叶斯计算：用并行模拟和学习过的传输映射替代MCMC链，通过稠密矩阵乘积实现高算术强度；2) 共轭增强：利用Polya-Gamma和全局-局部收缩先验，将内循环简化为高强度的线性代数运算；3) 低精度计算：利用蒙特卡洛误差占主导的误差预算，合理降低计算精度。
AI.findings: 1) MCMC是内存受限的最坏情况内核；2) 生成式贝叶斯计算和共轭增强可将推理推向计算受限区域；3) softmax注意力机制等价于Nadaraya-Watson核估计，其二次复杂度源于核矩阵的构建；4) 基于Halton序列的QMC特征映射有望降低Transformer的计算成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将计算机体系结构中的屋顶线模型引入贝叶斯计算分析框架；2) 揭示了softmax注意力与核密度估计之间的理论等价性；3) 提出了通信感知的统计复杂度理论的设计原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为高效贝叶斯推断算法设计提供了基于算术强度的指导原则；2) 为降低Transformer计算复杂度（从二次到更低）提供了基于准蒙特卡洛的可行路径；3) 在保证蒙特卡洛误差可接受的前提下，允许使用低精度计算提升效率。

title: When Profit Consumes Its Conditions: Human Capacity and the Temporal Ontology of Surplus
affiliations: Inspired Research Collective

detail.title: When Profit Consumes Its Conditions: Human Capacity and the Temporal Ontology of Surplus
detail.abstract: A firm may report profit while diminishing the human capacities on which its production depends. The profit may be institutionally valid and yet fail to constitute a regenerative surplus. This article develops a philosophical account of that divergence by treating surplus as a temporally extended and relational status rather than a merely periodic remainder. Human capacities are described as non-owned constitutive conditions: they are embodied in persons, reproduced through social relations, and causally necessary to particular modes of production without becoming assets of the firm. Building on capital-maintenance reasoning, Marxian labour-power, Polanyi's fictitious commodity, social-reproduction theory, the capability approach, and critical accounting, the article distinguishes extractive profit, human-capacity debt, boundary displacement, and regenerative surplus. It also clarifies the paper's relation to O'Connor's second contradiction of capitalism and Fraser's account of cannibal capitalism: those theories explain how accumulation undermines its conditions, whereas the present argument asks what that dependence implies for the classification of profit itself. Extractive profit is identified through a two-stage framework that separates causal classification from responsibility attribution: counterfactual difference-making and productive mechanism establish causal relevance, while foreseeability, organisational control, benefit appropriation, and remedial capacity ground responsibility. Boundary displacement is distinguished from legitimate social provision through additionality, avoidability, private appropriation, and reciprocity. No universal depletion metric is proposed. Instead, the paper offers a context-sensitive preservation test whose threshold is constrained by reproducibility, non-displacement, worker participation, and the irreversibility of some harms. The result is an immanent critique of the inference from accounting profit to value creation.

AI.tldr: 本文从哲学层面论证，企业报告的利润可能只是"提取性利润"（extractive profit），而非"再生性剩余"（regenerative surplus），因为它可能建立在消耗人类能力的债务之上。文章提出一个两阶段框架（因果归因→责任归属），区分了合法社会供给与"边界位移"（boundary displacement），并构建了情境敏感的"保存测试"（preservation test），以评判利润是否真正创造了价值。
AI.research_question: 当企业报告利润时，如何判断该利润是真正的价值创造（再生性剩余），还是以消耗人类能力为代价的提取性利润？如何从哲学上区分这两者？
AI.motivation: 传统会计利润可能掩盖企业对社会再生产条件的消耗。企业可以报告合法利润，同时摧毁其生产所依赖的人类能力。这种分歧需要理论化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本维护推理（capital-maintenance reasoning）、马克思劳动力理论、波兰尼的虚拟商品、社会再生产理论、能力方法（capability approach）、批判会计学，以及奥康纳的资本主义第二重矛盾、弗雷泽的食人资本主义。
AI.method: 哲学概念分析与规范论证，建立分类框架（两阶段框架：因果分类+责任归属），并构建情境敏感的保存测试。
AI.findings: 1. 区分了四种概念：提取性利润、人类能力债务、边界位移、再生性剩余。2. 提出了两阶段框架：反事实差异制造与生产机制确立因果相关性；可预见性、组织控制、利益占有、补救能力确立责任。3. 通过额外性、可避免性、私人占有、互惠性区分边界位移与合法社会供给。4. 提出保存测试，阈值约束包括可再生产性、非位移性、工人参与性、某些伤害的不可逆性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将剩余概念从周期性余额重新定义为时间延展的关系性状态。2. 将人类能力描述为"非拥有的构成性条件"（non-owned constitutive conditions）。3. 推进了奥康纳和弗雷泽的理论：他们解释积累如何破坏自身条件，本文则追问这种依赖对利润本身分类的意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为批判会计学提供了概念工具，以识别会计利润与价值创造之间的脱节。2. 没有提出普适的消耗度量指标，而是提供了情境敏感的保存测试，具有实践可操作性。3. 对从会计利润推断价值创造的推断进行了内在批判。

title:
Data Center Policy across the 50 States 
A Survey of Incentives, Land Use, and Energy Regulation
affiliations: 273 Ventures and 273 Ventures

detail.title:
Data Center Policy across the 50 States 
A Survey of Incentives, Land Use, and Energy Regulation
detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of AI infrastructure has driven a wave of data center development across the United States. We draw on a dataset of 890 documented projects in all 50 states as of June 2026; among active projects with reported disclosures, announced investment is approximately $1.79 trillion and reported power capacity is approximately 240 GW. This Article presents the first 50-state survey to integrate five dimensions of data center policy with project-level investment data and a scored cross-state typology: (1) tax incentives and economic development programs, (2) zoning restrictions, moratoria, and local governance, (3) energy regulation and grid impacts, (4) environmental and resource constraints including water, noise, and air quality, and (5) federal regulatory developments at FERC and DOE. Drawing on a novel dataset of state legislation, public utility commission proceedings, and project-level data, we document near-universal incentive competition: 49 states use at least one data-center-relevant incentive mechanism, including 38 states with dedicated data center tax incentives. At the same time, 34 states contain localities with enacted data center moratoria (208 in total), and 20 states have enacted measures that roll back, pause, exclude, or materially tighten incentive eligibility since 2024. We identify a structural paradox: states compete aggressively for data center investment through multi-decade tax exemptions while localities move to impose moratoria and restrict by-right zoning. We read this paradox as the surface form of a vertical mismatch in fiscal federalism, in which the level of government that captures the benefits is not the level that bears or perceives the local costs. We further argue that energy access—interconnection timing, generation adequacy, and a defensible cost-allocation path—has become the gatekeeping constraint on data center siting, with tax policy operating mainly as a tiebreaker among sites that already have a credible power path. Case studies of Virginia, Texas, Georgia, Michigan, and Arizona illustrate how these dimensions interact in practice. We conclude by describing patterns of policy convergence that are emerging across states with different market structures and political contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文基于全美50州890个数据中心项目的系统数据，首次整合了税收激励、 zoning限制、能源监管、环境约束和联邦政策五个维度，揭示了州级政府积极提供税收优惠吸引投资与地方政府实施暂停令之间的结构性矛盾，指出能源接入已成为数据中心选址的关键约束。
AI.research_question: 美国各州的数据中心政策在哪些维度上存在何种结构性矛盾？税收激励、地方治理、能源监管、环境约束和联邦政策之间如何互动？
AI.motivation: AI基础设施扩张引发数据中心建设浪潮，但缺乏对全美50州政策的系统性整合研究。现有文献多关注单一政策维度，未能揭示跨层级政府间的政策冲突及其深层机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政联邦主义的纵向错配理论（vertical mismatch in fiscal federalism）：受益政府层级（州级）与承担成本层级（地方）的分离导致了激励竞争与地方限制并存的结构性悖论。
AI.method: 混合方法：1. 构建890个项目级投资数据库；2. 50州立法与公用事业委员会程序分析；3. 跨州政策类型学评分；4. 五个州（弗吉尼亚、得克萨斯、佐治亚、密歇根、亚利桑那）的深度案例研究。
AI.findings: 1. 49州使用至少一种数据中心激励措施，38州有专项税收优惠；2. 34州存在地方性暂停令（共208项），20州自2024年起收紧了激励资格；3. 能源接入（并网时间、发电充足性、成本分摊路径）成为选址的"守门人"约束；4. 不同市场结构和政治背景的州之间出现政策趋同模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"财政联邦主义纵向错配"解释框架，将数据中心政策冲突理论化为受益与成本承担层级分离的结构性问题，为理解基础设施治理中的跨层级张力提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了首个50州政策全景图，揭示了能源接入作为关键瓶颈的政策含义，有助于协调州-地方在数据中心发展中的利益冲突，并评估税收优惠与能源成本分摊政策的有效性。

title: Policy Push: Expanding the Commodity Derivatives Market in India
affiliations: Government of India - Indian Economic Service

detail.title: Policy Push: Expanding the Commodity Derivatives Market in India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: Since 2014, India's commodity derivatives market has evolved significantly under the regulatory oversight of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), following its merger with the Forward Markets Commission in 2015. A key development occurred on March 1, 2024, when the Government of India expanded the list of tradable commodities from 91 to 104 and increased commodity categories from 12 to 18, introducing areas like dairy, forestry, and chemicals. The notification also recognized "options in goods" as derivatives for the specified commodities.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2024年3月1日印度政府将可交易商品从91种扩展到104种、商品类别从12个增加到18个（新增乳制品、林业、化工等领域）这一监管改革对印度商品衍生品市场的影响，并探讨了"商品期权"被正式认定为衍生品的意义。
AI.research_question: 印度商品衍生品市场监管改革（2024年商品清单扩展及期权认定）对市场发展有何影响？
AI.motivation: 印度商品衍生品市场自2014年以来在SEBI监管下经历了重要变革，2024年的政策扩展是里程碑事件，需要评估其对市场深度、参与度和风险管理功能的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 衍生品市场发展理论、金融监管与市场效率理论、商品市场风险管理理论。
AI.method: 基于2024年3月1日印度政府官方通知的政策分析，结合SEBI监管历史演变（2015年Forward Markets Commission并入SEBI）进行制度描述。
AI.findings: 1) 可交易商品从91种增至104种，商品类别从12个增至18个，覆盖乳制品、林业、化学品等新领域；2) "商品期权"被正式纳入衍生品范畴，为市场参与者提供了更多风险管理工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴市场商品衍生品监管改革提供了制度演进的案例研究，丰富了金融监管与市场创新关系的理论探讨。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及类似新兴经济体的监管机构提供了商品衍生品市场扩展和产品创新的政策参考，有助于提升农产品和商品市场的价格发现与风险管理效率。
