title: Hosting Capacity and Economic Viability of Grid-Connected Photovoltaic Systems in Mozambique: A Finance-First Framework Analysis Based on 1,320 Observations (2015-2024)
affiliations: Universidade Pedagógica de Maputo

detail.title: Hosting Capacity and Economic Viability of Grid-Connected Photovoltaic Systems in Mozambique: A Finance-First Framework Analysis Based on 1,320 Observations (2015-2024)
detail.abstract: When the discount rate, not solar irradiance, is the dominant predictor of the levelized cost of energy in one of the world's sunniest countries, energy policy needs recalibrating. Across 110 grid-connected photovoltaic projects in Mozambique (1,320 observations, 2015-2024), OLS regressions, Logit models, and fixed-effects panel estimators consistently identify financial structure, not technical performance, as the binding constraint on PV viability. This article formalizes that empirical regularity into the Finance-First PV Integration Framework (F²PIF): a three-stage sequential architecture in which financial risk mitigation is established before not alongside technical site assessment. Key findings are: (1) the discount rate is the primary LCOE predictor (β =-0.003, p < 0.05) while GHI, installed capacity, and technology type are statistically indistinguishable from zero; (2) the Performance Ratio is the sole significant technical predictor of financial viability (Logit OR = 31.4, p < 0.10), identifying preventive maintenance as the highest-return operational intervention; (3) rural network hosting capacity reaches 15% of peak load under current conditions but approximately doubles with 2-hour BESS integration; and (4) regulatory gaps not grid physics represent the binding scalability constraint. These findings challenge the techno-centric paradigm in energy access planning and offer a replicable framework for Mission 300 and SDG 7 implementation across sub-Saharan Africa.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对莫桑比克110个并网光伏项目的实证分析发现，贴现率而非太阳辐照度是LCOE的主要预测因子，金融结构而非技术性能是光伏项目可行性的关键约束，并提出了"金融优先的光伏整合框架"（F²PIF）。
AI.research_question: 在太阳能资源丰富的国家（莫桑比克），决定光伏项目经济可行性的关键因素是技术性能还是金融结构？
AI.motivation: 能源规划领域长期存在技术中心主义范式，忽视金融约束对光伏项目可行性的决定性作用，尤其在发展中国家。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融优先的光伏整合框架（F²PIF）：一个三阶段顺序架构，强调金融风险管理应先于（而非并行于）技术选址评估。
AI.method: 对莫桑比克110个并网光伏项目（1320个观测值，2015-2024年）进行OLS回归、Logit模型和固定效应面板估计。
AI.findings: (1) 贴现率是LCOE的主要预测因子（β=-0.003, p<0.05），而GHI、装机容量和技术类型的影响不显著；(2) 性能比（PR）是唯一显著的技术可行预测因子（Logit OR=31.4, p<0.10）；(3) 农村配电网承载力在2小时BESS集成后翻倍；(4) 监管缺口是比电网物理容量更关键的规模化约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了能源规划领域的技术中心主义范式，提出金融约束优先于技术约束的理论框架（F²PIF）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Mission 300和SDG 7在撒哈拉以南非洲的实施提供可复制的框架，指出预防性维护是最具回报的运营干预措施。

title: Cognitive versus Physical Impairment and the Use and Cost of Long-Term Care in Japan
affiliations: Waseda University, Waseda University, University of Tokyo and Waseda University

detail.title: Cognitive versus Physical Impairment and the Use and Cost of Long-Term Care in Japan
detail.abstract:
Japan has the world’s oldest population and a universal Long-Term Care Insurance (LTCI) system, yet how care use and costs differ between cognitive and physical impairment remains underexamined. Using the nationally representative Comprehensive Survey of Living Conditions (2016 and 2019 waves; 324,466 adults aged 65 and older), we compare the utilization, intensity, and cost of long-term care across three groups: those with a dementia diagnosis (defined as regularly receiving medical treatment for dementia), those with physical (ADL) limitations but no dementia, and those with neither. A dementia diagnosis is associated with dramatically higher care use—75.3% receive some care, versus 5.3% of the unimpaired reference group. In models adjusting for demographic and socioeconomic characteristics, dementia raises the probability of receiving formal care by 55 percentage points and informal care by 52 percentage points—roughly double the effects of ADL limitations—and, conditional on use, is associated with about 113 additional hours of formal care per month (some 60% more than physical limitations alone). We estimate formal-care costs at 1.07–4.03% of GDP (depending on the valuation method) and co-residing informal-care costs at 0.79% of GDP. Per-capita formal-care costs are substantially higher for those with dementia (about 3.5 versus 2.0 million JPY annually under the self-reported approach), whereas informal-care costs are nearly uniform across impairment types—underscoring the intensive, and largely invisible, contribution of family caregivers. With the dementia and mild-cognitive-impairment population projected to reach roughly 12 million by 2040, these findings point to mounting fiscal and family-care pressures from cognitive impairment in Japan.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 利用日本全国代表性数据，比较痴呆症患者、身体（ADL）受限但无痴呆症者以及无这两类问题者三类群体的长期护理使用、强度和成本。发现痴呆症与极高的护理使用率相关（75.3%接受护理），并导致正式护理概率增加55个百分点、非正式护理概率增加52个百分点，每月额外增加约113小时正式护理。痴呆症患者的人均正式护理成本（约350万日元/年）显著高于身体受限者（约200万日元/年），而非正式护理成本几乎一致。随着痴呆症和轻度认知障碍人口到2040年预计达1200万，日本将面临巨大的财政和家庭照护压力。
AI.research_question: 在日本老龄化最严重且拥有全民长期护理保险（LTCI）的背景下，认知障碍（痴呆症）与身体（ADL）受限在长期护理使用、强度和成本上存在怎样的差异？
AI.motivation: 尽管日本拥有全球最老的人口结构和全民LTCI体系，但痴呆症与身体障碍对护理使用和成本的差异尚未得到充分研究。随着痴呆症患者数量预计到2040年达到约1200万，理解这一差异对预测财政压力和非正式照护负担（家庭照护者）至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究未明确提出特定理论框架，但基于护理需求经济学和公共卫生视角，将护理使用分为正式护理和非正式护理，并从概率、强度和成本三个维度进行比较分析。
AI.method: 使用日本全国代表性的"综合生活状况调查"（2016年和2019年数据；324,466名65岁及以上成年人）。将样本分为三组：定期接受痴呆症医疗诊断者、有ADL限制但无痴呆症者、无这两类问题者。采用多元回归模型调整人口和社会经济特征，比较三组的护理使用概率、小时数及成本。
AI.findings: （1）痴呆症患者中75.3%接受某种护理，而无问题的参照组仅5.3%。（2）痴呆症使获得正式护理的概率增加55个百分点、非正式护理增加52个百分点，效果约为ADL限制的两倍。（3）痴呆症与每月额外约113小时的正式护理相关，比单独身体受限多约60%。（4）正式护理成本占GDP的1.07-4.03%（因估值方法不同），同居非正式护理成本占GDP的0.79%。（5）痴呆症患者人均正式护理成本约350万日元/年，身体受限者约200万日元/年，但非正式护理成本几乎一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统量化了痴呆症与身体障碍对护理使用和成本的差异化影响，揭示了认知障碍在护理需求中的主导作用比身体障碍更为显著，为理解不同失能类型的护理经济负担差异提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为日本及类似高龄化国家（如中国等东亚国家）的长期护理政策制定提供数据支持，提示需重点关注认知障碍人群的护理需求。（2）揭示了非正式护理成本的高度隐性（家庭照护者贡献巨大且几乎不因障碍类型而异），提醒政策制定者关注家庭照护者的支持。（3）与痴呆症相关的巨大护理负担（占GDP可观比例）提示有必要加强预防、早期干预和社区照护体系建设。

title: Ports, Technology and Inter-City Trade: The Economics and Geopolitics of Evolving Maritime Transport Networks
affiliations: University of British Columbia (UBC), Universitat Pompeu Fabra (UPF) - Centre de Recerca en Economia Internacional (CREI), Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU) and University of Oregon

detail.title: Ports, Technology and Inter-City Trade: The Economics and Geopolitics of Evolving Maritime Transport Networks
detail.abstract:
Maritime transport remains the backbone of global trade, yet the port and shipping network that carries it has been transformed by containerization and related technological advances. Drawing on newly available granular data---digitized historical shipping records, georeferenced ship movements, and shipment-level routing information---we present five stylized facts on the structure and evolution of the maritime network. Global shipping activity is highly concentrated among a changing lineup of dominant top ports even as lower-ranked ports disperse, while state-owned Chinese port terminal operators increasingly account for these global volumes, boosting overall port operations while delivering efficiency gains mostly to Chinese vessels. We use these facts to organize a synthesis of a fast-growing literature: containerization reshaped which port cities could expand, reinforced hub-and-spoke concentration that yields large but localized welfare gains, embedded ports in multimodal networks that amplify the returns to infrastructure, and generated market power, congestion, and environmental costs. Together, this evidence shows how evolving maritime technologies simultaneously deepen global integration and heighten the economic and geopolitical importance of critical nodes in the transport network---and of who controls them.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用全新的高精度数据（数字化历史航运记录、地理参考船舶轨迹、货物路径信息），总结了全球海运网络的五个典型化事实，并系统梳理了集装箱化如何重塑港口城市格局、强化枢纽-支线结构、嵌入多式联运网络、以及带来市场力量与环境污染等后果。
AI.research_question: 全球海运网络的结构与演化特征是什么？集装箱化技术如何重塑港口与航运体系的经济与地缘政治格局？
AI.motivation: 海运是全球贸易的命脉，但集装箱化及相关技术进步如何改变港口与航运网络的结构、效率及权力分布，尚缺乏基于大规模微观数据的系统实证刻画。作者利用新获取的精细化数据填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 枢纽-辐条网络理论、多式联运与基础设施回报理论、市场力量与福利分配理论、地缘经济学。
AI.method: 利用数字化历史航运记录、地理参考船舶轨迹、货物级路径信息等新数据，进行描述性统计与典型化事实归纳，并结合文献综述进行系统性整合。
AI.findings: 1. 全球航运高度集中于少数顶级港口，且顶级港口排名不断变动，低排名港口则趋于分散。2. 中国国有港口运营商日益主导全球集装箱吞吐量，提升了整体运营效率，但效率收益主要流向中国籍船舶。3. 集装箱化重塑了港口城市的发展空间。4. 强化了枢纽-辐条结构，带来局部但巨大的福利收益。5. 港口嵌入多式联运网络，放大了基础设施投资的回报。6. 同时产生了市场力量、拥堵和环境成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合并更新了集装箱化对海运网络影响的理论认识，揭示了技术变迁如何同时深化全球一体化并增强关键节点的经济与地缘政治重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于港口基础设施投资、航运市场治理、以及关键节点控制权的地缘政治风险的实证依据；为行业参与者理解全球航运格局演变趋势提供了数据驱动的分析框架。

title: Economic Well-Being of Latino Households in the U.S.: a Scoping Review of Research on Poverty, the Safety Net, and Family Supports
affiliations: Duke University, University of Illinois Chicago, Duke University Sanford School of Public Policy and Duke University

detail.title: Economic Well-Being of Latino Households in the U.S.: a Scoping Review of Research on Poverty, the Safety Net, and Family Supports
detail.abstract:
This scoping review curates empirical research on economic well-being among Latino households in peer reviewed journals from 1990 to 2025, following PRISMA guidelines and a preregistered search strategy. The search yielded more than 5,000 studies revealing a greater than five-fold increase since the early 2000s. The majority of studies examined Medicaid and health insurance and approximately half examined government benefit programs, particularly with respect to eligibility criteria and benefit receipt. Few studies examined the employment outcomes of Latinos in the context of government benefit availability and even fewer focus on Latinos and income support. A deeper content review revealed that studies examining Hispanics are typically through comparative analyses with other racial and ethnic groups. These studies find higher poverty and material hardship, and lower receipt of government benefits, among Latino families relative to non-Latino White households. Fewer studies consider heterogeneity within Hispanic populations. Research on economic well-being among Latino households, as distinct from more general investigations regarding immigrants, expanded in tandem with growth in the Latino population and shifts in social policy. Key policy-relevant open topics of research that affect Latinos include those related to tax credits, benefit generosity, employment, and considerations of mixed-citizen status households.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了1990-2025年间关于拉丁裔家庭经济福祉的实证研究，发现该领域自2000年以来研究数量增长超过五倍，主要集中在医疗补助和健康保险，以及政府福利项目的资格与领取，但对就业、收入支持和群体内部异质性的研究相对不足。
AI.research_question: 拉丁裔家庭经济福祉的实证研究呈现怎样的发展脉络、主题分布和研究空白？
AI.motivation: 拉丁裔是美国增长最快的少数族裔之一，但其经济福祉状况（贫困率、物质困难、福利领取等）与白人家庭存在显著差距，现有文献缺乏系统性的整合与梳理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 范围综述（Scoping Review）方法，遵循PRISMA指南和预注册搜索策略。
AI.method: 对1990-2025年间同行评审期刊中关于拉丁裔家庭经济福祉的实证研究进行系统检索，筛选超过5,000项研究，并进行更深层次的内容审查。
AI.findings: 1. 研究数量自2000年以来增长五倍以上；2. 多数研究聚焦医疗补助和健康保险；3. 约半数研究涉及政府福利项目的资格与领取；4. 较少研究关注拉丁裔在政府福利背景下的就业结果；5. 极少研究关注拉丁裔与收入支持；6. 多数研究通过与其他种族群体的比较分析，发现拉丁裔家庭贫困率和物质困难更高，福利领取更低；7. 较少研究关注拉丁裔群体内部的异质性；8. 研究重点随拉丁裔人口增长和社会政策变化而扩展。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统识别了拉丁裔家庭经济福祉研究领域的知识图谱与发展趋势，揭示了研究主题的不平衡分布，指出了群体内部异质性这一被忽视的重要维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了与拉丁裔经济福祉密切相关的关键政策议题方向，包括税收抵免、福利慷慨度、就业以及混合公民身份家庭的特殊需求。

title: Cheaper to Run, Harder to Earn: Working from Home and Bank Efficiency
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond, Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond - Quantitative Supervision & Research and Federal Reserve Banks - Quantitative Supervision & Research

detail.title: Cheaper to Run, Harder to Earn: Working from Home and Bank Efficiency
detail.abstract: We study how remote work affects Bank Holding Company(BHC) efficiency in the U.S. in the post-pandemic period. We measure BHC exposure through the workfrom-home rate of finance-industry workers in its pre-pandemic markets, separating this staff channel from the local incidence of remote work. Greater staff exposure improves cost efficiency and reduces revenue efficiency with a roughly one-year delay, leaving profit efficiency unchanged. Cost gains are concentrated in banks with large physical and technological footprints; revenue losses are concentrated in relationshipintensive banks. Our findings suggest that remote work shifts the composition of bank production, with implications for bank management and supervision.

AI.tldr: 研究后疫情时期远程工作对美国银行控股公司（BHC）效率的影响。通过金融行业员工远程工作率衡量银行暴露程度，发现员工远程工作暴露增加会（约一年滞后）提高成本效率但降低收入效率，净效果对利润效率无显著影响。成本收益集中在物理和技术 footprint 大的银行，收入损失集中在关系密集型银行。
AI.research_question: 后疫情时期远程工作如何影响美国银行控股公司的效率？
AI.motivation: 疫情后远程工作普及率大幅提升，但远程工作对银行业这一传统关系密集型行业的生产效率和经营模式有何具体影响尚不明确，尤其是对银行控股公司整体效率的实证证据不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 远程工作通过"员工渠道"（staff channel）影响银行生产组合的构成，即员工远程办公改变了银行的投入成本结构和产出收入模式。
AI.method: 利用疫情前金融行业从业者在银行所在市场的远程工作率作为银行远程工作暴露的度量，将其与银行层面的效率指标进行面板回归分析，并区分"员工渠道"（staff exposure）与"本地渠道"（local incidence）。
AI.findings: 1) 员工远程工作暴露增加→约1年后成本效率提升、收入效率下降，利润效率不变；2) 成本效率收益集中在物理足迹大、技术投入大的银行；3) 收入效率损失集中在关系密集型银行。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了远程工作对银行生产组合（production composition）的重新配置效应，从成本侧和收入侧分别刻画了其非对称影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行管理层在远程工作时代的成本管理、技术投资与关系维护策略提供参考，并为银行监管者评估远程工作对银行经营稳健性的潜在影响提供依据。

title: The American Security State Hosts the World Cup

detail.title: The American Security State Hosts the World Cup
detail.abstract: The 2026 FIFA World Cup arrives in the United States at a moment of acute contradiction. President Trump has positioned the tournament as a centrepiece of his 'Golden Age' soft power narrative — proof, rendered in stadium lights, that America remains the indispensable global host. Yet the same administration has constructed the most aggressive domestic immigration enforcement apparatus in modern American history, applied entry restrictions to nationals of 39 countries, and deployed ICE and Homeland Security Investigations personnel to all 16 host cities on a continuous operational basis throughout the tournament. This paper analyses the structural contradiction between these two simultaneous projects and traces its concrete consequences: visa denials for spectators from qualifying nations, the detention of players, the deportation of accredited team photographers, the exclusion of a FIFA-appointed referee, and the near-grounding of national squads. It examines the Save the World Cup Act and its failure to advance through Congress, the fiscal and reputational costs of reduced tourist arrivals, and the political collision between federal enforcement and Democratic mayors in host cities including Newark, Chicago, and Seattle. The paper argues that the tournament does not merely co-exist with the security state — it operates within it, and the world-audience it attracts will observe both simultaneously. The soft power dividend Trump expects depends on a premise — that the game dissolves borders — that American border policy directly contradicts. The paper concludes that the 2026 World Cup is the most revealing single case study of the gap between American self-image and the operational reality of its current governing doctrine.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2026年美国FIFA世界杯与特朗普政府强硬移民执法政策之间的结构性矛盾。赛事被定位为"软实力"展示窗口，但同期实施的史上最严格移民执法——包括对39国公民的入境限制、ICE人员常驻全部16个主办城市——直接导致了参赛球员被拘留、摄影师被驱逐、裁判被拒签、国家队险些无法入境等一系列具体后果。论文认为，世界杯并未与安全国家并存，而是运行在其中，其吸引的全球观众将同时见证这一矛盾。特朗普期望的软实力红利取决于"比赛消融边界"这一前提，而美国边境政策恰恰与之直接抵触。
AI.research_question: 美国在举办2026年世界杯（软实力展示）的同时实施史上最激进的移民执法（硬边境管控），这两种相互矛盾的国家项目如何共同运作？其具体后果和深层含义是什么？
AI.motivation: 2026年世界杯在美国举办，这是移民执法与大型赛事之间的冲突首次以如此大规模、系统性的方式暴露出来。现有文献多将大型赛事视为纯粹的软实力工具，忽视其与安全国家机器之间的结构性张力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 软实力与安全国家的结构性矛盾理论；国家形象建构与边境管控实践的张力分析；大型赛事的政治经济学框架。
AI.method: 案例分析法，综合运用政策文本分析、事件追踪（签证拒签、拘留、驱逐等具体事件）、国会立法进程分析、财政与声誉成本评估。
AI.findings: （1）世界杯运行在安全国家之内，而非与之并存；（2）产生了具体可追溯的后果：参赛国观众被拒签、球员被拘留、摄影师被驱逐、FIFA指定裁判被排除、国家队被扣押；（3）《拯救世界杯法案》未能在国会通过；（4）游客减少造成财政和声誉损失；（5）联邦执法与民主党市长在主办城市发生政治碰撞。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"大型赛事运作于安全国家之内"的理论框架，挑战了传统软实力研究将大型赛事与国家管控机器视为分离实体的假设；揭示了软实力与硬权力之间的结构性矛盾而非共存关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为赛事组织者、国际体育机构（FIFA）和政策制定者提供了警示：如果移民执法与大型赛事之间的矛盾不解决，将产生具体的经济、声誉和运营风险；为未来申办国提供了评估自身政策一致性的分析工具。

title: Financial Decision Modeling for Intellectual Property Portfolio Optimization: Real-World Evidence for Building Strategies

detail.title: Financial Decision Modeling for Intellectual Property Portfolio Optimization: Real-World Evidence for Building Strategies

declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded in whole by the National Science Centre in Poland, grant ‘Brand Abuse: Brand as a New Personal Interest under the Polish Civil Code against an EU and US Backdrop‘, grant holder: Marlena Maria Jankowska-Augustyn, number: 2021/43/B/HS5/01156. For the purpose of Open Access, the author has applied a CC-BY public copyright licence to any Author Accepted Manuscript (AAM) version arising from this submission.

detail.abstract:
Managing an intellectual property portfolio resembles managing a financial investment portfolio. Both require balancing potential returns and risks, operating under resource constraints, and adapting to changing market conditions. This article shows how concepts derived from Modern Portfolio Theory and decision modeling can enhance the strategic management of IP assets.

By drawing analogies between financial and intellectual property assets, the article develops a framework based on expected value, risk, and interdependence among patents and other IP rights. It demonstrates how analytical tools can support decisions on investment, budget allocation, portfolio optimization, and the discontinuation of underperforming assets. Case studies involving companies such as IBM, Nokia, Qualcomm, and Dow illustrate the practical relevance of these approaches and confirm their value for effective IP portfolio management.

AI.tldr: 本文借鉴现代投资组合理论（Modern Portfolio Theory）和决策建模的概念，提出了一个基于期望价值、风险和知识产权资产间相互依赖关系的分析框架，用于战略性地管理知识产权（IP）组合，包括投资决策、预算分配、组合优化及处置表现不佳的资产。IBM、诺基亚、高通和道氏化学的案例证实了该方法的实用性。
AI.research_question: 如何将现代投资组合理论和决策建模中的概念应用于知识产权资产的战略性管理？
AI.motivation: 知识产权组合管理在收益与风险平衡、资源约束和市场变化等方面与金融投资组合高度相似，但缺乏系统化的分析工具。本文旨在弥合这一差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现代投资组合理论（Modern Portfolio Theory）、决策建模、期望价值与风险分析、资产相互依赖关系。
AI.method: 概念类比与框架构建，结合IBM、诺基亚、高通和道氏化学的案例研究进行实践验证。
AI.findings: 基于金融投资组合理论的分析工具可以有效支持IP投资决策、预算分配、组合优化及低效资产处置；多个行业领先企业的案例表明该方法具有实践价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将现代投资组合理论系统性地拓展到知识产权管理领域，建立了跨学科的IP资产分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业IP管理者提供了可操作的分析工具和决策模型，帮助其在资源约束下优化IP组合的收益-风险结构，并识别应剥离的低效资产。

title: Psychosocial Health and Well-Being After A Mortality Shock
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill, SurveyMETER and Duke University

detail.title: Psychosocial Health and Well-Being After A Mortality Shock
detail.abstract: We investigate the short- and long-run impacts of unexpected mortality on psychosocial health in the context of a large-scale high-mortality natural disaster, the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami. The effects of the tsunami-related mortality measured at the community level are contrasted with the effects of individual-specific loss of close kin using population-representative longitudinal survey data from the Study of the Tsunami Aftermath and Recovery. In the short-run, two years post-tsunami, both community and individual-level mortality exposures are significant predictors of elevated depression and post-traumatic stress symtoms. In the longer-run, ten years post-tsunami, individual-level exposures are slightly attenuated but remain significant predictors of both psychosocial health measures; in contrast, community-level mortality predicts post-traumatic stress but not depression symptoms. Mortality is linked to smaller household sizes in the short- and long-run and to less social support in the long-run, although the latter effect differs substantially for males and females. The estimates adjust for other tsunami exposure measures and, in the individual-level analyses, we compare people living in the same community at the time of the tsunami who were exposed to the same community-level mortality rate.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2004年印度洋海啸后的纵向调查数据，发现社区层面和个体层面的死亡暴露在短期（2年）内均显著预测抑郁和创伤后应激症状；长期（10年）个体层面效应减弱但仍显著，而社区层面仅预测创伤后应激症状。死亡暴露还与家庭规模缩小和长期社会支持减少有关。
AI.research_question: 意外死亡率（社区层面与个体层面）对心理社会健康的短期和长期影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 大规模高死亡率自然灾害（如2004年印度洋海啸）对幸存者心理社会健康的长期影响机制尚不明确，尤其是社区层面死亡率与个体层面亲属死亡的差异化效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 灾难死亡率暴露的层次理论（社区集体创伤 vs. 个体丧亲）；心理社会健康的恢复与衰减模型；社会支持中介机制。
AI.method: 使用"海啸后果与恢复研究"（STAR）代表性纵向调查数据，比较社区层面死亡率与个体层面亲密亲属死亡对心理社会健康（抑郁、创伤后应激）的短期（2年）和长期（10年）影响，并调整其他海啸暴露因素，在个体层面分析中比较同一社区的居民。
AI.findings: 短期：社区与个体层面死亡率均显著预测抑郁和创伤后应激症状；长期：个体层面效应减弱但仍显著，社区层面仅预测创伤后应激症状而非抑郁；死亡暴露导致短期和长期家庭规模缩小，长期社会支持减少（存在性别差异）。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了社区集体创伤与个体丧亲两种死亡率暴露机制的差异化长期心理影响路径，揭示了社区层面死亡率对抑郁症状的衰减效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为灾后心理健康干预提供了分层靶向策略：短期需兼顾社区与个体层面，长期应重点关注个体丧亲者，并考虑社会支持恢复中的性别差异。

title: Billy AI and the Copyright Bottleneck: a Kraljic Matrix Approach to AI-driven Design in Denim
affiliations: , University of Silesia in Katowice - Poland Faculty of Law and Administration and Mackenzie Presbyterian University

detail.title: Billy AI and the Copyright Bottleneck: a Kraljic Matrix Approach to AI-driven Design in Denim
detail.abstract: In March 2026, the Spanish textile technology company Jeanologia unveiled Billy AI, an artificial intelligence platform capable of extracting highly detailed laser finishing designs directly from a single garment photograph. Trained on more than 5,000 proprietary laser designs and synthetic datasets, the system employs dual adversarial AI architecture. This article examines Billy AI from three interconnected perspectives: (1) a technical description of the system's architecture and its integration within Jeanologia's three-decade production ecosystem; (2) an evaluation of industry benefits across efficiency, consistency, democratization, and sustainability dimensions; and (3) a comprehensive legal analysis of the challenges that AI-driven design extraction raises. The legal analysis encompasses copyright ownership under CJEU, USCO, and Chinese standards; the GEMA v. OpenAI three-phase framework; operator liability; data security; EU AI Act compliance; and the structural asymmetry between US fair use and European TDM exceptions. The article introduces a novel application of the Kraljic (1983) procurement portfolio matrix to classify the copyrighted training inputs of domain-specific AI systems-distinguishing strategic, bottleneck, leverage, and non-critical items-and proposes input-differentiated risk mitigation strategies for industry stakeholders.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了西班牙纺织科技公司Jeanologia开发的Billy AI平台——该平台能从单张服装照片中提取高精度激光整理设计。文章从技术架构、行业效益和法律合规三个维度展开，并创新性地将Kraljic采购组合矩阵应用于AI训练输入的版权分类，提出了针对性的风险缓解策略。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的设计提取系统（以Billy AI为例）在技术实现、行业应用和法律合规层面面临哪些挑战与机遇？如何对AI系统的版权训练输入进行分类管理？
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI在工业设计领域的快速渗透，从现有产品照片中提取设计的技术带来了显著的效率提升，但也引发了版权归属、数据安全和合规性等复杂法律问题。本文旨在为这一新兴领域提供技术、商业和法律三个层面的综合分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kraljic（1983）采购组合矩阵（战略品、瓶颈品、杠杆品、非关键品）；GEMA v. OpenAI三阶段框架；欧盟、美国和中国版权法标准；EU AI Act合规要求；美国合理使用与欧洲TDM例外的结构性不对称。
AI.method: 多维度定性分析，包含技术架构描述、行业效益评估（效率、一致性、民主化、可持续性）、比较法律分析（三大法域版权标准），以及Kraljic矩阵在AI训练输入分类中的创新应用。
AI.findings: Billy AI采用双对抗性AI架构，整合于Jeanologia三十年生产生态中；AI设计提取在效率和民主化方面优势显著，但版权归属模糊；Kraljic矩阵可有效区分战略型（高利润影响、高供应风险）与瓶颈型训练输入，从而制定差异化风险管理策略；三大法域在AI生成内容的版权保护上存在显著不对称。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Kraljic采购组合矩阵首次应用于AI系统的版权训练输入分类，为领域特定AI的知识产权风险管理提供了新的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为纺织及更广泛的AI应用行业提供了区分化的训练数据风险缓解策略；为企业在EU AI Act等监管框架下的合规实践提供了操作指南；为平衡AI创新与版权保护提供了多法域视角的参考。

title: How Do Cryptocurrency Market Collapses Impact Bank Performance? Evidence from Major Crypto Crashes (2017-2024)

detail.title: How Do Cryptocurrency Market Collapses Impact Bank Performance? Evidence from Major Crypto Crashes (2017-2024)
detail.abstract: This study examines the systematic impact of cryptocurrency market collapses on traditional bank performance using a comprehensive dataset of 5,673 US banks over 32 quarters from 2017Q1 to 2024Q4. Employing a difference-in-differences methodology with treatment intensity based on geographic crypto exposure (Google Trends search interest across 51 US states), I find that major cryptocurrency crashes increase average bank Return on Assets (ROA) by 2.1 basis points. Banks in high crypto-interest states experience significantly larger effects (3.4 bps). The results suggest flight-to-safety mechanisms as the primary channel. This research provides empirical evidence on crypto-to-banking spillovers and has implications for financial stability and bank risk management.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用美国5,673家银行2017-2024年的面板数据，发现加密货币市场崩盘反而通过"安全转移"机制使传统银行ROA平均提升2.1个基点，且在加密货币关注度高的州效果更显著（3.4个基点）。
AI.research_question: 加密货币市场崩溃如何系统性影响传统银行的绩效表现？
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场波动日益剧烈，但其对传统银行体系的溢出效应尚未得到充分实证研究，尤其是银行是否会从加密市场危机中受益。
AI.theoretical_framework: "安全转移"机制（Flight-to-Safety）：当加密货币市场崩溃时，投资者将资金从高风险加密资产转移到传统银行等安全资产，从而提升银行绩效。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences），以Google Trends搜索兴趣指数衡量美国51个州的地理级加密货币暴露程度作为处理强度变量，使用2017Q1-2024Q4共32个季度、5,673家美国银行的面板数据。
AI.findings: （1）加密货币大崩盘使银行平均ROA提高2.1个基点；（2）加密货币关注度高的州，银行ROA提升幅度更大（3.4个基点）；（3）主要机制为"安全转移"效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地实证检验了加密货币市场危机对传统银行绩效的正向溢出效应，验证了"安全转移"机制在加密货币与传统银行之间的适用性，丰富了金融传染与金融稳定性文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融监管机构评估加密货币风险对银行体系的影响提供实证依据；为银行风险管理中纳入加密市场动态提供参考；对金融稳定政策制定具有启示意义。

title: Can the Attention Economy Stay Stable? Corporate Governance, the Dictator's Dilemma, and the Bifurcation Between Macroeconomic Collapse and Structural Stability

detail.title: Can the Attention Economy Stay Stable? Corporate Governance, the Dictator's Dilemma, and the Bifurcation Between Macroeconomic Collapse and Structural Stability
detail.abstract:
In our first paper, Is Human Attention Still Necessary?, we argued that as AI automates routine cognition the binding economic constraint shifts to productive human attention, and that on the production side the transition is a smooth crossover: writing mu_A for the macro-scale shadow price of productive human attention, its marginal social value, the economy moves from a regime in which attention is free (mu_A = 0) to one in which it is scarce (mu_A > 0). The sharp event, the one that decides whether the attention-dominant economy stays structurally stable or collapses, does not live on the production side. It lives in governance, and that paper named it, located it in the nonlinear coupling between ownership and attention, and left the proof to the papers that follow. This paper is the firm-scale half of that proof: it completes the coupling the first paper named and the four-scale bridge the research programme set out, and carries the firm-scale result up toward the macro bifurcation it implies, stated as a disciplined conjecture under explicit conditions rather than a closed theorem.

Our route runs through a structural fact: a conventional corporation is, in its control structure, a dictatorship. A single controlling class, capital, governs through reports it cannot independently verify, with no constitutional channel by which the people who hold the work can correct the picture. The history of such structures is not stability but recurrence: as Durant (1968) traced across civilizations, concentrated power rises and falls in a long systole and diastole, and what slowed the fall, when anything did, were the moral and religious codes that held rulers to some account. Putkaradze (2024) gives the mechanism beneath that pattern. A dictatorship is workable only while its information stays truthful, and his model proves it does not: loyalty-driven distortion accumulates while the ruler, acting on a flattered picture, steers into a decline he cannot see. The corporate dictatorship was admissible in the material regime not because it was stable but because attention was genuinely free, so the resource it could not honestly see did not yet matter. The attention transition removes that grace: the structure must now govern the very resource its corrupted channel hides from it, and the dilemma turns from a latent flaw into the mechanism of collapse. The recurring failure Durant documented is, at corporate scale and AI speed, the failure mode this paper is about.

We supply the missing coupling as control theory applied to governance: decentralising decisions out of opaque corridors and binding them to continuously calibrated measurement, of which honest information is the consequence, not the assumption. Its strength is a single dimensionless gain built from the firm's constitution, and we prove the closed loop undergoes a non-smooth transcritical bifurcation at a critical governance level. Below it the corrupted attractor (the zombie firm) exists and the healthy state is only weakly metastable, with a lifetime set by the rate of corruption and the governance gap; above it the corrupted attractor is annihilated. Putkaradze's runaway is the zero-governance limit. We give the bifurcation a closed-form Lyapunov certificate, derive the healthy-state lifetime, and carry the firm-scale result up the four-scale chain as far as it honestly reaches. The collapse direction is a disciplined aggregation: a population of corporate dictatorships drains toward the depressed attention economy the first paper described. The constructive direction, that each constitutional firm gains ground rather than persisting as a durable island, turns on a selection dynamic this paper does not contain and the macro programme (Part 4 of this series) takes up; whether the attention economy holds together or comes apart turns on it, conditional and not closed here. The stakes are the ones Durant's record makes plain. We have broken the dictator's information loop with virtue before, and watched virtue fail on schedule. The question this paper makes precise is whether we can now break it by structure, and get the largest economic transition in history right where we have repeatedly gotten the smaller ones wrong.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制理论证明，企业层面的注意力治理存在一个临界点：低于该治理水平，企业陷入腐败吸引子（僵尸企业）；高于该水平，腐败吸引子被消灭。这一结论向上聚合为宏观注意力经济的分岔条件，决定整个经济系统是稳定还是崩溃。
AI.research_question: 在注意力稀缺的经济中，企业治理结构如何决定经济系统是否会崩溃？具体而言：传统的公司独裁（资本单方控制）在注意力转型后是否必然走向崩溃？是否存在一个临界治理水平，使得系统从不稳定转向稳定？
AI.motivation: 第一篇文章提出，当AI自动化了常规认知，经济约束从物质转向人类注意力，且生产侧的转变是平滑的，但决定系统是否崩溃的关键在治理侧——所有权与注意力的非线性耦合。本文旨在完成这一耦合的"企业层面"证明。
AI.theoretical_framework: 控制理论（治理作为闭环反馈）、分岔理论（非光滑跨临界分岔）、Durant的历史循环理论（权力兴衰）、Putkaradze的独裁信息模型（忠诚驱动的信息失真）。
AI.method: 将治理建模为控制理论问题：将决策从"不透明走廊"分散出去，绑定到持续校准的测量。推导出一个由企业章程决定的无量纲增益，证明闭环系统存在一个非光滑跨临界分岔临界点。给出Lyapunov证书的闭式解，推导健康状态的生命周期。
AI.findings: (1) 存在一个临界治理水平，低于它则腐败吸引子（僵尸企业）存在、健康状态弱亚稳定（寿命由腐败率和治理缺口决定）；高于它则腐败吸引子被消灭。(2) Putkaradze的失控模型是零治理的极限情况。(3) 企业层面结果可沿四尺度链向上聚合：企业独裁群体向第一篇文章描述的"抑郁注意力经济"滑落。(4) 建设性方向（每个宪政企业获得优势而非仅作为持久孤岛）依赖于一个选择动态，这不在本文范围内，由系列第四部分处理。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将治理问题严格形式化为控制理论中的分岔问题，给出了注意力经济崩溃的数学条件。(2) 连接了Durant的历史循环理论、Putkaradze的独裁信息模型与当代AI经济学。(3) 证明了"通过结构打破独裁信息回路"的可行性条件。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为企业治理设计提供了可量化的临界条件：治理水平必须超过某个阈值才能避免组织崩溃。(2) 解释了为什么传统公司结构在物质充裕时代可行但在注意力经济中会失效。(3) 为AI时代的制度设计提供了"通过结构而非道德"的路径——历史上道德约束屡次失败，现在需要结构性解决方案。

title: Tax Incentives and Venture Capital Risk-Taking: Evidence from the QSBS Program
affiliations: University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration and

detail.title: Tax Incentives and Venture Capital Risk-Taking: Evidence from the QSBS Program
detail.abstract: Do tax subsidies prompt investors to take on risk? We address this question by looking at investors' responses to changes to the Qualified Small Business Stock (QSBS) program, which reduces capital gains taxes on startup investing. We do so under a framework in which some startup investors — venture capitalists (VCs) — combine outside funding with incentive-based compensation, while others invest their own funds. Using bunching, triple-differences, and matching designs that exploit industry eligibility, investment vintage, and holding-period requirements, we analyze data from 158 thousand investor–firm pairings over two decades. We identify strategic investment timing, with subsidies prompting bunching at tax-eligible holding-period thresholds. Most notably, when and where tax subsidies apply, VCs shift their project selection toward riskier ventures: they invest more in pre-commercial stage startups, become more likely to provide startups with their initial capital, and invest more in startups with pre-existing debt, while becoming less likely to co-syndicate their investments. Tax-subsidized VC-backed ventures show higher failure rates, but on the flip side, attain higher valuations at exit and are more likely to reach "unicorn status." None of these patterns are observed for comparable non-VC investors in startups exposed to the same tax subsidies. Our tests further show that tax incentives lead to reallocation toward more innovative industries, yielding more impactful patents. Our study is the first to show that tax policy can shift entrepreneurial financing toward riskier, more innovative, and valuable startups.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国合格小型企业股票（QSBS）税收减免政策的变动，通过聚束、三重差分和匹配设计等方法，发现税收补贴促使风险投资者（VC）投资更早期、风险更高的初创企业，这些企业失败率更高但成功后的估值也更高，同时税收补贴还促使资本向更具创新性的行业重新配置。
AI.research_question: 税收补贴是否会促使投资者承担更多风险？具体而言，针对初创企业投资的资本利得税减免如何影响风险投资者（VC）和非VC投资者的投资行为与绩效？
AI.motivation: 税收政策是影响创业投资的重要工具，但已有研究对税收补贴是否以及如何改变投资者的风险承担行为缺乏深入理解。本文利用QSBS项目的准自然实验变异性，试图填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于两类投资者的委托代理框架：一类是VC（结合外部资金与激励性薪酬），另一类是非VC投资者（使用自有资金）。税收补贴可能通过改变VC的激励结构来影响其风险偏好。
AI.method: 利用行业资格、投资年份和持有期要求等政策变异，采用聚束分析（bunching）、三重差分（triple-differences）和匹配设计（matching designs），分析过去20年间15.8万个投资者-企业配对数据。
AI.findings: (1) 税收补贴促使投资者在税收合格的持有期阈值处出现聚束行为；(2) VC在税收补贴适用时转向风险更高的项目：更多投资于商业前阶段的初创企业、更可能提供初始资本、更多投资有债务的初创企业、更少联合投资；(3) 享受补贴的VC投资企业失败率更高，但退出估值更高，更可能成为"独角兽"；(4) 非VC投资者未表现出类似模式；(5) 税收激励导致资本向更具创新性的行业重新配置，产生更有影响力的专利。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从实证角度证明税收政策能够将创业融资引导向风险更高、创新性更强、价值更大的初创企业，揭示了税收补贴通过影响VC的委托代理激励结构来改变风险承担行为的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计创业税收激励政策提供了实证依据，表明针对VC的税收补贴可以有效促进高风险高回报的创业投资和创新活动，但也需注意其可能带来的更高失败率。

title: Sector-Differentiated Tax Exemptions in Investment Networks
affiliations: Rio de Janeiro State University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Sector-Differentiated Tax Exemptions in Investment Networks
detail.abstract: In this paper, we analyze sector-differentiated subsidies in production and investment networks. Our work expands Liu’s (2019) model of industrial policy in production networks to include the economy's investment goods network. We show how Liu’s main theoretical results must be modified when two distinct networks connect the sectors of the economy. We then present two applications of this theory to Brazil. Our first finding is that incorporating the investment network leads to changes in the sector priority ranking indicated by the theory. For our second application, we analyze the impact of sector-differentiated federal tax exemptions in Brazil in 2019, which were estimated at R$ 265 billion, or 3.6% of Brazil's GDP. We calculate that the impact of these subsidies on aggregate income was nearly zero. However, in a counterfactual scenario where subsidies are redistributed among sectors based on the theory-derived ranking, income increases by up to 1.7% within the investment-augmented production network.

AI.tldr: 本文在生产和投资网络中分析部门差异化补贴，扩展了Liu（2019）的产业政策模型，并将其应用于巴西。研究发现，纳入投资网络会改变部门优先排序；2019年巴西联邦税收豁免对总收入的近零影响，但基于理论重新分配补贴可使收入提升最高1.7%。
AI.research_question: 在包含生产和投资双重网络的经済中，部门差异化补贴如何影响经济总量？如何修正Liu（2019）的经典理论结果？
AI.motivation: Liu（2019）模型仅考虑生产网络，忽略了投资品网络在经济中的独立作用。本文旨在弥合这一理论空白，并利用巴西数据检验其政策含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展Liu（2019）的生产网络产业政策模型，引入投资品网络，构建双网络框架下的补贴效应分析。
AI.method: 理论建模：在生产和投资双重网络框架下推导修正后的产业政策最优条件。实证应用：利用巴西部门数据，进行反事实模拟和政策评估。
AI.findings: 1）纳入投资网络后，理论给出的部门补贴优先排序发生显著变化；2）2019年巴西实际联邦税收豁免（占GDP 3.6%）对总收入影响几乎为零；3）按理论排序重新分配补贴，可使收入提升最高1.7%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将投资品网络纳入生产网络模型，修正了单一网络框架下的产业政策理论结果，为部门差异化补贴提供了更完整的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴西等发展中经济体优化产业补贴政策提供了理论依据和具体排序方案，表明重新分配补贴可带来显著经济收益。

title: The Effect of Counterfeit Pharmaceuticals on Global

detail.title: The Effect of Counterfeit Pharmaceuticals on Global

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I, Chepkirui Cheruiyot, have no personal or financial affiliation with any person or organization pertaining this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No patients/ participants were involved i this research
declarations.funderStatement: This research paper has not been funded by anyone.

detail.abstract: Last year, the Pharmacy and Poisons Board of Kenya recalled a chemotherapy drug used to treat a variety of cancers. This was prompted by various reports by consumers claiming that the drug looked suspicious. The cancer drug was manufactured by an Indian company. Notably, India is one of the leading manufacturers of medicines including counterfeit medicines. The suspected counterfeit batch was recalled and hospitals with the said batch were asked to stop administering the drug and hand them over to the PPB for investigations. In April 2024, Nigeria's National Agency for Food and Drugs Administration and Control recalled a popular cough syrup for kids known as Benylin Paediatric Syrup. 1 This was after reports of the syrup causing uncommon side effects to the kids that had taken it. On testing, it was discovered that the syrup contained a toxic substance known as diethylene glycol. 2 The toxic batch was promptly recalled from the market. It being a popular brand, several countries also had to recall the batch including Kenya. These instances show how counterfeit pharmaceuticals pose a global health risk.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析肯尼亚和尼日利亚的假药召回案例，揭示了假药对全球健康构成的严重威胁。
AI.research_question: 假药如何构成全球健康风险？
AI.motivation: 通过具体案例（肯尼亚抗癌药召回、尼日利亚儿童止咳糖浆召回）说明假药问题的严重性和全球性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球公共卫生安全理论、药品监管体系理论
AI.method: 案例分析法
AI.findings: 假药不仅存在于发展中国家，且具有跨国传播特性；印度作为主要药品生产国也是假药重灾区；有毒物质（如二甘醇）掺入是常见假药问题；假药召回需要多国协同行动。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了全球卫生安全视角下假药问题的理论认识，强调了供应链全球化背景下药品监管的脆弱性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒各国加强药品进口监管和国际协作；警示消费者对药品外观和来源保持警惕；为药品监管机构提供案例参考。

title: Safety Theater: The People-First Chatbot Act and the Protection It Withholds

detail.title: Safety Theater: The People-First Chatbot Act and the Protection It Withholds
detail.abstract: On July 9, 2026, Representatives Valerie Foushee and Greg Casar introduced H.R. 9619, the People-First Chatbot Act, federal legislation built on model text drafted by the Consumer Federation of America, the Electronic Privacy Information Center, and Fairplay. The bill is promoted as a comprehensive answer to chatbot harm: data privacy, safety by design, strict products liability, and a private right of action for injured users. Read at the provision level, the statute delivers something different. It regulates a conversational surface rather than a technology, leaving every consequential deployment of the same models untouched. Its privacy sections bar advertisers and the government from chat logs while its safety section permits those logs to be retained for as long as five years and requires a monthly risk assessment whose metrics the Federal Trade Commission will define only after passage. Its liability regime rests on a metric deferred to that Commission and an “injury in fact” the text never scopes, and imposes liability without regard to care on systems whose outputs cannot be guaranteed. Its remedy reaches no bystander: the injury liability runs to a user harmed through use, and the private right of action reaches only a person injured by one of the Act’s own violations, so the gravest documented victims of chatbot involved violence, the bystanders of the Florida State University and Tumbler Ridge shootings, take nothing, though ordinary products liability doctrine already serves them. It regulates the wrong actor as well as the wrong unit: every duty attaches to a provider who creates or distributes a chatbot, the word “deployer” appears nowhere, and a person running an autonomous agent on his own account under his own name owes nothing while the open-source maintainer answers with reasonable care no defense and privity expressly abolished. And the consent on which its entire adult privacy title depends cannot be obtained from part of the class it names: the Act makes “informed” a condition of consent, elects a written description in easy-to-understand language as the vehicle, and imports the Americans with Disabilities Act’s definition of disability, which is in substantial part a definition of substantial limitation in reading and thinking, while the peer-reviewed record on simplified consent information reports null results for the readers who need it most. And if the statute’s “injury in fact” reaches emotional harm, chatbot users would recover the emotional distress damages that Cummings v. Premier Rehab Keller categorically denies to disabled plaintiffs suing under Section 504. This Commentary supplies a provision-level critique of the introduced text of H.R. 9619, documents the bystander gap against the litigation now pending over the Florida State and Tumbler Ridge attacks, identifies the emotional distress inversion the bill would work against disability civil rights remedies, and closes with a seven-part alternative, each element with a working model in enacted law: regulate by consequence, minimize data rather than retain and scan it, keep safety detection in the moment, place the substance in the statute, match liability to the machine, make the remedy usable, and invest in the capability of the protected.

AI.tldr: 本文对H.R. 9619《人民优先聊天机器人法案》进行条款层面的批判性分析，指出该法案表面上是应对聊天机器人危害的全面方案，实则存在多个根本性缺陷：监管的是对话界面而非技术本身、隐私与安全条款自相矛盾、责任机制依赖未定义的标准、救济范围排除最严重的旁观者受害者、监管对象错误、知情同意条款对残障人士不可实施，并与现有残障民权救济形成反向歧视。文章最后提出七点替代立法方案。
AI.research_question: H.R. 9619《人民优先聊天机器人法案》在条款层面存在哪些根本性缺陷？如何设计更有效的聊天机器人监管立法？
AI.motivation: 该法案被宣传为应对聊天机器人危害的全面立法方案，但条款层面的分析揭示其存在严重缺陷，可能无法保护最需要保护的受害者，甚至与现行残障民权法律产生冲突。有必要进行条款层面的批判性分析，并提出现实可行的替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产品责任理论、隐私与安全平衡理论、知情同意理论、残障民权法律框架（ADA及Section 504）、产品责任与侵权法原理
AI.method: 条款层面的法律文本批判分析（provision-level critique），结合已提起的诉讼案例（佛罗里达州立大学和Tumbler Ridge枪击案）进行文档分析，并与现行法律（产品责任法、ADA、Section 504、Cummings案判例）进行比较法分析。
AI.findings: 1. 法案监管的是"对话界面"而非技术本身，核心模型部署不受监管；2. 隐私条款禁止广告商和政府访问聊天记录，但安全条款允许保留长达五年并要求月度风险评估；3. 责任制度依赖FTC事后定义的指标和未界定的"事实伤害"，对无法保证输出的系统施加严格责任；4. 救济范围排除旁观者；5. 监管对象是"提供者"而非"部署者"，自主运行Agent的个人不承担责任；6. 知情同意条款引用ADA残障定义，但简化同意信息对阅读障碍者无效；7. 如果"事实伤害"包括情感伤害，将造成与Cummings案判例的矛盾，使残障原告处于更不利地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了新兴AI监管立法中"监管表面而非实质"的立法陷阱，提出了"监管后果而非技术"的替代理论框架，识别了聊天机器人责任立法与残障民权救济之间的结构性冲突。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者提供了七项具体的替代立法建议及现行法律中的工作模型：按后果监管、最小化数据而非保留扫描、实时安全检测、实体内容写入法律、责任与机器特性匹配、使救济可用、投资受保护群体的能力建设。

title: Gender Differences in Self-Promotion and Career Advice
affiliations: Monash University - Department of Economics, The University of Sydney and

detail.title: Gender Differences in Self-Promotion and Career Advice
detail.abstract: We study the role of self-promotion and career advice in sustaining gender differences in labor market outcomes. We conduct a pre-registered experiment in which “advisers” advise “workers” to attempt either a more or a less ambitious task. We find that women promote themselves less than men and, as a result, are 12 percentage points less likely to be advised to choose the more ambitious task. This gender gap in advice persists across both quantitative and qualitative self-assessments and is robust to variation in advisers’ information sets—including when advisers observe workers’ actual performance—but is eliminated and even reversed when advisers are informed of the gender gap in self-promotion.

AI.tldr: 研究发现女性自我推销更少，导致她们被建议选择更有雄心任务的概率比男性低12个百分点；但当顾问知晓这一性别差距后，该差距消失甚至逆转。
AI.research_question: 自我推销和职业建议如何维持劳动力市场结果的性别差异？
AI.motivation: 探究自我推销中的性别差距如何通过职业建议渠道持续影响女性的劳动市场表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于性别差异理论、自我推销与信息传递理论
AI.method: 预注册实验：顾问为"工作者"提供任务选择建议（更有雄心 vs. 较不雄心勃勃的任务）
AI.findings: 女性自我推销少于男性，导致被建议选择更有雄心任务的概率低12%；该差距在定量和定性自我评估中均存在，且在顾问知晓实际表现后仍然稳健；但当顾问被告知自我推销的性别差距后，该差距消失甚至逆转。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了自我推销的性别差距通过"职业建议"这一中介机制影响劳动力市场结果，补充了性别不平等再生产的社会机制理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示组织可通过提升决策者对性别自我推销差异的认知来减少职业建议中的性别偏见，为干预措施设计提供实证依据。

title: A Diagnostic Threshold for Differentiable Causal Discovery: Beyond ρ = 0.3

detail.title: A Diagnostic Threshold for Differentiable Causal Discovery: Beyond ρ = 0.3

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses only publicly available datasets (TCGA, CSI 300, DepMap) and synthetic data. No human subjects or animal experiments were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: The intra-cluster correlation threshold ρ = 0.3 has been widely adopted as a default in differentiable causal discovery since the NOTEARS formulation, yet its validity has never been empirically evaluated across scientific domains. We provide the first systematic investigation of this convention through three contributions. First, we establish theoretical properties of a principled moment-based ρ estimator, proving its consistency and characterizing its boundary behavior at ρ = 0 and ρ = 1. Second, we deploy the estimator to six domains-panel econometrics, cancer genomics, computational neuroscience, climate time-series analysis, financial risk networks, and genome-wide CRISPR dependency datafinding ρ = 0.0000 in four of six domains, ρ = 0.0068 in neuroscience, and ρ = 1.0000 in CRISPR dependency data under covariance-based pilot adjacency matrices. In every domain, ρ = 0.3 is rejected at p < 10-3. Third, we conduct a synthetic benchmark across 216 Erdős-Rényi and scale-free graph configurations, demonstrating that the ρ = 0.3 default produces catastrophic failure (F1 = 0), while ρ correctly diagnoses the weak-signal regime and stability selection emerges as the most robust practical threshold strategy (F1 = 0.461). Our results establish that the ρ = 0.3 convention lacks empirical justification and should be replaced by a data-driven, pipeline-aware estimate, with ρ serving as a diagnostic signal rather than a one-size-fits-all threshold.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估了可微因果发现中广泛使用的默认阈值ρ=0.3的有效性。通过理论证明、六个真实域实证检验和216种合成图配置的基准测试，发现该默认值缺乏实证依据，在大多数域中实际ρ值接近0或1，且会导致灾难性失败（F1=0），应被数据驱动的自适应估计替代。
AI.research_question: 可微因果发现中广泛采用的默认阈值ρ=0.3是否具有跨科学领域的实证有效性？应如何正确估计和使用ρ参数？
AI.motivation: 自NOTEARS提出以来，ρ=0.3作为默认阈值被大量使用，但从未被系统评估过其在各科学领域的有效性。这种未经检验的惯例可能导致因果发现结果的严重偏差，亟需系统性的理论和实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于矩的ρ估计量理论（包括一致性和边界行为分析）、稳定选择（stability selection）策略、可微因果发现框架。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：证明基于矩的ρ估计量的一致性，刻画其在ρ=0和ρ=1处的边界行为；2) 实证分析：在六个领域（面板计量经济学、癌症基因组学、计算神经科学、气候时间序列、金融风险网络、CRISPR依赖性数据）中估计ρ；3) 合成基准测试：在216种Erdős-Rényi和无标度图配置下比较ρ=0.3默认值、基于ρ的诊断和稳定选择策略的性能（F1分数）。
AI.findings: 1) 六个域中四个域的ρ估计值为0.0000，神经科学为0.0068，CRISPR依赖性数据为1.0000（基于协方差导向邻接矩阵）；2) 所有域中ρ=0.3均在p<10-3水平被拒绝；3) ρ=0.3默认值导致灾难性失败（F1=0），而基于ρ的诊断能正确识别弱信号区间，稳定选择是最稳健的实用阈值策略（F1=0.461）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次严格证明基于矩的ρ估计量的一致性并刻画其边界行为；系统揭示ρ=0.3惯例缺乏理论依据；建立数据驱动、流程感知的ρ估计框架的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 推翻ρ=0.3作为默认阈值的通行做法；提供可操作的替代方案：使用基于矩的ρ估计量作为诊断信号，采用稳定选择作为阈值策略；为因果发现实践者提供跨领域的实证基准和参数选择指南。

title: Equilibrium Excess Demand in the Low Income Rental Housing Market: Theory and Experimental Evidence
affiliations: McMaster University - Department of Economics, ,  and McMaster University

detail.title: Equilibrium Excess Demand in the Low Income Rental Housing Market: Theory and Experimental Evidence
detail.abstract: We develop a model of monopolistic competition in the rental housing market for low-income households with endogenous tenancy default. Identical suppliers choose the number of rental units to supply and the rental price to charge to maximize expected profits. Potential tenants who differ in their incomes and face an uninsurable income risk choose whether to engage in a costly search for rental housing. If they search and find a rental unit, then they must commit to a rental agreement before their income uncertainty is resolved. Consequently, some tenants may default on their rental payments. We show that tenancy default can explain persistent excess demand in the low-income rental housing market without any government price regulations, and that such excess demand can lead to nonstandard effects of government regulations. We also test whether the excess-demand equilibrium is behaviorally plausible by designing a laboratory experiment. Our experimental results reveal that, with feedback and repetition, the excess-demand equilibrium that requires landlord participants to restrict supply is no more difficult for participants to reach than a market-clearing equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含内生租户违约的低收入租房市场垄断竞争模型，证明违约行为可导致无价格管制下的持续超额需求，并通过实验室实验验证该均衡的行为可行性。
AI.research_question: 低收入租房市场中，为何会在无政府价格管制的情况下出现持续的超额需求？租户违约机制如何解释这一现象？
AI.motivation: 低租房市场普遍存在"短缺"现象，传统解释多归因于租金管制等政策干预。但现实中即使无管制也观察到超额需求，本文试图从租户违约这一内生风险角度提供新解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 垄断竞争模型；内生违约理论；搜寻理论；超额需求均衡
AI.method: 理论建模（垄断竞争+内生违约）+ 实验室实验（检验超额需求均衡的行为可行性）
AI.findings: （1）租户违约风险可导致房东主动限制供给，形成无管制下的超额需求均衡；（2）此超额需求下政府干预可能产生非标准效应；（3）实验表明该均衡在重复反馈下与市场出清均衡同样容易达成。
AI.theory_contributions: 将内生违约引入住房市场垄断竞争模型，为无管制下的超额需求提供了新理论解释；揭示了违约风险如何改变房东供给决策和市场均衡性质。
AI.practical_contributions: 对低收入住房政策制定有启示：在存在违约风险的市场上，传统的供给端或价格管制政策可能产生非预期效果；实验验证为理论预测的行为合理性提供了经验支持。

title: A Principled Estimator of Intra-Cluster Correlation for the Stratified Causal Discovery Threshold

detail.title: A Principled Estimator of Intra-Cluster Correlation for the Stratified Causal Discovery Threshold

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses only publicly available datasets (TCGA, CSI 300, DepMap) and synthetic data. No human subjects or animal experiments were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: Cluster-aware causal discovery reduces sample complexity from O (d 3) to O (d log d) through stratified gradient estimation, but the decision to stratify depends on a critical threshold n crit whose practical computation requires an intra-cluster correlation parameter p. Current practice sets p = 0.3-the median within-cluster Pearson correlation across cancer types-a convention with no theoretical basis that shifts n crit by several hundred samples at typical dimensions (d = 150). We propose ˆ︁ p, a gradient-based estimator that exploits the geometric structure of NOTEARS score matrices. We prove V n-consistency via matrix concentration, derive its asymptotic distribution, and bound the resulting n crit decision error. On the Sachs protein signaling benchmark-real single-cell data with 17 known causal edges-ˆ︁ p converges to a small but non-zero score-space correlation with bias decaying from 0.0034 at n = 200 to 0.0001 at n = 853. On the TCGA pan-cancer benchmark, ˆ︁ p correctly returns near-zero values when pilot NOTEARS cannot recover structure, triggering a conservative default that prevents erroneous clustering recommendations. We prove that when p S = 0, the estimator automatically tightens n crit to its theoretical minimum-a behavior that is not an estimation failure but the correct statistical decision, since any potential benefit from clustering in this regime is dominated by the additional noise it introduces. Together, the theoretical guarantees and multi-platform validation establish ˆ︁ p as the first principled alternative to the ad-hoc p = 0.3 convention, restructuring the decision logic of stratified causal discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于梯度的估计量p̂，用于替代因果发现中无理论依据的p=0.3经验约定，通过几何结构和矩阵浓度理论证明了其统计一致性，并在多个基准上验证了有效性，从而重构了分层因果发现的决策逻辑。
AI.research_question: 如何为聚类感知的因果发现方法提供一个有理论依据的簇内相关性参数p的估计量，以替代当前无理论基础的p=0.3经验约定？
AI.motivation: 当前聚类感知的因果发现方法中，决定是否分层的关键阈值n_crit依赖于簇内相关性参数p，但实践中p被随意设为0.3——这一中位数经验值无理论基础，且在高维场景下会导致n_crit产生数百个样本的偏移。
AI.theoretical_framework: NOTEARS评分矩阵的几何结构、矩阵浓度理论、渐近分布推导、决策误差界
AI.method: 提出基于梯度的估计量p̂，利用NOTEARS评分矩阵的几何结构；通过矩阵浓度理论证明Vn一致性；推导渐近分布；对n_crit决策误差进行界分析；在Sachs蛋白质信号基准和TCGA泛癌基准上验证。
AI.findings: 在Sachs基准上，p̂收敛到微小但非零的分数空间相关性，偏差从n=200时的0.0034降至n=853时的0.0001；在TCGA基准上，当pilot NOTEARS无法恢复结构时，p̂正确返回近零值，触发保守默认值；当p_S=0时，估计器自动将n_crit收紧至理论最小值。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为分层因果发现中的簇内相关性参数提供了有理论依据的估计量，证明了其Vn一致性、渐近分布和决策误差界，揭示了p_S=0时估计器行为并非估计失败而是正确的统计决策。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了p=0.3经验约定的首个有理论依据的替代方案，重构了分层因果发现的决策逻辑，在多平台基准（单细胞数据和泛癌数据）上验证了实用性。

title: The Mean Was Positive. The Strategy Still Failed — a Falsification-First Case Study in Protected Validation and Imperfect Research Governance

detail.title: The Mean Was Positive. The Strategy Still Failed — a Falsification-First Case Study in Protected Validation and Imperfect Research Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced the research. The study was conducted independently and was not sponsored by any employer, broker, data vendor, investment manager, or other third party.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study used historical market data and research-repository records and involved no human participants, patients, identifiable personal data, or animal subjects. Institutional ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author using personal time and pre-existing computing resources.

detail.abstract:
A retail-executable FOMC calendar rule — long SPY from the prior close into the statement-day close, inspired by but not replicating the pre-FOMC announcement drift of Lucca and Moench (2015) — looked compelling in training: across 112 scheduled FOMC events (2002–2015) it earned +$3.561 per event after frozen costs (daily t-statistic 3.20, profit factor 2.33), positive in thirteen of fourteen years, surviving a doubled-cost stress test. In the disjoint 2016–2020 validation window, read under a one-authorized-read protocol, the rule remained positive — +$0.195 per event — but uneconomic, failing the preregistered +$1.00 expectancy and 1.20 profit-factor bars, and was killed. A TLT negative control outperformed the equity rule in that window, a warning sign consistent with a duration or monetary-easing confound; no causal claim is made. The paper also discloses a governance defect: an ambiguous statistical promotion rule (R2) was resolved only after the training result was visible. The contribution is two-tier: an audit trail that exposed imperfect promotion governance, and a separately protected validation boundary — disjoint data, predetermined thresholds, a negative control, no rescue pass — that held, stopping a persuasive training result before it could become a deployment candidate.

AI disclosure. Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and OpenAI ChatGPT assisted with software implementation, repository evidence retrieval and organization, structural and language editing, and document formatting. The author established the research questions, hypotheses, validation rules and thresholds, interpreted the results, and drew the conclusions. All AI-assisted outputs were reviewed and verified against the research repository and cited sources. The author accepts full responsibility for the manuscript.

AI.tldr: 本文记录了一个基于FOMC公告日的交易策略从"训练集表现优异"到"验证集被否决"的完整审计轨迹，揭示了研究治理缺陷，并展示了一个有效的验证边界如何阻止了看似诱人的回测结果成为真实部署策略。
AI.research_question: 一个可执行的、基于FOMC公告日的SPY交易策略（受Lucca & Moench 2015的pre-FOMC漂移现象启发），在经过严谨的样本外验证和预设阈值检验后，是否依然具有经济意义上的交易价值？
AI.motivation: 学术文献中发现的"pre-FOMC公告漂移"现象已被广泛讨论，但将其转化为实际可执行的零售交易策略时，往往存在过度拟合、数据窥探和治理漏洞等问题。本文旨在通过一个严格的事前注册验证协议，检验该策略的真实可靠性，并揭示研究治理中的缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: FOMC公告前漂移（Pre-FOMC Announcement Drift, Lucca & Moench 2015）；样本外验证（Out-of-sample validation）；事前注册研究（Preregistered research）；研究治理与可重复性危机。
AI.method: 设定一个可执行的交易规则（FOMC公告日买入SPY并持有至收盘），在训练期（2002-2015，112次事件）进行回测，设定事前预设的通过阈值（期望收益≥+$1.00/事件，利润因子≥1.20）；然后在独立的验证窗口（2016-2020）进行一次性检验，并引入TLT国债ETF作为负控制。
AI.findings: 训练期表现极为出色（+$3.561/事件，t统计量3.20，利润因子2.33，13/14年正向收益），但在验证期收益急剧萎缩至+$0.195/事件，未通过预设的经济意义阈值。TLT负控制在验证期表现优于SPY策略，暗示可能存在久期或货币宽松的混杂因素。研究治理缺陷在于统计晋升规则（R²）的模糊性在训练结果可见后才被解决。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提供了一个完整的审计轨迹，暴露了不完善的晋升治理（promotion governance）问题，即从"发现"到"部署"之间的决策流程存在漏洞；（2）展示了一个隔离保护的验证边界（分离数据、预设阈值、负控制、不得补救）如何有效工作，阻止了令人信服的回测结果成为实际部署候选。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为量化交易策略的研发流程提供了治理框架的借鉴——即使训练结果再优异，也必须在严格的事前注册验证下接受检验；（2）揭示了看似稳健的回测结果可能隐藏混杂因素（如TLT负控制的表现暗示该策略收益可能来源于降息周期而非公告日效应本身）；（3）对零售量化投资者有警示意义，表明简单复制学术发现到实际交易中可能面临严重的样本外衰减。

title: The Labor Market Impacts of GLP-1s
affiliations: University of Copenhagen, , University of Copenhagen - Department of Economics, Rockwool Foundation Research Unit and Duke University - Stanford School of Public Policy

detail.title: The Labor Market Impacts of GLP-1s
detail.abstract: We estimate the causal impacts of GLP-1 treatment on labor market outcomes using linked Danish administrative data and a matched stacked difference-in-differences design. We compare patients who initiate GLP-1 treatment during the first two years of Semaglutide availability to observably similar patients who initiate four years later. We find that GLP-1 treatment reduces long-term sickness leave by 17.3%. We estimate total fiscal benefits of GLP-1 initiation of approximately 1.3–1.5% of annual labor income per employed individual. We do not detect statistically significant or economically meaningful impacts on income, labor force participation, or employment over four years.

AI.tldr: 本文利用丹麦行政数据和匹配堆叠双重差分法，估计GLP-1治疗对劳动力市场结果的因果影响。研究发现，GLP-1治疗使长期病假减少17.3%，每位就业者每年带来约1.3–1.5%劳动收入的财政收益，但对收入、劳动力参与率和就业无显著影响。
AI.research_question: GLP-1治疗（如Semaglutide）对患者劳动力市场结果（病假、收入、就业等）的因果影响是什么？
AI.motivation: GLP-1药物（如司美格鲁肽）广泛用于治疗肥胖和糖尿病，但其对患者社会经济结果（尤其是劳动力市场表现）的因果效应尚缺乏严谨的因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康经济学中的人力资本理论：健康改善可提高劳动生产率和劳动供给；公共财政视角：健康干预可能通过减少病假和医疗支出产生财政收益。
AI.method: 利用丹麦行政数据，采用匹配堆叠双重差分法（matched stacked difference-in-differences），比较Semaglutide上市前两年内开始治疗的患者与四年后开始治疗的相似患者。
AI.findings: （1）GLP-1治疗使长期病假减少17.3%；（2）每名就业者每年带来约1.3–1.5%劳动收入的财政收益；（3）对收入、劳动力参与率和就业率无统计显著或经济意义显著的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为健康投资改善人力资本的理论提供了因果证据；拓展了GLP-1药物经济影响评估的研究视角，从临床指标延伸至劳动力市场。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估GLP-1药物的社会经济效益提供量化依据；提示GLP-1治疗可减少病假成本，但对整体就业和收入影响有限，有助于医保和公共财政决策。

title: How a critical focus on gender can transform One Health into a plural understanding of care
affiliations: Università di Bologna, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Montreal, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Universidad Nacional de Colombia, Njala University, National Pedagogical University, Njala University, International Development Research Centre, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Southern California - Program on Global Health and Human Ritghts

detail.title: How a critical focus on gender can transform One Health into a plural understanding of care
detail.abstract: Despite growing recognition of gender's importance in global health, One Health frameworks have insufficiently engaged with critical gender theory and feminist scholarship. This paper argues that meaningful progress requires moving beyond categorical gender roles toward a relational, processual understanding of gender as something people do in relationship with others, including non-human others, and as deeply entangled with practices of care. Drawing on the collective experience of the Collaborative One Health Research Initiative on Epidemics (COHRIE) — four community-based, equity-focused research projects conducted across nine countries in Africa and Latin America between 2021 and 2026 — we offer a comparative analysis of how gender shaped zoonotic disease exposure, epidemic vulnerability, and community resilience in diverse socioecological contexts. Findings across projects consistently show that attending to gender redirects attention to who cares for whom: the largely unrecognised, unpaid, and intersectionally differentiated labour of care that women and men perform for their families, animals, and environments. The paper further demonstrates that gender cannot be disentangled from ethnicity, land access, colonial history, and governance structures, nor from Indigenous ontologies that conceive health as an emergent property of the relationships between humans, animals, plants, and territories. We conclude with five recommendations for embedding relational, intersectional, and decolonial approaches to gender into One Health research, policy, and practice — arguing for a paradigm shift from a global health security logic centred on disease surveillance and preparedness, toward an ethos of prevention grounded in plural, community-based ecologies of care.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了"一体健康"框架对性别议题的忽视，基于在非洲和拉丁美洲九国开展的四项社区研究，提出应将性别视为关系性、过程性的实践，并强调其与照料劳动的深刻关联。文章最后提出五项建议，倡导从"全球卫生安全"转向"基于多元社区照料生态的预防"范式。
AI.research_question: 性别如何形塑人畜共患病的暴露、流行病脆弱性与社区韧性？如何将关系性、交叉性与去殖民化的性别视角嵌入"一体健康"研究与实践？
AI.motivation: 现有"一体健康"框架对性别议题的处理流于表面，未能与批判性别理论和女性主义学术进行深入对话，限制了其对健康不平等根源的理解和干预效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判性别理论（性别作为"做"出来的关系性实践）、女性主义照护伦理、交叉性理论、去殖民理论、原住民本体论（健康是人与非人关系的涌现属性）。
AI.method: 基于COHRIE联盟在非洲和拉丁美洲九国开展的四个社区导向、关注公平的研究项目的比较分析。
AI.findings: 性别问题将注意力引向"谁照料谁"——大量未被承认、无偿且交叉分化的照料劳动；性别与族群、土地获取、殖民历史、治理结构以及原住民本体论密不可分。
AI.theory_contributions: 将批判性别理论和女性主义照护伦理系统引入"一体健康"框架，提出从"类别化性别"转向"关系性、过程性性别"的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出五项嵌入关系性、交叉性与去殖民化性别方法的可操作建议，倡导从"疾病监测与防范"的全球卫生安全逻辑转向"基于多元社区照料生态的预防"范式。

title: Modern Difference-in-Differences, Same Old Answer: What Event-Study Estimates Really Tell Us About the Effects of Minimum Wages on Jobs
affiliations: University of California, Irvine - Department of Economics and University of California, Irvine

detail.title: Modern Difference-in-Differences, Same Old Answer: What Event-Study Estimates Really Tell Us About the Effects of Minimum Wages on Jobs
detail.abstract: Two prominent publications in the recent minimum wage literature argue that estimation of the employment effects of minimum wages should use "clean" event-study designs, and that doing so leads to the conclusion that minimum wages have very limited, if any, effects on employment. We explore the use of event-study designs in this context, using the event-study stacked design of Cengiz, Dube, Lindner and Zipperer (2019a) and the related local projections difference-in-differences approach in Dube and Lindner (2024), along with their same data sources and period coverage. We generally find negative and significant employment effects of minimum wages in the United States, both overall and - more strongly - in the restaurant industry. The null results in these two papers are fragile and depend critically on a number of choices regarding variables, events, sample definitions, and weighting; they are not attributable to using an event-study design.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，近期关于最低工资的"干净"事件研究设计文献所报告的无就业效应结论非常脆弱，依赖特定的变量选择、事件定义、样本界定和加权方式；在使用相同数据和方法后，作者普遍发现了显著为负的就业效应。
AI.research_question: 使用事件研究设计方法，最低工资对就业究竟有无显著影响？近期两篇使用"干净"事件研究设计的论文结论是否稳健？
AI.motivation: 近期最低工资文献中，两篇有影响力的论文（Cengiz et al., 2019a; Dube & Lindner, 2024）声称使用"干净"事件研究设计后发现最低工资对就业影响非常有限甚至为零。这一结论与部分传统文献存在分歧，有必要检验其稳健性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件研究设计（Event-study design）；堆叠事件研究设计（Stacked design）；局部投影双重差分法（Local projections difference-in-differences）。
AI.method: 复制并扩展Cengiz et al. (2019a)和Dube & Lindner (2024)的分析，使用相同的数据来源和时间跨度，但调整变量选择、事件定义、样本界定和加权方式等关键设定，检验结果的稳健性。
AI.findings: （1）在美国整体数据和餐饮行业数据中，最低工资对就业存在显著为负的效应；（2）这两篇论文报告的零结果非常脆弱，对变量选择、事件定义、样本界定和加权方式等设定高度敏感；（3）零结果并非由于使用了事件研究设计本身所致，而是源于特定的分析选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了事件研究设计在最低工资就业效应研究中的适用性和局限性，指出"干净"设计本身并不必然导致零结果，方法选择与具体设定同等重要。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者而言，最低工资上调可能带来显著的就业负面影响，尤其是在餐饮等低工资行业；政策评估需警惕研究结论对方法选择的敏感性。

title: Optimal Static Hedging for Budget-Constrained Korean Oil Importers

detail.title: Optimal Static Hedging for Budget-Constrained Korean Oil Importers
detail.abstract: A Korean crude-oil importer facing correlated WTI and USD/KRW exposure must decide, before any option is bought, what fraction of each to hedge out of a fixed premium budget-a static allocation problem this paper poses and solves exactly as a convex program, cross-verified by independent implementations. The budget binds at a vertex but shallowly; the allocation's extreme asymmetry is a closed-form consequence of the WTI leg's dominant variance and near-zero cross-asset correlation, not an optimizer artifact; and cost minimization alone selects a different, worse-hedged corner than risk minimization. The paper then quantifies, and resolves, a limitation specific to knockout pricing: its premium is cheap because the option can die, and under the stress scenario the hedge is bought against, jump-adapted exact simulation shows it is dead with high probability-far above the unconditional statistics a naive reading would suggest, enough to make an all-knockout book infeasible under the very stress it targets. An instrument-mix program letting the optimizer choose between a standalone-priced knockout leg and a vanilla leg resolves this: feasible at every mortality level, it switches instruments at a closed-form indifference point and, at the measured stress mortality, selects the all-vanilla book-budget-feasible and lower-risk than the knockout program's own optimum. The knockout structure's premium discount, at its measured mortality, is decisively not worth having.

AI.tldr: 本文研究韩国原油进口商在固定保费预算约束下，如何最优配置WTI和USD/KRW对冲比例。研究发现最优解呈现极端不对称性，且敲出期权在压力情景下死亡率极高，导致其保费折扣不值得，最终应选择全部 vanilla 期权组合。
AI.research_question: 在固定保费预算约束下，面临相关WTI和USD/KRW风险暴露的韩国原油进口商，应如何静态分配对冲比例？以及敲出期权结构在此场景下是否值得使用？
AI.motivation: 实际中企业面临多重相关风险暴露，且对冲预算有限，需在预算约束下最优分配对冲资源。同时敲出期权虽保费低廉，但可能在最需要保护时失效，需量化评估其实际价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 凸优化理论、敲出期权定价与跳跃扩散过程、静态对冲分配模型
AI.method: 凸规划精确求解（独立实现交叉验证）、闭合形式推导、跳跃自适应精确模拟
AI.findings: 1. 预算约束在顶点处约束较弱，分配极度不对称是WTI方差主导和跨资产相关性接近于零的闭合形式结果；2. 成本最小化与风险最小化选择不同角点解；3. 压力情景下敲出期权死亡率远高于无条件统计量，导致全敲出组合在目标压力下不可行；4. 工具混合程序在闭合形式无差异点切换，压力死亡率下选择全vanilla组合，预算可行且风险更低；5. 敲出结构在实测死亡率下的保费折扣不值得。
AI.theory_contributions: 将静态对冲分配问题建模为凸规划并给出精确解；揭示了敲出期权在压力场景下死亡率远高于朴素理解的现象；建立了敲出与vanilla期权之间的无差异切换条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为面临多重相关风险暴露的企业提供了固定预算下最优对冲比例的精确求解方法；明确建议在压力情景死亡率较高时不应使用敲出期权；提供了可操作的instrument-mix优化框架。

title: Contracting Frictions, Geography, and Multinational Firms: Evidence from Mexico

detail.title: Contracting Frictions, Geography, and Multinational Firms: Evidence from Mexico
detail.abstract: In this paper, I explore how contracting frictions and geography influence the trade costs faced by multinationals in their affiliates located in Mexico relative to domestic firms. I document two key facts. First, distance to firm’s home countries influences firms’ sourcing patterns. Second, sectors with a larger presence of foreign affiliates are more intensive in relationship specific inputs. I develop a small open economy model with multiple sectors, imperfect contracting, input relationship-specificity, global sourcing and multinational production. I compute a set of counterfactual equilibria to gauge the relative importance of contracting frictions, trade costs, and productivity in the price advantage of multinationals over domestic firms. My findings show that, contrary to priors, foreign firms seem to have a disadvantage relative to domestic firms in trade costs and contracting frictions. Eliminating all differences between foreign and domestic firms leads to reduction in real GNP of 2.7 percent, while doing so only for productivity reduces real GNP by 2.2 percent.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了合同摩擦和地理因素如何影响跨国公司在墨西哥子公司的贸易成本，发现跨国公司在贸易成本和合同摩擦方面相对于本土企业存在劣势，而生产率优势才是其竞争力的关键来源。
AI.research_question: 合同摩擦和地理距离如何影响跨国公司相对于本土企业的贸易成本？
AI.motivation: 已有研究多关注跨国公司的生产率优势，但对其在贸易成本和合同摩擦方面是否同样具有优势缺乏系统探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多部门小开放经济模型，融合了不完全合同、投入品关系专用性、全球 sourcing 和跨国生产。
AI.method: 构建理论模型并计算反事实均衡，量化合同摩擦、贸易成本和生产率对跨国公司价格优势的相对重要性。
AI.findings: （1）距离母国越远，企业 sourcing 模式受影响；（2）外资企业占比高的行业更依赖关系专用性投入；（3）跨国公司在贸易成本和合同摩擦方面相对于本土企业存在劣势；（4）消除所有差异使实际 GNP 下降2.7%，仅消除生产率差异使实际 GNP 下降2.2%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将合同摩擦与地理因素纳入统一框架，系统分析了跨国公司相对于本土企业的成本结构差异，挑战了跨国公司具有全方位优势的传统认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了跨国公司竞争力的真正来源是生产率优势而非贸易成本或合同优势，为发展中国家吸引外资政策提供了理论依据。

title: How Exogenous Liquidity Affects Information Efficiency in the Options Market
affiliations: Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU) and

detail.title: How Exogenous Liquidity Affects Information Efficiency in the Options Market
detail.abstract: We exploit the staggered 2001 decimalization to examine how exogenous liquidity affects option-market information efficiency. Using a Difference-in-Differences design, treated options exhibit narrower spreads and greater participation by discount customers. Aggregate option order imbalance (OI) becomes more predictive of subsequent five-day straddle returns, particularly among stocks with higher noise-trading activity. A market-maker hedging proxy exhibits no comparable increase in predictive power, providing little support for a pure hedging explanation. Complementary evidence from the post-COVID period shows stronger aggregate OI predictability following increased retail participation, consistent with reduced short-run informational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2001年股票交易最小报价单位十进制化这一外生冲击，研究流动性改善对期权市场信息效率的影响。研究发现，流动性提升后，期权价差收窄、散户参与增加，整体期权订单不平衡对后续收益的预测能力增强，尤其在噪声交易较多的股票中更为明显。但做市商对冲因素无法解释这一现象，而COVID后散户参与增加也强化了订单不平衡的预测力，表明流动性提升可能降低短期信息效率。
AI.research_question: 外生流动性冲击如何影响期权市场的信息效率？
AI.motivation: 流动性对市场信息效率的影响在理论上存在分歧：更好的流动性可能通过降低交易成本吸引知情交易者（提高效率），也可能吸引噪声交易者（降低效率）。本文利用2001年十进制化的准自然实验，为这一争论提供因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论、信息效率理论、流动性-信息效率权衡假说
AI.method: 双重差分法（DID），以2001年股票报价十进制化为外生冲击
AI.findings: 1) 流动性增加后期权价差收窄，散户参与度上升；2) 期权订单不平衡对后续跨式期权收益的预测能力增强；3) 该效应在噪声交易较高的股票中更显著；4) 做市商对冲因素无法解释预测力提升；5) COVID后散户参与增加也强化了订单不平衡的预测力。
AI.theory_contributions: 为流动性如何影响期权市场信息效率提供了因果证据，揭示了流动性提升可能通过吸引噪声交易者降低短期信息效率的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 对市场监管者而言，流动性改善不必然提升市场效率，需关注噪声交易增加导致的短期可预测性；对投资者而言，期权订单不平衡可作为预测短期收益的信号。

title: Autocrats Before Autocracy: A Non-Tautological Measure of Democratic Backsliding

detail.title: Autocrats Before Autocracy: A Non-Tautological Measure of Democratic Backsliding
detail.abstract: Do autocratic-mandated leaders erode democratic institutions, and through what channels? To answer these questions, I construct a new database of autocratic executives (Prime Ministers, Presidents) across 62 competitive democracies from 1945 to 2025, using an ex-ante definition based on party campaign manifestos scored by a large language model for the share of content devoted to autocratic rhetoric. First, I show that the election of an autocratic-mandated leader strongly predicts whether a country transitions into autocracy within the following decade, under two independent regime classifications. Second, using local-projections and heterogeneity-robust difference-indifferences, I show that once in power these leaders weaken democratic institutions and judicial constraints on the executive gradually and cumulatively without reversion. They do so through executive non-compliance with the courts and court packing, rather than outright purges of sitting judges, alongside rising government and self-censorship of the media and harassment of journalists. Together the results show that autocratic-mandated leaders are constrained by existing institutional guardrails at first but wear them down over time, and that this trajectory is, to a meaningful degree, visible in their campaign rhetoric before it unfolds.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1945-2025年间62个竞争性民主国家的数据，通过大语言模型分析政党竞选宣言中的威权修辞占比，构建了"威权授权领导人"数据库。研究发现，这类领导人当选后，会通过司法不服从、法院扩编、媒体压制等方式逐步侵蚀民主制度和司法约束，最终在十年内显著增加国家向威权转型的概率。
AI.research_question: 威权授权的领导人是否会侵蚀民主制度？通过什么渠道发生？
AI.motivation: 民主衰退是当代政治学的核心议题，但现有研究对"通过选举上台的威权倾向领导人如何逐步瓦解民主制度"这一机制缺乏系统性实证证据。作者希望通过事前（ex-ante）识别威权授权领导人，追踪其执政后的制度侵蚀路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民主衰退理论、威权授权理论、制度约束理论。核心观点：威权授权的领导人并非一开始就能摧毁民主，而是受到现有制度护栏约束，但会通过渐进策略逐步磨损这些护栏。
AI.method: 1. 利用大语言模型（LLM）对62个民主国家（1945-2025）的政党竞选宣言进行威权修辞内容评分，事前定义威权授权领导人；2. 使用局部投影法（local projections）和异质性稳健双重差分法进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 1. 威权授权领导人当选后，该国十年内转型为威权政体的概率显著上升（两种独立政体分类标准下均成立）；2. 这类领导人通过司法不服从（拒不执行法院判决）和法院扩编（而非直接清洗现任法官）来削弱司法约束；3. 同时伴随着政府审查和媒体自我审查的上升，以及对记者的骚扰；4. 制度侵蚀是渐进的、累积的，且不可逆转。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了"威权授权"（autocratic-mandate）这一新的概念框架，将竞选修辞与制度侵蚀联系起来；2. 揭示了民主衰退的"渐进磨损"机制，挑战了"突然崩溃"的传统叙事；3. 表明领导人的竞选言论具有事前预测力，为预警民主衰退提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为民主监督机构提供了一种基于竞选言论的事前预警工具；2. 提醒选民和制度守护者关注候选人的威权修辞，而非仅关注政策立场；3. 为司法独立和媒体自由的保护机制设计提供实证依据。

title:
The Algorithm of Desire: Digital Escapism, Blank-Slate Heroines, and the Economy of Imaginary Love in Contemporary Female Visual Novel Culture 
A Psychoanalytic, Poststructuralist, and Cultural-Critical Essay
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title:
The Algorithm of Desire: Digital Escapism, Blank-Slate Heroines, and the Economy of Imaginary Love in Contemporary Female Visual Novel Culture 
A Psychoanalytic, Poststructuralist, and Cultural-Critical Essay
detail.abstract: The spectacle is not a collection of images; it is a social relation between people that is mediated by images."-Guy Debord, The Society of the Spectacle (1967/1994, p. 4) "Enjoyment is not a state but a mode of relating. The subject does not find enjoyment in an object; it finds it in the gap, in the failure to reach the object."-Slavoj Žižek, The Plague of Fantasies (1997, p. 6)

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过德波（景观社会）和齐泽克（享乐与缺失）的思想，探讨了当代社会中图像、欲望与主体之间的关系。德波认为景观不是图像集合，而是由图像中介的社会关系；齐泽克则认为享乐不在于占有对象，而在于追求对象过程中的失败与间隙。两者共同揭示了现代主体在消费主义与视觉文化中的结构性困境。
AI.research_question: 本文的研究问题是如何理解当代社会中图像中介的社会关系（景观）与主体欲望结构（享乐）之间的内在关联，以及这种关联如何塑造现代主体的存在方式。
AI.motivation: 德波和齐泽克的引文分别从社会宏观层面和主体心理层面揭示了当代资本主义文化的核心悖论，但两者之间的理论对话尚未被充分展开。本文旨在弥合这一理论鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）德波的景观社会理论——图像中介的社会关系；2）齐泽克的拉康式精神分析——享乐（jouissance）作为缺失与失败的结构性关系。
AI.method: 理论分析与比较研究，通过对德波和齐泽克核心概念的文本细读与对话，进行哲学与社会理论的交叉分析。
AI.findings: 景观社会通过图像制造了永不可及的欲望对象，而主体的享乐恰恰产生于对这种缺失的反复体验。两者共同构成了资本主义意识形态的再生产机制：景观提供幻象，享乐维系欲求。
AI.theory_contributions: 将德波的宏观社会批判与齐泽克的微观主体分析进行理论嫁接，揭示了景观社会运作的心理动力学基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解当代社交媒体、消费文化和视觉政治中的主体困境提供了批判性分析框架，有助于人们反思自身在景观社会中的欲望结构。

title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Biological Graph Architecture (BDH) for Multi-Echelon Supply Chain Optimization Under Disruptions

detail.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Biological Graph Architecture (BDH) for Multi-Echelon Supply Chain Optimization Under Disruptions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. Neither human nor animal experimentation was conducted in this study. The research relies purely on computational algorithms and secondary dataset simulations.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Managing a multi-echelon supply chain under demand volatility and disruption risks is a complex sequential decision-making problem. Current Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) models relying on Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLP) or Graph Neural Networks (GNN) often struggle to capture complex network topologies or suffer from oversmoothing and scalability issues in large-scale graphs. To overcome these limitations, this research proposes a novel Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) framework integrating Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with the Dragon Hatchling (BDH) architecture as the core policy network. BDH is a biologically inspired, scale-free network model that leverages local neuron interactions and Hebbian working memory.
By modeling a two-echelon supply chain environment subject to stochastic demand and lead-time disruptions, the proposed BDH-PPO model enables agents to autonomously reason and adapt to supply shocks without relying on computationally expensive chain-of-thought processes. Through rigorous simulation, we demonstrate that the BDH-PPO model converges faster and outperforms static inventory policies (e.g., base-stock, (s, Q)) in minimizing total operational costs while effectively dampening the Bullwhip Effect.
Current State of the Art (The Gap): While Transformer-based models and traditional RL have been extensively used, BDH represents a novel "post-Transformer" architecture. To date, no existing Q1/Q2 Scopus literature has published the direct integration of BDH as the Policy Network in a MARL framework for supply chain inventory control. This project aims to be the pioneer in translating BDH's cognitive reasoning capabilities from NLP tasks into the domain of Control and Logistics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将龙雏（BDH）生物启发式无标度网络架构与PPO算法结合的多智能体强化学习框架（BDH-PPO），用于解决多级供应链在需求波动和中断风险下的库存控制问题。仿真表明，该方法相比传统静态库存策略和现有DRL模型，收敛更快、总运营成本更低，并能有效抑制牛鞭效应。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种新型的多智能体强化学习框架，以克服现有MLP/GNN/Transformer模型在复杂供应链网络拓扑捕捉、过平滑及可扩展性方面的局限，并实现高效、低成本的库存控制？
AI.motivation: 现有DRL模型（MLP/GNN）难以捕捉复杂网络拓扑或存在过平滑与可扩展性问题；Transformer模型虽有潜力但计算成本高。BDH作为一种生物启发的后Transformer架构，尚未被应用于供应链库存控制的MARL中，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 龙雏（BDH）架构（生物启发式无标度网络模型，利用局部神经元交互与赫布工作记忆）；PPO算法；多智能体强化学习（MARL）框架；牛鞭效应理论；多级供应链库存管理理论。
AI.method: 构建两层级供应链环境（含随机需求与前置期中断）；将BDH作为策略网络集成到PPO算法中形成BDH-PPO框架；通过仿真实验与静态库存策略（base-stock、(s, Q)）进行对比。
AI.findings: BDH-PPO模型收敛速度更快；在最小化总运营成本方面优于静态库存策略；能有效抑制牛鞭效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将BDH架构作为策略网络引入MARL框架用于供应链库存控制，拓展了生物启发式计算在运营管理领域的应用边界；提出了一种克服GNN过平滑和Transformer计算瓶颈的新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为复杂多级供应链提供了无需昂贵链式推理的高效库存决策方案；帮助企业降低运营成本并缓解牛鞭效应，提升供应链应对需求波动和中断的鲁棒性。

title: Climate Regulation, Asset Stranding and Foreign Investors
affiliations: IE Business School and

detail.title: Climate Regulation, Asset Stranding and Foreign Investors
detail.abstract: Climate regulation is typically studied as a repricing event. We show it is also a sorting event, moving in opposite directions across the same market. Using Boston's 2013 building carbon mandate, we find regulation strands the bottom of the market while reallocating the top to foreign capital. Financially vulnerable buildings lose buyers entirely rather than simply repricing, forfeiting the energy upgrades that ownership changes enable, while the most valuable properties attract investors experienced in managing regulatory risk. A well-intentioned regulation fails because the buildings that most, not least, need to improve are locked out of the trading mechanism.

AI.tldr: 研究发现建筑碳监管不仅是重新定价事件，更是一个"分选"事件——在波士顿2013年建筑碳强制令下，市场底部的建筑被彻底锁定（失去买家），而顶级的建筑则被重新分配给外国资本。财务脆弱的建筑无法通过所有权变更实现能效升级，而最有价值的房产吸引了擅长管理监管风险的投资者。好心办坏事：最需要改造的建筑反而被排除在交易机制之外。
AI.research_question: 气候监管如何影响房地产市场的交易动态？它是否仅仅导致重新定价，还是会引发买卖双方的分选效应？
AI.motivation: 既有研究通常将气候监管视为重新定价事件，但本研究认为监管还可能改变市场参与者的构成，产生"分选"效应——将不同质量的资产重新分配给不同类型的投资者，尤其是在市场底部和顶部产生相反方向的变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管分选理论（regulatory sorting）、市场锁定效应（market lockout）、资本重新配置理论
AI.method: 以波士顿2013年建筑碳强制令为自然实验，分析监管对不同价值等级建筑交易行为、买家构成和能源升级的影响
AI.findings: 1. 监管导致市场底部的建筑完全失去买家（锁定效应），而不仅仅是价格下跌；2. 市场顶级的建筑被重新分配给擅长管理监管风险的外国资本；3. 财务脆弱的建筑无法通过所有权变更来获取能源升级；4. 监管的初衷是好的，但最需要改造的建筑反而被排除在交易机制之外，导致政策失效
AI.theory_contributions: 提出气候监管的"分选效应"概念，超越了传统的"重新定价"视角；揭示了监管可能产生的非预期市场结构重塑后果
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供警示：气候监管设计需考虑市场分层效应，避免最需要改进的资产反而被市场排斥；建议配套金融支持或过渡机制以保护脆弱资产

title: Mitigating Requirement-change Intrusion Spillovers in Software Development: Additional Task
affiliations: Fudan University, School of Management, Fudan University, University of Nottingham, Ningbo - University of Nottingham Ningbo China and Fudan University
