title: The Legal Regime of Public Private Partnership in Bangladesh: An Overview and Analysis

detail.title: The Legal Regime of Public Private Partnership in Bangladesh: An Overview and Analysis

publicationDetails.detailsText: BiLD Law Journal, Volume 1, No.1. Pp. 47-60,

detail.abstract: Infrastructure is the backbone of economic growth of a country. Export, import, supply of goods and energy depends on infrastructure. A country with a strong infrastructure attracts investment as the risk factors regarding business seems deductible. Infrastructural development itself requires investment. The Government of a country basically initiates the projects relating to the development. Mega scale projects require a huge amount of monetary investment as maximum of these projects generates income for a long period. The prospect of mega infrastructural development attracts entrepreneurs. Moreover, the huge monetary investment required for long term projects needs private investors as the Government may not always be able to bear the responsibility of the sole contributor. The concept of Private Public Partnership (PPP) originated to facilitate the infrastructural development of a country. This concept allows both the Public sector and the Private sector to work side by side as investors and contributors. Bangladesh has set up a goal to become a member of the second world country by 2021. The Government prepared its vision 2021 as a strategic paper and development of infrastructure through PPP is one of the top priorities. As a result, Bangladesh got its first PPP related legislation in 2015. This paper concentrates on the history, development and features of current PPP related laws and papers of Bangladesh.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了孟加拉国公私合作伙伴关系（PPP）相关法律的历史、发展和特点，探讨了PPP模式在基础设施开发中的作用及孟加拉国为实现2021年愿景所做的立法努力。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国PPP相关法律的历史发展、特征及其在基础设施开发中的作用是什么？
AI.motivation: 基础设施是经济增长的支柱，而大型项目需要巨额长期投资，政府难以独立承担。PPP模式可解决资金不足问题。孟加拉国设定了2021年成为二流国家的发展目标，并于2015年出台了首部PPP相关立法，因此有必要对其法律体系进行系统梳理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公私合作伙伴关系（PPP）理论，即公共部门与私营部门作为投资者和贡献者协同合作以促进基础设施发展的概念框架。
AI.method: 文献回顾与法律条文分析，对孟加拉国PPP相关法律的历史发展、现行特征进行梳理与归纳。
AI.findings: 孟加拉国于2015年出台了首部PPP相关立法；PPP模式被列为孟加拉国2021愿景中基础设施发展的优先事项之一。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了孟加拉国PPP法律的历史演进脉络，补充了发展中国家PPP法律体系研究的案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国及其他发展中国家完善PPP法律框架、吸引私营部门参与基础设施投资提供了历史经验和立法参考。

title: Tax-Induced Emigration: Who Flees High Taxes? Evidence from the Netherlands
affiliations: Maastricht University, Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Erasmus School of Economics (ESE), Maastricht University and Maastricht University

detail.title: Tax-Induced Emigration: Who Flees High Taxes? Evidence from the Netherlands
detail.abstract: We study a policy change in the Netherlands that unexpectedly reduced the duration of preferential tax treatment for high-skilled migrants from specific countries. Using administrative data, we document substantial out-migration responses driven entirely by the top 1% of earners, with no detectable response below the 95th percentile. Among the 95-99th percentile, previously internationally mobile workers also leave sooner, particularly to countries offering tax breaks, consistent with tax shopping behavior and pointing to distortionary effects of international tax competition. Increased tax intake from remaining workers offsets revenue lost from departing high earners, making the policy fiscally cost-neutral.

AI.tldr: 荷兰一项削减高技能移民税收优惠的政策导致顶级收入者（前1%）大量外流，而95分位以下无反应。税收竞争存在扭曲效应，但政策在财政上成本中性。
AI.research_question: 针对高技能移民的优惠税收政策期限缩短后，是否会引致人才外流？哪些群体反应最强烈？是否存在税收套利行为？政策对财政有何影响？
AI.motivation: 各国通过税收优惠吸引高技能人才，但国际税收竞争可能产生扭曲效应。荷兰意外缩短部分国家高技能移民的税收优惠期限，为准自然实验提供了契机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收竞争理论、移民流动弹性理论、税收套利行为理论。
AI.method: 利用荷兰行政数据和准自然实验（政策突变），采用事件研究法等计量方法分析不同收入分位数群体的外迁反应。
AI.findings: 外迁反应完全由前1%最高收入者驱动；95-99分位中此前具有国际流动性的工人也提前离开，且流向提供税收优惠的国家；税收收入因剩余高收入者贡献增加而实现财政成本中性。
AI.theory_contributions: 细化了税收竞争理论中不同收入群体的异质性反应，揭示了国际税收套利行为的存在及其对人才流动的扭曲效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了税收优惠设计（如期限、目标群体）的实证依据；表明税收优惠缩短可能不损害财政可持续性，但会改变人才分布格局。

title: The Indian Philosophical Discourses and Intangible Socio-Economic-Cultural Heritage: A Study of Eight Manufacturing Clusters of West Bengal, India
affiliations: , Rajatpur I. N. Vidyapith and

detail.title: The Indian Philosophical Discourses and Intangible Socio-Economic-Cultural Heritage: A Study of Eight Manufacturing Clusters of West Bengal, India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict of interest among the authors.
declarations.ethicsApproval: We have sincerely followed all the research ethics
declarations.funderStatement: The first author received doctoral fellowship from Visva-Bharati(University)

detail.abstract:
The Indian Knowledge System (henceforth, IKS) refers to a vast and multifaceted corpus of intellectual traditions that evolved in the subcontinent over several millennia. Rooted in profound philosophical inquiry, it established the epistemological and ontological foundations for subsequent developments in scientific reasoning, artistic and cultural expressions, principles of governance, and broader socio-economic-political organisational forms. This eclectic intellectual heritage was transmitted across generations through tangible economic and cultural artefacts and intangible socio-economic-cultural traditions/institutions (heritage), thereby ensuring continuity within the civilisational transformations.

In this study, we identify Mahatma Gandhi and Gurudev Rabindranath Tagore as two of the most significant modern bearers of this great philosophical tradition and seek to enlighten our research with their intellectual legacies. We try to uncover the relevance of these great thinkers to the contemporary problem of inclusive and sustainable development in the Global South; we try to understand whether their ideas could offer an alternative to the present hegemonic bandwagon, in the context of the fundamental problem called development. Both Gandhi and Tagore positioned themselves in sharp contrast to the principles of neo-classical and neo-liberal thought. Their emphasis lay on village-centred development and small-scale production systems grounded in cooperation, reciprocity, and sharing of knowledge and a variety of resources across and over the generations.

However, under the neo-classical and neo-liberal regimes, policymakers in the developing nations of the Global South, including India, largely emulated the trajectories of their industrialised counterparts. This has resulted in exclusionary patterns of growth, generating vast pools of unemployed labourers who are absorbed into the unorganised/informal sectors, primarily comprising non-farm micro-small-medium enterprises. The majority of this sector remains excluded from the benefits of accumulation-driven growth, and consequently suffers from persistent economic and social vulnerabilities. In this context, the formulation of inclusive strategies aimed at strengthening micro-enterprises emerges as a crucial pathway toward sustainable and equitable development. And in this very context, we invoke Gandhi and Tagore as two great visionaries from the East.

As a long-term inclusive and sustainable development strategy for the non-farm sectors in developing countries, cluster-focused policies have been advocated, as clusters generate scale, synergies, collective efficiency, and competitive advantage, even for smaller firms under private ownership. In this regard, we are interested in studying micro, small, and medium enterprise (MSME) clusters, specifically the production organisation of firms, intra-cluster (inter-firm) interactions in the production plane, and the impact of inter-firm collaboration on firm performance.

Through rigorous empirical exercise, we have found that inter-firm collaboration positively impacts firm performance. Collaboration is the natural outcome of social embeddedness, maintained through informal arrangements, shared history, friendships, ethnic and religious identities, long-term relationships, social networks, and mutual trust.

AI.tldr: 本文以印度知识体系（IKS）为哲学根基，援引甘地和泰戈尔的思想遗产，论证以小规模、合作为核心的产业集群发展模式可作为全球南方国家应对新古典/新自由主义发展困境的替代方案，并通过实证研究发现企业间合作（基于社会嵌入）正向影响企业绩效。
AI.research_question: 甘地和泰戈尔的思想对全球南方国家包容性与可持续发展有何启示？产业集群中企业间合作如何影响企业绩效？
AI.motivation: 新古典和新自由主义政策导致全球南方国家出现排斥性增长、大量非正规就业和经济脆弱性问题，需要探索替代性发展路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 印度知识体系（IKS）哲学传统；甘地的乡村中心论和小规模生产思想；泰戈尔的合作、互惠与知识共享理念；社会嵌入理论；产业集群理论。
AI.method: 对MSME集群进行实证研究，分析企业间生产组织、集群内互动及合作对企业绩效的影响。
AI.findings: 企业间合作正向影响企业绩效；合作是社会嵌入的自然结果，通过非正式安排、共享历史、友谊、民族/宗教认同、长期关系、社交网络和相互信任来维持。
AI.theory_contributions: 将东方哲学传统（甘地、泰戈尔）引入当代发展经济学讨论，为替代主流发展范式提供理论依据；将社会嵌入理论应用于产业集群分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球南方国家制定以产业集群为核心的包容性发展战略提供实证支持；强调非正式制度和社会资本在中小企业发展中的关键作用。

title: Logistics Platforms as the Moderator of Information Sharing and Service Execution in Container Transport
affiliations: Erasmus University Rotterdam, Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Rotterdam School of Management (RSM) and Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Rotterdam School of Management (RSM)

detail.title: Logistics Platforms as the Moderator of Information Sharing and Service Execution in Container Transport
detail.abstract: We examine a situation where logistics platforms, through sharing digital information of multiple quality levels, determine the overall service reliability of container transport together with transport operators. By analytically modeling the interplay between information sharing and transport execution, we demonstrate that: (1) improving either information sharing or transport execution service individually could further improve the overall service reliability of the container transport chain, and (2) given a pre-defined requirement on deadline and reliability of the final customer, information service and transport service establish an efficiency frontier. We further show, with our game-theoretic analysis, that possibilities exist for coordination between logistics platforms and transport operators and propose a coordination mechanism such that both parties could maximize their individual profits while offering this combined service. Our results complement the current knowledge on the role of logistics platforms as an information sharing facilitator and shed light on possible competition between digital information sharing entities and physical logistics service providers, who individually maximize their profits given a predefined objective.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了物流平台与运输运营商通过共享多层级数字信息，共同决定集装箱运输整体服务可靠性的问题。通过博弈论模型分析，揭示了信息共享与运输执行之间的效率边界，并提出了一种协调机制，使双方在满足客户时效和可靠性要求的前提下实现利润最大化。
AI.research_question: 物流平台（信息共享方）与运输运营商（运输执行方）如何通过多层级数字信息共享协同决定集装箱运输的整体服务可靠性？
AI.motivation: 现实中物流平台通过共享多层级数字信息来提升整体服务质量，但信息共享方与运输执行方各自追求利润最大化，可能存在利益冲突。现有文献对两者在服务可靠性上的互动机制及协调路径缺乏深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论、效率前沿理论、服务可靠性理论。
AI.method: 建立分析模型，刻画信息共享与运输执行之间的互动关系；通过博弈论分析探讨协调机制。
AI.findings: （1）单独改善信息共享或运输执行服务均可提升整体服务可靠性；（2）在给定的客户截止时间和可靠性要求下，信息服务与运输服务存在一条效率前沿；（3）通过协调机制，物流平台与运输运营商可在满足客户要求的同时实现各自利润最大化。
AI.theory_contributions: 补充了物流平台作为信息共享促进者的角色理论，揭示了数字信息共享实体与实体物流服务提供商之间的竞争与协调关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为物流平台与运输运营商之间的合作协调提供了机制设计参考，有助于提升集装箱运输链的整体服务可靠性。

title: The Floating Balance Sheet. How Cargo Data Becomes Financial Infrastructure.
affiliations: Jagiellonian University and Atexxa Group AG

detail.title: The Floating Balance Sheet. How Cargo Data Becomes Financial Infrastructure.
detail.abstract:
A cargo event is also a financial event. No platform treats it that way. Visibility vendors track shipments for operations. The bank, the insurer, and the treasury team are left to price risk from slow, document-driven signals.

This white paper argues the gap is structural, not technical. No new feature closes it. The obstacle is who owns the data, and who profits from holding it back. The remedy is structural too: neutral, federated infrastructure. Each party keeps control of its own data. Only the financial consequence moves upward.

That missing layer is the Floating Balance Sheet. It lets cargo in motion be priced, financed, and insured while the goods are still moving. The argument draws on the USD 2.5 trillion trade finance gap and 25 interviews across five stakeholder groups. The window is 2026 to 2028, opened by EU rules forcing cargo-event data into machine-readable form.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，货物事件本质上也是金融事件，但现有平台仅将其视为运营数据。核心论点是，这一缺口是结构性的而非技术性的，解决方案在于建立中立、联邦化的基础设施（浮动资产负债表），使货物在运输途中即可被定价、融资和保险。2026-2028年欧盟法规将强制货物事件数据机器可读化，为这一变革打开窗口。
AI.research_question: 如何弥合货物在途时运营数据与金融定价之间的结构性鸿沟，使货物事件同时成为可被银行、保险公司和财务团队利用的金融信号？
AI.motivation: 全球贸易融资缺口高达2.5万亿美元，现有系统依赖缓慢的、基于文件的信号来定价风险，导致大量货物在运输途中无法获得融资和保险。这是一个结构性问题，而非技术问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: "浮动资产负债表"（Floating Balance Sheet）概念——将运输途中的货物视为可动态定价、融资和保险的金融资产，而非仅作为运营跟踪对象。
AI.method: 基于2.5万亿美元贸易融资缺口的宏观数据，以及对五个利益相关者群体进行的25场深度访谈。
AI.findings: 当前缺口是结构性的，根源在于数据所有权和谁从数据阻滞中获利；解决方案也是结构性的：需要中立的、联邦化的基础设施，各方保留数据控制权，仅让金融后果向上流动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"浮动资产负债表"作为连接货物运营数据与金融定价的缺失中间层，重新定义了货物在途状态下的金融属性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行、保险公司和企业财务团队提供了在货物运输途中即可进行定价、融资和保险的路径框架；指出2026-2028年欧盟法规是关键的窗口期。

title: Using a Two-step Clustering Approach to Examine Judiciary Efficiency in European Countries
affiliations: Faculty of Economics, Matej Bel University in Banska Bystrica, Slovakia and Faculty of Economics, Matej Bel University in Banska Bystrica, Slovakia

detail.title: Using a Two-step Clustering Approach to Examine Judiciary Efficiency in European Countries
detail.abstract: Panel data, also known as longitudinal data, is collected and analysed across various research areas. This type of data consists of statistical objects that are periodically observed over time. In comparison to cross-sectional data, there are significantly fewer clustering techniques available for panel data. Therefore, the main objective of the contribution is to present a two-step clustering approach. In the first step, the panel data are transformed into a static form using a set of proposed characteristics that capture time dynamics. In the second step, the objects are clustered using conventional spatial clustering algorithms, such as K-means clustering or hierarchical partitioning. The clustering performance of this approach is then compared to that of the well-known KML method using real panel data sets. These datasets include indicators that assess the effectiveness of courts at the first instance level. Factors like digitalisation in the public sector are affecting the judiciary's efficiency during this period. The methodology implemented allowed us to categorise European countries based on the efficiency of their courts while capturing the dynamic trends. This approach is generally helpful in assessing and comparing the efficiency of public spending and evaluating the quality of public institutions, including courts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种两步聚类法用于面板数据分析：第一步通过一组特征将面板数据转化为静态形式，第二步使用传统空间聚类算法（如K-means）进行聚类。通过法院效率的真实面板数据验证，该方法优于KML方法，并能有效对欧洲国家进行动态聚类。
AI.research_question: 如何对面板数据（纵向数据）进行有效的聚类分析？
AI.motivation: 面板数据相较于横截面数据可用的聚类技术非常有限，需要开发新的聚类方法以捕捉时间动态特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两步聚类法；时间动态特征提取；传统空间聚类算法（K-means、层次聚类）
AI.method: 第一步：通过一组特征将面板数据转化为静态形式，捕捉时间动态；第二步：使用K-means或层次聚类等传统聚类算法进行聚类。并与KML方法进行对比。
AI.findings: 该方法能够有效对欧洲国家基于法院效率进行聚类，并捕捉动态趋势，聚类表现优于KML方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种结合时间动态特征提取与传统聚类算法的面板数据聚类新框架，弥补了面板数据聚类技术不足的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 可用于评估和比较公共支出效率以及公共机构（如法院）的质量，为政策制定和公共管理提供数据驱动的分类依据。

title: Fifty Years of Knowledge Management Research: A System-Level Analysis of Intellectual, Conceptual and Social Structures
affiliations: Academia Forţelor Terestre „Nicolae Bălcescu”, Academia Forţelor Terestre „Nicolae Bălcescu”, Academia Forţelor Terestre „Nicolae Bălcescu”, Academia Forţelor Terestre „Nicolae Bălcescu” and Lucian Blaga University of Sibiu

detail.title: Fifty Years of Knowledge Management Research: A System-Level Analysis of Intellectual, Conceptual and Social Structures
detail.abstract: Knowledge Management (KM) has evolved over the last five decades as a complex sociotechnical system shaped by interactions between organizational processes, technologies and social actors. This study maps the systemic evolution of KM research between 1975 and 2025 by examining its intellectual, conceptual and social subsystems. Using a largescale bibliometric science-mapping approach that combines performance indicators and network-based techniques, we analyze 33,153 documents indexed in the Web of Science Core Collection. The results reveal a pronounced post-1995 expansion of the field, marked by a consolidated core of specialized journals and influential scholars, alongside an increasingly global research network. The analysis shows that KM research is structured around four interdependent dimensions: organizational processes, strategic orientations, technological infrastructures and socio-cultural factors. More recent developments indicate the emergence of new system trajectories associated with digital transformation, knowledge governance and sustainability. Viewed through a system-level lens, these findings position KM as an evolving research system characterized by adaptive and cross-domain dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模文献计量科学图谱方法，分析了1975至2025年间33,153篇知识管理文献，揭示KM作为复杂社会技术系统的演化路径，发现其围绕组织流程、战略导向、技术基础设施和社会文化因素四个相互依赖维度构建，并呈现数字化转型、知识治理和可持续性等新兴轨迹。
AI.research_question: 1975至2025年间知识管理研究的系统演化路径是怎样的？其智力、概念和社会子系统如何构成并演变？
AI.motivation: KM在过去五十年中已演变为复杂的社会技术系统，但缺乏从系统层面对其演化进行的全面、大规模文献计量分析，特别是对智力、概念和社会子系统的综合考察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂社会技术系统理论；知识管理的系统演化视角（包含智力、概念和社会三个子系统）
AI.method: 大规模文献计量科学图谱方法，结合绩效指标和基于网络的技术（如引文分析、共词分析、合作网络分析），对Web of Science Core Collection中33,153篇文献进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. KM在1995年后显著扩张；2. 形成了由专业期刊和权威学者组成的核心群；3. 研究网络日益全球化；4. KM研究围绕四个维度展开：组织流程、战略导向、技术基础设施和社会文化因素；5. 新兴轨迹包括数字化转型、知识治理和可持续性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将KM定位为一个具有适应性和跨领域动态的演化研究系统，提供了系统层面的整合视角，揭示了KM作为社会技术系统的多维结构和演化规律。
AI.practical_contributions: 为KM领域的研究者提供了清晰的领域结构图谱和发展方向指引；帮助实践者了解KM的关键维度（组织、战略、技术、文化）及前沿趋势（数字化转型、知识治理、可持续性）。

title: Improving Human-Algorithm Interaction with Causal Machine Learning-based Decision Support
affiliations: IESEG School of Management, Catholic University of Lille - IESEG School of Management, Catholic University of Lille - IÉSEG School of Management, Lille Campus, Research Institute of China Unicom (Shanxi) for New Industrialization and Ghent University

detail.title: Improving Human-Algorithm Interaction with Causal Machine Learning-based Decision Support

declarations.funderStatement: Maud Van den Broeke and Marijn Verschelde acknowledge financial support from the French National Research Agency through the project BALANCE (ANR-22-CE10-0006-01).

detail.abstract: This study demonstrates how causal machine learning (CML) can enhance human-algorithm interaction (HAI) in digital operations. In settings where algorithm aversion and algorithm appreciation shape human decision-making behavior, a key managerial challenge is determining when human decision-makers should override algorithmic decisions, and when they should not. Using Infrabel's digitized railway control room as our empirical setting, we examine the heterogeneous effects of controllers' overrides of algorithmic decisions on train punctuality. Specifically, we examine how override effects differ across operational contexts with distinct characteristics and how to design a CML-based decision support system (DSS) to improve HAI. Our empirical results reveal substantial heterogeneity in the override effects across traffic contexts. In particular, we find that zone-hour-specific workload is the primary driver of treatment-effect heterogeneity relative to other operational context characteristics included in the analysis. To translate these insights into managerial practice, we develop a prototype DSS based on an instrumental-variable forest approach that provides real-time, context-specific causal recommendations regarding override decisions under confounding. Counterfactual analysis shows that aligning decisions with DSS recommendations improves punctuality by 6.618 seconds per train section, exceeding the average observed delay change of 4.744 seconds and indicating significant potential for delay reduction. The study contributes to operations research by integrating causal inference and machine learning to support human decision-making in algorithmic operational environments.

AI.tldr: 本文利用因果机器学习（CML）方法，研究数字运营中人类操作员何时应覆盖算法决策。以比利时Infrabel铁路控制室为场景，发现覆盖效应存在显著异质性，工作负荷是主要驱动因素，并开发了基于工具变量森林的决策支持系统，反事实分析表明该系统可将准点率提升6.618秒/列车段。
AI.research_question: 在数字运营中，人类决策者何时应该覆盖算法决策，以及如何利用因果机器学习设计决策支持系统来改善人机交互？
AI.motivation: 在算法厌恶与算法偏好共存的环境中，管理者面临的关键挑战是判断何时应当允许人类覆盖算法决策。传统方法难以在混杂因素存在的运营环境下提供精准的因果推荐。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因果机器学习（Causal Machine Learning, CML）；算法厌恶（Algorithm Aversion）与算法偏好（Algorithm Appreciation）理论；工具变量森林（Instrumental-Variable Forest）。
AI.method: 以比利时Infrabel数字化铁路控制室为实证场景，运用基于工具变量森林的因果机器学习方法，估计覆盖决策的异质性处理效应，并开发实时、情境特定的因果推荐决策支持系统，进行反事实分析验证效果。
AI.findings: 覆盖效应在运营情境间存在显著异质性；区域-小时级别的工作负荷是驱动处理效应异质性的首要因素；反事实分析表明，遵循DSS建议可将准点率提升6.618秒/列车段，超过平均延时变化4.744秒，具有显著的延时减少潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将因果推断与机器学习集成应用于运营管理领域，为解决算法环境下的人机交互问题提供了因果分析框架；扩展了异质性处理效应在数字运营决策中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可在混杂因素存在的实时运营环境中提供情境特定因果推荐的原型决策支持系统，为管理者提供了何时允许人类覆盖算法的可操作指导，显著提升运营效率。

title: A Review of Payments Clearing Systems for Operations Researchers
affiliations: , University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management, Payments Canada, University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management and Hefei University of Technology - School of Management

detail.title: A Review of Payments Clearing Systems for Operations Researchers
detail.abstract: Payment clearing systems process trillions of dollars in transactions daily across interconnected banking networks, serving as the foundational infrastructure underpinning nearly all financial and commercial activity in modern economies. Despite their enormous scale and systemic significance, payment systems remain comparatively underexplored within the operations research and management science literature. This paper reviews the design and operations of such systems through an operations management perspective, centering on the fundamental trade-off between settlement risk and liquidity sourcing costs. Our core contribution lies in developing a unified analytical framework that decomposes payment systems into three interconnected components: (i) payments and liquidity input that capture stochastic payment flows and liquidity policy instruments; (ii) the clearing process characterizing clearing architectures and algorithms; and (iii) the performance objective that assesses system outcomes via a social cost function encompassing strategic policy costs and daily operational costs. Building on this framework, we structure the existing literature around two central design problems: liquidity policy design covering both strategic and operational choices that shape banks' liquidity endowment; and payment submission behavior and the clearing architecture design encompassing clearing timing, netting density and clearing algorithms. We demonstrate that these design dimensions jointly determine systemic stability and efficiency. We further synthesize extant studies highlighting how network interconnectedness and strategic delay incentives give rise to systemic vulnerability and payment gridlock. Finally, we identify prominent research gaps spanning dynamic optimization of clearing operations, endogenous payment network formation, and the joint calibration of complementary policy tools. We conclude that future advances in this domain call for dynamic, state dependent models that unify system design, participant incentives, and real-time operational dynamics, with the ultimate goal of enhancing both the efficiency and resilience of payments clearing systems.

title: Entrenched Militarism and Recurrent Coups: Thailand and Myanmar in Comparison

detail.title: Entrenched Militarism and Recurrent Coups: Thailand and Myanmar in Comparison

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare that I have no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or organizational affiliations that could have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not require ethical approval as it relied solely on the analysis of published literature and publicly accessible documents. No human participants were involved, and no primary data were collected.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no financial support from any funding agency, commercial organization, or not-for-profit institution for the research, authorship, and publication of this article.

detail.abstract: Despite from growing democracy trends that has improved over the past few years, ongoing conflicts in Southeast Asia, particularly in Thailand and Myanmar, have undermined democracy, leading to a resurgence of conflict. This paper compares between the role of civil society and the military between these disputed countries, showing how their struggles challenge civilian governments and often engage in political violence. Using a qualitative comparative approach, this study focuses on how the matters that related to historical, institutional, and normative implications of the current literature on civil-military relations in Southeast Asia. The findings suggest that both militaries justified coups by defending democratic and cultural authority, such as the monarchy in Thailand and the concept of "consensus democracy" in Myanmar. Furthermore, weak civilian governance, elite polarization, and the strategic use of military-drafted constitutions to shape the division of power enable their continued political dominance. The study concludes that meaningful democratic civilian rule requires the dismantling of both formal constitutional privileges and informal elite networks that allow the military to repeatedly veto democratic processes.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了泰国和缅甸的公民社会与军队在民主进程中的作用，发现两国军队通过捍卫民主与文化权威（泰国君主制、缅甸"共识民主"）为政变辩护，并利用宪法特权和精英网络维持政治主导地位。研究认为，实现真正的民主文官统治需打破正式宪法特权和非正式精英网络。
AI.research_question: 东南亚冲突国家（泰国和缅甸）中，公民社会与军队如何互动？军队如何利用政治策略维持其主导地位？
AI.motivation: 尽管全球民主化趋势有所发展，但东南亚地区（特别是泰国和缅甸）的持续冲突正在破坏民主进程，导致冲突复苏。理解军队如何挑战文官政府并参与政治暴力，对于推动该地区民主转型至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 军民关系理论；历史制度主义；规范制度分析；民主化理论中的文官控制与军事干预政治框架。
AI.method: 定性比较分析（Qualitative Comparative Approach），聚焦于历史、制度和规范层面，对泰国和缅甸进行案例比较研究。
AI.findings: 1）两国军队均以捍卫民主与文化权威（泰国君主制、缅甸"共识民主"）为政变正当化理由；2）文官治理薄弱、精英极化以及军队起草的宪法是军队持续政治主导的制度性工具；3）正式宪法特权与非正式精英网络共同构成军队反复否决民主进程的机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了东南亚军民关系理论，揭示了军队如何通过文化权威话语和宪法设计双重路径维持政治主导，超越了传统"政变—民主转型"的二元分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为民政政府与民主改革者提供了政策启示：真正实现民主文官统治需要同时拆除正式宪法特权和瓦解非正式精英网络，而非仅仅推动选举或政权更迭。

title: The Role of Dispute Resolution Clauses in International Upstream Oil and Gas Contracts with Emphasis on Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR)

detail.title: The Role of Dispute Resolution Clauses in International Upstream Oil and Gas Contracts with Emphasis on Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, animals, clinical data, or personal data; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

keywords: Upstream Oil and Gas Contracts International Petroleum Agreements Dispute Resolution Clauses

detail.abstract: Since the mid-twentieth century, international commercial arbitration has been widely recognized as one of the most important and appropriate mechanisms for resolving international commercial disputes. In this regard, many national legal systems have been updated in accordance with international conventions governing arbitration and the enforcement of arbitral awards. Nevertheless, due to the issuance of inconsistent arbitral decisions in certain cases, the confidence of both petroleum-producing states and international oil companies has occasionally been affected. In particular, some oil-exporting countries perceive the submission of disputes with foreign legal entities to international arbitration as potentially inconsistent with, or even weakening, their national sovereignty. In order to address such concerns and to reduce the possibility of biased or unfair decisions, the use of alternative dispute resolution (ADR) mechanisms has increasingly been recommended. This article seeks to examine in detail the various methods for resolving disputes arising from international upstream oil and gas contracts, with particular attention to ADR mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文详细考察了国际上游油气合同争议的多种解决方式，特别关注替代性争议解决机制（ADR），以应对国际商事仲裁中不一致裁决对石油生产国主权信心造成的影响。
AI.research_question: 国际上游油气合同争议有哪些有效的解决方式？替代性争议解决机制（ADR）如何应对仲裁不一致及主权顾虑问题？
AI.motivation: 国际商事仲裁在某些案件中做出不一致的裁决，影响了石油生产国与国际石油公司的信心，部分石油出口国认为提交国际仲裁可能削弱其国家主权。因此需要研究替代性争议解决机制以降低偏见或不公裁决的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际商事仲裁理论、国家主权理论、替代性争议解决（ADR）机制理论
AI.method: 文献分析与规范研究，详细考察国际上游油气合同争议的各种解决方法
AI.findings: 国际商事仲裁存在裁决不一致的问题；石油生产国将争议提交仲裁可能产生主权顾虑；替代性争议解决机制（ADR）被推荐作为应对这些问题的有效方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了国际上游油气合同争议解决的理论框架，将国家主权关切纳入争议解决机制选择的考量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为石油生产国和国际石油公司提供了除传统仲裁外的争议解决替代方案，有助于降低偏见裁决风险并保护国家主权利益。

title: A Multi-Dimensional Economic Stress Monitoring System: Identifying Economic Stress From 38 Macroeconomic Indicators
affiliations: Lexington High School

detail.title: A Multi-Dimensional Economic Stress Monitoring System: Identifying Economic Stress From 38 Macroeconomic Indicators
detail.abstract: This paper presents a continuous economic health monitoring system built on 38 macroeconomic indicators pulled from the FRED database. This system, unlike many other binary models, provides a continuous reading on the country's economic health. The system draws these 38 macroeconomic indicators from various different sectors with the attempt to cover most if not all economic conditions. These sectors include: labor markets, inflationary measures, financial conditions, trade and commodities. This system achieves its continuous economic health monitoring through the use of percentile-based analysis across multiple rolling lookback periods. Moreover, testing against all available US recessions since 1990 (2001, 2008-09, 2020) shows that the model correctly identified all 3 periods as recessionary events, with stress levels peaking at 84% to 88% across all recessions. Furthermore, sample testing was conducted on each crisis using information only available up to that recession. The tests were conducted and showed that the model identified 2 out of the 3 recessions correctly, with the near miss reaching a peak level of 66.9%, just below the 70% threshold. One of the biggest findings was the pre-recession acceleration analysis, which shows a stress acceleration averaging 10.9% quarter after quarter versus a change of-0.5% stress acceleration for non-recessionary quarters (Cohen's d = 1.04; p = 0.045; n = 3). Furthermore, the model was benchmarked against similar models and showed to lead the Sahm Rule by 4 quarters. As of Q1 2026, the system reads 32.1% at the 45th historical percentile, showing that the economy is near its long-run median without any elevated stress levels.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于FRED数据库38个宏观经济指标的连续经济健康监测系统，采用百分位分析和滚动回溯期方法，成功识别了1990年以来所有美国衰退期（2001、2008-09、2020），峰值压力水平达84%-88%，并发现衰退前压力加速平均达10.9%（Cohen's d=1.04）。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够提供连续读数的（而非二元分类的）经济健康监测系统，并有效识别和预测经济衰退？
AI.motivation: 现有经济健康监测模型多为二元分类（衰退/非衰退），缺乏连续的、细粒度的经济健康度量；需要一个能覆盖多部门、多指标的综合系统来实时监测经济压力水平。
AI.theoretical_framework: 百分位分析（Percentile-based Analysis）、滚动回溯期（Rolling Lookback Periods）、压力加速分析（Stress Acceleration Analysis）
AI.method: 从FRED数据库选取38个宏观经济指标（涵盖劳动力市场、通胀、金融条件、贸易和大宗商品），通过多个滚动回溯期的百分位分析构建连续经济健康指数；对1990年以来三次衰退进行回测，并进行信息可得性受限的样本外测试；采用Cohen's d和p值检验衰退前压力加速的显著性；与Sahm规则等基准模型进行对比。
AI.findings: 1. 模型正确识别了2001、2008-09和2020年三次衰退，压力峰值达84%-88%；2. 信息受限测试中成功识别2/3衰退，近失案例峰值达66.9%（接近70%阈值）；3. 衰退前压力加速平均10.9%，非衰退季度仅-0.5%（Cohen's d=1.04，p=0.045）；4. 领先Sahm规则4个季度；5. 截至2026年Q1，系统读数为32.1%（第45百分位），显示经济处于长期中位数附近无异常压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于多指标百分位分析的连续经济健康监测框架，验证了压力加速作为衰退前兆信号的有效性，为经济预警提供了新的理论度量方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可实际部署的经济健康监测工具，能够连续输出经济压力读数；相比Sahm规则等传统模型提前4个季度发出预警信号，对政策制定者和投资者具有重要参考价值。

title: Contagious Polarization: How Divisive Shocks Reshape Legislative Behavior Across Policy Domains

detail.title: Contagious Polarization: How Divisive Shocks Reshape Legislative Behavior Across Policy Domains
detail.abstract: This paper examines how exogenous divisive shocks contribute to political polarization among U.S. legislators and influence legislative outcomes. Using roll-call vote data from the U.S. House of Representatives between 2005 and 2015, I study the effects of mass shooting events (MSEs)—salient but quasi-random shocks—on legislators’ behavior. Leveraging a difference-in differences design, I find that Representatives from affected districts significantly increase party discipline and reduce bipartisan cooperation. These effects extend across a wide range of cultural policy areas while leaving economic policy largely unchanged, revealing the contagious nature of polarization: a shock on one divisive cultural issue triggers partisan realignment across broader domains. To unpack these dynamics, I analyze congressional speeches and legislators’ ideological responses. Representatives from affected districts display stronger rhetorical polarization. I further show that this polarization arises from identity-based voter realignment rather than from changes in electoral incentives.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2005-2015年美国众议院唱名表决数据，采用双重差分法研究大规模枪击事件这一外生分裂性冲击如何加剧美国立法者的政治极化，并影响立法结果。研究发现，受冲击选区的众议员显著增强了政党纪律，减少了跨党派合作，这种极化效应蔓延至广泛的文化政策领域，但经济政策未受影响。
AI.research_question: 外生的分裂性冲击（如大规模枪击事件）如何加剧美国立法者的政治极化，并影响立法结果？
AI.motivation: 理解政治极化的成因至关重要，但现有研究难以厘清外生冲击对极化的因果效应。大规模枪击事件作为准随机、高显著性的外部事件，为识别这种因果效应提供了独特的研究机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 身份驱动的选民重新联盟理论（identity-based voter realignment），区别于传统的选举激励变化理论。
AI.method: 双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences），结合2005-2015年美国众议院唱名表决数据、国会演讲文本分析及立法者意识形态测量。
AI.findings: （1）受冲击选区的众议员显著提高了政党纪律，减少了跨党派合作；（2）极化效应蔓延至广泛的文化政策领域，但经济政策基本未受影响，揭示了极化的"传染性"；（3）受影响选区的众议员表现出更强的修辞极化；（4）这种极化源于身份驱动的选民重新联盟，而非选举激励的变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了极化具有"传染性"——单一文化议题上的分裂性冲击会触发跨领域的党派重新调整；区分了身份驱动机制与选举激励机制，证明身份政治是极化扩散的核心驱动力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国政治极化的动态扩散机制提供了因果证据；提示外生的、高度显眼的公共事件可能通过身份认同机制系统性改变立法行为，对公共政策制定和危机沟通具有启示意义。

title: Board-Approved, Perfectly Legal: The NBFC Loophole Behind India's Predatory Lending Apps - From the Andhra Pradesh Microfinance Crisis to App-Based Digital Lending: A Regulatory History and Policy Analysis

detail.title: Board-Approved, Perfectly Legal: The NBFC Loophole Behind India's Predatory Lending Apps - From the Andhra Pradesh Microfinance Crisis to App-Based Digital Lending: A Regulatory History and Policy Analysis
detail.abstract: In October 2010, after roughly two hundred borrowers in Andhra Pradesh had reportedly died by suicide amid coercive collection by microfinance agents, the state government shut the industry down almost overnight and the Reserve Bank of India convened a committee under Y. H. Malegam to work out what had gone wrong. The committee's answer was, in effect, that price and conduct both needed hard limits: it recommended a 24% ceiling on the annualised rate an NBFC-MFI could charge and a 10 to 12 percent margin cap on top of the cost of funds. Those limits held, more or less, for a decade. Then, beginning with a June 2021 consultative paper and finalised in the 2022 microfinance framework, the RBI removed both caps and replaced them with a requirement that each lender's own board approve its pricing policy. This paper argues that the removal of the Malegam-era caps, layered on top of a licensing regime in which acquiring a dormant NBFC is markedly easier than registering a new one, has recreated-in app-based form-much of the price and collection dynamic that produced the 2010 crisis in the first place. Using RBI circulars, court judgments, NCRB and MeitY enforcement data, and documented harassment and suicide cases from 2022 through 2024, the paper traces how a small operator can lawfully acquire a licensed but inactive Base-Layer NBFC, launch a consumer lending app under that licence, disclose a rate that technically satisfies the Key Fact Statement requirement, and still extract an effective annualised cost running into the hundreds of percent once processing-fee deductions are accounted for. A comparative section examines how the United Kingdom (the FCA's 2015 price cap of 0.8% per day with a 100% total-cost ceiling) and Kenya (the Central Bank of Kenya's 2021 licensing power, which lets the regulator set pricing parameters directly rather than leave them to lender boards) addressed structurally similar problems. The paper closes with a set of specific, sequenced recommendations, the central one being a statutory all-in cost cap for small-ticket unsecured digital credit, restoring in substance what the Malegam Committee had recommended in 2011 and what the sector operated under until 2022. A July 2026 investigation by the business publication The Ken, drawing on Ministry of Corporate Affairs filings and lenders' own board-approved interest rate policy documents, independently corroborates this mechanism, naming specific NBFCs whose revenue grew by several hundred to several thousand times in a single year after acquisition.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度2022年取消小额贷款利率上限后，通过收购休眠NBFC牌照、以APP形式发放消费贷，实际年化利率高达数百%，重现了2010年安得拉邦危机中的定价与催收乱象。文章提出恢复法定全成本利率上限的核心建议。
AI.research_question: 印度2022年取消马勒甘委员会时代利率上限后，数字消费贷市场是否重现了2010年危机的定价与催收动态？
AI.motivation: 2010年安得拉邦因小额贷暴力催收引发两百余人自杀，行业被叫停。2022年印度央行取消利率上限后，APP贷款乱象频发。作者试图揭示监管放松如何通过牌照收购机制再造危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管套利理论、利率上限与市场失灵、牌照经济学的"休眠资产"套利机制、信息披露与实际成本的背离分析。
AI.method: 多源实证分析：RBI通知、法院判决、NCRB执法数据、MeitY数据、2022-2024年骚扰与自杀案例文献；对比英国（FCA日息0.8%封顶+100%总成本上限）和肯尼亚（央行直接设定定价参数）的制度比较。
AI.findings: 通过收购休眠NBFC牌照，运营商可在合规披露名义利率的同时，通过手续费抵扣使实际年化利率高达数百%；2026年The Ken调查独立证实多家NBFC在收购后单年收入增长数百至数千倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了"牌照休眠—收购套利—APP放贷"这一新型监管套利链条，丰富了数字金融时代的监管捕获与制度漏洞理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出分步政策建议，核心是恢复小额无担保数字信贷的法定全成本利率上限（实质重拾马勒甘委员会2011年建议方案）；为印度及其他新兴市场数字贷监管提供直接政策参照。

title: The Impact of Microfinance and Financial Inclusion Tools on Household and Microenterprise Outcomes”
affiliations: , , ,  and

detail.title: The Impact of Microfinance and Financial Inclusion Tools on Household and Microenterprise Outcomes”
detail.abstract:
Financial inclusion is now a central policy mechanism in the promotion of household welfare, financial resilience, and microenterprise growth in the developing economies. The growth of microcredit, micro-savings and commitment savings products, digital payments, mobile money, digital credit, and micro-insurance over the last few years has changed the financial decision-making of low-income households. But the literature currently analyzes these tools to a great extent separately, which provides minimal information on how various financial tools collectively affect the outcomes of households and microenterprises.

The present research fills this gap by taking a composite framework to look at the relative impacts of key financial inclusion instruments on the household welfare, business performance and financial attitude. The research is based on a systematic literature review on both the experimental and quasi-experimental studies and on primary survey findings of 116 low-income households and on the owners of microenterprises. Likert-scale variables were used to capture the financial outcomes, business performance indicators, and attitudinal measures.

 The reliability analysis proves the high internal consistency of the measurement tool (Cronbach a = 0.850). With the non-normality of the variables, parametric statistical methods were used (robust and non-parametric) and that is one-way ANOVA with Welch corrections and chi-square tests of independence. The results show that the effects of financial inclusion instruments are very heterogeneous. Insurance cover comes with increased financial security, higher savings discipline, increased corporate stability and reduced loan-related stress.

The mechanisms of commitment savings seem to be better at encouraging financial discipline than credit based interventions, whereas digital payments seem to make transactions more convenient and responsive to shocks without necessarily improving long run welfare. The occupational factor turns out to be a major predictor of financial performance, and gender and age do not have a significant explanatory value.

In general, the findings demonstrate that the outcomes of financial inclusion are related to the design of tools, the characteristics of their users, and the underlying behavioral processes. The paper highlights the importance of concerted, well-planned financial inclusion policies and not single product-centered strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述和116户低收入家庭及微型企业主的原始调查数据，采用复合框架分析多种金融普惠工具（保险、承诺储蓄、数字支付、信贷等）对家庭福利、企业绩效和金融态度的相对影响。研究发现各工具效应高度异质：保险提升金融安全与储蓄纪律，承诺储蓄优于信贷促进财务纪律，数字支付便利交易但未改善长期福利，职业是财务绩效的主要预测因子。研究强调需要协调规划的综合金融普惠政策，而非单一产品导向策略。
AI.research_question: 多种金融普惠工具（如小额信贷、小额储蓄、数字支付、移动货币、数字信贷、小额保险等）对低收入家庭福利、微型企业绩效和金融态度的相对影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有文献大多将各种金融普惠工具分开分析，缺乏对多种金融工具如何共同影响家庭和微型企业成果的综合理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融普惠复合框架，整合了家庭福利、企业绩效和金融态度三个维度；行为金融视角下工具设计特征与用户特征的交互作用。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述（实验与准实验研究）+ 116户低收入家庭及微型企业主原始问卷调查；Likert量表测量；可靠性分析（Cronbach α=0.850）；因数据非正态性，采用参数统计方法（带Welch校正的单因素方差分析）和非参数方法（卡方独立性检验）。
AI.findings: (1) 金融普惠工具的效果具有高度异质性；(2) 保险带来更高的财务安全感、储蓄纪律和企业稳定性，降低贷款相关压力；(3) 承诺储蓄机制比信贷干预更能鼓励财务纪律；(4) 数字支付提升交易便利性和应对冲击能力，但未改善长期福利；(5) 职业是财务绩效的主要预测因子；(6) 性别和年龄无显著解释力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了金融普惠工具效应的复合分析框架，揭示了工具设计特征、用户特征和行为过程三者的交互机制，挑战了单一工具导向的研究范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，强调需要协调规划的综合性金融普惠政策，而非单一产品导向策略；指导金融机构根据用户职业等特征差异化设计金融产品。

title: What Is Freedom? New Liberal Economics

detail.title: What Is Freedom? New Liberal Economics
detail.abstract:
Man is born free, and everywhere he is in chains.” Since Jean-Jacques Rousseau established the foundational principles of the Social Contract, the historical trajectory of humanity’s pursuit of genuine emancipation has been set. Yet, why do these fetters remain perpetually unbroken? This article conducts an in-depth extension of Hayek’s neoliberal economics, systematically elucidating its theoretical premises, critiquing its limitations, and offering necessary conceptual supplements.

Although this endeavor inherits the true ethos of Hayek’s thought, it operates much like a physician prescribing a targeted remedy to cure a disease: while therapeutically necessary, the medicine is seldom palatable to the patient. Therefore, this work should ultimately be understood as a therapeutic inheritance—an inheritance driven by the intent to cure, rather than by mere reverence.

AI.tldr: 本文对哈耶克的新自由主义经济学进行了深度拓展，系统阐述了其理论前提，批判了其局限性，并进行了必要的概念补充。作者将其工作定位为“治疗性继承”——以治愈问题为导向，而非单纯崇拜。
AI.research_question: 为什么人类追求自由的努力始终未能打破束缚？如何对哈耶克的新自由主义经济学进行必要的修正与补充？
AI.motivation: 承袭卢梭提出的社会契约与人类解放的命题，作者观察到尽管自由理念深入人心，但现实的“枷锁”始终未被打破，因此需要对哈耶克的自由主义理论进行批判性修正。
AI.theoretical_framework: 哈耶克的新自由主义经济学；社会契约论传统（卢梭）。
AI.method: 理论拓展与批判性分析，通过对哈耶克思想的系统性延伸、局限性批判和概念补充来完成。
AI.findings: 哈耶克的新自由主义经济学存在局限性，需要进行治疗性继承——即在保留其精神内核的同时，针对其缺陷进行修正和概念上的补充，而非全盘接受。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出“治疗性继承”这一理论态度，区分了盲目继承与批判性修正；对哈耶克理论进行了系统性批判与补充。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解当代自由与束缚的悖论提供了新的理论视角，有助于指导如何在现实层面推进真正的解放。

title: LRISK: Systemic Liquidity Risk in Mutual Funds
affiliations: Banque de France, Banque de France and CREST-ENSAE

detail.title: LRISK: Systemic Liquidity Risk in Mutual Funds
detail.abstract: This paper introduces LRISK, a forward-looking measure of systemic liquidity risk in mutual funds that quantifies the aggregate price pressure on financial markets conditional on a systemic redemption shock. The model captures the mechanics of fire sale spillovers by integrating three amplification channels: flow commonality, portfolio similarity, and endogenous declines in asset liquidity. Tracing the evolution of systemic liquidity risk from 2011 to 2024, we validate the predictive capabilities of LRISK at the asset, fund, and aggregate levels. At the asset level, LRISK-implied price pressure drives the cross-section of corporate bond returns during the COVID-19 crisis. At the fund level, higher LRISK exposure translates into underperformance during redemption shocks and helps explain funds' adoption of redemption in kind. At the aggregate level, LRISK serves as an early warning indicator, forecasting market distress up to two quarters ahead. Finally, a system-wide optimization exercise using the LRISK measure shows that a central planner could substantially reduce the spillovers generated by uncoordinated liquidations, suggesting that macroprudential tools can be designed to mitigate systemic liquidity risk.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了LRISK指标，一种前瞻性的共同基金系统性流动性风险度量，通过整合流量共同性、投资组合相似性和资产流动性内生下降三个放大渠道，量化系统性赎回冲击下的市场价格压力，并在资产、基金和总体三个层面验证了其预测能力，最后通过系统优化证明了宏观审慎工具缓解系统性流动性风险的可行性。
AI.research_question: 如何量化共同基金在系统性赎回冲击下的流动性风险，并验证其在资产、基金和总体层面的预测能力？
AI.motivation: 现有流动性风险度量多为事后或静态视角，缺乏前瞻性指标来捕捉共同基金之间因赎回冲击导致的抛售传染效应，而此类风险对金融稳定具有重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 火灾抛售溢出机制，包含三个放大渠道：流量共同性（赎回行为的相关性）、投资组合相似性（基金持仓重叠）、资产流动性内生下降（抛售导致流动性恶化）。
AI.method: 构建LRISK前瞻性度量模型，在资产、基金和总体三个层面进行实证验证，包括公司债券收益截面分析、基金业绩表现与赎回应对行为分析、市场困境预测，以及系统优化模拟。
AI.findings: （1）资产层面：LRISK隐含的价格压力在COVID-19危机期间驱动公司债券收益的截面差异；（2）基金层面：高LRISK敞口的基金在赎回冲击期间表现更差，并更倾向采用实物赎回（redemption in kind）；（3）总体层面：LRISK可作为早期预警指标，提前两个季度预测市场困境；（4）系统优化：中央计划者通过协调可大幅减少非协调清算产生的溢出效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了第一个前瞻性的系统性流动性风险度量指标LRISK，将三种传染渠道整合在一个统一框架内，拓展了火灾抛售和流动性风险理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了宏观审慎工具设计的定量依据，帮助基金经理评估自身流动性风险敞口，并为投资者识别脆弱基金提供参考。

title: The Everyday Cost of Paradise: Seasonal Grocery Inflation as a Tourism-led Externality
affiliations: University of Split, University of Zagreb - Faculty of Economics & Business and

detail.title: The Everyday Cost of Paradise: Seasonal Grocery Inflation as a Tourism-led Externality

declarations.funderStatement: This paper/research was funded by the European Union (NextGenerationEU) under the Croatian Recovery and Resilience Plan 2021–2026 (NRRP), through the University of Split institutional project “Tourism of Tomorrow: Resilience, Sustainability and Digital Transformation (TURBO; IP-UNIST-04)”, approved by the Ministry of Science, Education and Youth of the Republic of Croatia. Views and opinions expressed are however those of the author(s) only and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Union or the European Commission. Neither the European Union nor European Commission can be held responsible for them.

detail.abstract: This study conceptualizes tourism-led grocery inflation as a cost-of-living externality affecting everyday goods. Using retailer-published price microdata for Croatia, it aggregates 1.3 billion daily observations into monthly datasets covering May-October 2025. Prices are already higher in tourism-intensive coastal municipalities in May and then show additional coastal price growth over the summer, tracing an inverted U-shaped pattern that peaks in July-August and moderates by October. The pattern persists for essential goods and identical barcode-matched products. Retailer responses are heterogeneous: some chains show stronger coastal price increases during the peak season, while others show little or no coastal-inland differential. The findings identify a resident-facing tourism externality and support local cost-of-living monitoring to inform place-sensitive policy.

AI.tldr: 本研究将旅游导向的杂货通胀概念化为一种影响日常商品的生活成本外部性。利用克罗地亚零售商发布的微观价格数据，汇总了2025年5-10月13亿条日度观测值。结果显示，旅游密集的海岸城市价格在5月已更高，夏季进一步增长，呈倒U型模式（7-8月达峰，10月缓和）。该模式对必需品和条形码匹配的相同产品均成立。零售商反应异质：部分连锁店旺季沿海涨价明显，其他则无显著差异。研究识别了面向居民旅游外部性，支持地方生活成本监测以制定因地制宜政策。
AI.research_question: 旅游活动是否以及如何推高当地居民日常消费品（杂货）的价格，形成一种生活成本外部性？
AI.motivation: 旅游对居民生活成本的影响（特别是日常杂货通胀）在文献中较少被量化分析，现有研究多关注住房、服务业价格，忽视了旅游对基本生活用品价格的传导效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 旅游导向的杂货通胀作为生活成本外部性（cost-of-living externality）的概念框架。
AI.method: 利用克罗地亚零售商发布的微观价格数据（1.3亿条日度观测），汇总为2025年5-10月月度数据集；对比旅游密集海岸城市与内陆城市的价格差异及季节性变化模式。
AI.findings: （1）旅游密集海岸城市杂货价格在5月已高于内陆；（2）夏季海岸价格额外增长，呈倒U型，7-8月达峰，10月回落；（3）模式对必需品和条形码匹配产品成立；（4）零售商反应异质：部分连锁店旺季沿海涨价明显，其他无显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将旅游导致的杂货价格上涨概念化为一种面向居民的生活成本外部性，拓展了旅游外部性研究的范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为旅游目的地的地方生活成本监测和政策制定（如因地制宜的价格干预、居民补贴）提供了实证依据。

title: Storing Power or Projecting Influence? The Political Economy of Energy Storage Choice in Central Asia: Pumped Hydro versus Batteries through the Lens of Infrastructure Projection of Geopolitics
affiliations: and Kyrgyz State Technical University

detail.title: Storing Power or Projecting Influence? The Political Economy of Energy Storage Choice in Central Asia: Pumped Hydro versus Batteries through the Lens of Infrastructure Projection of Geopolitics
detail.abstract: The choice between pumped hydro energy storage (PHES) and battery energy storage systems (BESS) in Central Asia is conventionally framed as an engineering and cost-optimisation problem. This paper argues that it is, in fact, a geopolitical decision. Applying the author's framework of the Infrastructure Projection of Geopolitics (IPG) and its dysfunctional extension, Infrapopulism, we develop a three-axis analytical grid-projection, dependency, and narrative-to-reality gap-and apply it to the two dominant storage technologies. We show that BESS predominantly projects an external (largely Chinese) geopolitics and generates a novel, cyclical form of infranomic dependency, yet disciplines delivery and is therefore structurally resistant to infrapopulism; PHES can serve as an instrument of a small state's own infrastructural projection and secures infranomic sovereignty in operation, but is acutely vulnerable in financing and is the principal generator of infrapopulism in the region's energy sector. Engineering calculations of Kyrgyzstan's storage potential show that the Toktogul reservoir alone holds a seasonal storage potential of roughly 5,840 GWh, and a 60-year life-cycle comparison finds BESS roughly twice as costly as PHES for an equivalent duty owing to replacement cycles. No single technology dominates across all three axes. The optimum is a portfolio whose regulatory architecture neutralises the specific weakness of each technology, anchored in the common electricity market of the Eurasian Economic Union (Art. 79) and in tariff reform. The empirical anchor is the April 2026 final investment decision on the Mirny wind-plus-BESS project in Kazakhstan, read against the decades-long declaratory history of the Kambarata cascade in Kyrgyzstan.

AI.tldr: 本文论证中亚地区抽水蓄能（PHES）与电池储能（BESS）的选择并非单纯工程优化问题，而是地缘政治决策。通过作者提出的"基础设施地缘政治投射"（IPG）框架及其病态延伸"基础设施民粹主义"，从投射、依赖、叙事-现实差距三个维度分析两种技术，发现BESS投射外部（中国）地缘政治并产生新型周期性"基础设施金融依赖"，但纪律性强、抗民粹主义；PHES可服务小国自身投射、保障运营主权，但融资脆弱且易滋生民粹主义。技术分析显示托克托古尔水库季节性储能潜力约5,840 GWh，BESS全生命周期成本约为PHES两倍。最优方案是结合两者优势的投资组合，以欧亚经济联盟共同电力市场和电价改革为制度锚点。
AI.research_question: 中亚地区选择抽水蓄能（PHES）还是电池储能（BESS）这一决策，其本质是工程成本优化问题还是地缘政治问题？两种技术在地缘政治投射、依赖性及叙事-现实差距三个维度上各自有何特征与弱点？
AI.motivation: 既有文献将储能技术选择简化为工程经济问题，忽略了基础设施投资背后的地缘政治逻辑。中亚作为大国博弈前沿，储能基础设施选择深刻影响区域权力格局、主权自主性和能源治理模式。作者旨在揭示这一"去政治化"讨论中的深层地缘政治维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施地缘政治投射（IPG）框架；基础设施民粹主义（Infrapopulism）；三轴分析网格：投射（Projection）、依赖（Dependency）、叙事-现实差距（Narrative-to-reality gap）；基础设施金融依赖（Infranomic dependency/sovereignty）。
AI.method: 理论框架构建；三轴比较分析；工程估算（托克托古尔水库储能潜力、60年生命周期成本对比）；案例研究（哈萨克斯坦Mirny风电+BESS项目2026年最终投资决策 vs. 吉尔吉斯斯坦坎巴拉塔梯级水电站数十年声明史）。
AI.findings: 1. BESS投射外部（中国）地缘政治，产生周期性"基础设施金融依赖"，但项目交付纪律性强，结构上抵抗基础设施民粹主义。2. PHES可作为小国自身基础设施投射工具，保障运营中的"基础设施金融主权"，但融资阶段高度脆弱，是区域能源部门基础设施民粹主义的主要来源。3. 托克托古尔水库季节性储能潜力约5,840 GWh。4. 60年生命周期内，BESS成本约为PHES的两倍（因更换周期）。5. 没有任何单一技术能在三个维度全面占优，最优方案是投资组合+制度设计（欧亚经济联盟第79条+电价改革）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将基础设施研究从"工程-经济"范式拓展至地缘政治分析；提出了IPG框架和"基础设施民粹主义"概念；构建了"投射-依赖-叙事现实差距"三轴分析网格；提出了"基础设施金融依赖/主权"概念，丰富了国际政治经济学中关于基础设施与权力关系的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中亚国家储能技术选择提供了超越单纯成本核算的决策框架；指出了BESS和PHES各自的政治脆弱性，提出了投资组合+制度设计的政策建议；为欧亚经济联盟能源市场一体化提供了具体的技术-制度协调路径；对大国（中国）基础设施投资的地缘政治效应提出了警示。

title: The Geopolitical Blockchain: Infrastructural Power of Protocols and the Architecture of a Polycentric Order

detail.title: The Geopolitical Blockchain: Infrastructural Power of Protocols and the Architecture of a Polycentric Order
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the concept of protocol geoeconomics — an analytical framework in which the infrastructure of digital governance is treated as an autonomous instrument for the distribution of power amid the systemic crisis of the multilateral order. The central argument holds that as the traditional mechanisms of global governance lose their function as neutral arbiters, control over the rules of verification, enforcement, and sanctioning of international commitments becomes a key resource of geopolitical agency. Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) in this perspective is not a replacement for diplomatic institutions but the next logical form of infrastructural power — the appropriation of political influence through the ownership of coordination protocols. The paper introduces two operational categories: the sovereign node (a national point of participation in a distributed ledger that cannot be unilaterally disconnected) and protocol Westphalianism (a digital-age analogue of the Westphalian system in which a state's sovereignty is defined by its capacity to maintain a verifying node in critical international coordination systems). A formal model of algorithmic stability is developed through a slashing function and quadratic weighting of influence, providing structural protection against unipolar capture of the system. The dynamic National Influence Index (NI) operationalises representation as a function of verifiable contribution rather than historical privilege. Three contributions emerge. First, infrastructural power is established as a self-standing analytical category describing power exercised through rules of computation rather than through resources or territory. Second, the sovereign node operationalises the concept of digital sovereignty, hitherto largely declarative in the literature. Third, protocol Westphalianism provides a structural exit from the false dichotomy between national sovereignty and global governance. The framework is positioned as the digital extension of Infrastructure Projection of Geopolitics (IPG, WP-IPG-2026-01), with strategic implications for Russia, BRICS+, and the Global South in the construction of Multipolar World Order 2.0.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"协议地缘经济学"框架，将数字治理基础设施视为在多边秩序系统性危机中分配权力的自主工具。核心观点是：当传统全球治理机制失去中立仲裁功能时，对验证、执行和制裁国际承诺规则的掌控成为地缘政治代理的关键资源。分布式账本技术（DLT）并非外交制度的替代品，而是基础设施权力的下一逻辑形态——通过拥有协调协议来获取政治影响力。论文引入"主权节点"和"协议威斯特伐利亚主义"两个操作化范畴，并通过罚没函数与影响力二次加权构建了算法稳定性模型，提出动态国家影响力指数（NI）。
AI.research_question: 在多边秩序系统性危机背景下，数字治理基础设施如何作为地缘政治权力的分配工具运作？主权国家如何通过参与分布式账本协议来获得和维护地缘政治影响力？
AI.motivation: 传统全球治理机制失去作为中立仲裁者的功能，而现有文献对数字主权的讨论大多停留在宣言层面，缺乏操作化概念。需要一种新的分析框架来理解基础设施权力如何成为地缘政治代理的关键资源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协议地缘经济学（Protocol Geoeconomics）；基础设施权力（Infrastructural Power）；主权节点（Sovereign Node）；协议威斯特伐利亚主义（Protocol Westphalianism）；算法稳定性模型（Slashing Function与Quadratic Weighting）；动态国家影响力指数（National Influence Index, NI）
AI.method: 理论建构与形式化建模：提出概念框架，并通过罚没函数（slashing function）和影响力二次加权（quadratic weighting）构建算法稳定性模型，以防止系统被单极捕获。
AI.findings: 1. 基础设施权力可作为独立分析范畴，描述通过计算规则而非资源或领土行使的权力。2. 主权节点操作化了数字主权概念，使其从宣言性走向可分析性。3. 协议威斯特伐利亚主义提供了超越国家主权与全球治理之间虚假二元对立的结构性出路。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将基础设施权力确立为独立分析范畴。2. 通过主权节点操作化数字主权概念。3. 提出协议威斯特伐利亚主义，超越主权与全球治理的二元对立。4. 将地缘政治分析拓展到协议层基础设施。
AI.practical_contributions: 对俄罗斯、金砖国家+及全球南方在构建多极世界秩序2.0中具有战略启示；为国际协调系统的去中心化治理提供操作化路径。

title: The Algorithmic Screening Exam: EMTALA’s Blind Spot for AI Triage

detail.title: The Algorithmic Screening Exam: EMTALA’s Blind Spot for AI Triage
detail.abstract: Emergency departments across the country are deploying artificial intelligence triage systems that functionally shape, and in some cases substitute for, the medical screening examination that the Emergency Medical Treatment and Labor Act (EMTALA) requires. 1 The statute was written to prevent "patient dumping" by ensuring every person who presents to an emergency department receives a screening by qualified medical personnel. It never contemplated an algorithm performing that function. This Essay argues that AI triage systems create three unresolved EMTALA problems: (1) whether an algorithmically influenced screening satisfies the statutory requirement; (2) whether an AI system that diverts patients away from the emergency department triggers EMTALA's stabilization obligation; and (3) who bears liability (the hospital, the vendor, or both) when an AI triage failure results in an EMTALA violation. Current guidance from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services is silent on all three questions, and the window for regulatory clarity is closing as adoption accelerates.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI分诊系统在急诊科部署所引发的《紧急医疗和劳工法案》（EMTALA）法律问题，包括算法筛查是否符合法定要求、AI分流患者是否触发稳定义务，以及违规时的责任归属。
AI.research_question: AI分诊系统在急诊科的应用对EMTALA法规产生了哪些尚未解决的法律问题？
AI.motivation: 美国各地急诊科正大规模部署AI分诊系统，这些系统在功能上塑造甚至替代了EMTALA要求的医学筛查检查，但该法规在制定时并未考虑算法的参与，产生了法律真空。
AI.theoretical_framework: EMTALA法规框架、算法监管理论、医疗责任分配理论
AI.method: 法律文本分析、案例研究、法规解释学
AI.findings: AI分诊系统造成三个未解决的EMTALA问题：（1）受算法影响的筛查是否符合法定要求；（2）将患者从急诊分流出去的AI系统是否触发EMTALA的稳定义务；（3）AI分诊失误导致EMTALA违规时，医院、供应商或双方谁承担法律责任。CMS当前指南对这三个问题均未涉及。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI治理理论引入紧急医疗法律框架，揭示了现有医疗监管体系在算法介入下的理论盲区。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者和监管机构（如CMS）提供政策建议，指出需要在AI分诊加速普及前明确法律规则，以保障患者权益并分配责任风险。

title: Structural Economy: The Effect of Economic Destruction From International Markets on Selected Underdevelopment Countries

detail.title: Structural Economy: The Effect of Economic Destruction From International Markets on Selected Underdevelopment Countries
