AI.tldr: 本文分析了国际市场冲击对依赖石油、天然气和钻石等大宗商品的发展中国家（特别是安哥拉、赤道几内亚、刚果民主共和国）经济的强烈影响，指出这些国家因经济结构薄弱，在面对外生冲击时缺乏足够应对能力，导致经济停滞甚至破坏效应。
AI.research_question: 国际市场冲击如何影响依赖大宗商品的发展中国家经济？特别是这些冲击如何通过经济结构脆弱性传导至国内经济？
AI.motivation: 许多发展中国家高度依赖石油、天然气和钻石等大宗商品出口，国际市场波动对这些经济体造成显著冲击，理解这一传导机制对政策制定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外生冲击理论、经济结构脆弱性理论、资源依赖理论
AI.method: 案例分析法，以安哥拉、赤道几内亚、刚果民主共和国等国家为例，分析疫情冲击和石油价格下跌期间的经济表现。
AI.findings: 1. 依赖大宗商品的发展中国家经济受到国际市场的强烈影响；2. 疫情冲击和国际油价下跌验证了安哥拉经济的极度依赖性；3. 钻石价格波动同样反映了显著的经济依赖；4. 外生冲击下，经济结构薄弱的国家缺乏足够应对能力，产生"经济破坏效应"；5. 薄弱的制度和政治机构会进一步加剧经济停滞。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了外生冲击与资源依赖型经济体脆弱性关系的理论理解，提出了"经济破坏效应"这一概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为依赖大宗商品的发展中国家提供了政策启示：需要加强经济结构多元化、增强制度建设和政策应对能力，以应对外生冲击。

title: Infranomics: The Foundational Economic Stratum — A Canonical Definition with Operational Index

detail.title: Infranomics: The Foundational Economic Stratum — A Canonical Definition with Operational Index
detail.abstract: This paper presents the canonical definition of Infranomics — the foundational economic stratum that constitutes the lower level of the three-tier stratification (Infranomics → Classical Economy → Ultranomics) on which the author's research programme is built. The concept has been repeatedly deployed in prior work, but has not until now received a separate canonical formalization. The paper closes this methodological gap and simultaneously demarcates the political-economic concept developed here from the prior systems-engineering concept of the same name introduced by Gheorghe and Masera (2010, 2014). Infranomics in the political-economic sense is defined as the economic stratum in which physical and physical-adjacent infrastructure — energy networks, transportation systems, water systems, telecommunications, datacenters as physical objects — operates as the material foundation of all subsequent economic activity, and whose objects possess a structural power not reducible to their market value. Infranomics is not an industry or a sector; it is the lower economic level upon which the classical economy stands, and through it the ultranomic apex. The stratum is constituted by four features: (1) physical-territorial anchoring; (2) structural power not reducible to market value; (3) coercion of dependency; (4) sub-economic financing as constitutive. Together these features differentiate Infranomics from the classical economic stratum and justify it as a distinct theoretical category. The paper also introduces an operational instrument — the Infranomic Sovereignty Index (ISI) — a four-axis system for assessing the degree of infranomic sovereignty held by a state across its critical infrastructure sectors. The ISI evaluates four dimensions per sector: decision control, local financing share, technical standard origin, and political transferability. The instrument is applicable without specialized training and produces profiles comparable across countries and across sectors. The paper differentiates Infranomics from five adjacent concepts: from infrastructure economics as a mainstream subfield (sectoral, not structural); from systems-engineering Infranomics in the Gheorghe-Masera sense (decision-methodology, not stratum); from Infrastructure Political Geography (IPG) as an applied analytical framework operating on the infranomic stratum; from geo-economics as a foreign-policy concept; and from infrastructure studies in critical theory traditions (Easterling, Larkin, Mitchell, Khalili) which capture important dimensions but do not develop infranomics as a structural-economic stratum. Five anticipated objections are addressed within the text. The concluding section discusses three macro-consequences: the redefinition of sovereignty as infranomic control; infrapopulism as the predictable political pathology of infranomic dependency; and the hierarchy of structural conditioning under which the classical economy and ultranomics both depend on infranomic prerequisites.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Infranomics（基础经济学）的正式定义，将其定位为三层经济分层（基础经济学→古典经济学→超经济学）的最底层，并介绍了四个构成特征和一个操作性评估工具——基础经济主权指数（ISI）。
AI.research_question: 如何对Infranomics这一政治经济学概念进行规范的形式化定义，并将其与先前系统工程领域的同名概念区分开来？
AI.motivation: Infranomics概念已在作者先前研究中反复使用，但一直缺乏独立的规范化形式化定义；同时需要将政治经济学意义上的Infranomics与Gheorghe和Masera（2010, 2014）提出的系统工程意义上的同名概念进行明确区分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三层经济分层理论（Infranomics→古典经济学→Ultranomics）；基础设施的结构性权力理论；基础经济主权理论。
AI.method: 概念形式化界定与理论建构；提出Infranomics的四个构成性特征；设计Infranomic Sovereignty Index (ISI)四轴评估系统。
AI.findings: Infranomics的四个特征：物理-领土锚定性、不可还原为市场价值的结构性权力、依赖的强制性、作为构成性特征的亚经济融资。ISI四维度：决策控制、本地融资份额、技术标准来源、政治可转移性。提出了三个宏观后果：主权重新定义为基础经济控制、基础民粹主义、结构性条件层级。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对Infranomics进行规范形式化定义；将其确立为区别于古典经济学的独立理论范畴；与五个邻近概念（基础设施经济学、系统工程Infranomics、基础设施政治地理学、地缘经济学、批判理论中的基础设施研究）进行了系统区分。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了Infranomic Sovereignty Index (ISI)这一无需专业培训即可应用的评估工具，可用于跨国、跨行业的基础经济主权比较分析。

title: From Wages to Watts: Energy as the Measure of Synthetic Labor in Two Emerging Economic Architectures

detail.title: From Wages to Watts: Energy as the Measure of Synthetic Labor in Two Emerging Economic Architectures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The Citizen 5.0 framework discussed here is developed in full in the author’s forthcoming book, Citizen 5.0: A New Social Contract for Artificial Intelligence (CRC Press, an imprint of Taylor & Francis Group), and in companion papers (Galipeau, 2026a, 2026b, 2026c). This article draws on and refers to that work as a scholarly article, recasting its argument in new prose, quoting only brief attributed passages, and pointing readers to the book rather than reproducing it, and it gives credit to the Publisher and the Work accordingly. It is intended to complement, not to substitute for or compete with, the book.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Data availability. This is a conceptual paper and generated no datasets. All primary materials are the cited published works.
declarations.funderStatement: None. The author developed the Citizen 5.0 framework that is one of the two objects of comparison and has a clear interest in its reception. The paper attempts to mitigate this by applying symmetric scrutiny and by declining to rank the frameworks. Readers should nonetheless weight the self-comparison with this conflict in view. The author has no financial relationship with Roemmele or Read Multiplex.

detail.abstract: Two independent proposals now argue that the unit in which economic value is measured is shifting from the wage to the watt. Brian Roemmele's JouleWork prices the output of autonomous AI agents in an energy-denominated wage unit and runs it, in a live "Zero-Human Company," as a continuous thermodynamic payroll. The framework presented in Citizen 5.0: A New Social Contract for Artificial Intelligence (Galipeau, 2027; hereafter Citizen 5.0) makes the joule a unit of public account and an ecological budget, taxes the surplus that synthetic labor captures when it displaces human work through a Synthetic Labor Tax, and governs compute through a Joule Standard and a Metabolic Ledger. This paper compares the two on four dimensions held separate from any value judgment: their mathematical formulations, their methodological approach, their results to date, and their prospects for realization. The comparison finds that the frameworks measure different objects, an agent's energy-weighted output as against a firm's displacement surplus; that they operate at different layers, a firminternal wage as against a societal account; and that they rest on opposite governance logics, bottom-up market selection as against top-down fiscal deliberation, while converging on a shared thermodynamic premise and a shared token mechanism. Neither is implemented at scale, both are explicitly illustrative, and each supplies what the other lacks. Beyond the comparison, the paper offers one constructive result, stated formally as a falsifiable proposition: a firm running JouleWork-style accounting makes the Citizen 5.0 tax base directly observable, reducing its central measurement problem from three unknowns per task to one, and so positioning JouleWork as a candidate micro-foundation for the Citizen 5.0 architecture rather than a rival to it. The independent convergence of a builder and an institutionalist on energy-denominated value is read here not as a settled result but as a signal that the field is at its beginning. The paper closes with a research agenda.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了两套以能量（焦耳）作为经济价值计量单位的框架——JouleWork和Citizen 5.0，发现它们在数学形式、方法论、实现前景上存在差异但共享热力学前提与代币机制，并提出JouleWork可作为Citizen 5.0的微观基础，从而解决后者的关键测量难题。
AI.research_question: 两套以焦耳为价值计量单位的框架（JouleWork与Citizen 5.0）在数学公式、方法论、已有结果和实现前景四个维度上有何异同？它们彼此是竞争还是互补关系？
AI.motivation: 经济价值的计量单位正从工资转向能量（瓦特），两套独立提案同时出现，需要系统比较以厘清它们的区别与联系，并探索整合可能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 热力学价值理论；能量本位经济学；合成劳动力征税理论；代谢分类账（Metabolic Ledger）；焦耳标准（Joule Standard）。
AI.method: 理论比较分析：在数学公式、方法论、已有结果、实现前景四个维度上对两套框架进行无价值判断的系统比较，并提出可证伪的整合命题。
AI.findings: （1）两者测量对象不同：JouleWork测量代理的能量加权产出，Citizen 5.0测量企业的劳动力替代剩余；（2）运作层级不同：企业内部工资 vs. 社会账户；（3）治理逻辑对立：自下而上的市场选择 vs. 自上而下的财政审议；（4）共享热力学前提与代币机制；（5）JouleWork可使Citizen 5.0的税基直接可观测，将三个未知数降为一个。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出JouleWork可作为Citizen 5.0的候选微观基础，而非竞争对手；将两套框架的趋同解读为领域处于起步阶段的信号，而非成熟结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为构建以能量为价值单位的AI经济体系提供了可操作的路径：通过企业层面实施JouleWork会计，为宏观层面Citizen 5.0的合成劳动力税提供可观测的税基。

title: Cognitive Dissonance at Scale: How Named-Individual Accountability Breaks Institutional Rationalisation

detail.title: Cognitive Dissonance at Scale: How Named-Individual Accountability Breaks Institutional Rationalisation
detail.abstract: This paper applies Festinger's (1957) theory of cognitive dissonance to institutional accountability at scale. The diagnosis it begins from-that responsibility dissolves when distributed across anonymous collective processes-is well established in political theory and organisational ethics, and the paper claims no originality for it. Its contribution is an instrument that acts on that condition: the Burgess Principle binary test, which asks whether a named human being applied their individual mind to the specific facts of a specific case before a significant decision issued, and which converts a diffuse structural problem into an attributable, citable, answerable record on demand. Drawing on a documented dataset of 80 interactions across 15 named institutions, the paper shows the test relocating accountability from the institution to an identified role-holder, who must evidence individual consideration (SOVEREIGN) or leave its absence on the record (NULL). Because the dataset is a single-author convenience sample, the paper treats it as a set of existence proofs rather than a population estimate, separates every classification from any contested legal allegation, and validates the rubric against two matters of public record-the Australian Robodebt scheme and the Post Office Horizon prosecutions-in which the author had no involvement. The paper also connects NULL to its cognitive microfoundations, drawing on Shaw and Nave's (2026) account of 'cognitive surrender' to artificial (System 3) outputs, and reads the binary test as a real-world device for reactivating the deliberative scrutiny that surrender displaces. A dedicated section sets out, and operationalises, the ethical limits the framework imposes on itself, including a correction and right-of-reply protocol, on the principle that a standard demanding attributable accountability must be answerable on the same terms. Individuals are identified by role, not name.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Burgess Principle 二元测试"作为将制度性问责转化为可归属、可记录的个人问责的工具，通过80个跨机构案例验证，并连接"认知投降"理论说明其认知微观基础。
AI.research_question: 如何在集体匿名决策过程中将弥散的责任重新归属到具体个人，实现制度层面可操作的问责机制？
AI.motivation: 政治理论与组织伦理已确认"责任在匿名集体过程中消散"这一诊断，但缺乏可操作的工具将结构性模糊问题转化为可归属、可引证、可问责的个体记录。
AI.theoretical_framework: Festinger (1957) 认知失调理论；Shaw & Nave (2026) "认知投降"（Cognitive Surrender）理论（向人工智能/系统3输出投降）；制度问责理论
AI.method: Burgess Principle 二元测试（SOVEREIGN/NULL 二分法）；80个跨15个命名机构的单作者便利样本（作为存在性证明而非总体估计）；针对Robodebt计划和Post Office Horizon起诉两起公共事件的效度检验；伦理限制协议（更正与答辩权机制）
AI.findings: 二元测试成功将问责从制度层面重新定位到具体角色持有人；识别出"认知投降"（向AI/系统输出放弃个体深思熟虑）作为NULL状态的微观基础；在两项公共事件中验证了框架的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将认知失调理论从个体层面扩展到制度问责场景；将"认知投降"概念操作化为可识别的问责状态（NULL）；建立了结构性问责问题与个体认知过程之间的理论桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可在实际决策流程中部署的二元测试工具（Burgess Principle）；设计了包含更正与答辩权的自反性伦理限制协议；通过角色而非姓名标识个人，平衡了问责与隐私。

title: A Healthcare Analytic Framework for Lung Allocation Process Modeling Using Path Analysis
affiliations: Yarmouk University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Healthcare Analytic Framework for Lung Allocation Process Modeling Using Path Analysis
detail.abstract: Lung allocation includes complex associations among clinical, immunological, and procedural factors, many of which reveal nonlinearity with post-transplant outcomes. Current studies often rely on linear or predictive approaches; these approaches either lack interpretability or fail to capture nonlinear relationships. In this study, we introduce an integrated path-analytic framework combining Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) with Bayesian neural network-based Universal Structural Modeling (USM) to analyze lung transplant outcomes using United Network for Organ Sharing (UNOS) data.  SEM is first used to construct clinically interpretable unobserved (or latent) representations of lung allocation factors. These unobserved constructs are then integrated into USM to discover nonlinear and interaction effects. Model performance is evaluated using censoring-aware survival metrics (Concordance index (C-index), area under the curve (AUC), and Integrated Brier Score (IBS)) and classification metrics for functional outcomes. Using 5-fold cross validation, the proposed framework shows improved discrimination and calibration compared with linear, non-linear, clinical-only, and Lung Allocation Score (LAS) baselines, while preserving structural interpretability. This work donates a validated integration of unobserved -variable modeling and nonlinear learning for associational analysis of lung allocation process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合结构方程模型（SEM）与贝叶斯神经网络通用结构模型（USM）的集成路径分析框架，用于分析肺移植分配结果。该框架首先利用SEM构建临床可解释的潜变量，再将其纳入USM发现非线性和交互效应。在UNOS数据上，该框架相比线性模型、非线性模型、纯临床模型及LAS基线，在区分度和校准度上均有提升，同时保持了结构可解释性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个兼具临床可解释性与非线性建模能力的集成分析框架，以揭示肺移植分配过程中各因素与移植后结局之间的复杂关联关系？
AI.motivation: 当前肺移植分配研究多依赖线性或纯预测方法：线性方法无法捕捉变量间的非线性关系，纯预测方法（如黑箱模型）缺乏可解释性。两者均难以同时满足临床决策对准确性和可解释性的双重需求，亟需一种能整合潜变量建模与非线性学习的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构方程模型（SEM）：用于构建临床可解释的潜变量表示；贝叶斯神经网络通用结构模型（USM）：用于发现非线性和交互效应；潜变量建模与非线性学习的整合路径分析框架。
AI.method: 数据来源：UNOS肺移植数据。步骤1：使用SEM构建肺移植分配因素的潜变量表示；步骤2：将潜变量纳入USM以发现非线性与交互效应；模型评估：采用C-index、AUC、IBS等考虑删失的生存指标及分类指标；验证方式：5折交叉验证，与线性模型、非线性模型、纯临床模型及LAS基线对比。
AI.findings: 提出的SEM-USM集成框架在区分度和校准度上均优于线性模型、非线性模型、纯临床模型及LAS基线；框架保留了结构可解释性的同时，成功捕获了肺移植分配过程中的非线性与交互效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将SEM（潜变量建模）与贝叶斯神经网络USM（非线性学习）进行系统整合，构建了用于肺移植分配关联分析的集成路径分析框架，为医学领域潜变量与非线性建模的融合提供了方法论验证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为肺移植分配决策提供了兼具高预测性能与临床可解释性的分析工具，有助于优化器官分配策略，改善移植后结局评估的准确性。

title: Which livelihood capital matters most? Prioritizing drought resilience drivers for rural food security using the sustainable livelihood framework Authorship Statement
affiliations: Razi University and Razi University

detail.title: Which livelihood capital matters most? Prioritizing drought resilience drivers for rural food security using the sustainable livelihood framework Authorship Statement
detail.abstract: Droughts have severely affected rural livelihoods in Iran and endangered food security. Kermanshah Province, despite high agricultural potential, faces alarming food insecurity levels. This study prioritized livelihood capitals human, social, natural, physical, and financial in food resilience under drought using the sustainable livelihood framework. A survey of 384 rural household heads in Kermanshah was analyzed using PLS-SEM. Results showed that 65.8% of households were food insecure, more than double the national average. Livelihood capitals, except human capital, were critically low. Financial capital had the greatest impact on food resilience (β = 0.345), followed by social (β = 0.234), human (β = 0.162), natural (β = 0.145), and physical capital (β = 0.123). The five capitals explained 63.9% of the variance in food resilience. Rather than conventional education-extension approaches, policies should prioritize financial empowerment through local markets, eliminating intermediaries, and direct producer-consumer connections. Local cooperative networks for sharing drought adaptation experiences and replacing traditional crops with low-water-demand alternatives are recommended. The prioritization pattern depends on ecological conditions and drought severity, so a single model cannot be generalized to all regions. This research contributes to sustainable livelihood knowledge and offers practical solutions for drought adaptation.

title: When AI Agents Pay: The Viability Bound
affiliations: Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR), Rotterdam School of Management (RSM)

detail.title: When AI Agents Pay: The Viability Bound

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: This research is self-funded

detail.abstract: When should a task that includes payments be handed to an autonomous AI agent, and when should a human still own and execute it? This paper decomposes the cost of an autonomous agentic AI task into three parts: inference, verification, and settlement. The binding cost is verification, and it rises steeply with complexity, because a trustless auditor cannot re-run the task on chosen inputs and can reliably check only a bounded number of actions at once. A more capable verifier agent lowers this cost only modestly; only simplifying the task's interaction structure changes how fast it grows. The result is a bounded "Goldilocks zone'': agents beat humans only up to a threshold complexity, and humans should retain the most complex tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文从成本角度分析了自主AI代理何时应接管包含支付的任务，发现验证成本是关键约束，并提出了一个有限的"金发姑娘区域"：AI代理仅在复杂度低于阈值时优于人类，最复杂任务仍应留给人类。
AI.research_question: 何时应该将包含支付的任务交给自主AI代理，何时仍应由人类执行？
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理自主执行支付相关任务的能力增强，需要界定AI与人类在任务执行中的最优分工边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 任务成本分解框架（推理成本、验证成本、结算成本），其中验证成本是核心约束。
AI.method: 理论建模与成本分析。
AI.findings: 验证成本随任务复杂度急剧上升；更强的验证代理只能适度降低成本；简化任务的交互结构才能改变成本增长速度；存在有限的"金发姑娘区域"——AI代理仅在复杂度低于某一阈值时优于人类。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI代理任务的三成本分解框架，揭示了验证成本作为关键约束的机制，界定了AI与人类任务分配的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在支付相关任务中如何合理分配AI与人力资源提供了明确指导原则。

title: Elevating Brands Through Intellectual Capital: Legal and Economic Synergies
affiliations: , University of Silesia in Katowice - Poland Faculty of Law and Administration and Mackenzie Presbyterian University

detail.title: Elevating Brands Through Intellectual Capital: Legal and Economic Synergies

declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded in whole by the National Science Centre in Poland, grant “Brand Abuse: Brand as a New Personal Interest under the Polish Civil Code against an EU and US Backdrop”, grant holder: Marlena Maria Jankowska-Augustyn, number: 2021/43/B/HS5/01156. For the purpose of Open Access, the author has applied a CC-BY public copyright licence to any Author Accepted Manuscript (AAM) version arising from this submission.

detail.abstract: The research explores how brands contribute to economic growth by fostering consumer loyalty, enabling premium pricing, and facilitating market differentiation. Additionally, the paper delves into the interplay between IP protection and brand management, emphasizing the necessity of robust legal frameworks to safeguard brand integrity and prevent abuse. Through a comparative analysis of different regulatory environments, the study identifies best practices in brand protection and leverages interdisciplinary insights from law, economics, and management. The intellectual capital approach broadens the understanding of brands, recognizing their role in enhancing intangible assets such as human capital, relational capital, and structural capital. This comprehensive perspective underscores the importance of strategic brand management in leveraging intellectual capital for sustained economic success. By integrating theoretical and empirical evidence, the study offers a holistic view of brands as dynamic entities that embody both legal protections and economic potentials. As a concrete illustration of these concepts, the paper will subsequently examine the M&M's brand to demonstrate how a well-managed brand leverages both IP frameworks and intellectual capital. The findings contribute to the ongoing discourse on the strategic importance of brands, providing valuable implications for policymakers, business leaders, and academics. Ultimately, this research advocates for a synergistic approach that aligns IP strategies with intellectual capital management to maximize the legal, economic, and organizational benefits of strong, well-managed brands.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨品牌如何通过促进消费者忠诚度、实现溢价定价和市场差异化推动经济增长，并分析知识产权保护与品牌管理之间的互动关系。通过跨学科视角（法学、经济学、管理学）和比较分析，研究提出将知识产权战略与智力资本管理协同，以最大化品牌的法律、经济和组织效益，并以M&M's品牌为案例进行说明。
AI.research_question: 品牌如何通过知识产权保护与智力资本管理的协同作用推动经济增长，以及在跨学科视角下如何实现品牌保护的最佳实践？
AI.motivation: 现有研究较少将品牌管理、知识产权保护与智力资本视角进行系统性整合，本文旨在弥合这一理论空白，为政策制定者、企业领导者和学术界提供品牌战略管理的综合框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 智力资本方法（涵盖人力资本、关系资本和结构资本）；知识产权法律框架；品牌经济学理论（消费者忠诚度、溢价定价、市场差异化）。
AI.method: 比较分析法（对比不同监管环境）；跨学科整合（法学、经济学、管理学）；理论与实证证据结合分析；案例研究（M&M's品牌）。
AI.findings: 品牌通过消费者忠诚、溢价定价和市场差异化促进经济增长；强有力的知识产权保护对维护品牌完整性至关重要；将品牌视为智力资本的一部分（人力资本、关系资本、结构资本）能更全面地理解其价值；知识产权战略与智力资本管理的协同能最大化品牌效益。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了品牌作为动态实体的综合视角，融合了法律保护与经济潜力；将智力资本理论拓展至品牌管理领域；建立了知识产权战略与智力资本管理协同的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供品牌保护的最佳实践建议；为企业领导者提供战略品牌管理指南；强调跨部门协同（法务、管理、经济）对品牌价值最大化的重要性。

title: The Impact of the Gaza War on Crime Rates in Muslim-Israeli Settlements
affiliations: Charles University in Prague - Faculty of Law

detail.title: The Impact of the Gaza War on Crime Rates in Muslim-Israeli Settlements
detail.abstract: This paper tests for differential crime rates between predominantly Muslim and non-Muslim Israeli settlements relative to the timing of the Gaza War using a difference-in-differences specification. I find that Muslim settlements experienced an additional 34.40 crime incidents per 100k residents in the average post-war quarter. The baseline effect is driven by security, public order, and against property offenses. The rise in public order offenses depends on localized social unrest (i.e., protest and riot events), whereas the effect on security offenses is suggestive of broader wartime enforcement. The increase in against property offenses is explained neither by localized social unrest nor socioeconomic status.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用双重差分法，发现加沙战争后以色列穆斯林定居点的犯罪率显著上升，主要体现为安全、公共秩序和财产犯罪，其中公共秩序犯罪与本地社会动荡相关，安全犯罪与战时执法相关，财产犯罪的原因尚不明确。
AI.research_question: 加沙战争前后，以色列穆斯林与非穆斯林定居点的犯罪率是否存在显著差异？
AI.motivation: 检验战争冲突对少数族群社区犯罪率的影响，以及不同犯罪类型背后的驱动机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 冲突理论、社会动荡与犯罪关系、战时执法理论
AI.method: 双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences）
AI.findings: 加沙战争后，穆斯林定居点每10万居民平均增加34.40起犯罪案件；该效应主要由安全犯罪、公共秩序犯罪和财产犯罪驱动；公共秩序犯罪上升与本地抗议和骚乱事件相关；安全犯罪上升暗示战时执法强化；财产犯罪上升无法由本地社会动荡或社会经济地位解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了不同犯罪类型在战后上升的异质性机制，揭示了战时执法、社会动荡与犯罪之间的复杂关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解冲突背景下少数族群社区犯罪率变化提供实证依据，有助于制定更有针对性的战后治安与社区干预政策。

title: What is in a Bottle? Thirty Design Strategies for Luxurious Packaging, Transcending Intellectual Property to Embrace Intellectual Capital
affiliations: and University of Silesia in Katowice - Poland Faculty of Law and Administration

detail.title: What is in a Bottle? Thirty Design Strategies for Luxurious Packaging, Transcending Intellectual Property to Embrace Intellectual Capital
detail.abstract: This study explores the nuanced role of intellectual property (IP) and intellectual capital (IC) in the premium beverage industry, focusing on bottle design as a strategic asset. By analyzing the ways brands like Maker's Mark, Veuve Clicquot, and Glenfiddich differentiate themselves through unique bottle features, our study highlights how companies are building brand identity and consumer loyalty outside conventional IP protections. This approach emphasizes the importance of design strategy in the beverage industry and reflects broader trends in leveraging IC to create a competitive advantage. This study examines the strategic role of bottle design within premium and luxury beverage brands, aiming to uncover how companies use IC-such as design, brand equity, and consumer perception-to create value in areas not covered in traditional IP rights. The study examines how design elements shape consumer expectations and enhance brand prestige, illuminating the intersection of IP and brand identity. The study provides a novel perspective on the role of design strategy in the premium beverage industry, contributing to both academic and practical discourse on how brands build value outside traditional IP frameworks. It highlights how bottle design serves as an IC, shaping brand identity and consumer loyalty in ways that redefine value creation in competitive markets.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在高端饮料行业中，瓶身设计如何作为知识产权和智力资本的战略资产，帮助品牌在传统知识产权保护之外建立品牌身份和消费者忠诚度，并通过Maker's Mark、Veuve Clicquot和Glenfiddich等案例进行分析。
AI.research_question: 高端饮料品牌如何利用瓶身设计作为智力资本，在传统知识产权保护框架之外创造价值并建立竞争优势？
AI.motivation: 传统知识产权保护在高端饮料行业存在局限，品牌越来越多地通过独特的设计元素来差异化自身，但学术界对此战略角色的理解尚不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识产权（IP）理论、智力资本（IC）理论、品牌识别理论、设计战略理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，分析Maker's Mark、Veuve Clicquot和Glenfiddich等品牌的瓶身设计策略。
AI.findings: 瓶身设计在传统IP保护之外发挥着重要的战略作用，能有效塑造品牌身份、提升消费者忠诚度，并作为智力资本创造竞争优势；设计元素影响消费者期望并增强品牌声望。
AI.theory_contributions: 为智力资本与品牌战略的交叉领域提供了新视角，揭示了设计在传统知识产权框架外创造价值的机制，拓展了对IP与品牌身份关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高端饮料品牌提供了通过设计战略建立差异化竞争优势的实践指导，帮助管理者理解如何利用非传统IP资产（如瓶身设计）构建品牌价值。

title: The Role of Digitalization in Early Internationalization Research: A Systematic Literature Review and Future Research Directions
affiliations: , University of Vaasa and Autonomous University of Barcelona

detail.title: The Role of Digitalization in Early Internationalization Research: A Systematic Literature Review and Future Research Directions
detail.abstract: The purpose of this research is to systematically collate and synthesize the literature on how digitalizationrelated antecedents influence the processes and outcomes of early internationalizing firms. To do so, the present study systematically reviews a total of 120 related articles published in a broad range of academic journals from 1994 to 2024. The review enables us to outline the development of major research areas in terms of themes, theoretical approaches, and methodological issues at the intersection of the early internationalization and digitalization research. We contribute by offering a model that delineates a more subsumed, multilevel explanation of the interface of early internationalization and digitalization. Further, we propose a number of future research directions based on the integration of the reviewed articles and inputs purposefully collected from surveyed scholars in the field.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了1994-2024年间120篇关于数字化前因如何影响早期国际化企业过程与成果的文献，提出了一个多层次整合模型，并指出了未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: 数字化相关前因如何影响早期国际化企业的过程与成果？
AI.motivation: 早期国际化（如天生全球化企业）与数字化研究的交叉领域日益重要，但缺乏系统性的文献整合与理论梳理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多层次整合模型，涵盖数字化前因、早期国际化过程与成果之间的作用机制。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述法，涵盖1994-2024年间120篇相关学术论文。
AI.findings: 梳理了该交叉领域的研究主题、理论路径与方法论演变；提出了一个更包容的多层次解释模型；基于文献整合与学者调研提出了未来研究方向。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了早期国际化与数字化交叉领域的多层次整合模型，为后续理论发展提供了系统性框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为早期国际化企业如何利用数字化前因驱动国际化进程提供了理论指导，也为学者明确了未来研究重点。

title: Decarbonizing Long-haul Heavy-duty Electric Trucks with Co-optimized Corridor Charging Hubs
affiliations: Shanghai University of Electric Power, Shanghai University of Electric Power, East China Branch of State Grid Corporation of China, Shanghai University of Electric Power, University of Exeter, Durham University, Shanghai Normal University and Shanghai University of Electric Power

detail.title: Decarbonizing Long-haul Heavy-duty Electric Trucks with Co-optimized Corridor Charging Hubs
detail.abstract: The decarbonization of long-haul road freight is a major challenge because high-power charging, grid constraints and corridor-level heterogeneity jointly shape the cost and feasibility of heavy battery electric truck operations. Highway charging hubs can function as en-route charging stops that segment long trunk expressways into feasible charging corridors, but deciding where to build hubs and how large to build them remains difficult when land premiums, grid interconnection costs and time-of-use electricity tariffs vary sharply across space. Here we develop a corridor optimization framework that jointly plans charging-hub location and capacity, grid interconnection, and charging operations. Across 35 selected national trunk expressway freight corridors with one-way distances of 773-4,081 km, we find that optimized corridor planning brings operating costs close to diesel benchmarks, with a mean unit energy cost of about 2.62 CNY km^{-1}, and increases the share of economically competitive corridors from about 17% to 60%, corresponding to 6 to 21 routes. Environmental performance depends strongly on regional grid carbon intensity. Under baseline operations, only 15 of 35 corridors achieve net emissions benefits relative to diesel, whereas optimized planning reduces route-level emissions by about 0.3-50.4% relative to unoptimized HBET operations across all 35 corridors and expands the set of environmentally competitive routes from 15 to 32. Optimized planning also mitigates the payload penalty by reducing required onboard energy storage, with a 60-70% reduction on an ultra-long-haul corridor relative to unoptimized baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文针对长途公路货运脱碳难题，开发了一个走廊优化框架，联合规划充电站选址、容量、电网接入和运营策略。在35条中国国家干线高速货运走廊上，优化规划使运营成本接近柴油水平，单位能耗成本约2.62元/公里，经济竞争力走廊占比从17%提升至60%，并显著减少碳排放和有效载荷损失。
AI.research_question: 如何在高功率充电、电网约束和走廊异质性共同作用下，优化重型电池电动卡车长途干线货运的充电站选址、容量及运营策略，以实现成本与环境的双重效益？
AI.motivation: 长途公路货运脱碳面临巨大挑战，高压充电、电网约束和走廊层面的异质性共同影响着重型电池电动卡车的运营成本和可行性。当前在土地溢价、电网并网成本、分时电价空间差异显著的背景下，如何建设充电枢纽仍是一个难题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 走廊优化框架，联合规划充电站选址与容量、电网接入以及充电运营策略。
AI.method: 开发走廊优化框架，对35条中国国家干线高速货运走廊（单程距离773-4081公里）进行建模分析，比较优化与未优化方案的经济性和环境表现。
AI.findings: （1）优化规划使平均单位能耗成本约2.62元/公里，接近柴油基准水平；（2）经济竞争力走廊占比从约17%提升至60%（6条增至21条）；（3）基准运营下仅15条走廊实现净排放效益，优化后扩展至32条，排放降低0.3-50.4%；（4）优化规划使超长续航走廊的所需车载储能减少60-70%，减轻有效载荷损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个同时考虑充电站选址、容量、电网接入和运营策略的联合优化框架，填补了长途电动卡车充电基础设施规划在空间异质性下的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国国家干线高速货运走廊的电动化转型提供了可操作的充电基础设施规划方案，显著提升电动卡车在长途运输中的经济竞争力和环境效益。

title: A Hybrid Prior–Performance Monte Carlo Model for Forecasting FIFA World Cup Knockout Outcomes: Methodology and Retrospective Validation 1986–2026

detail.title: A Hybrid Prior–Performance Monte Carlo Model for Forecasting FIFA World Cup Knockout Outcomes: Methodology and Retrospective Validation 1986–2026

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study used only publicly available aggregate sports statistics and did not involve human participants, animals, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: We present a Monte Carlo simulation framework for forecasting the champion of the FIFA World Cup from the first knockout round onward. Each surviving team is assigned a scalar strength rating that linearly combines season-long priors (FIFA ranking and aggregate squad market value), in-tournament group-stage performance (expected goals created and conceded, goals, and individual "star" production), and a pre-tournament goalkeeper/defensive-pedigree term. Strength differences drive a Poisson goal-scoring engine with extra-time and penalty-shootout resolution, and the fixed knockout bracket is simulated approximately 300,000 times to estimate each team's championship probability. The weight configuration was selected against six tournaments (2002-2022) under a relaxed objective requiring the eventual champion to rank among the model's most-probable title-winners. A key methodological finding is that adding an explicit goalkeeper/defensive-pedigree feature was necessary to capture defensively-anchored champions (notably Italy 2006 and Spain 2010) that goal-based signals systematically underrate. The final model ranks the eventual champion among its two most-probable title-winners in all ten tournaments examined (1986-2022) — a statement about which two teams are likeliest to win the trophy, not a prediction of first and second place — including a strict out-of-sample test on four pre-tuning tournaments (1986-1998) in which the champion was among the top two every time. Leave-one-tournament-out cross-validation on the modern set places the champion among the top two in five of six held-out folds. Applied prospectively to the in-progress 2026 World Cup from the Round of 32, the model identifies Argentina (28.0%) and Spain (21.1%) as the leading championship candidates. We discuss limitations, principally the small number of tournaments available for validation and the risk of in-sample weight selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个蒙特卡洛模拟框架，从淘汰赛阶段开始预测FIFA世界杯冠军。该模型综合了赛季前先验（FIFA排名和球队总市场价值）、小组赛表现（预期进球、实际进球、球星表现）以及门将/防守 pedigree 特征，通过泊松进球引擎模拟比赛，并基于2002-2022六届赛事优化权重。最终模型在1986-2022全部十届赛事中都将冠军列为其最可能的两支冠军球队之一，包括严格的四届赛事（1986-1998）样本外测试。对2026年世界杯的预测显示，阿根廷（28.0%）和西班牙（21.1%）是夺冠最大热门。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够有效预测世界杯冠军（从淘汰赛阶段开始）的蒙特卡洛模拟框架？
AI.motivation: 世界杯赛事的稀缺性（每四年一届、样本量小）使得传统的统计预测方法面临挑战；现有的预测模型往往未能充分捕捉防守型球队的夺冠潜力（如意大利2006、西班牙2010），需要一种可解释且稳健的模拟方法来提升预测准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 蒙特卡洛模拟、泊松进球模型、加时赛与点球决胜机制、强度评级（线性组合赛季先验、小组赛表现、防守特征）
AI.method: （1）为每支球队分配一个标量强度评级，线性组合三个维度：（a）赛季前先验（FIFA排名、球队总市场价值）；（b）小组赛表现（预期进球xG、实际进球、球星个人产出）；（c）门将/防守 pedigree（赛前特征）。（2）强度差异驱动泊松进球引擎，支持加时赛和点球决胜。（3）对固定淘汰赛对阵进行约30万次模拟。（4）权重选择：基于2002-2022六届赛事，采用"冠军须在模型最高概率球队中排名靠前"的宽松目标进行优化。验证方法包括1986-1998的样本外测试和留一赛事交叉验证。
AI.findings: （1）加入门将/防守 pedigree 特征是必要的，使得模型能捕捉到以防守著称的冠军（意大利2006、西班牙2010）。（2）最终模型在全部十届赛事（1986-2022）中都将冠军列为其两支最可能的冠军球队之一。（3）在四届赛事的样本外测试（1986-1998）中，冠军始终在模型预测的前两名之内。（4）现代六届赛事的留一交叉验证中，冠军在五轮折叠中位列前两名。（5）对2026年世界杯的预测：阿根廷（28.0%）和西班牙（21.1%）是主要夺冠候选。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）证明了在世界杯预测模型中，防守特征（门将/防守 pedigree）对于捕捉防守型冠军球队具有不可替代的作用。（2）提供了一个在极小样本（仅十届赛事）条件下进行模型验证和权重选择的方法论框架。（3）展示了强度评级线性组合与泊松模拟相结合在单败淘汰制赛事预测中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为体育预测分析领域提供了一个可复现、可解释的世界杯冠军预测工具，支持实时更新（从小组赛进入淘汰赛阶段）。（2）提供了具体的2026年世界杯夺冠概率预测（阿根廷28.0%、西班牙21.1%等），具有直接的应用价值。（3）为体育博彩、球队备战和媒体分析提供了基于数据的决策参考。

title: Stablecoins under Stress in a National Economy: Transaction-Level Evidence from Austrian Crypto-Asset Service Providers
affiliations: IMT School for Advanced Studies Lucca, Oesterreichische Nationalbank (OeNB), , Oesterreichische Nationalbank (OeNB),  and

detail.title: Stablecoins under Stress in a National Economy: Transaction-Level Evidence from Austrian Crypto-Asset Service Providers
detail.abstract: Cryptoassets are increasingly entangled with the traditional financial system, and how this activity integrates into national economies and behaves under stress bears on financial stability and the design of public digital money. However, blockchain pseudonymity and the lack of geographic identifiers force existing work to rely on indirect proxies to infer and locate market participants. Here we use a regulatory registry that directly identifies the on-chain addresses of all crypto-asset service providers (CASPs) registered in Austria, reconstructing their on-chain transaction activity across Bitcoin, Ether, USDC, and USDT through May 2025, and separating retail-like from institutionally mediated flows. We find that Austrian CASPs intermediate roughly $30 billion with external counterparties and are integrated globally rather than domestically. In value, this activity is dominated by a few institutional counterparties; in number, by retail-like ones. Around three major shocks, the Terra-Luna collapse, the FTX bankruptcy, and the Silicon Valley Bank failure, the two groups respond through different mechanisms, and stablecoins do not act as a uniform safe haven. The clearest case is SVB, where retail-like deposits and institutional withdrawals are consistent with USDC's two-tiered redemption mechanism. These patterns are invisible in aggregate data. Registry-based, transaction-level measurement thus offers a reproducible, cross-jurisdictional basis for monitoring how cryptoasset markets transmit risk.

AI.tldr: 本文利用奥地利监管注册数据，直接识别该国所有加密资产服务商的链上地址，重建其交易活动，发现这些机构跨国整合程度高、面对三大冲击时零售与机构用户反应机制不同，稳定币并非统一避风港，并指出基于注册的交易级监测可为跨境风险监控提供可复现基础。
AI.research_question: 加密资产活动如何融入国民经济？在压力事件下，零售类与机构中介类交易行为有何差异？稳定币是否充当统一的安全避风港？
AI.motivation: 现有研究依赖间接代理变量推断市场参与者的地理位置，缺乏直接识别链上实体所属国家的可靠方法，导致对加密资产如何与传统金融体系互动、如何在危机中传导风险的理解受限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 加密资产市场参与者分层（零售 vs 机构中介）、稳定币双层赎回机制、危机时期资金流动理论。
AI.method: 利用奥地利监管注册数据直接识别该国所有CASPs的链上地址，重建其在Bitcoin、Ether、USDC和USDT上的交易活动直至2025年5月，区分零售类与机构中介类资金流，并围绕Terra-Luna崩盘、FTX破产、硅谷银行倒闭三次冲击事件进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 奥地利CASPs中介约300亿美元外部交易，呈全球整合而非国内整合特征；从价值看由少数机构主导，从数量看由零售用户主导；三次冲击中两组用户响应机制不同，稳定币未充当统一避风港；SVB事件中最明显，零售存款增加与机构赎回并存，符合USDC双层赎回机制；这些模式在聚合数据中不可见。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了基于监管注册直接识别链上实体所属国家的方法论创新；揭示了零售与机构在不同危机下的异质性行为模式；修正了稳定币是统一安全避风港的常见假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨境加密资产风险监测提供了可复现、基于交易级数据的监管工具基础；对央行数字货币设计和金融稳定政策具有参考价值。

title: SNAP Purchasing Power and Household Time Allocation
affiliations: American University

detail.title: SNAP Purchasing Power and Household Time Allocation
detail.abstract: SNAP benefits are set uniformly across the contiguous United States, but geographic variation in food prices creates substantial disparities in the program's real purchasing power. This paper exploits this variation using a triple-difference strategy that compares SNAP-eligible to near-eligible households across 35 local markets. A 10-percent increase in SNAP purchasing power was associated with a 7-percent reduction in daily purchasing time and a 4-percent increase in leisure time, with no meaningful results on market work, home production, childcare, or sleep. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that these associations differ by gender and parental status. These findings suggest that geographic disparities in benefit adequacy affect not only what households can purchase but how they allocate their time.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国各州食品价格差异，发现SNAP购买力每提高10%，受助家庭每日采购时间减少7%、休闲时间增加4%，对工作、家务、育儿和睡眠无显著影响，且效应因性别和育儿状况而异。
AI.research_question: SNAP（补充营养援助计划）的实际购买力因地区食品价格差异而变化，这种购买力差异如何影响受助家庭的时间配置？
AI.motivation: SNAP福利在全美统一设定，但食品价格存在显著地理差异，导致实际购买力不平等。这种不平等是否不仅影响家庭能买什么，还影响他们如何分配时间？这一问题尚未被充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间分配理论（家庭生产模型）：家庭在市场价格和时间成本之间权衡，福利购买力的变化会改变家庭的采购效率，进而影响时间在不同活动（市场工作、家务、休闲等）之间的重新配置。
AI.method: 三重差分法，比较SNAP合格家庭与接近合格家庭（收入略高于资格线）在35个地方市场中的时间使用差异，利用各市场食品价格差异识别因果效应。
AI.findings: SNAP购买力每提高10%，每日采购时间减少7%，休闲时间增加4%；对市场工作、家务生产、育儿和睡眠无显著影响；效应在性别和育儿状况上存在异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将福利购买力与时间配置联系起来，拓展了家庭生产模型的应用；揭示了地理价格差异通过时间配置渠道影响福利效应的新机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为SNAP福利的区域差异化调整提供实证依据；提示政策制定者关注福利的实际购买力不平等，而不仅是名义金额的统一性。

title: Life After Divorce: Effects of Joint Custody on Parents and Children
affiliations: , , , Yale University, Stockholm University, Stockholm University, Ifo Institute,  and

detail.title: Life After Divorce: Effects of Joint Custody on Parents and Children
detail.abstract: Divorce reshapes family life, yet little is known about one of its most consequential features: the allocation of child custody. We study the impact of joint versus sole custody on both parents and children using rich administrative data from Sweden linked to over 25 years of newly-collected court custody rulings. To address selection concerns, we exploit random assignment of custody disputes to judges who differ sharply in their propensity to grant joint custody. For fathers, joint custody substantially raises earnings and improves mental health, consistent with sustained paternal involvement enhancing labor market attachment and psychological well-being. In contrast, there are no measurable labor market or mental health effects for mothers. Turning to children, joint custody increases standardized test scores and school quality without affecting mental health outcomes. Joint custody increases fathers' chances of remarriage, keeps separated parents in closer geographic proximity, and has no effect on intimate partner violence allegations against either partner. These findings inform longstanding debates over the role of child custody in shaping post-divorce family life.

AI.tldr: 本文利用瑞典超过25年的法院监护权裁决数据，研究发现联合监护（相较于单独监护）显著提升了父亲的收入和心理健康，对母亲无明显影响，同时提高了孩子的考试成绩和学校质量，但不影响孩子的心理健康。
AI.research_question: 离婚后，联合监护权与单独监护权对父母和子女分别产生怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 离婚重塑家庭生活，但关于子女监护权分配这一关键后果的研究十分有限，现有证据难以回答联合监护与单独监护孰优孰劣。
AI.theoretical_framework: 父亲持续参与育儿可增强其劳动力市场依附和心理福祉的理论；监护权安排对儿童发展影响的理论。
AI.method: 利用瑞典行政数据与25年以上法院监护权裁决数据，通过法官对联合监护倾向的随机分配来解决选择性问题，进行准实验因果推断。
AI.findings: 联合监护提高父亲的收入和心理健康；对母亲无显著影响；提高孩子的标准化考试成绩和学校质量；不显著影响孩子的心理健康；增加父亲再婚概率；维持分居父母的地理邻近性；对亲密伴侣暴力指控无影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为联合监护与单独监护对家庭各成员的差异化影响提供了严谨的因果证据，填补了离婚后监护权分配后果的研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为离婚后监护权政策的制定和司法实践提供了实证依据，有助于法官和政策制定者更全面地评估联合监护权的利弊。

title: COVID-19 Pandemic and Prosociality: An Experiment with Healthcare Professionals
affiliations: London School of Economics, Catholic University of the Sacred Heart of Milan, Catholic University of the Sacred Heart, Rome and University of Cologne

detail.title: COVID-19 Pandemic and Prosociality: An Experiment with Healthcare Professionals
detail.abstract: We study the extent to which exposure to COVID-19 relates to healthcare professionals' prosociality. Drawing on empirical evidence from an incentivized experiment and a companion survey of healthcare professionals (HCPs) at a large Italian hospital (N = 194), we find that different forms of exposure to COVID-19 predict their altruistic motivation in heterogeneous ways. HCPs who worked in COVID-19 wards or had a close relative or friend severely affected by the virus are more than 5 percentage points more likely to prioritize patient welfare over personal gain, with the association for professional exposure being mostly driven by female HCPs, especially nurses. Conversely, personally contracting COVID-19 is associated with a 6 percentage point decline in prosociality. Our results highlight that different experiences of need shape prosocial behavior in hospital settings

AI.tldr: 本文研究新冠疫情暴露程度如何影响医护人员的亲社会行为。通过对意大利某大型医院194名医护人员的激励实验和配套调查，发现不同形式的疫情暴露对利他动机产生异质性影响：在新冠病房工作或有亲友严重感染的人员更倾向优先考虑患者福利（提高5%以上），而个人感染新冠则使亲社会性下降6%。专业暴露的影响主要由女性医护人员（尤其是护士）驱动。
AI.research_question: 新冠疫情暴露程度如何影响医护人员的亲社会性（利他动机）？不同形式的疫情暴露（专业暴露、个人感染、亲友感染）对亲社会行为的影响是否存在异质性？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情对医疗系统造成巨大压力，理解疫情经历如何影响医护人员的利他动机和患者福利优先的决策，对于优化医疗资源配置、保障医护团队稳定性以及提升医疗服务质量具有重要的理论和实践意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 亲社会行为理论、利他动机理论、疫情暴露与需求体验对行为影响的心理学框架。
AI.method: 采用激励实验（incentivized experiment）与配套调查问卷相结合的方法，样本为意大利某大型医院的194名医护人员。通过不同形式的疫情暴露变量（专业暴露、个人感染、亲友感染）与亲社会行为指标进行关联分析。
AI.findings: （1）在新冠病房工作或有亲友严重感染的人员，其亲社会性提高5个百分点以上（更倾向优先考虑患者福利而非个人利益）；（2）专业暴露的影响主要由女性医护人员（尤其是护士）驱动；（3）个人感染新冠则与亲社会性下降6个百分点相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同形式的疫情暴露对亲社会行为的异质性影响机制，拓展了疫情背景下亲社会行为理论，为理解"亲历痛苦"与"见证他人痛苦"对利他动机的差异化效应提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗机构管理者提供了疫情后医护团队心理支持和激励策略的实证依据；提示需关注个人感染新冠的医护人员的心理恢复和亲社会动机维护；为性别差异化干预（尤其关注女性护士群体）提供了参考。
