title: Freedom of Contract and Sustainability Considerations in the European Financial Sector
affiliations: Radboud University Nijmegen - Institute for Financial Law (IFR)

detail.title: Freedom of Contract and Sustainability Considerations in the European Financial Sector

keywords: Termination and suspension of the contract

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Banking Institute Working Paper Series No. 211
publicationDetails.journalName: European Banking Institute (EBI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In the European financial sector, sustainability considerations increasingly restrict the contractual freedom of banks and other financial institutions. Using Dutch law as a case study for the impact of EU law on national contract law, this chapter examines these restrictions across three stages—the pre-contractual stage, the content of contracts, and termination or suspension of the contract—and assesses them against three criteria: legitimacy, proportionality, and consistency. It analyses statutory duties under the CSDDD alongside civil-law duties of care, arguing that duties of refusal towards upstream business partners can be regarded as proportionate, whereas a general downstream duty of refusal risks being disproportionate absent global acceptance. The chapter shows that EU sustainability regulation is being transformed: the second von der Leyen Commission's simplification agenda and the CSDDD2 amendments—notably abolishing the duty to terminate business relationships—signal a shift away from ever-stricter constraints towards reconciling sustainability objectives with European competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文以荷兰法为案例，分析了欧盟可持续法规在合同前、合同内容、合同终止三个阶段对银行等金融机构契约自由的限制，并从合法性、比例性和一致性三个标准进行评估。文章指出，CSDDD下的法定义务与民法注意义务不同，对上游商业伙伴的拒绝义务是相称的，但对下游的普遍拒绝义务在缺乏全球共识下可能不相称。同时，第二届冯德莱恩委员会的简化议程和CSDDD2修正案（废除终止商业关系的义务）标志着从严格限制向兼顾可持续目标与欧洲竞争力的转变。
AI.research_question: 欧盟可持续法规如何通过荷兰合同法实践，在合同前、合同内容和合同终止三个阶段限制金融机构的契约自由？这些限制在法律上是否具有合法性、比例性和一致性？
AI.motivation: 欧洲金融领域中可持续性考量正日益限制银行等金融机构的契约自由，但现有研究缺乏对这类限制的系统性法律评估。作者希望通过荷兰法的案例研究，结合CSDDD等最新法规变化，为理解欧盟可持续法规对合同法的实际影响提供分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合法性、比例性和一致性三个评估标准；CSDDD下的法定义务与民法注意义务的区分；上游与下游商业关系的二元分析框架。
AI.method: 法律规范分析：以荷兰法为案例，结合欧盟CSDDD等法规，对合同三阶段进行规范性评估。
AI.findings: (1) 对上游商业伙伴的拒绝义务可视为比例相称，但对下游的普遍拒绝义务在缺乏全球共识下可能不相称；(2) CSDDD2修正案废除终止商业关系的义务，表明欧盟正从严格限制转向兼顾可持续与竞争力；(3) 可持续法规对契约自由的限制在不同阶段和不同方向（上游/下游）存在不一致性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了评估可持续法规对契约自由限制的合法性-比例性-一致性三维框架；区分了上游和下游拒绝义务的不同法律正当性基础；揭示了欧盟可持续法规从"趋严"到"平衡"的范式转变。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融从业者和法律实务工作者提供了CSDDD及CSDDD2修正案下合规义务的清晰法律分析；帮助银行等金融机构理解在不同合同阶段的具体法律风险与义务边界。

title: Auditing in Crisis: Can External Auditing Capture Organisational Resilience or Does It Entrench Compliance-Driven Vulnerability?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Auditing in Crisis: Can External Auditing Capture Organisational Resilience or Does It Entrench Compliance-Driven Vulnerability?
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether external audit practice can evaluate and foster organisational resilience. It argues that the compliance orientation, backward-looking temporal focus, and epistemological foundations of the prevailing paradigm create significant tensions with resilience as a dynamic, forward-looking, and transformative capacity. The study combines interpretive documentary analysis of International Standards on Auditing, INTOSAI auditing standards, and audit case evidence from COVID-19-era organisational collapses, the Ghanaian banking clean-up, and climate-related audit deficiencies, with thirty-six semi-structured interviews with senior audit partners, public sector auditors, audit committee chairs, and academic specialists in Ghana and South Africa. Three dimensions of audit-resilience tension are identified. Temporal tension describes how backward-looking financial statement verification appears insufficient for capturing prospective resilience dimensions. Epistemological tension describes how the commitment to verifiable quantifiable evidence appears to exclude relational, adaptive, and cultural resilience dimensions. Political tension describes how bilateral principal-agent accountability appears misaligned with the networked, multi-stakeholder accountability architectures that resilient systems require. Competing perspectives are presented and evaluated. The paper is primarily theoretical and interpretive, grounded in two African jurisdictions. The paper contributes a three-dimensional framework for understanding tensions between conventional audit epistemology and resilience, and proposes a resilience-oriented audit model with specific procedures, reporting implications, and assurance approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了外部审计实践能否评估和培养组织韧性，识别了审计与韧性之间的时间、认识论和政治三个维度的张力，并提出了一个韧性导向的审计模型。
AI.research_question: 外部审计实践能否评估和培养组织韧性？审计与韧性之间存在哪些张力？
AI.motivation: 传统的合规导向、回溯性时间聚焦和经验主义认识论与韧性作为一种动态、前瞻性和变革性能力之间存在显著张力，需要系统性地识别和解决这些张力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 韧性理论、审计认识论、组织韧性、多利益相关方问责理论
AI.method: 解释性文献分析（ISA、INTOSAI审计标准、COVID-19时代组织崩溃案例、加纳银行业清理、气候相关审计缺陷）结合36个半结构化访谈（高级审计合伙人、公共部门审计师、审计委员会主席、学术专家），研究区域为加纳和南非。
AI.findings: 识别出三个审计-韧性张力维度：时间张力（回溯性财务验证不足以捕捉前瞻性韧性）、认识论张力（可验证量化证据排除了关系性、适应性和文化韧性维度）、政治张力（双边委托代理问责与韧性所需的网络化多利益相关方问责架构不匹配）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个三维框架（时间、认识论、政治）来理解传统审计认识论与韧性之间的张力；提出了韧性导向的审计模型，包括具体程序、报告含义和鉴证方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为审计实务提供了韧性导向的审计模型，帮助审计师在实践中评估和促进组织韧性；为监管机构改进审计标准提供了理论依据。

title: Canada's Productivity Paradox and Minority Foreign Ownership: Boardroom Reconfiguration and the Branch Plant Transformation -Evidence from Keel Infrastructure

detail.title: Canada's Productivity Paradox and Minority Foreign Ownership: Boardroom Reconfiguration and the Branch Plant Transformation -Evidence from Keel Infrastructure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The research utilizes publicly available data sources and does not involve human participants or identifiable personal data. As such, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Canada’s digital economy faces a persistent structural tension: while strategic foreign investment can accelerate firm-level commercial scaling, it may also induce governance reconfigurations that weaken domestic innovation capacity. This study examines the micro-foundations of this “productivity paradox” through the 2024–2026 boardroom transition of Toronto-headquartered Bitfarms Ltd., initiated by U.S.-based competitor Riot Platforms, culminating in the firm’s redomiciliation to the United States as Keel Infrastructure Corp.

Adopting an abductive qualitative design grounded in the Gioia methodology, the study traces how foreign strategic investors can leverage sub-threshold equity accumulation to gain effective influence without triggering formal review under the Investment Canada Act. Anchored in New Internalization Theory, and drawing on Transaction Cost Economics and the Knowledge-Based View, the analysis shows that full acquisition is not always necessary to internalize a firm’s strategic assets. Instead, minority ownership positions can enable governance shifts that simultaneously support commercial expansion, such as the development of a 2.2 gigawatt high-performance computing pipeline, while contributing to what this study conceptualizes as a “branch plant transformation.”

The findings suggest that such transformations involve the reallocation of strategic decision-making and innovation capacity beyond domestic boundaries, with implications for long-term productivity and policy design. The study concludes by outlining potential avenues for incorporating behavioral and governance-based triggers into foreign investment review frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过Bitfarms Ltd.的案例，揭示了外国战略投资者如何通过低于审查门槛的少数股权积累实现治理重构，导致企业“分支工厂式转型”——将战略决策与创新能力转移至境外，从而解释了加拿大数字经济中的“生产力悖论”。
AI.research_question: 外国战略投资者如何通过低于正式审查门槛的少数股权投资，引发目标企业的治理重构，从而在促进商业规模化的同时削弱东道国的本土创新能力？
AI.motivation: 加拿大数字经济面临结构性张力：战略性外国投资可加速企业规模化，但可能引发治理重构从而削弱本土创新能力。现有外国投资审查框架（如《加拿大投资法》）主要关注正式收购，忽略了少数股权积累带来的隐性控制路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新内部化理论（New Internalization Theory）、交易成本经济学（Transaction Cost Economics）、知识基础观（Knowledge-Based View）
AI.method: 归纳式定性研究，采用Gioia方法论进行严谨的扎根理论分析。
AI.findings: 1）完全收购并非内化企业战略资产的必要条件，少数股权即可实现治理重构；2）治理重构可在支持商业扩张（如建设2.2GW高性能计算管道）的同时，导致“分支工厂式转型”——战略决策与创新能力向境外转移；3）现有外资审查框架存在行为与治理层面的监管盲区。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了新内部化理论，提出少数股权同样可以实现战略资产的内化；概念化了“分支工厂式转型”（branch plant transformation）作为外国投资者隐性控制的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为《加拿大投资法》等外资审查框架提出改进建议：应将行为与治理层面的触发机制纳入审查标准，以识别低于正式门槛的隐性控制风险。

title: Adverse Social Behaviour at Work and Mental Health in the European Health and Care Workforce: Elevated Exposure Without Differential Vulnerability. A Cross-Sectional Study of 35 Countries in the European Working Conditions Survey 2024
affiliations: , , European University of Tirana and University of Shkodra "Luigj Gurakuqi"

detail.title: Adverse Social Behaviour at Work and Mental Health in the European Health and Care Workforce: Elevated Exposure Without Differential Vulnerability. A Cross-Sectional Study of 35 Countries in the European Working Conditions Survey 2024
detail.abstract:
Purpose. Health and care workers are disproportionately exposed to violence and harassment at work. It remains unclear whether they experience greater mental-health consequences from adverse social behaviour (ASB) than other workers. We examined whether the association between ASB and mental health differs between health and care workers and the rest of the European workforce.

Methods. Cross-sectional analysis of the European Working Conditions Survey 2024 (35 countries; n = 36,644). Health and care workers (n = 2,172) were identified from ISCO-08 major groups 22 and 32, and personal care workers (group 53) in human-health or residential-care industries. Exposure was eight forms of ASB (composite, count, and individual forms). Outcomes were WHO-5 wellbeing, emotional exhaustion, sleeping difficulties and anxiety. Weighted regression with country fixed effects estimated exposure-by-sector interactions; a severe-exhaustion threshold model tested for scale artefacts.

Results. ASB was more common among health and care workers than other workers (26.0% vs 17.0%). ASB was strongly associated with poorer mental health on every outcome (WHO-5: −10.85 points, 95% CI −11.53 to −10.16). The sector-by-exposure interaction was null for wellbeing, sleeping difficulties and anxiety; a nominally significant interaction for emotional exhaustion did not replicate on a severe-threshold specification (p = 0.15), indicating scale compression. Within the sector the wellbeing penalty was carried by psychological forms—bullying, humiliation and verbal abuse.

Conclusion. The elevated mental-health burden of the European health and care workforce reflects greater exposure to adverse social behaviour, not greater vulnerability to it. Prevention should prioritise reducing exposure rather than building individual resilience.

AI.tldr: 欧洲健康与照护工作者在工作场所遭受不良社会行为（ASB）的比例（26.0%）显著高于其他行业（17.0%），且ASB与更差的心理健康显著相关。但分析表明，健康与照护工作者的心理健康负担更重主要源于更高的暴露水平，而非对该类行为的脆弱性更强。因此，政策应优先减少ASB暴露，而非仅增强个人韧性。
AI.research_question: 相比于其他行业工作者，健康与照护工作者遭受不良社会行为（ASB）后是否会产生更严重的心理健康后果？
AI.motivation: 健康与照护工作者面临不成比例的职场暴力和骚扰，但其心理健康是否因ASB而受到更严重影响尚不清楚。明确这一机制有助于制定更有针对性的干预策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于暴露-脆弱性框架，区分心理健康负担的来源是更高的暴露水平（exposure）还是更强的脆弱性（vulnerability）。
AI.method: 采用2024年欧洲工作条件调查（35国，n=36,644）的横截面数据。通过ISCO-08（22、32组及53组）识别健康与照护工作者（n=2,172）。ASB包含8种形式（复合指标、计数指标及单独指标），心理健康结局为WHO-5幸福感、情绪耗竭、睡眠困难和焦虑。使用加权回归（含国家固定效应）检验行业与ASB的交互作用，并采用严重耗竭阈值模型检查尺度效应。
AI.findings: （1）ASB在健康与照护工作者中更普遍（26.0% vs 17.0%）；（2）ASB与所有心理健康指标显著负相关（如WHO-5下降10.85分）；（3）行业×ASB交互作用对幸福感、睡眠困难和焦虑不显著；情绪耗竭的交互作用在严重阈值模型中不稳健（p=0.15），表明存在尺度压缩效应；（4）在健康与照护行业内部，心理形式的ASB（欺凌、羞辱、言语辱骂）对幸福感损害最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过区分"暴露"与"脆弱性"两个机制，澄清了健康与照护工作者心理健康负担的来源，为职业健康心理学中的"风险暴露-后果"模型提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出预防策略应从"增强个体韧性"转向"减少工作场所ASB暴露"，为欧盟及各国职业健康政策调整提供依据。

title: A Mid-Range Theory of Relational Distance and Curvilinear Value Realization in Organizational Combinations

detail.title: A Mid-Range Theory of Relational Distance and Curvilinear Value Realization in Organizational Combinations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a purely theoretical and conceptual manuscript that does not involve any human participants, patients, or experimental animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no financial support for the research, authorship, or publication of this article

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a mid-range theory of relational distance to model the curvilinear path of value realization in organizational combinations. Aligning with the principles of engaged scholarship, this framework translates a critical real-world problem setting (the notoriously high failure rate of corporate combinations) into a rigorously defined theoretical area of concern. It proposes that combinations routinely fail because both extreme similarity and extreme difference tend to destroy value: similarity creates capability redundancy and cognitive lock-in, while extreme difference exhausts a firm's absorptive capacity, creating severe operational and cultural friction. Consequently, value is maximized at an optimal threshold (the "Zone of Optimal Tension" or "Goldilocks Zone") where resource novelty is fully leveraged before communication fatigue and integration friction trigger an exponential decline. Because managers often cannot eliminate this distance, they must match their chosen corporate vehicle (e.g., mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, strategic alliances, etc.) to the existing relational distance, using the governance structure as an elastic filter to absorb friction. By bridging macroeconomic corporate strategy with the micro-foundations of organizational design, this paper explicitly delineates the constructs (What), their relationships (How), and the underlying psychological and economic mechanisms (Why), establishing a robust, value-added theoretical contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"关系距离"的中层理论，解释企业组合中价值实现的曲线路径。极端相似导致能力冗余和认知锁定，极端差异则耗尽吸收能力，价值在"最佳张力区"（金发姑娘区）实现最大化。管理者无法消除距离，而应选择合适的治理结构作为弹性过滤器来吸收摩擦。
AI.research_question: 企业组合（如并购、合资、战略联盟等）中，关系距离如何影响价值实现？为什么企业组合的失败率如此之高？
AI.motivation: 企业组合（并购、合资、联盟等）失败率极高，这是一个重大的现实问题。现有理论无法充分解释为什么极端相似和极端差异都会导致价值毁灭。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系距离理论（Relational Distance Theory）；最佳张力区/金发姑娘区（Zone of Optimal Tension/Goldilocks Zone）；吸收能力理论；认知锁定理论；治理结构弹性过滤机制。
AI.method: 中层理论建构（Mid-range Theory Building），采用"涉入式学术"（Engaged Scholarship）原则，将现实问题转化为严格的理论命题。
AI.findings: 1）企业组合中价值实现呈曲线（倒U型）路径；2）极端相似（关系距离过小）导致能力冗余和认知锁定；3）极端差异（关系距离过大）耗尽吸收能力，产生运营和文化摩擦；4）存在一个最优阈值即"最佳张力区"，价值在此最大化；5）管理者应匹配治理结构（如并购、合资、联盟）到现有关系距离，而非试图消除距离。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了"关系距离"这一新构念，整合了宏观企业战略与微观组织设计；2）构建了价值实现的倒U型曲线理论，解释了企业组合的高失败率；3）明确了构念（What）、关系（How）与机制（Why）三个理论维度，建立了一个严谨、增值的理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了可操作的战略框架：不要强行消除关系距离，而应根据现有距离选择恰当的治理结构（并购、合资或联盟），将其作为弹性过滤器来吸收摩擦，从而最大化组合价值。

title: What Keynes Would Say About Pakistan's IMF Programme

detail.title: What Keynes Would Say About Pakistan's IMF Programme
detail.abstract: John Maynard Keynes remains, nearly ninety years after the publication of The General Theory of Employment, Interest and Money (1936), the most consequential economist of the modern era-the architect of macroeconomics, the intellectual force behind the Bretton Woods institutions, and the theorist whose central insight, that aggregate demand rather than supply determines the level of output and employment, was rediscovered by policymakers worldwide during the 2008 financial crisis and again during the COVID-19 pandemic. I revisit here Keynes' intellectual legacy-his rejection of Say's Law, his theory of effective demand, his advocacy of counter-cyclical fiscal policy, and his role in designing the postwar international financial architecture-and apply it directly to a live policy debate: Pakistan's fiscal trajectory across its FY2025-26 and FY2026-27 federal budgets under the 2024 IMF Extended Fund Facility. Pakistan's Public Sector Development Programme was cut by PKR 173 billion in FY2025-26 and then held flat in nominal terms in FY2026-27 even as tax revenue targets rose 18 percent-while debt servicing fell by roughly PKR 383 billion, freeing fiscal space that was substantially redirected toward an 18 percent increase in defence spending rather than development. I argue that Pakistan's predicament has evolved from a simple austerity story into a more precise Keynesian expenditure-composition problem: newly available fiscal space is being allocated in ways whose long-run productivity consequences differ sharply, and that choice deserves more explicit scrutiny than Pakistan's domestic fiscal debate currently gives it. I am not arguing that Keynes offers Pakistan an easy alternative-external financing constraints and genuine security imperatives are real and cannot be wished away by domestic policy choice alonebut I do think the Keynesian question of how public expenditure composition affects long-run productive capacity is being asked too rarely in Pakistan's current fiscal debate, and deserves more serious attention than it currently receives.

AI.tldr: 本文运用凯恩斯理论分析巴基斯坦2025-27财年预算的支出结构问题：尽管财政空间因债务偿还减少而释放，但巴基斯坦将这笔资金主要用于增加国防支出而非发展支出，忽视了凯恩斯关于公共支出结构影响长期生产能力的核心关切。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦的财政紧缩问题如何演变为一个凯恩斯主义视角下的支出构成问题？即新释放的财政空间在不同用途之间的分配如何影响长期生产能力？
AI.motivation: 凯恩斯理论在2008年金融危机和新冠疫情期间被重新发现，但鲜有人将其应用于巴基斯坦当前的财政辩论。巴基斯坦在IMF计划下的预算削减和支出结构调整，恰恰提出了凯恩斯式的核心问题：公共支出结构如何影响长期生产能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 凯恩斯理论：否定萨伊定律、有效需求理论、反周期财政政策主张、战后国际金融架构设计。核心分析工具是"支出构成"视角，关注公共支出的生产力效应差异。
AI.method: 理论应用与政策分析：将凯恩斯理论框架直接应用于巴基斯坦FY2025-26和FY2026-27联邦预算的具体数据，进行财政轨迹追踪和支出结构比较分析。
AI.findings: 巴基斯坦的公共部门发展计划被削减1730亿卢比，随后名义持平；税收目标上升18%；债务偿还减少约3830亿卢比；释放的财政空间主要用于增加18%的国防支出，而非发展性支出。这构成了一个"凯恩斯式支出构成问题"。
AI.theory_contributions: 将凯恩斯理论从传统的总需求管理层面深化到公共支出结构对长期生产能力影响的层面；展示了凯恩斯分析框架在当代发展中国家财政政策辩论中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦的财政政策辩论引入了一个被忽视的关键维度：财政空间释放后的分配选择对长期生产能力的差异影响；提示政策制定者应在安全需求与发展支出之间进行更审慎的权衡。

title: One Law at Every Scale: A Scale-Invariant Theory of Institutional Stability

detail.title: One Law at Every Scale: A Scale-Invariant Theory of Institutional Stability
detail.abstract: This paper states the single dynamical object behind a four-part programme on institutional stability and shows that the firm-scale theory, its macroeconomic extension, the accompanying essays, the company, and the proposed legislation are not four themes that rhyme but one object observed at four magnifications. The object is a boundary-equilibrium bifurcation in an inclusion gain: a system tracks its own true state only while the people who hold that truth are inside the loop with power to correct it, and above a critical gain beta* it sits in a truthful basin while below it a self-reinforcing corrupted basin captures it. The paper sets out the substrate-free equations, instantiates them at the scales of a mind, a community, a firm, and an economy, and renders an honest renormalization verdict. The firm and the economy are the strongest rung, though not a Wilsonian renormalization: the macro selection threshold sigma_X* = mu_C - b_1 is the same boundary-equilibrium type one scale up, an inclusion gain crossing unity against a loss rate, and the macro order parameter is literally composed of firm-scale outcomes, conditional on capital-gated autocatalytic formation (b_1 > 0). The mind and the community are partial, near-genuine: the firm equations transfer under a substrate-faithful variable swap, and the boundary-equilibrium corner is derived at both, from a robust generative likelihood (in cognition, outlier-robust perception; in the public, identity-protective reasoning, which is the same bounded-influence updating). The numerical checks against the firm's own fixed points are a transcription guard; the upgrade past mere resemblance rests on that corner derivation, which could have failed. The propagation operator that spreads the cure across a population is the same percolation threshold pqsz > 1 at every scale, and its link-attack piece is literally the same object at the community scale, where engineered distrust is bond dilution. The result is stated as a theorem with five named footnotes, so that "theorem" is exact and not triumphal: the critical gain is not the bare number one but a balance condition, the inclusion gain crossing the corruption channel's marginal gain, normalized to one at the firm and substrate-dependent elsewhere, and case-measured rather than calibrated; the corner at mind and community is derived conditional on a robust likelihood; minor analytic leftovers remain; and the macro bifurcation's existence is itself conditional on b_1 > 0. The unifying claim is that the rigid mind is the atom of the corruption channel, so the math, the essays, the company, and the legislation are one object; the keeper is that inclusion is the condition for reality-tracking stability, not charity, while coercion can hold the corrupted basin durably but only as a persistent decoupling from the truth; and the one hopeful asymmetry is that the gain is trainable at the mind scale, which makes "do not go numb" the boundary condition of the whole structure. A reader who has met none of the other parts can follow the result from this paper alone; the four parts it synthesizes are cited where each is needed.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了一个跨尺度的统一动力学对象——包含增益中的边界平衡分岔。在认知、社区、企业和经济四个尺度上，同一结构重复出现：系统在掌握真相者处于反馈环路中时才能追踪真实状态；高于临界增益β*时系统处于诚实盆地，低于时则陷入自我强化的腐败盆地。论文给出了无基底方程、各尺度实例化及重整化判定，核心主张是"刚性心智是腐败通道的原子"，"包容"是现实追踪稳定性的条件而非慈善，而增益在心智尺度上是可训练的。
AI.research_question: 一个统一的动力学对象能否解释从个体认知到宏观经济的制度稳定性？不同尺度（心智、社区、企业、经济）上的腐败与诚实动态是否存在相同的数学结构？
AI.motivation: 制度稳定性研究中存在碎片化问题：微观与宏观理论、企业与经济、认知与公共领域被视为不同主题。本文试图证明它们其实是同一对象在不同放大倍数下的观测结果，从而为理解腐败传播与系统真实性追踪提供统一框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边界平衡分岔理论（boundary-equilibrium bifurcation）；包含增益（inclusion gain）；重整化群思想（非Wilson型）；渗流阈值（percolation threshold）；稳健似然理论（robust generative likelihood）；身份保护推理（identity-protective reasoning）；有界影响更新（bounded-influence updating）；自催化形成（autocatalytic formation）。
AI.method: 理论推导：建立无基底方程并在四个尺度上实例化；通过变量置换实现企业方程向心智和社区尺度的忠实传递；推导边界平衡角点解；数值检验（转录保护）；渗流算子同构性验证；以定理形式陈述结果，附五个命名脚注说明条件与局限。
AI.findings: （1）企业尺度的宏观选择阈值σ_X* = μ_C - b_1与微观边界平衡类型相同，只是尺度放大了一级；（2）心智和社区是"近似真正的"（near-genuine）重整化：企业方程可通过基底忠实的变量置换传递，边界平衡角点可从稳健生成似然推导；（3）传播治愈的渗流算子pqsz > 1在各尺度相同，社区尺度上的链接攻击等同于键稀释；（4）宏观分岔的存在性依赖于b_1 > 0（资本门控的自催化形成）；（5）刚性心智是腐败通道的原子单元。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了跨尺度统一的腐败-诚实动力学理论，将微观认知机制与宏观制度稳定性纳入同一数学框架；区分了"包容"与"慈善"：前者是系统追踪真实状态的必要条件，后者不是；揭示了"强制"可以维持腐败盆地但代价是与真相脱耦；发现"增益可训练性"在心智尺度上是整个结构的不对称希望来源。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制度设计提供可操作的边界条件：包容性（将真相持有者纳入反馈环路）是系统真实追踪稳定性的关键；提出了可测量而非校准的临界增益方法（case-measured）；"不要麻木"（do not go numb）成为整个结构的边界条件——心智尺度的增益训练是防止系统滑入腐败盆地的起点。

title: Is Human Attention Still Necessary? A Synthesis for Navigating the AI-Attention Transition

detail.title: Is Human Attention Still Necessary? A Synthesis for Navigating the AI-Attention Transition
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is automating cognitive work fast enough to force a question older economic transitions never had to ask so directly: if machines can replicate human thinking, are people becoming less relevant? This paper synthesizes results from decades of economics and control theory to map that transition. It composes several wellestablished results into a single, navigable account of where human value goes as AI grows abundant, and what institutions must do to keep that value from being lost. We stand on three foundations. From the theory of production (Krusell et al., 2000), AI-augmented capital and skilled human judgment are complements, not substitutes: more of one raises the value of the other. From growth theory (Baumol, 1967; Aghion et al., 2019), an essential input that cannot be automated becomes the bottleneck that governs how much an economy can produce: output is limited by the weakest link, not the strongest. Composing these, we identify that weakest link in the AI era as productive human attention: the judgment, oversight, creativity, care, leadership, and synthesis that remain when routine cognitive work is automated. We keep the claim falsifiable: it holds only if attention and AI-capital are gross complements (an elasticity of substitution below one, σ 2 < 1). Two consequences follow. First, institutions that treat human attention as a free input, the default in conventional corporate governance, are not merely unfair. As optimal-control solutions in the new regime they are provably inadmissible, a one-line contradiction in the planner's costate; and where attention is a depreciable stock, sustained mis-encoding drives output toward zero, asymptotically. Second, who owns AIproductive systems, decided at company formation, not corrected by redistribution afterward, will set which future the economy converges to. We give a governance design (an investor-share cap, contribution-gated equity, and an anti-stagnation rule) built to converge to durable employee co-ownership. Beneath this sits the claim we care about most, and we are precise about its status. We argue that the divide between a society which collapses under mis-encoded governance and one which stays structurally stable is a genuine bifurcation: a threshold across which the whole coupled system of ownership, attention, and production converges to qualitatively different fates. The discrete ownership dynamics already converge to opposite fixed points on either side of a 50%-control line; we locate the bifurcation in the nonlinear coupling of ownership and attention, and commit the companion paper to proving it. This paper establishes the foundation for that work.

AI.tldr: 本文整合经济学与控制理论，论证当AI替代常规认知工作后，人类生产性注意力成为经济瓶颈。若注意力与AI资本呈低替代弹性（σ<1），将注意力视为免费投入的治理结构在最优控制中不可行。论文提出基于员工共同所有权的治理设计，并论证治理错误编码可能导致系统分岔——社会走向崩溃或保持结构稳定取决于所有权初始配置。
AI.research_question: 当AI大规模自动化认知劳动时，人类价值将如何演变？哪些制度安排能够防止人类价值在经济系统中被侵蚀？
AI.motivation: 历史上经济转型从未如此直接地面对一个问题：如果机器能复制人类思维，人是否变得不再重要？作者试图提供一个可导航的理论框架来理解这一根本性转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三大支柱：1）生产理论（Krusell et al., 2000）：AI增强资本与人类技能判断是互补品；2）增长理论（Baumol, 1967; Aghion et al., 2019）：不可自动化的必要投入成为经济瓶颈；3）最优控制理论与非线性动力学：治理结构对注意力存量的编码影响系统收敛方向。
AI.method: 理论综合与演绎：整合已建立的数理经济学与控制理论结果，通过逻辑演绎构建从生产函数到治理设计到系统分岔的理论链条。
AI.findings: 1）人类生产性注意力是AI时代的"最薄弱环节"（前提：注意力与AI资本替代弹性σ<1）；2）将注意力视为免费投入的传统治理在最优控制中不可行（违反协态条件，且注意力作为可折旧存量时导致产出渐近趋于零）；3）所有权初始配置（而非事后再分配）决定经济收敛到何种均衡，存在50%控制线分岔；4）提出治理设计方案（投资者份额上限、贡献门槛股权、反停滞规则）可收敛到持久员工共同所有权。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次将生产理论的互补性、增长理论的瓶颈效应与最优控制的协态条件系统整合，建立AI时代人类价值的可证伪理论框架；2）提出治理系统存在分岔阈值的论证框架（为后续论文奠基）；3）将所有权结构与注意力存量的非线性耦合建模为动力系统。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）对政策制定者警示：公司成立时的所有权设计比事后再分配更关键；2）提供具体的治理制度设计（份额上限、贡献门槛、反停滞规则）作为路径参考；3）论证"免费注意力"假设下现有公司治理的制度缺陷。

title: Environmental Design and Digital Well-being Among Youth: An Interdisciplinary Review Integrating Neuroscience, Environmental Psychology, and Traditional Spatial Practices Author

detail.title: Environmental Design and Digital Well-being Among Youth: An Interdisciplinary Review Integrating Neuroscience, Environmental Psychology, and Traditional Spatial Practices Author
detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of digital technologies has profoundly transformed the educational, social, and psychological experiences of children, adolescents, and young adults. While digital devices provide unprecedented opportunities for learning, communication, creativity, and global connectivity, excessive and poorly regulated digital engagement has emerged as an important public health concern. Research increasingly associates problematic digital technology use with impairments in attention, executive functioning, emotional regulation, sleep quality, academic performance, and psychological well-being. At the same time, growing evidence from neuroscience, environmental psychology, and building science suggests that the physical characteristics of learning and living environments-including natural lighting, indoor air quality, thermal comfort, acoustics, exposure to nature, and spatial organisation-may influence cognitive performance, emotional resilience, and technology-use behaviours. This interdisciplinary review synthesises current evidence regarding the relationships among environmental design, brain function, cognitive performance, and digital well-being in young people. Drawing upon findings from neuroscience, environmental psychology, education, architecture, public health, and behavioural science, the review examines how environmental conditions may support healthier patterns of technology use while enhancing learning, attention, emotional regulation, and overall well-being. The review also discusses traditional spatial practices, including Vastu Shastra, from cultural and architectural perspectives, highlighting areas where empirical evidence is limited and further scientific investigation is warranted. Based on the available evidence, the paper proposes the Environmental Digital Well-being Model (EDWM), an integrative conceptual framework describing potential pathways linking built environments, brain function, digital behaviour, and health outcomes. The review concludes with evidence-informed recommendations for educational institutions, architects, policymakers, healthcare professionals, families, and researchers aimed at creating environments that promote healthier digital habits and improved cognitive and psychological well-being among youth.

AI.tldr: 本文通过跨学科综述，整合环境设计、大脑功能、认知表现与数字健康之间的关系，提出环境数字健康模型（EDWM），为青少年创造促进健康数字习惯的环境提供建议。
AI.research_question: 环境设计如何影响青少年的认知表现、数字行为模式及整体数字健康？
AI.motivation: 数字技术过度使用已成为重要的公共卫生问题，而同时自然环境与建筑环境因素可能影响认知和情绪调节能力，但二者之间的关系缺乏系统性的跨学科整合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境数字健康模型（EDWM），整合神经科学、环境心理学、建筑科学等领域的理论。
AI.method: 跨学科文献综述，整合神经科学、环境心理学、教育学、建筑学、公共健康和行为科学的研究发现。
AI.findings: 物理环境特征（自然光、空气质量、热舒适度、声学、接触自然、空间组织）可能影响认知表现、情绪韧性和技术使用行为；环境条件可以支持更健康的数字技术使用模式，同时增强学习、注意力、情绪调节和整体健康。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了环境数字健康模型（EDWM），系统描述了建筑环境、大脑功能、数字行为与健康结果之间的潜在路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构、建筑师、政策制定者、医疗专业人员、家庭和研究者提供了基于证据的建议，以创造促进青少年健康数字习惯和改善认知心理福祉的环境。

title: The Enforcement Gap: Why Africa's AI Regulations Need Runtime Enforcement

detail.title: The Enforcement Gap: Why Africa's AI Regulations Need Runtime Enforcement

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and maintainer of Comply54, an open-source AI governance framework discussed in this paper. The views expressed are the author's own, and no commercial entity influenced the research or its conclusions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work is a technical and conceptual study based on publicly available laws, regulations, technical documentation, and software implementations. It did not involve human participants or require institutional ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was independently conducted and self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: Africa is not facing an AI regulation gap; it is facing an AI enforcement gap. Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, and the African Union have all moved quickly on data protection, financial conduct, and AI-specific rules, with real enforcement to back them, including a $220 million penalty against Meta and a ₦766.2 million penalty against MultiChoice Nigeria. At the same time, AI agents are already approving loans, screening transactions, and accessing patient records at production scale, built on frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) with no built-in awareness of the jurisdiction they operate in. This paper argues that the resulting accountability gap is not a policy problem to be solved with more legislation, but an infrastructure problem, requiring a runtime enforcement layer that evaluates AI agent actions against jurisdiction-specific policy before execution. Drawing on firsthand experience translating Nigerian, Kenyan, and South African regulatory frameworks into machine-checkable policy, including a contribution merged into Microsoft's Agent Governance Toolkit that was outdated by a change in Nigerian law eight days later, the paper documents where legal requirements map cleanly onto code, where they don't, and what an operative runtime enforcement model looks like in practice. It closes with specific recommendations for developers, fintechs, and regulators, including the African Union's Continental AI Strategy Phase 2.

AI.tldr: 非洲不存在AI监管缺口，而是存在AI执法缺口。本文主张，AI代理问责缺口不是需要更多立法的政策问题，而是基础设施问题，需要在执行前对AI代理行为进行管辖区特定政策的运行时评估。基于第一手经验，本文记录了法律要求如何映射到代码、何处无法映射，并提出了运行时执行模型的具体建议。
AI.research_question: 非洲AI监管与执法之间是否存在缺口？如何通过技术基础设施解决AI代理的跨司法管辖区问责问题？
AI.motivation: 非洲多国已出台AI和数据保护法规并实际执行（如对Meta罚款2.2亿美元），但AI代理（如贷款审批、交易筛查）基于LangChain等无内置司法意识框架运行，造成问责真空。现有立法无法解决这一运行时合规问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 运行时执法层（Runtime Enforcement Layer）理论——将法律政策转化为机器可检查的规则，在AI代理执行动作前进行实时合规评估。
AI.method: 第一手经验：将尼日利亚、肯尼亚、南非的监管框架转化为机器可执行的策略代码；参与微软Agent治理工具包开发（贡献合并后8天即因尼日利亚法律变更而过时）。
AI.findings: 部分法律要求可以清晰映射到代码，部分无法映射；已有实际执法案例（Meta罚款2.2亿美元、MultiChoice Nigeria罚款7.662亿奈拉）；提出运行时执法模型的具体操作方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI问责问题从"政策缺口"重新定义为"基础设施缺口"；提出"运行时执法层"概念框架，填补了AI治理中法律与技术之间的操作性空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为开发者、金融科技公司和监管机构提供具体建议；为非洲联盟大陆AI战略第二阶段提供实操指导；证明法律政策变动频率远超技术实现更新速度，需建立动态合规机制。

title: Who Shares Data? Bounded Rationality and Strategic Disclosure in Data Markets *
affiliations: and

detail.title: Who Shares Data? Bounded Rationality and Strategic Disclosure in Data Markets *
detail.abstract: Privacy regulation relies on informed consent, delegating consumer protection to consumer choice. But the payoff to sharing depends on how firms use data and on who else shares, so disclosure is a strategic decision, and consumers differ in their ability to reason through it. This paper studies how bounded rationality changes the welfare consequences of transparency-based privacy regulation. We model data disclosure as a simultaneous strategic game in which a consumer’s payoff depends on both firm use of the data and the composition of the pool that agrees to share. We estimate a cognitive-hierarchy model using a data-sharing study fielded through the Dutch LISS panel, in which 3,598 respondents rated their trust in nine organizations and made a real decision whether to share their data with academic researchers. The estimates imply substantial heterogeneity in strategic sophistication: most consumers do not fully internalize the strategic consequences of disclosure, and beliefs about downstream data use differ sharply across organizations. We then evaluate a transparency policy that improves consumers’ understanding of disclosure and shifts the population toward higher cognitive sophistication. The policy generates a direct welfare gain for previously naive consumers by correcting their disclosure mistakes, but it also induces adverse selection in the disclosure pool, lowering realized payoffs through an equilibrium channel. This sorting creates a privacy externality whose extent is bounded by the cognitive distribution. Whether transparency increases average welfare, therefore, depends on the joint distribution of cognitive types and data values in the population.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了有限理性如何改变基于透明度的隐私监管的福利后果。通过认知层级模型和数据共享实验发现，大多数消费者无法完全内化披露的战略后果。提高认知水平的透明度政策虽能纠正错误，但会引发披露池的逆向选择，产生隐私外部性，最终福利效果取决于认知类型与数据价值的联合分布。
AI.research_question: 有限理性如何改变基于透明度的隐私监管的福利后果？
AI.motivation: 隐私监管依赖知情同意，将消费者保护委托给消费者选择。但共享的回报取决于企业如何使用数据以及谁在共享，因此披露是一个战略决策，而消费者在推理能力上存在差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知层级模型（Cognitive-hierarchy model）、战略博弈模型
AI.method: 通过荷兰LISS面板开展数据共享研究，3598名受访者对9个组织的信任程度进行评分，并做出是否与学术研究人员共享数据的真实决定。
AI.findings: 消费者在战略 sophistication 上存在显著异质性；大多数消费者无法完全内化披露的战略后果；对下游数据使用的信念在不同组织间存在显著差异。透明度政策虽能纠正 naive 消费者的披露错误带来直接福利收益，但也会通过均衡渠道引发披露池的逆向选择，产生隐私外部性，其程度受制于认知分布。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在有限理性条件下，基于透明度的隐私监管会产生均衡层面的福利权衡，即纠正个体错误与逆向选择带来的隐私外部性之间的张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估隐私监管政策的更精确框架：透明度政策是否提高平均福利，取决于认知类型与数据价值在人群中的联合分布，不能一概而论。

title: Deep Sequence Architectures in High-Frequency Finance: Benchmarking TimesNet and Classical Machine Learning Across Volatility Regimes
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Deep Sequence Architectures in High-Frequency Finance: Benchmarking TimesNet and Classical Machine Learning Across Volatility Regimes

keywords: Independent Quantitative Researcher Financial Time Series

detail.abstract: Forecasting high-frequency intraday financial time series is a notoriously challenging task due to extreme volatility, low signal-to-noise ratios, and persistent regime shifts. Traditional machine learning (ML) models, heavily reliant on manually engineered technical indicators, often treat historical observations as independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.), thereby failing to capture complex, non-linear temporal dependencies. While recurrent neural networks (RNNs) address sequential memory, they frequently struggle with long-range dependencies and multi-scale volatility clustering in financial data. This paper presents a comprehensive empirical evaluation of state-of-the-art deep sequence architectures-specifically TimesNet, PatchTST, and recurrent models (LSTM/GRU)-benchmarked against classical tree-based models (Random Forest, XGBoost). Using twelve years of 5-minute intraday data for the XAUUSD (Gold/USD) market (2013-2025), we evaluate predictive performance through a leakage-free, chronologically split pipeline. Our analysis indicates that reframing 1D financial time series into 2D tensors through multi-periodicity (the TimesNet approach) significantly enhances forecasting reliability. Under a three-class Triple-Barrier labeling scheme, TimesNet attained a predictive accuracy of 78.7%, consistently outperforming classical baselines (~35%). Rather than solely relying on standard classification metrics, we incorporate these forecasts into a risk-adjusted trading simulation. The outcomes illustrate the specific market conditions where deep temporal models thrive, highlighting their adaptability across changing volatility regimes and structural breaks compared to traditional feature-engineered methods.

AI.tldr: 本文对比了TimesNet、PatchTST、LSTM/GRU等深度时序模型与传统树模型（随机森林、XGBoost）在黄金5分钟高频数据上的预测表现，发现基于多周期2D张量重构的TimesNet在三类三柱标签方案下准确率达78.7%，远优于传统模型（约35%），并在风险调整交易模拟中展现出对波动率机制变化的强适应性。
AI.research_question: 深度时序架构（特别是基于多周期性的2D张量重构方法）是否能在高频金融时间序列预测中显著优于传统机器学习模型和经典循环神经网络？
AI.motivation: 高频金融数据存在极端波动、低信噪比和机制转换等挑战，传统ML模型依赖手工特征且假设i.i.d.，RNN虽能建模序列但难以捕捉长程依赖和多尺度波动率聚集，亟需评估更先进的深度时序架构在该场景下的表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多周期性时序建模（TimesNet将1D序列重构为2D张量）、Transformer补丁式时序处理（PatchTST）、循环神经网络长短期记忆（LSTM/GRU）、三重柱形标签法（Triple-Barrier labeling）
AI.method: 使用2013-2025年XAUUSD黄金5分钟高频数据，通过无数据泄露的时间顺序划分进行训练/测试；对比模型包括TimesNet、PatchTST、LSTM/GRU、随机森林、XGBoost；采用三类三重柱形标签方案进行预测，并基于预测结果构建风险调整交易模拟。
AI.findings: TimesNet在预测准确率上达到78.7%，远超传统基线模型（约35%）；深度时序模型在不同波动率机制和结构性断点下展现出较强的适应能力；将预测融入交易模拟后，能清晰识别出适合深度时序模型的市场条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了多周期性2D张量重构（TimesNet）在高频金融时序预测中的有效性，揭示了将序列建模从一维扩展到二维多周期视角的理论优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高频交易和量化投资者提供了深度时序模型选择的实证依据，展示了TimesNet在实际交易模拟中的风险调整表现，帮助识别不同市场条件下模型的有效性边界。

title: From Excellence to Viability Why Enduring Corporate Success Depends on Systemic Capabilities, Not on Time Horizons

detail.title: From Excellence to Viability Why Enduring Corporate Success Depends on Systemic Capabilities, Not on Time Horizons

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, financial, or institutional relationships that could have influenced, or could reasonably be perceived to have influenced, the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this conceptual working paper, as it does not involve human participants, patients, personal data, experiments, surveys, or clinical material.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The paper was prepared independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the limits of classical management studies on corporate excellence and enduring performance. It takes as its point of departure Peters and Waterman's In Search of Excellence and Collins and Porras' Built to Last. Peters and Waterman's book is publicly described as being based on a study of forty-three American companies and as presenting eight basic management principles associated with excellence. Collins and Porras' work is described by Stanford Graduate School of Business as drawing on a six-year research project in which eighteen exceptional and long-lasting companies were studied in direct comparison with leading competitors. 12 The central argument of this paper is that neither momentary excellence nor observed longevity is a sufficient proxy for strategic viability. Excellence describes superior performance in a given context. Endurance describes historical persistence over time. Viability, however, describes a firm's systemic capability to regenerate relevance, value creation, governability, and legitimacy when its relevant environment changes. The paper grounds this distinction in Christoph Ph. Schließmann's strategy work, especially "Die neue Dimension strategischen Denkens" and Das Konzept Interdependency: Chancen und Risiken systemischer Komplexität erkennen und steuern. Schließmann's Strategy Cube adds viability in the relevant system to market-based strategy analysis and thereby shifts the diagnostic focus from industry position and performance toward systemic life-capability. 67 Drawing on strategy theory, dynamic capabilities, organizational learning, resilience theory, business model research, and Schließmann's system-oriented approach, the paper develops Corporate Viability as a strategic category. Viability is conceptualized as a dynamic relation between agility, robustness, and complexity, and further specified through capabilities of strategically relevant market sensing, complexity processing, business-model evolution, ambidextrous learning, and strategic reflexivity. The paper's core thesis is that firms are not viable because they have lasted; rather, they last if they repeatedly mobilize viability-relevant capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了经典管理学中对"卓越"和"持久"的片面理解，提出"企业生存力"（Corporate Viability）作为战略分析的新范畴，论证企业不是因为持续存在而具有生存力，而是因为能够反复调动生存力相关能力才能持续存在。
AI.research_question: "卓越"（excellence）和"持久"（endurance）是否足以作为衡量企业战略可行性的代理指标？如何将"生存力"（viability）确立为一种独立的战略分析范畴？
AI.motivation: 经典管理学研究（如《追求卓越》《基业长青》）将企业卓越表现和历史持久性视为成功标志，但二者均不能反映企业在环境变化中系统性再生相关性、价值创造、可治理性和合法性的能力。本文试图超越这些局限性，引入生存力作为战略分析的新维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: Schließmann的"战略立方体"（Strategy Cube）框架、动态能力理论、组织学习、韧性理论、商业模式研究、系统导向方法。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念分析，基于对已有战略理论、动态能力、组织学习、韧性理论、商业模式研究的综合与整合，并结合Schließmann的系统导向方法进行理论推演。
AI.findings: 卓越和持久不能作为战略可行性的充分代理；生存力应被概念化为敏捷性、稳健性与复杂性之间的动态关系；生存力通过市场感知、复杂性处理、商业模式演化、双元学习、战略反思等能力来具体化；企业不是因为存在得久才具有生存力，而是因为反复调动生存力相关能力才能持续存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 明确区分了"卓越""持久"与"生存力"三个概念，将生存力确立为独立的战略范畴；2. 将Schließmann的战略立方体引入主流战略讨论，拓展了以市场定位和绩效为中心的传统战略分析；3. 提出生存力是敏捷性、稳健性与复杂性的动态关系，为战略管理提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了超越追求短期卓越和单纯历史延续性的战略思维，引导企业关注系统性生存能力，尤其是在环境变化时再生相关性、价值创造、可治理性和合法性的能力。

title: Internalizing the Public Good Production in Space Industry: An Unexpected Convergence

detail.title: Internalizing the Public Good Production in Space Industry: An Unexpected Convergence
detail.abstract: This working paper presents selected results of research applying the Public Goods Input Chain (PGIC) framework to the historical and crosscountry evolution of space exploration value chains. Two boundaries are considered in the space projects' lifecycle: one between private-goods production and their consequential transformation into perfect or imperfect public goods (PG-boundary), and another separating corporate-controlled and governance-controlled elements within the same value chain (CG-boundary). The crosscountry historical dynamics comparison demonstrates the convergence in PG-CG architectures, underscoring the need to strengthen the public strategic component of the institutional environment. The construction of a non-profit transnational corporation with a public ownership structure is suggested as a development of the elaborated approaches. The Working Paper presents the main directions and components, while in-depth explanations, detailed structural descriptions, and other necessary elements of a research article will be integrated to build a full-fledged research paper.

AI.tldr: 本文运用公共物品投入链（PGIC）框架，研究太空探索价值链的历史与跨国演变，分析了私人物品向公共物品的转化边界（PG边界）以及企业控制与治理控制之间的边界（CG边界），发现各国PG-CG架构趋同，建议加强制度环境的公共战略组成部分，并构建非营利性跨国公共所有制公司。
AI.research_question: 太空探索价值链在历史与跨国比较中如何演变？PG边界与CG边界如何影响太空项目生命周期的制度架构？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏从公共物品投入链视角系统分析太空探索价值链的跨国历史演化及其制度边界动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共物品投入链（PGIC）框架，涵盖私人物品向公共物品转化的PG边界，以及企业控制与治理控制之间的CG边界。
AI.method: 历史分析与跨国比较研究，基于PGIC框架对各国太空探索价值链的演化进行对比。
AI.findings: 各国在PG-CG架构上呈现趋同特征；需要加强制度环境中公共战略组成部分的强度；建议构建非营利性跨国公共所有制公司。
AI.theory_contributions: 将PGIC框架拓展到太空探索领域，提出PG-CG双边界分析范式，丰富了公共物品理论与价值链治理理论的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为太空探索领域的跨国合作与制度设计提供了政策建议，特别是加强公共战略成分以及构建非营利性跨国公共所有制组织的构想。

title: Proximity as a Substitute of Contract Enforcement in Specialized Trade
affiliations: and Tecnológico de Monterrey

detail.title: Proximity as a Substitute of Contract Enforcement in Specialized Trade
detail.abstract: We examine how geographic proximity substitutes for contractenforcement institutions in enabling trade in specialized goods. When products require customization, successful trade depends on either strong contract enforcement or close buyer-seller relationships enabling monitoring and trust. Proximity facilitates such relationships by reducing business travel costs. Our theoretical framework predicts institutional quality primarily affects specialized trade at longer distances, where relationship-building becomes prohibitively expensive. Using bilateral product-specific export data in a gravity model, we find strong empirical support for this prediction. Consistent with our theory, business travel and passenger flights decline more sharply with distance toward destinations with weak contract enforcement institutions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了地理距离如何替代合同执行制度，促进专业化商品的贸易。当产品需要定制时，成功的贸易依赖于强有力的合同执行或买卖双方之间的密切关系（便于监督和信任）。地理接近性通过降低商务旅行成本促进这种关系。理论预测制度质量主要影响长距离的专业化贸易，因为长距离下建立关系成本过高。通过双边产品层面的出口数据和引力模型，实证支持了这一预测。商务旅行和客运航班在前往合同执行制度较弱的目的地时，随距离下降更为显著。
AI.research_question: 地理距离如何替代（或弥补）合同执行制度的不足，以促进专业化（定制化）商品的贸易？
AI.motivation: 当产品需要定制化时，交易面临较高的合同不完全性风险。虽然正式制度（如合同执行）可以降低这种风险，但制度较弱的国家如何实现专业化贸易？作者提出地理接近性带来的密切关系（通过降低商务旅行成本促进监督和信任）可以作为一种替代机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 制度与贸易理论：合同执行质量影响贸易，尤其影响需要关系专用性投资的专业化商品。2. 地理距离与关系成本：地理接近性降低商务旅行成本，促进买卖双方建立密切关系（监督与信任），从而替代正式制度。3. 制度-距离交互效应：制度质量主要影响长距离的专业化贸易，短距离时关系可替代制度；距离越长，制度劣势越明显。
AI.method: 1. 引力模型：使用双边产品层面的出口数据，估计制度质量对贸易的影响如何随距离变化。2. 补充分析：检验商务旅行和客运航班数据，验证距离对制度较弱目的地的旅行流量下降更显著。
AI.findings: 1. 制度质量对专业化贸易的影响随距离增加而增强：长距离下，弱制度显著抑制贸易；短距离下，制度影响减弱（关系可替代）。2. 商务旅行和客运航班数据支持机制：前往制度较弱目的地的旅行流量随距离下降更显著，说明关系维护成本更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将地理距离视为正式制度的替代机制，丰富了制度与贸易的文献。2. 提出并验证了制度-距离交互效应，解释了为何制度较弱的国家仍能在近距离内实现专业化贸易。3. 明确了关系（信任与监督）作为中介机制，并利用商务旅行数据验证了这一机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策启示：制度较弱的国家可以优先发展与邻近市场的专业化贸易，利用地理接近性弥补制度不足。2. 企业启示：在制度环境较差的地区开展定制化交易时，应重视与买方的地理接近性，降低关系维护成本。3. 基础设施启示：改善交通连接（如航线）可促进制度较弱国家的贸易参与。

title: The Right Amount of Wrong: Error Injection for AI Oversight
affiliations: Harvard University - Harvard Medical School, GSK, GSK, GSK and Harvard Business School

detail.title: The Right Amount of Wrong: Error Injection for AI Oversight

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Greg Powell, Jeffery Painter, and Andrew Bate are employees of GSK. The study was conducted in collaboration with GSK. GSK did not provide funding for the study. The authors declare no other personal or financial relationships that may have or could be perceived to have influenced the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was reviewed and approved by the Harvard University Area Institutional Review Board under protocol IRB25-1200. All participants provided informed consent before participating in the study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research is partially supported by the HBS AI Associates Program. GSK did not provide funding for the study.

detail.abstract: Organizations increasingly use AI systems to generate draft outputs that are reviewed by humans before downstream use, particularly in high-stakes settings such as healthcare. As AI systems become more accurate, however, their errors become increasingly rare, making reviewers less vigilant while simultaneously making reviewer performance difficult for organizations to observe. We study whether intentionally inserting realistic errors into selected AI outputs before review, a practice we refer to as controlled error injection, can improve human oversight while creating observable opportunities to measure reviewer performance. We investigate this question through a preregistered, double-blind, 12-week randomized experiment in AI-assisted pharmacovigilance review. Seventeen Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) reviewers evaluated AI-generated summaries of adverse event reports under a control condition and three levels of error injection. We find that the effect of controlled error injection is nonmonotone. Relative to the control condition, low-frequency error injection reduced true-error detection by 6 percentage points, whereas high-frequency error injection increased true-error detection by 9 percentage points. False-positive detection did not differ significantly across conditions. Higher levels of error injection also increased review time and reduced trust in the AI system. Finally, reviewers who identified more injected errors were also more likely to identify naturally occurring AI-generated errors. These findings suggest that controlled error injection can improve oversight in AI-assisted workflows while simultaneously providing organizations with a practical signal of reviewer vigilance. At the same time, the effectiveness of the intervention depends critically on the frequency of injected errors. Low levels of error injection reduced true-error detection, whereas higher levels improved it, suggesting that organizations should carefully calibrate the prevalence of injected errors when deploying this intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一项在AI辅助药物警戒审核中开展的12周双盲随机实验，研究了在AI生成内容中人为注入可控错误对人工监督质量的影响。结果发现，低频率错误注入会降低真实错误检测率（下降6个百分点），而高频率错误注入则提升检测率（上升9个百分点），同时高注入水平也增加了审核时间并降低了信任度。识别注入错误的审核员也更擅长识别AI自然产生的错误。
AI.research_question: 在AI辅助工作流中，人为向AI生成输出中注入可控错误是否能够改善人类对AI输出的监督效果，同时为组织提供可观察的审核员绩效信号？
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统准确性提高，其错误变得罕见，导致审核员警惕性下降（"警惕性衰退"），同时组织难以观察审核员的表现。需要一种既能保持审核员警惕性、又能创造可测量绩效信号的干预手段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号检测理论（Signal Detection Theory）、警惕性衰退理论（Vigilance Decrement）、人机协同监督理论
AI.method: 预注册、双盲、12周随机实验。17名药学博士（PharmD）审核员在AI辅助药物警戒审核场景下，分别处于对照组和三种不同错误注入频率的实验组，评估AI生成的不良事件报告摘要。
AI.findings: （1）错误注入效果呈非单调性：低频率注入使真实错误检测率下降6个百分点，高频率注入使检测率上升9个百分点；（2）假阳性检测率在各组间无显著差异；（3）高频率错误注入增加审核时间并降低对AI系统的信任；（4）识别注入错误越多的审核员，也越能识别AI自然产生的错误。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了错误注入对人工监督的非单调影响机制，挑战了"越多错误越能提高警惕性"的简单假设；为信号检测理论在人机协同监督中的应用提供了实证证据；发现了注入错误与自然错误识别之间的正向关联，为错误注入作为监督能力代理指标提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了一种可操作的AI监督质量提升手段——可控错误注入，同时可将其作为审核员警惕性的可观测绩效信号；指出了关键的管理启示：错误注入频率需要精心校准，低频率注入反而适得其反；在高风险领域（如药物警戒、医疗诊断）的人机协同流程设计中有直接应用价值。

title: Contract Enforcement and International Trade: A New Look

detail.title: Contract Enforcement and International Trade: A New Look
detail.abstract: This paper reexamines the role of contract-enforcement institutions in international trade. The standard view is that countries with stronger domestic institutions specialize in contract-intensive sectors because weak enforcement discourages relationship-specific investment. I argue that this view is incomplete in an open economy: firms may source specific inputs from abroad, and contracting frictions may depend on the institutions of both the input supplier and the input buyer. I develop a multi-country model in which incomplete contracts generate an industry-specific bilateral cost wedge for relationshipspecific inputs. The model distinguishes two channels. First, contracting frictions raise the effective trade cost of specific inputs. Second, they raise production costs in sectors that rely heavily on those inputs. The model also implies that exporter and importer institutions are substitutes, and that access to foreign suppliers may partly mitigate weak domestic institutions. Using bilateral product-level trade data and measures of rule of law, I find evidence for both cost channels. Trade in specific inputs is increasing in the quality of contract enforcement in both origin and destination countries, and the marginal effect of one country's institutions is weaker when the other country's institutions are stronger. Domestic institutions also matter more in sectors that rely heavily on domestic specific inputs and in industries where know-how transfers are important. However, the direct evidence that access to foreign institutions offsets weak domestic institutions is limited. The results suggest that domestic institutions remain central to comparative advantage, but their effects operate through global input sourcing as well as domestic production.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了合同执行制度在国际贸易中的作用，指出标准观点忽略了企业可能从国外采购特定投入品，且合同摩擦取决于输入供应商和买方双方制度。作者构建多国模型区分两种成本渠道，并用双边产品级贸易数据验证了制度质量对特定投入品贸易的影响及制度间的替代关系。
AI.research_question: 合同执行制度如何通过两种成本渠道影响国际贸易中的特定投入品贸易？出口国和进口国的制度质量如何相互作用？
AI.motivation: 标准理论认为国内制度强的国家在合同密集型行业具有比较优势，但忽略了开放经济中企业可从国外采购投入品，且合同摩擦涉及买卖双方制度，因此需要重新审视制度对贸易的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全合同理论；多国贸易模型；比较优势理论
AI.method: 构建多国一般均衡模型，区分制度影响贸易的两种成本渠道；使用双边产品级贸易数据与法治指数进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 特定投入品贸易随出口国和进口国合同执行质量提高而增加；两国制度存在替代关系，一国制度效应在对方制度较弱时更强；国内制度在依赖国内特定投入品和知识转移重要的行业中作用更大；但国外制度缓解国内制度不足的直接证据有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出制度影响贸易的双渠道理论（贸易成本渠道+生产成本渠道）；2. 揭示进出口国制度间的替代关系；3. 将制度比较优势分析从封闭经济扩展到全球投入品采购框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为发展中国家通过改善法律制度促进特定投入品贸易提供依据；2. 提示政策制定者国内制度仍是比较优势的核心，但可通过参与全球供应链部分弥补制度短板。

title: Beyond Market Positioning

This may be perceived as an intellectual or professional interest. No financial relationship with any third party, organization, publisher, software provider or sponsor influenced the preparation, argumentation or conclusions of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a conceptual strategy and management paper. It does not involve patients, human research participants, personal data, clinical data, surveys, experiments or identifiable case-study participants. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The paper was prepared independently by the author.

keywords: Governance and Systemic Complexity Strategic Management

detail.abstract: Strategic management has traditionally assessed corporate strength through market position, competitive advantage, growth and profitability. These dimensions remain essential, but they are increasingly insufficient in environments shaped by technological acceleration, interdependence, regulatory shifts, platform dynamics, supply-chain fragility and systemic complexity. A firm may hold a strong market position and generate attractive financial performance while simultaneously losing its ability to remain viable in the system in which it actually operates. This conceptual paper develops systemic viability as a third dimension of strategic management. It integrates the Schließmann Strategy Cube and the Schließmann Viability Matrix into a theorybuilding framework for assessing corporate strategy under conditions of complexity. The Strategy Cube extends strategic positioning beyond relative market strength and market performance by adding viability in the relevant system. The Viability Matrix clarifies that complexity is not only a source of risk, but also a source of variety, recombination, innovation and strategic renewal, provided that an organization possesses sufficient agility and robustness to process and use it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"系统生存力"（systemic viability）作为战略管理的第三维度，超越传统的市场地位与财务绩效，通过Schließmann战略立方体与生存力矩阵，为企业应对复杂环境提供新的评估框架。
AI.research_question: 在技术加速、相互依存、监管变化、平台动态、供应链脆弱性和系统复杂性日益凸显的环境下，企业如何在传统市场地位和财务绩效之外，评估自身在真实运作系统中的持续生存能力？
AI.motivation: 传统战略管理仅关注市场地位、竞争优势、增长和盈利能力，但这些维度在复杂系统中已不足以判断企业的长期存续能力。一个企业可能市场表现优异，却正在丧失其在系统中的生存力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了Schließmann战略立方体（Strategy Cube）和Schließmann生存力矩阵（Viability Matrix），将战略定位从相对市场实力和市场绩效拓展至系统生存力维度；并将复杂性重新界定为不仅是风险来源，更是多样性、重组、创新和战略更新的来源。
AI.method: 概念性研究（conceptual paper），通过理论构建框架提出新的战略评估维度。
AI.findings: 提出了系统生存力作为战略管理的第三维度；战略立方体扩展了传统的二维战略定位；生存力矩阵揭示了复杂性在组织具备敏捷性和稳健性时，可转化为创新和战略更新的积极力量。
AI.theory_contributions: 在传统的市场地位与财务绩效二维战略评估基础上，增加了"系统生存力"这一第三维度，丰富了战略管理理论；重新定义了复杂性在战略管理中的角色，从纯粹的风险视角转向兼具机会视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了评估自身在复杂系统中长期生存能力的分析工具（战略立方体与生存力矩阵），帮助企业在追求市场表现的同时，注重系统层面的适应性与稳健性。

title: The Cost of Continuous-Time Illusions: Empirical Failures of the Avellaneda-Stoikov Model in Hawkes-Driven Limit Order Books
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Cost of Continuous-Time Illusions: Empirical Failures of the Avellaneda-Stoikov Model in Hawkes-Driven Limit Order Books
detail.abstract: The Avellaneda-Stoikov (A-S) framework (2008) remains a foundational pillar for algorithmic market making, providing elegant closed-form solutions for dynamic inventory management under liquidity constraints. However, its core tractability relies on two restrictive assumptions: independent Poisson order arrivals and continuous mid-price standard Brownian motion. This paper utilizes high-precision, live-fire execution data from a custom matching engine to empirically dismantle these assumptions. By applying Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) to tick-level trade logs, we demonstrate that aggressive order flow operates near criticality, characterized by a self-exciting Hawkes process with a branching ratio of α β = 0.9970. We leverage vectorized Maximum Adverse Excursion (MAE) and Maximum Favorable Excursion (MFE) analytics to quantify the exact financial penalty of assuming a memoryless market. Our findings prove that during order-flow clustering, the AS reservation price formula lags physical reality, structurally forcing market makers to quote directly into toxic adverse drift and capture severe tail-risk drawdowns.

AI.tldr: 本文利用高频实盘数据证明Avellaneda-Stoikov做市框架的核心假设（独立泊松订单流和布朗运动中间价）不成立，实际订单流具有自激发的临界性特征（分支比0.9970），导致AS模型在订单流聚集时报价滞后于市场现实，使做市商遭受毒性的逆向漂移和尾部风险回撤。
AI.research_question: Avellaneda-Stoikov算法做市框架的两大核心假设（独立泊松订单到达、连续标准布朗运动中价）在真实高频市场中是否成立？若不成立，其偏离对做市商实际损益有何量化影响？
AI.motivation: A-S框架因其简洁的闭式解在算法做市领域被广泛使用，但其可处理性依赖于对订单流特性的强假设。现有文献缺乏使用真实高频逐笔交易数据对这些假设进行直接检验和量化偏差的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: Avellaneda-Stoikov做市框架（动态库存管理下的最优报价策略）、Hawkes自激发过程（刻画订单流聚集与临界性）、最大不利偏移（MAE）与最大有利偏移（MFE）分析。
AI.method: 使用定制撮合引擎的高精度实盘执行数据；采用最大似然估计（MLE）对逐笔交易日志进行Hawkes过程拟合，计算分支比；运用向量化MAE/MFE分析量化定价偏差的财务影响。
AI.findings: （1）激进订单流接近临界状态，表现为自激发的Hawkes过程，分支比αβ=0.9970；（2）A-S框架假设的无记忆市场与真实市场的记忆性（订单流聚集）存在显著差异；（3）在订单流聚集期间，A-S保留价格公式滞后于物理现实，导致做市商报价直接面对毒性的逆向漂移，并承受严重的尾部风险回撤。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证推翻了A-S框架中独立泊松订单流和布朗运动中价两个核心假设，揭示了真实订单流具有自激发临界性特征，为算法做市理论从无记忆过程向具有记忆性的点过程模型演进提供了实证基础和量化证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 量化了在订单流聚集场景下继续使用A-S框架的财务代价（毒性的逆向漂移和尾部风险回撤），为做市商在实际交易中识别和规避模型风险提供了具体的分析工具（MAE/MFE）和方法论指导。

title: Price Cuts Without Savings: Moral Hazards in Volume-Based Centralized Procurement
affiliations: , Tongji University, Tongji University - Advanced Institute of Business, Tongji University and Tongji University

detail.title: Price Cuts Without Savings: Moral Hazards in Volume-Based Centralized Procurement
detail.abstract: Centralized procurement is designed to lower input prices by pooling demand across downstream providers. Whether these price reductions translate into lower spending for final users, however, is unclear when procurement covers only one component of a product bundle and does not fully specify the product's post-award quality. In this paper, we study this question in the context of China's National Volume-Based Procurement (NVBP) reform, a national government-run group purchasing program for pharmaceuticals. Using a difference-indifferences design, we analyze a unique patient-visit-level panel of outpatient visits from multiple hospitals in a Chinese province. We find that NVBP reduces patients' spending on the contracted core drugs by 10.1%, yet patients' total medical expenditure does not decline by a statistically or economically meaningful amount. We identify two channels that help explain this limited pass-through. First, providers expand the quantity of non-procured auxiliary prescriptions, consistent with downstream agents shifting toward the margins that remain outside the procurement contract and retain positive markups. Second, patients visit hospitals more frequently and experience more active adjustment of their core-drug regimens, with more core-drug items changed between consecutive visits and more items new to their prescription histories, consistent with an upstream quality response under price-and-volume auctions with limited post-award quality monitoring. We further show that savings concentrate among patients with low historical visit frequency and among those treated in non-tertiary hospitals located in the provincial capital. Taken together, our findings suggest that centralized procurement design should not focus on price reductions alone. When the buyer contracts on only part of a treatment bundle and is not the final user, realized savings depend on both upstream quality incentives and downstream substitution toward non-contracted margins.

AI.tldr: 本文研究中国国家集中带量采购（NVBP）改革对患者医疗总支出的影响，发现虽然核心药品价格下降10.1%，但患者总医疗支出并未显著减少，原因在于供应商增加非集采辅助处方、患者就诊频率上升及核心药品方案调整更频繁。
AI.research_question: 集中采购仅覆盖产品组合中的部分组件且未完全规定中标后质量时，价格降低是否会转化为最终用户的支出下降？
AI.motivation: 集中采购旨在通过汇总下游需求降低投入品价格，但当采购仅覆盖产品组合的一部分且未完全规定中标后质量时，价格降低能否传导至最终用户尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全契约理论、价格与数量拍卖中的质量激励、下游替代行为
AI.method: 双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences），使用中国某省份多家医院的门诊患者就诊层面面板数据
AI.findings: 1. NVBP使集采核心药品支出下降10.1%，但患者总医疗支出未显著下降；2. 两个传导渠道：下游供应商增加非集采辅助处方（替代至保留正加成的非合同边际），上游患者就诊更频繁、核心药品方案调整更活跃；3. 节省集中在历史就诊频率低的患者及省会城市非三级医院。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示集中采购设计中仅关注价格降低的局限性，阐明当买方仅对治疗组合的一部分进行采购且非最终用户时，实际节省取决于上游质量激励和下游向非合同边际的替代。
AI.practical_contributions: 为集中采购政策设计提供建议：不应仅关注价格降低，需考虑上游质量监控和下游替代行为对总支出的影响。
